title: feat: validate BFCL through native APIs and guard eval parity / 通过原生 API 验证 BFCL 并保障跨硬件评估一致性
body:
## Summary

Keep BFCL working through native APIs on supported backends, remove runtime framework-source patches, and validate AMD/NVIDIA evaluation coverage. TRT BFCL remains disabled while MiniMax B200/B300/GB200 moves to the official `1.3.0rc28.dev202609220000` nightly; vendor validators remain enabled and GPU qualification of the new image is pending. **Draft: selected suites pass across both vendors, but complete framework, offload, concurrency and multi-node parity remains unfinished.**

## Changes

- Remove TRT chat-schema/executor-metrics patches and both MiniMax vLLM CPU-offload patch callers plus their shared helper. Use native tool parsers; preserve separate Chat Completions and Responses identities. Do not rewrite requests or synthesize token usage.
- Add stock BFCL Responses smoke, exact selected-case manifests, failure artifacts and API provenance. Retain upstream Kimi's 20-step limit. Request budgets are 180 seconds for MiniMax/smoke and 600 seconds for full Kimi, with two SDK retries.
- Upgrade MiniMax B200/B300 vLLM to official `af1c0149`, containing native mixed-layout CPU-offload and MSA fixes. Use native FlashInfer draft attention on both SKUs. Correct CPU budget conversion from decimal GB to bytes; preserve the production grid.
- Update MiniMax B200/B300 TRT and GB200 Dynamo-TRT from `1.3.0rc23.post1` to official nightly `1.3.0rc28.dev202609220000`. Synchronize all seven GB200 recipes, use native `block_reuse_config.policy: per_conversation`, and remove the unsupported `fuse_qkv_index_projection` field. BFCL is disabled for `trt` and `dynamo-trt`, including explicit overrides: eval-only jobs skip before GPU allocation, and throughput jobs omit BFCL. Vendor validators stay enabled. Remove the experimental TRT nightly probe; runtime patches remain removed. The adapters and suites stay intact, and `utils/evals/EVALS.md` documents the small workflow/runtime guard removal needed to re-enable TRT after validating a stock image.
- Preserve main’s Kimi MI355X `nightly-rocm100-af1c0149` image, native `vllm-simple` production offload, ROCM_AITER_MLA draft attention and concurrency settings. Keep the branch’s native BFCL diagnostics and remove runtime dependency installation from the optional LMCache path. Historical LMCache and old-image BFCL failures do not establish results for this updated recipe.
- Add experimental resident Kimi B300 and MiniMax MI300X probes. Production MI300X remains unchanged because the replacement's LMCache arm is unvalidated.
- Add a native Kimi CPU-cache restoration check. Add a separate `bfcl_kimi_diagnostic` for `multiple_0`–`multiple_15`: temperature 0.001, 16 threads, 60-second request timeout, two retries, 600-second suite bound. Only this diagnostic enables native NaN counters and archives final metrics, including after failure. Full-suite sampling remains unchanged.
- Use the job token for public checkout/run statistics after shared credential failures. Merge current main while preserving every historical changelog byte.

## Historical TRT skip validation

On source `63e450258`: 129 eval-dispatch tests pass, including explicit TRT/Dynamo-TRT skips and continued vendor/non-TRT evaluation dispatch. Both reusable workflows pass actionlint; shell syntax, changelog generation and diff checks pass. The 22 generated TRT eval rows retain rc23.post1 and the full MiniMax vendor suite. [Workflow guard verification](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35392126380) passed: both explicit TRT BFCL jobs were skipped before GPU allocation, and the workflow completed successfully. This verifies skip behavior, not GPU evaluation or throughput.

## Verified BFCL coverage

All rows below completed every expected case with no integration error. The MiniMax vLLM rows use 8 BFCL threads and requested temperature 0.001. `c` identifies the serving recipe's concurrency. These are selected BFCL suites, not the complete leaderboard; zero thresholds establish diagnostic completion, not a quality acceptance baseline.

| Model / framework / SKU / recipe | Result | Run |
|---|---:|---|
| MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 / vLLM af1 / B200 / TP4 resident c1 | **898/1,000** | [35154685442](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35154685442) |
| MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 / vLLM af1 / B200 / TP4 native lazy CPU offload c15, corrected 1.082 TB budget | **895/1,000** | [35244609202](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35244609202) |
| MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 / vLLM af1 / B300 / TP4 native lazy CPU offload c30 | **898/1,000** | [35171313858](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35171313858) |
| MiniMax-M3-MXFP8 / vLLM v0.27.1 / H100 / TP8 c1, CPU weight offload, resident KV | **899/1,000** | [35173594641](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35173594641) |
| MiniMax-M3-MXFP8 / vLLM d910 / H200 / TP8 resident c1 | **895/1,000** | [35171252969](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35171252969) |
| MiniMax-M3-MXFP8 / vLLM af1 / MI300X / TP8 resident c2, experimental image | **899/1,000** | [35171259984](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35171259984) |
| MiniMax-M3-MXFP8 / vLLM v0.27.1 / MI325X / TP8 resident c1 | **892/1,000** | [35168911491](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35168911491) |
| MiniMax-M3-MXFP4 / vLLM 2a02 / MI355X / TP4 resident c4 | **877/1,000** | [35158177585](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35158177585) |
| MiniMax-M3 / ATOM / MI355X / TP4 resident c8 | **703/1,000** | [35031849044](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35031849044) |
| Kimi-K3 / vLLM ROCm100 af1 / MI355X / TP8 DCP1 resident c1, AITER DSpark7 | **1,039/1,240** | [35253995642](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35253995642) |
| Kimi-K3 / vLLM 3696c77 / B300 / TP8 DCP8 resident c8, DSpark7 | **1,042/1,240** | [35176168999](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35176168999) |
| Kimi-K3 / ATOM / MI355X / TP8 resident c4 | **1,038/1,240** | [35134517859](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35134517859) |

Kimi B300: 916/1,000 single-turn and 126/240 multi-turn; ATOM: 911/1,000 and 127/240. Both use 16 BFCL threads, temperature 0.001 and the stock 20-step limit. Checkpoint formats, images, backends and topologies differ; score differences are not hardware-only comparisons.

The updated AMD Kimi production recipe completed **1,240/1,240 unique records** matching the exact case manifest: **910/1,000 single-turn + 129/240 multi-turn = 1,039/1,240 (83.79%)**. Source `e2213f5c2`, official `nightly-rocm100-af1c0149`, TP8 DCP1 resident c1, native AITER DSpark7; server `max-num-seqs=2`, 16 BFCL threads. No recorded inference/integration failures, request-timeout or SDK-retry messages, server ERROR-level lines, tracebacks or OOM. Requested temperature 0.001 is clamped by the stock server to 0.01. Generation took **92m06s**; the GPU job including startup/cleanup took **99m44s**, excluding queue. There are **201 quality failures**; 881 per-turn decode messages are not 881 unique failed cases. This clears completion for the updated resident recipe, not native CPU offload or a hardware-only timing/quality comparison.

The new B200 offload run contains exactly 1,000 unique records with no inference/integration failures: simple 361/400, multiple 181/200, parallel 177/200, parallel-multiple 176/200. The stock server logged one MiniMax tool-parser exception; this is not an entirely error-free quality run. External-cache-hit logs stayed at zero, so this BFCL result alone does not prove CPU restoration.

Additional native evidence:

- [Kimi MI355X/vLLM bounded resident diagnostic](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35245047375): **12/16 correct**, all expected cases completed without integration errors; native corrupted-request counter was zero and no server error/OOM was logged. This short old-image diagnostic does not clear the earlier 1,240-case failure or establish its cause.
- [Kimi MI355X/vLLM TP8 DCP1 eager CPU offload c4](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35168097903): **4/4 smoke plus restoration check**. An 8,464-token prompt had zero cached tokens cold and 6,144 after clearing GPU cache; external-hit delta was also 6,144. Identical 32-token greedy output and finish reason. This validates one prefix, not all cache behavior.
- [MiniMax B200/vLLM TP4 lazy CPU offload c15](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35171307281): **4/4 smoke** with corrected 1.082 TB aggregate budget. Native served-model name is `/scratch/models/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4`; no checkpoint-hash equivalence claim.
- [MiniMax B300/vLLM TP4 lazy CPU offload c30 performance canary](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35173861054): 1,542 profiled completed requests, zero recorded request errors, **4,460,672 native external-cache-hit tokens**, and valid power telemetry on all four GPUs. Output throughput was 1,147.85 tok/s total (286.96/GPU). Limitation: harness teardown logged a grace-period timeout, one cancelled credit and remaining session-tree state. This 20-minute `agentx-fast` run proves native lazy CPU reads, but does not establish clean teardown, a performance gain, or official artifact-reuse eligibility.

## Failures and remaining blockers

- **Historical Kimi MI355X/vLLM full-suite failures:** both [resident](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35161687615) and [native eager CPU offload](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35171266818) hit the four-hour bound. Each saved 114 cases, including 112 request timeouts. Engines kept decoding without a logged crash/OOM. There is **no valid quality score**. An earlier identical resident recipe completed nearly the entire suite, so neither temperature nor offload alone is an established cause. The 16-case native-counter probe subsequently completed with 12 correct and zero recorded NaNs. The merged ROCm100/AITER resident recipe now completes all 1,240 cases as reported above. This verifies the updated recipe without establishing which earlier difference caused the failures; the full native CPU-offload path remains unvalidated.
- **TRT BFCL is intentionally excluded from this release.** The [official rc28 nightly experiment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35388550967) passed image import but failed during PyTorch compilation of a native MiniMax KV-cache call before BFCL started (0 cases). The current branch now pins official nightly `1.3.0rc28.dev202609220000`, whose GPU behavior remains unverified. The separate upstream source build passed four Responses smoke cases only with eager prefill and EAGLE3 disabled; that is not production EAGLE3 or full-suite qualification. No framework-source patch is added to force BFCL compatibility. Generic Responses adapter support is retained for other backends. Native performance-metrics behavior still requires fresh throughput validation.
- **Optional Kimi LMCache (historical failure; current main uses native `vllm-simple`):** [native failure](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35158175431) is `Unsupported kv_layout: none`, matching [upstream issue](https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache/issues/4870). The bundled revision lacks the upstream fix; published ROCm wheels target a different PyTorch ABI. DCP8 is unvalidated.
- **Kimi B300 Mooncake:** [no active RDMA rail](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35029701125) on two nodes. Resident B300 success does not validate Mooncake.

## Active validation

| Run | Scope / immutable source |
|---|---|
| [35244612071](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35244612071) | MiniMax B300 native offload c30, standard warmup and one-hour AgentX profile; `57ce9acdf`. |

Pending runs are not passing evidence. No production ingestion, PR merge or official sweep reuse is claimed.

## Local validation and follow-up

Main is merged through `b43fe5e10` in `905d1d624`. The latest sync resolved overlapping CI token changes by retaining main’s native job-token behavior and this branch’s BFCL suite options. The complete main changelog is preserved byte-for-byte, with the existing branch entry appended unchanged. Local CI selection: **1,804 passed, 2 skipped, 187 subtests passed**; changelog/matrix validation and diff checks passed. Actionlint passed with the pre-existing unsupported `$/` workflow-call syntax warning excluded. [GitHub CI](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35283217934), [Zizmor](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35283218010), changelog and reuse-gate all passed on `905d1d624`. The PR remains draft and mergeable. GPU results above retain their original immutable source revisions; the sync adds no Kimi/MiniMax recipe changes.

Remaining work: inspect active artifacts, validate other framework/concurrency/multi-node paths and changed production throughput against a matched baseline. Historical AMD vendor-result publication needs provenance review. Other SPEED-Bench/lm-eval/SWE-bench runtime modifications remain separate cleanup; the repository is not yet entirely patch-free.

Vendor coverage follow-up: [full Kimi and MiniMax vendor selection](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3226) is now merged into main and included here. Three live cells completed with quality misses; NVIDIA/Kimi remains queued. Vendor suites are separate from the BFCL results above.

Historical smoke interpretation: [the Kimi 1.0 result](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35157825655/job/105002096805) represents **one schema case × streaming/nonstreaming = 2/2 checks**, using required strict tool calling. Full vendor coverage is 204 unique cases / 408 checks. Current frontend source preserves `n_eff` in ingestion but drops counts in the chart projection/table. Display unique cases, check count and smoke/full identity without adding duplicate cases across retries. No frontend or production-data edits have been made.

## AI model disclosure

Codex assisted with the implementation, diagnostics, and branch synchronization. The exact underlying model/version is not exposed in the current runtime; the model versions of earlier delegated agents have not been verified.

## 概述与改动

保留 BFCL，通过原生 API 验证 AMD/NVIDIA 评估路径，移除框架运行时源码补丁。PR 保持草稿：两家硬件上的选定套件已经完成，但完整框架、offload、并发及多节点覆盖仍未完成。

- 删除 TRT 请求结构、执行器指标补丁，以及 MiniMax 两个 vLLM CPU offload 补丁调用和共享脚本；使用原生工具解析器，区分 Chat Completions 与 Responses，不改写请求或补造用量。
- 新增上游 Responses smoke、精确用例清单、失败产物及 API 来源信息；Kimi 保留上游 20 步限制。MiniMax/smoke 请求时限为 180 秒，完整 Kimi 为 600 秒，均最多两次 SDK 重试。
- MiniMax B200/B300 vLLM 升级官方 `af1c0149`，采用原生混合布局 CPU offload、MSA 修复及 FlashInfer 草稿 attention。CPU 预算按十进制 GB 换算为字节，正式扫描网格不变。
- MiniMax B200/B300 TRT 与 GB200 Dynamo-TRT 从 `1.3.0rc23.post1` 更新至官方 nightly `1.3.0rc28.dev202609220000`，同步全部七份 GB200 配方，使用原生 `block_reuse_config.policy: per_conversation`，移除已不支持的 `fuse_qkv_index_projection` 字段。新镜像的 GPU 验证尚未完成。`trt` 和 `dynamo-trt` 禁用 BFCL，包括显式覆盖：仅评估任务在分配 GPU 前跳过，吞吐量任务不执行 BFCL；厂商评估继续启用。移除 TRT nightly 实验配置，不恢复运行时补丁。现有适配器和套件完整保留；`utils/evals/EVALS.md` 说明原生镜像验证通过后，重新启用 TRT 时需移除的少量工作流和运行时分发限制。Kimi MI355X 保留 main 的 `nightly-rocm100-af1c0149` 镜像、正式配置中的原生 `vllm-simple` offload、ROCM_AITER_MLA 草稿 attention 及并发设置，同时保留本分支的原生 BFCL 诊断，并移除可选 LMCache 路径的运行时依赖安装。旧镜像和 LMCache 的历史失败不能代表此更新配置的结果。
- 新增 Kimi B300、MiniMax MI300X 实验配置；MI300X 正式配置暂未变更，其 LMCache 路径尚待验证。
- Kimi CPU smoke 加入原生缓存恢复检查。独立的 `bfcl_kimi_diagnostic` 选择 `multiple_0` 至 `multiple_15`，temperature 0.001、16 个线程、60 秒请求时限、两次重试、600 秒总时限；仅该诊断启用原生 NaN 计数，失败后也保存指标，完整套件的采样不变。
- 公共仓库检出和只读统计改用 GitHub 任务令牌；合入最新 main，完整保留历史性能日志字节。

### TRT 跳过行为的历史验证

源码 `63e450258` 的 129 项评估分发测试通过，覆盖 TRT/Dynamo-TRT 显式跳过 BFCL，以及厂商评估和其他后端 BFCL 继续执行。两个可复用工作流的 actionlint、Shell 语法、性能日志矩阵生成和差异检查通过。生成的 22 条 TRT 评估配置均保留 rc23.post1 与完整 MiniMax 厂商套件。[工作流跳过验证](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35392126380)通过：两条显式 TRT BFCL 任务均在分配 GPU 前跳过，工作流整体成功。这验证的是跳过行为，不是 GPU 评估或吞吐量。

## 已核验结果

上表各行全部预期用例均完成且无集成错误。七种 MiniMax vLLM SKU 的选定 1,000 用例结果分别为：B200 NVFP4 **898**、B300 NVFP4 原生 CPU offload **898**、H100 MXFP8 **899**、H200 MXFP8 **895**、MI300X MXFP8 **899**、MI325X MXFP8 **892**、MI355X MXFP4 **877**。这些 vLLM 套件使用 8 个 BFCL 线程、temperature 0.001，表中的 c 表示服务配方并发。MiniMax MI355X/ATOM 为 **703/1,000**。

新增 B200 原生 lazy CPU offload c15 结果为 **895/1,000**，已修正为 1.082 TB 总预算。原始产物包含 1,000 条唯一记录，无请求/集成失败；四类分别为 361/400、181/200、177/200、176/200。原生服务器记录了一次工具解析异常，因此不能称为完全无错误的质量验证。外部缓存命中日志为零，该 BFCL 运行本身不证明 CPU 缓存恢复。Kimi MI355X 的旧镜像 16 用例原生计数诊断完成，**12/16 正确**、无集成错误、NaN 计数为零，服务器未记录崩溃/OOM；该小规模诊断不能证明完整套件已修复。

更新后的 AMD Kimi 正式配方已完成 **1,240/1,240 条唯一记录**，与用例清单逐项一致：**单轮 910/1,000，多轮 129/240，合计 1,039/1,240（83.79%）**。源码为 `e2213f5c2`，官方 `nightly-rocm100-af1c0149` 镜像，TP8 DCP1 驻留 c1、原生 AITER DSpark7，服务器 `max-num-seqs=2`，16 个 BFCL 线程。未记录推理或集成失败、请求超时、SDK 重试、服务器 ERROR 级日志、异常堆栈或 OOM。请求 temperature 0.001 被原生服务器调整至 0.01。生成耗时 **92 分 06 秒**，GPU 任务含启动和清理为 **99 分 44 秒**，均不含排队。仍有 **201 个质量未通过用例**；881 条逐轮解码提示不等于 881 个独立失败用例。本结果只验证更新后的驻留配方，不证明原生 CPU offload 完整覆盖，也不能将耗时或分数差异单独归因于硬件。

Kimi B300/vLLM TP8 DCP8 驻留 c8 为 **1,042/1,240**（单轮 916/1,000，多轮 126/240）；MI355X/ATOM TP8 c4 为 **1,038/1,240**（单轮 911/1,000，多轮 127/240）。均使用 16 个 BFCL 线程、temperature 0.001 和上游 20 步限制。模型格式、镜像、后端和拓扑不同，不能将差异单独归因于硬件。选定套件不是整个 BFCL；零阈值用于诊断完成，不代表质量基线验收。

Kimi MI355X 原生 eager CPU offload c4 的 4/4 smoke 和一个前缀恢复检查通过：8,464 个输入 token，冷请求缓存为零，清空 GPU 缓存后命中 6,144 token，外部命中增量相同，32-token 贪心输出与终止原因一致。B200 原生 lazy CPU offload c15 在修正为 1.082 TB 总预算后 4/4 smoke 通过；服务使用本地模型路径，未验证 checkpoint 哈希等价性。

B300 20 分钟性能 canary 完成 1,542 个测量请求，记录中无请求错误，原生 CPU 缓存命中 **4,460,672 token**，四个 GPU 的功耗遥测均有效，总输出吞吐量 **1,147.85 tok/s（286.96/GPU）**。但 harness 收尾出现宽限期超时、一个取消的 credit 和剩余会话树状态，因此只能证明原生 lazy CPU 读取已实际发生，不能宣称收尾完全正常、性能提升或正式产物可复用。

## 失败与活跃验证

历史 Kimi MI355X/vLLM 驻留和原生 CPU offload 的完整套件均触及四小时上限，各保存 114 条记录，其中 112 条请求超时。引擎仍在解码，未记录崩溃/OOM，**没有有效质量分数**。此前相同驻留配方几乎完成全部用例，因此尚不能归因于 temperature 或 offload；16 用例诊断随后完成且 NaN 计数为零。合并后的 ROCm100/AITER 驻留配方现已完成全部 1,240 个用例，结果见上文；这证明新配方可完成评估，但尚未定位旧配方失败的具体原因，原生 CPU offload 完整路径仍待验证。

本次发布明确排除 TRT BFCL。官方 rc28 nightly 实验通过镜像导入，但在 PyTorch 编译原生 MiniMax KV-cache 调用时失败，BFCL 尚未启动（0 个用例）。当前分支改用官方 nightly `1.3.0rc28.dev202609220000`，该镜像的 GPU 行为仍待验证。独立的上游源码构建仅在 eager 预填充且关闭 EAGLE3 时通过四用例 Responses smoke，不能证明正式 EAGLE3 配方或完整套件已通过；不通过框架源码补丁强行兼容 BFCL。通用 Responses 适配器保留供其他后端使用。移除指标补丁后的原生性能行为仍需重新验证。可选 Kimi LMCache 的历史失败来自不兼容 API，已发布外部 ROCm wheel 的 PyTorch ABI 不匹配，DCP8 未验证；当前 main 正式配置已使用原生 `vllm-simple`。B300 Mooncake 在两个节点没有活动 RDMA rail，驻留路径通过不能替代此项验证。相关失败与上游源码链接见英文部分。

活跃任务：35244612071 为 B300 标准预热、一小时性能验证，源码为 `57ce9acdf`。运行中不代表通过，未合并 PR、导入生产数据或宣称正式扫描复用。

## 验证与后续

title: [TileRT] GLM-5.3 FP8 MI355X PD-disaggregated AgentX recipe on tilert 0.1.6.post1 layer-sharded PD buffers / 基于 tilert 0.1.6.post1 按层分片 PD 缓冲的 GLM-5.3 FP8 MI355X PD 分离 AgentX 配方
body:
> **Alternative to [#3330](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3330), same recipe, same author (@CrimsonDump).** #3330 keeps GLM-5.3's two 99.06 GiB TileRT PD buffers in pinned host memory through a 5-file engine patch plus waiver. This PR tests the other route: **`tilert==0.1.6.post1`** (PyPI, 2026-09-22) keeps both buffers on the GPU but **shards them by layer across the eight devices**, so no patch, no waiver and no `TILERT_PD_BUFFER_DEVICE` knob. Branch = #3330's head `992c9c0a1` + [CrimsonDump/InferenceX@56a1e5a](https://github.com/CrimsonDump/InferenceX/commit/56a1e5a59b8e9d58724096f26be2b7f72fea1f36) + cleanup/eval commits and a merge of `main`, all authored by @CrimsonDump. #3330 is left untouched; exactly one of the two should merge.
>
> **Status:** one sweep with `full-sweep-fail-fast` + `all-evals`: AgentX throughput plus one eval-only GSM8K job (details under *Sweep plan*). **Depends on [InferenceX-app#1202](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/pull/1202) being deployed first**, exactly as #3330 does (the site has no `glm5.3` DB key yet).
> <details><summary>中文</summary>
>
> 本 PR 是 [#3330](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3330) 的替代方案，配方与作者（@CrimsonDump）相同。#3330 通过一个 5 文件引擎补丁加豁免，把 GLM-5.3 的两个 99.06 GiB TileRT PD 缓冲放进锁页主机内存；本 PR 测试另一条路：**`tilert==0.1.6.post1`**（PyPI，2026-09-22）把两个缓冲留在 GPU 上、**按层分片到 8 张卡**，因此不需要补丁、豁免和 `TILERT_PD_BUFFER_DEVICE`。分支 = #3330 的 head `992c9c0a1` + CrimsonDump/InferenceX@56a1e5a + 清理/评测提交及合入 `main`，作者均为 @CrimsonDump。#3330 保持原样；两者只应合入其一。一次 sweep 同时跑吞吐与评测（`full-sweep-fail-fast` + `all-evals`）。同样依赖 InferenceX-app#1202 先部署。
>
> </details>

## Description

Same GLM-5.3 FP8 MI355X prefill/decode-disaggregated TileRT recipe as #3330 (upstream vLLM ROCm prefill + TileRT `decode_server` + `pd_router`, KV over mooncake, bf16 MLA wire layout, full 1048576-token context, 1 prefill node TP8 + 1 decode node TP8, AgentX at conc 1). What differs:

**1. `tilert==0.1.6.post1` instead of `0.1.6` + patch** ([af42b1d](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/commit/af42b1d75), cherry-pick of CrimsonDump/InferenceX@56a1e5a). Verified against the two PyPI wheels, not the release notes: post1 changes `tilert/pd_vllm/{transport,receive_server,prefill_connector,pd_router}.py` and `profiles/{base,mla_nsa}.py`. Both PD buffers become `nshards = min(TILERT_PD_SHARDS or 8, device_count)` per-device tensors of `ceil(num_layers/nshards)` layers (layer `lid` on shard `lid % nshards`), each registered with mooncake on its own device; `hello_layout` carries per-shard bases and `rdma_plan` writes layer by layer into the matching remote shard, so the KV path stays device-to-device. The `glm5_2` profile has 79 layers, so the heaviest shard holds 10: 99.06 GiB × 10/79 = **12.54 GiB per card** instead of 99.06 GiB on one. `pd_router.py` also replaces its fixed 600 s request timeouts with `TILERT_PD_HTTP_TIMEOUT_S` (default 3600), hence the router metadata bump to `0.1.6.post1`.

**2. The PD-DRAM patch, `docs/waiver/3330.md` and `TILERT_PD_BUFFER_DEVICE` are removed** ([93ca00c](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/commit/93ca00c34)): from the recipe, `server_tilert.sh` (validation, `--pd-buffer-device`, the connector's `tilert_pd_buffer_device` key), `job.slurm`, `setup_deps.sh` (patch application, the 0.1.6 pin guard, the `patch` apt package). Nothing inside either image is modified any more, so this PR needs **no engine-patch waiver and no `engine-patch` label**. Recipe comments and the `GPU_MEM_UTIL=0.85` derivation are reworded for the sharded layout.

**3. Evals actually run on this stack** ([9c2e6f7](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/commit/9c2e6f775)). `server_tilert.sh` sent every agentic job to the trace replay regardless of `EVAL_ONLY`/`RUN_EVAL`, and never exported `PORT`, which `run_lm_eval` requires. Agentic `EVAL_ONLY` jobs now run GSM8K on the same router, `RUN_EVAL` after a replay runs it once the replay finishes, and artifact staging mirrors `server_sglang.sh`. Simulated acceptance is already disabled under `RUN_EVAL`/`EVAL_ONLY`, so evals use real MTP verification.

**4. AgentX only.** The fixed-sequence config, its recipe and the fixed-sequence bench loop in `server_tilert.sh` are removed; the launcher now rejects anything but agentic-coding. `EVAL_ONLY` waits for the router and runs GSM8K; otherwise the AgentX replay runs and `RUN_EVAL` follows it. Changelog entries that named both keys now name `glm5.3-fp8-mi355x-tilert-agentic` only.

**Sweep plan.** The default eval subset excludes this config (`MIN_EVAL_CONC = 16` in `infx/matrix/generate.py`; TileRT decode is bs=1 so `conc-list: [1]`), so the PR carries `all-evals` next to `full-sweep-fail-fast`. With that label the planner emits the `multi_node.agentic` throughput row plus a `multinode_agentic_evals` row (conc 1, eval-only): throughput is only suppressed by `evals-only` or an entry-level flag (`plan.py`, `suppress_throughput`). So one sweep runs AgentX and one GSM8K job (`sweep-multi-node-agentic-evals`).

**Unchanged from #3330 and still open there and here:** the provisional golden-AL curve (GLM-5.2's, copied, labelled `PROVISIONAL`), framework ordering (TileRT-only GLM-5.3 on AMD, precedent NVIDIA `glm5.1`), and the InferenceX-app dependency.

## AI model disclosure

- **Original recipe (#3328/#3330 history):** `claude-opus-5[1m]` (Claude Opus 5, 1M context) via Claude Code; follow-up commits there `claude-opus-5[1m]` through `fb663fa26`, `claude-fable-5-1[1m]` (Claude Fable 5.1) from `432e65111`; `GPT 6 Astra` via Perplexity Computer for the `RDMAV_FORK_SAFE=1` port and the unfiltered-trace commit `67630b3bc`. All carried over unchanged.
- **[af42b1d](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/commit/af42b1d75)** is @CrimsonDump's commit cherry-picked as-is; its commit message does not state the tooling used, and none is claimed here.
- **This PR's assembly, [93ca00c](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/commit/93ca00c34), [9c2e6f7](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/commit/9c2e6f775), the changelog/MODELS commit and this description:** `claude-fable-5-1[1m]` (Claude Fable 5.1, 1M context) via Claude Code, operated by @Oseltamivir. **Role:** downloaded both wheels from PyPI and diffed them, read the sweep/eval generator and the eval helpers in `benchmark_lib.sh` to find the two eval gaps, removed the patch plumbing, and wrote the commit messages and this text. Numbers quoted here are either read from the wheel sources (layer counts, shard arithmetic, timeouts) or attributed to @CrimsonDump's MI350X run below; nothing on MI355X has been measured yet for this branch.

**@CrimsonDump, 2x8 MI350X, `--max-model-len 1048576`, bf16 wire layout, `tilert==0.1.6.post1` (from the [56a1e5a](https://github.com/CrimsonDump/InferenceX/commit/56a1e5a59b8e9d58724096f26be2b7f72fea1f36) commit message):**

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 改动说明

与 #3330 相同的 GLM-5.3 FP8 MI355X PD 分离 TileRT 配方（上游 vLLM ROCm prefill + TileRT `decode_server` + `pd_router`，KV 走 mooncake，bf16 MLA 布局，完整 1048576 上下文，1 个 prefill 节点 TP8 + 1 个 decode 节点 TP8，AgentX 并发 1）。不同之处：

**1. 用 `tilert==0.1.6.post1` 取代 `0.1.6` + 补丁**（af42b1d，cherry-pick 自 CrimsonDump/InferenceX@56a1e5a）。依据 PyPI 两个 wheel 的实际差异核对：post1 改动 `tilert/pd_vllm/{transport,receive_server,prefill_connector,pd_router}.py` 与 `profiles/{base,mla_nsa}.py`。两个 PD 缓冲改为 `nshards = min(TILERT_PD_SHARDS 或 8, device_count)` 个逐卡张量，每个含 `ceil(num_layers/nshards)` 层（第 `lid` 层落在第 `lid % nshards` 个分片），各自在所在卡上向 mooncake 注册；`hello_layout` 携带各分片基址，`rdma_plan` 逐层写入对应远端分片，KV 通路保持设备到设备。`glm5_2` profile 共 79 层，最重分片含 10 层：99.06 GiB × 10/79 = **每卡 12.54 GiB**。`pd_router.py` 同时把固定 600 秒的请求超时改为 `TILERT_PD_HTTP_TIMEOUT_S`（默认 3600），router 元数据随之升至 `0.1.6.post1`。

**2. 移除 PD-DRAM 补丁、`docs/waiver/3330.md` 与 `TILERT_PD_BUFFER_DEVICE`**（93ca00c）：涉及配方、`server_tilert.sh`、`job.slurm`、`setup_deps.sh`。两侧镜像内不再有任何改动，因此本 PR **不需要引擎补丁豁免，也不需要 `engine-patch` 标签**。

**3. 评测在此栈上真正可运行**（9c2e6f7）。`server_tilert.sh` 此前无视 `EVAL_ONLY`/`RUN_EVAL` 把所有 agentic 作业送去回放，也未导出 `run_lm_eval` 所需的 `PORT`。现在 agentic `EVAL_ONLY` 作业在同一 router 上跑 GSM8K，`RUN_EVAL` 在回放结束后运行，产物暂存对齐 `server_sglang.sh`；`RUN_EVAL`/`EVAL_ONLY` 下已关闭模拟接受，评测使用真实 MTP 验证。

**4. 仅保留 AgentX。** 移除固定序列配置、其配方与 `server_tilert.sh` 中的固定序列压测循环；启动脚本现在只接受 agentic-coding。`EVAL_ONLY` 等待 router 就绪后跑 GSM8K，否则运行 AgentX 回放，`RUN_EVAL` 在其后执行。原先同时列出两个键的变更记录现在只列 `glm5.3-fp8-mi355x-tilert-agentic`。

**Sweep 计划**：默认评测子集不含此配置（`MIN_EVAL_CONC = 16`，而 TileRT decode 为 bs=1、`conc-list: [1]`），因此本 PR 在 `full-sweep-fail-fast` 之外加了 `all-evals`。带该标签时规划器给出 `multi_node.agentic` 吞吐行与 `multinode_agentic_evals`（并发 1，eval-only）：只有 `evals-only` 或条目级标志才会抑制吞吐（`plan.py` 的 `suppress_throughput`）。因此一次 sweep 即跑 AgentX 与一个 GSM8K 作业。

**与 #3330 相同且仍待处理**：临时的黄金接受率曲线（抄自 GLM-5.2，已标 `PROVISIONAL`）、框架顺序（AMD 上 GLM-5.3 仅 TileRT，先例为 NVIDIA `glm5.1`）、InferenceX-app 依赖。

title: [TileRT] GLM-5.3 MI355X AgentX parallel KV inject experiments, reverted pending tile-ai/TileRT#66 / GLM-5.3 MI355X AgentX 并行 KV 注入实验（已回退，待 tile-ai/TileRT#66）
body:
> **Status: reverted to the unpatched recipe; parked until TileRT ships the fix.** This branch's tree is now identical to [#3366](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3366)'s head `a0caa02b9` (the unpatched `tilert==0.1.6.post1` AgentX recipe; its AgentX path is the one that produced sweep [35741321941](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35741321941)). No engine patch, no waiver. The experiment history is kept in the commits below.
>
> **Next:** the parallel KV inject goes upstream as [tile-ai/TileRT#66](https://github.com/tile-ai/TileRT/pull/66). Once a TileRT release carries it, this PR bumps `TILERT_VERSION` and re-runs AgentX unpatched, which also re-checks the no-engine-patch rule.

## What the experiments measured (MI355X, GLM-5.3 FP8, AgentX, conc 1)

| run | change on top of #3366 | TTFT p50 / p90 | E2E p50 / p90 |
|---|---|---|---|
| #3366, sweep 35741321941 | none | 5.76 / 8.09 s | 7.79 / 17.69 s |
| v1, sweep 35812357318 (cancelled after 29 requests) | parallel inject + byte-exact prefix reuse | inject 778 ms p50 at 361k tokens (vs ~3.8 s) | n/a |
| v2, sweep 35817675288 | parallel inject + byte-exact reuse, per cache | 3.20 / 5.31 s | 5.69 / 15.26 s |
| v3, sweep 35827481885 | parallel inject + tolerance-based reuse | 2.72 / 5.05 s | 5.34 / 15.60 s |
| v3 + no `--enforce-eager`, sweep 35836899099 | as v3, compiled vLLM prefill | same as v3 on the first 184 requests | same |

- **Parallel inject** (one stream per device pair instead of serial default-stream copies) cut the decode `inject` copy from 10.5 to 1.78 µs/token. It accounts for nearly all of the TTFT gain; this is what goes upstream.
- **Prefix reuse** did not pay off: bit-identical reuse held on only 25 of 246 turns (vLLM recomputes part of the prefix each turn, so layers 1-78 differ), and the tolerance version accepted KV differing by 0.25-0.36 relative L2 error, too large to call rounding without an eval. Dropped.
- **Removing `--enforce-eager`** on the vLLM prefill left TTFT unchanged (2.08 vs 2.18 s p50 over the same 184 requests). Dropped.
- What remains of TTFT after the parallel inject is prefill-side (1.8 s p50 / 4.4 s p90 residual) plus the 0.4 s KV send; E2E p90 is dominated by ~10 s of decode.

## AI model disclosure

- **Recipe and #3366 history:** as disclosed on #3366; carried over unchanged, including @CrimsonDump's commits `e3d79eea9` and `a0caa02b9`.
- **This PR's experiments, the revert, tile-ai/TileRT#66 and this description:** `claude-opus-5-5[1m]` (Claude Opus 5.5, 1M context) via Claude Code, operated by @Oseltamivir; the initial TTFT breakdown used `claude-fable-5-1[1m]`. **Role:** read the post1 wheel sources, wrote and iterated the patches, analysed the decode `REQSTAT` logs and AIPerf exports, and wrote the text.

## Checklist

title: [MI355X][SGLang][AgentX] Improve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash performance
body:
The current ROCm nightly sends V4.1 through a V4 backend that expects compression ratios 4/128; V4.1 requires 1/2. This PR adds a model-specific source backport from the official preview and a DSpark AgentX configuration for MI355X, retaining official nightly binaries.

- **Image and source:** pinned `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.20-rocm10-mi35x-20260922@sha256:f35d19d2e826f72c8fdfa3e1b3b29e7ecbaed691c688ff644370f5640990ae23`, SGLang `0.5.20.dev20260922+g598e43ba96`, ROCm 10.0.0. Isolated attention code comes from official preview digest `c609f74f01b206af9664fb66da8ebef47642a7328a2478eabeebb352e014661a`; provenance records original/adapted hashes. Only HIP `deepseek_v41` dispatch changes. This is a patched nightly, not stock-nightly qualification or a preview binary substitution.
- **Settings:** TP4/EP4, C1/2/4/8/16/32, GPU Engram/KV, memory fraction 0.60, 2048-token prefill, prefill graphs disabled, `expandable_segments:False` for ROCm10 AITER IPC compatibility. Based on the [official cookbook](https://lmsysorg.mintlify.app/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4_1) and #3245 long-context safeguards.
- **Runtime correction and evidence:** nightly enables a HIP fused kernel that always normalizes Q heads, while V4.1 sets `q_head_norm=False`. The official preview excludes this model from the fused path. These V4.1 recipes disable the existing optimization; provenance records exact source hashes. On the September 21 ROCm 7.2.4 image, stock DSpark then answered the same 52/719/2,159-token prompts correctly (`42`, with 19/23/23 generated tokens); before correction, both longer cases repeated for 384 tokens. The prompt asks “Janet has 19 apples and buys 23 more”; the longer variants prepend 80/240 inventory items and instruct the model to ignore them. This is bounded runtime evidence, not a graded accuracy result.
- **Completed accuracy:** [Canonical cache-disabled C1 GSM8K](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35692060546) passed all 1,319 examples, strict 97.1948%, flexible 97.1190%. [Experimental cache-enabled C1 GSM8K](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35696438420) passed all 1,319, strict 97.3465%, flexible 97.2707%. Both use real verification and no sample limit on the pinned September 22 image. Earlier direct C4 checks also passed; official results supersede those limited workflow claims.
- **Performance and failure diagnosis:** [20-minute C1/C32 feedback run](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35692082249) completed cache-disabled C1 at 1,713.40 logical tokens/s/GPU and p90 interactivity 106.68, 24 scored requests and no request errors; C32 failed before scoring. The [cache-enabled C1 feedback run](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35696436210) failed after 34 scored requests. In both failures, the first device callback was `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_OUT_OF_RESOURCES`, `Available Free mem : 0 MB`, in `ncclDevKernel_Generic_1`; later Engram scalar/collective teardown stacks are asynchronous observations, not proof of a separate root cause. Native-allocator reservation starving external HIP allocations is a hypothesis, not established causality. Existing GPU metric artifacts lack HBM allocated/reserved measurements.
- **ROCm10 compatibility evidence:** [Recorded before/after results](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/76ecec868bf88386b577ec964d7d610799089c89/benchmarks/patches/sglang_dsv41_rocm/evidence-rocm10.json) show generic HIP lookup selecting incompatible `.so.5` while PyTorch uses SDK `.so.7`; binding the already-loaded runtime passes exact shared/per-rank gathers. Stock FlashMLA byte offsets overflow above 2 GiB; V4.1-only pool routing to the [upstream #40351](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40351) int64 fix passes nine boundary cases in eager mode and graph replay, with original other-model behavior retained. AITER graph-buffer IPC export aborts with expandable segments; changing only the allocator to `False` passed full target/DSpark startup and real prompts (52/719/2,159 input; 19/23/25 output tokens, all answering 42). These checks establish bounded serving compatibility, not graded accuracy, long-context memory safety under load, or performance.
- **Cache/allocator diagnostic:** the isolated cache-enabled branch passed accuracy but failed AgentX stability. A [threshold-only test](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35740085711) was canceled before profiling after source inspection proved GC also requires a per-process limit below 1.0. The [corrected C1/C32 test](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35761467763), at `e92b363eedd094cd4ad979e0c70f44ed62ba6e59`, uses supported native-allocator GC 0.8 plus limit 0.99; same TP4/EP4, static pool 0.60, chunk 2,048, old pinned image and shipped precision. Both model profiles completed without request errors (C1: 90 requests; C32: 237), but both failed required power validation: idle `N/A` readings and missing end bracketing. Their raw exports are diagnostic only: C1 4,068.06 logical tokens/s/GPU at p90 interactivity119.28; C32 4,646.08 at75.17. These are 20-minute fast-feedback profiles, not qualified canonical frontier points. This is an isolated hypothesis test, not a selected improvement.
- **Latest image and topology coverage:** Docker Hub rebuilt the September 22 tag at 14:49 UTC with digest `6d71b69744074b26a02fd6267223227ca7399c540e0c1a73db10fe422a2ca405`, SGLang `244db08d60` and AITER `acf8fdf9`. All six installer source hashes still match; the actual image retains PyTorch `2.11.0+rocm10.0.0`, git `c9ab269`. Final qualification must use this rebuild. The [new full TP4/EP1 C1 GSM8K test](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35776039712) passed all 1,319 examples at experimental `bd19af96c777b0ae57d85901d46b1819fa55fb4c`: strict 97.3465%, flexible 97.2707%, with no sample limit and stock DSpark precision. The prior dispatch35763136403 reached server readiness but rejected a nonempty `EVAL_SUITE` before scoring; the corrected dispatch omits both suite and limit. A direct Neon staging query confirms the published vLLM baseline is TP4/EP1 at C1–32 (latest September 13). The current PR's TP4/EP4 matrix therefore does not match expert partitioning. The newer canceled workflow 35574132719 also explored TP2/EP1 and TP4/EP1 through C128, with host Engram at TP2 and GPU Engram at TP4; those are supplementary comparisons, with incomplete/erroring results at some points, not published baseline coverage. The experiment prepares those EP1 topologies using default kernel lookup. A bounded direct TP4/EP1 probe on the rebuilt image completed target/draft graph capture with about 111 GiB free per GPU and answered three real prompts correctly (52/719/2,159 input tokens; 19/26/26 output tokens, final answer 42, no length truncation). Actual PyTorch reported allocator fraction 0.99 on all four GPUs. The normal Slurm job 45520 on `mia1-p01-g16` completed successfully and shut down cleanly; this is startup evidence, not full accuracy or AgentX qualification. Latest TP4/EP1 C1 full accuracy is now qualified. [Canonical C1/C32 performance](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35786731860) completed at that commit: C1 passed with 2,456.91 total tokens/s/GPU, p90 interactivity 119.50, 185 scored requests and 97.20% TTFT / 100% ITL duration coverage. C32 served 831 requests without request errors but failed the unchanged 95% coverage gate (TTFT 93.24%, ITL 93.32%). Logs show the last decode at 00:33:22 followed by uninterrupted 2,048-token prefills through 00:37:54 with 37 live requests; prompt processing advanced, but decoding starved. C32 is not a qualified frontier point. The isolated supported `--prefill-decode-interval 16` change at `561f94d5863d6549468ac00a5e6947b31a6763ec` is now in a [canonical C32 retry](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35816891989) and [full C32 GSM8K](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35816893672), with memory, cache, image, precision and measurement protocol unchanged. The final TP4/EP1 C1/2/4/8/16/32 grid is prepared (six throughput plus six full eval jobs); selection and that full sweep remain pending. The canonical PR recipe is unchanged.
- **Power producer diagnosis:** a controlled pipe test inside the actual ROCm image reproduced `mawk` input buffering despite output `fflush()`. The isolated [collector repair](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/commit/f752648211f2bcdd8c09a4a29115441382e181a9) reads telemetry line by line; six monitor tests pass and the actual-image probe emits immediately while retaining invalid rows. It changes no model/configuration/compatibility code. Idle `N/A` handling remains unresolved under current strict validation; existing independent PowerX [#3316](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3316) and [#3055](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3055) address unreadable readings and collector shutdown. Those PRs were not changed or merged. The user explicitly made power optional for these SGLang PRs. Performance now uses supported `require-power=false`; invalid telemetry remains labelled invalid/unavailable, shared validation is unchanged, and no power claims are made. The collector repair is not bundled into the qualified-runtime performance tests, and these PowerX changes no longer gate progress.
- **Stock DSpark defaults:** no custom draft precision patch is included. Framework-shipped quantization and reference load-time behavior are retained; the stock draft loader and Markov settings remain unchanged. DSpark throughput uses the committed measured thinking-on AL 3.51; real evals clear synthetic acceptance. DSpark is the performance configuration across the whole concurrency curve. The provisional STP recipe has been removed; STP was used only to isolate the shared target correctness bug.
- **Patch review:** [waiver request](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/perf/mi355x-dsv41-sglang-nightly-20260921/docs/waiver/3343.md) records exact scope/hashes, upstream SGLang #39857 and AITER #5562 tracking, and removal criteria. Reviewer approval and Engram-specific upstream tracking remain pending; no priority waiver is applied.
- **Qualification incomplete:** `full-sweep-enabled` remains unset during full-accuracy and performance tuning. Final qualification requires restoring it and passing real throughput plus all evals on the final commit, with power optional per user direction. As soon as the official full sweep is completely green, deduplicate and post `/stage-results <run_id>` on this PR, then verify the staging acknowledgement. Native-allocator long-prefill fragmentation remains an explicit performance-validation risk. Published vLLM reference: TP4 C32, 40,919.40 logical tokens/s/GPU at p90 interactivity 46.90 (run 34710937012 attempt 2). No measured SGLang improvement or green full sweep is claimed. [Progress thread](https://semianalysis.slack.com/archives/C09PULGMVNG/p1790016465874519).

## AI model disclosure

- `gpt-6-astra`, high reasoning: MI355X recipe, image/native-precision audit, isolated backend adaptation, benchmark operation, and PR preparation.
- Coordinator: exact runtime model identifier was unavailable and could not be verified.
- Starting recipe adapted from #3245; that PR identifies Claude Code but does not expose a verifiable exact model identifier.

title: refactor: migrate fixed-sequence recipes to SRT-Slurm / 将定长配方迁移至 SRT-Slurm
body:
Converts all 50 active Slurm single-node fixed-sequence configs to native SRT recipes: 35 SGLang, eight TRT-LLM, and seven ATOM, covering all 407 existing points. This includes DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen3.5 on H100/H200/B200/B300 and MI300X/MI325X/MI355X. Models, images, concurrency ranges, topology, and serving settings are preserved. Every converted entry exists in current main's active master configs; the deprecation cleanup in #3349 is included. The two Docker-only RTX PRO 6000 fixed-sequence configs are now retired into the existing NVIDIA archive, with original settings and scripts preserved.

Fixed-sequence jobs in the eleven Slurm pools now require an SRT recipe. There is no fallback to the former single-node Bash implementation; the 50 replaced scripts are removed. Active single-node fixed-sequence coverage is SRT-only: the two RTX Docker configs and their scripts are archived, and their unused runner mappings, launcher, and runtime settings are removed. There is no active fixed-sequence Bash/Docker fallback. Changelog planning preserves entries naming archived configs without scheduling them; unknown keys and retired append-only selections still fail. AgentX, existing multi-node paths, and explicitly selected SPEED-Bench collectors retain their current execution paths. AgentX migration will be a separate PR.

Recipes own serving and workload settings; pool profiles own scheduling, mounts, model locations, and image caches. The connector selects exactly one native variant, validates it against the matrix, and applies runtime inputs. Submission, allocation state, cancellation, result/power staging, and native provenance are checked explicitly. Native eval dispatch uses the existing InferenceX eval implementation and propagates eval or staging failures.

Concurrency-dependent settings use **existing upstream SRT `zip_override_*` support**. Lists within a group pair by index and override `base`; they are not a Cartesian product. For example, [DeepSeek-R1 H200 TRT MTP](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/codex/single-node-srt-slurm/benchmarks/single_node/srt-slurm-recipes/dsr1/trtllm/h200-fp8-mtp/8k1k.yaml) uses MTP3 without DP attention at c4–32, then MTP1 with DP attention at c64–256, with corresponding batch/token budgets. [Qwen3.5 H200 SGLang](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/codex/single-node-srt-slurm/benchmarks/single_node/srt-slurm-recipes/qwen3.5/sglang/h200-fp8/8k1k.yaml) varies CUDA graph batch size with concurrency. InferenceX selects the indexed variant matching the job's concurrency and topology.

[srt-slurm #26](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm/pull/26) is on hold and is not a dependency of this migration. TRT recipes use the existing native `extra_args` support to pass `--served_model_name`, with matching `engine.served_model_name` metadata for clients. The SRT submodule now points to our fork at `c29ef7c`, including the existing AMD → MoRI → ATOM stack (#1, #11, #7) and [draft #27](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm/pull/27) for direct ATOM serving. Those dependencies remain unmerged and need review; #27 is stacked on #7. The goal remains returning to upstream once these capabilities land.

Validation:
- Local CPU suite at `8f3f0d551` after retiring the remaining Docker configs and fixing archived changelog selection: 1,991 passed, 1 skipped, and 187 subtests passed. Ruff, Bash syntax, changelog validation, and historical changelog byte preservation passed.
- All 407 points passed native schema, topology, submission selection, and expanded legacy/native command comparisons. Eval-only generation also passed for all 407 points. These checks do not establish hardware qualification.
- [Qwen3.5 H200 c4](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35736626607), runtime `a88a27a7cdf04d9f7b9e87492e6abdeadd38fc2c`: 40/40 requests, 432.42 output tokens/s, about -0.2% versus the matching published baseline.
- [Qwen3.5 H200 c16](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35739227935), same runtime: 160/160 requests, 1002.34 output tokens/s, about +0.6% versus the matching published baseline. Both runs use SGLang `v0.5.14-cu130`, FP8, TP8/EP8, 8k1k, and pass required eight-GPU power validation.
- [Qwen3.5 H200 c64](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35742866583), runtime `2763e8d002efd1786d7c52e30c73410c0d0803c2`: 640/640 requests, 1741.50 output tokens/s, about -1.5% versus the matching published baseline. Required eight-GPU power validation passed (maximum gap 1.183 s); Slurm completed with `0:0`, and result collection succeeded.
- [DeepSeek-R1 H200 c4](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35668029363), runtime `348f773eb6fba29cdb4216d41240cff122a4522e`: 40/40 requests, 344.78 output tokens/s, about -0.04% versus the matching published baseline; required power validation passed.

- [DeepSeek-R1 TRT MTP H200 c4](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35767925416), runtime `b4724b08bb1488105ff6fba32a46ad37470d6417`, SRT `2ac4eb1367dd2a78f597a72ca91afe4211d76b38`: FP8, TRT-LLM `1.3.0rc14`, TP8/EP8, MTP3, 8k1k, concurrency 4. Native E2E **passed**: 40/40 measured requests, 416.27 output tokens/s, correct served model name, eight-GPU power validation, result collection, and allocation cleanup. This exercises the existing recipe `extra_args` path without #26. A sequential [legacy control](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35770002471) at main `7e257acec661842d9b7f5651f92b4c29ea162fd7` completed 40/40 requests at 414.86 output tokens/s with identical input/output token totals: native throughput was +0.34%. The control workflow **failed result discovery**; its raw JSON was later included in the power-audit artifact. Offline validation of the unmodified telemetry in the verified cluster UTC timezone passed for all eight GPUs. That recovery does not change the failed workflow conclusion. This is one point on different H200 nodes, not full performance or accuracy qualification. Both allocations are released.

- [DeepSeek-R1 TRT MTP H200 c64](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35775383667), runtime `b4724b08`, SRT `2ac4eb1`: FP8, TRT-LLM `1.3.0rc14`, TP8/EP8 with DP attention, MTP1, 8k1k, 640/640 measured requests, 1622.04 output tokens/s. E2E, eight-GPU power validation, result collection, and cleanup passed. This verifies the higher-concurrency recipe variant; no fresh c64 control has been completed.

- [Qwen3.5 H200 eval integration](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35745079469), runtime `a67435c0f8d2cb2e2d0c61c829ca4197a1368e64`: SGLang `v0.5.14-cu130`, FP8, TP8/EP8, concurrency 4, GSM8K first 16 samples. All requests completed; strict and flexible exact match were 0.9375 (15/16). The workflow score gate **failed** against Qwen's 0.94 threshold. Native eval receipt was `0`, metadata/artifacts staged, and Slurm completed `0:0`. This proves the exercised execution/artifact path, not accuracy qualification; the limited-sample failure remains visible and the threshold is unchanged.

- [MI300X Qwen3.5 c4 startup check](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35780546041), runtime `571fa51b3`, SRT `c29ef7c`: FP8, SGLang `v0.5.12-rocm720-mi30x`, TP8/EP1, 8k1k. The allocation failed before server startup because the cluster preamble ended with a newline before the native `&&` join; **zero measured requests**. The allocation was released. Commit `0bd3bf5f7` fixes both affected AMD preambles and adds controller-based terminal verification for pools without working accounting; native shell execution and negative status cases passed locally. The [hardware retry](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35784091482) at `8e279188e` reached server readiness but failed before benchmark requests because `pip --user` is incompatible with the ROCm image virtual environment. Commit `c430090a8` removes the forced user-site install. The [AMD c4 hardware retry](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35792554061) at `6f60a8bf2`, SRT `c29ef7c`, **passed E2E**: 40/40 measured requests, 238.58 output tokens/s versus 241.17 in the matching 2026-05-17 InferenceX API baseline (**-1.07%**). Mean TTFT was 1.0813 s versus 0.9888 s (**+9.35%**); mean TPOT was 15.227 ms versus 15.143 ms (**+0.56%**). Required power passed on exactly eight GPUs (maximum sample gap 2 s); artifacts were collected and Slurm completed `0:0`, with the allocation released. This historical comparison does not establish latency parity or accuracy qualification.

- [DeepSeek-R1 B200 SGLang MTP c1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35788829575), runtime `c430090a8`, SRT `c29ef7c`: FP4, SGLang `v0.5.16-cu130`, TP4/EP1, 8k1k. **10/10 requests completed**, 297.44 output tokens/s versus 296.69 in the matching InferenceX API baseline dated 2026-08-06 (**+0.25%**); mean TTFT -3.59%, mean TPOT -0.02%. Slurm completed `0:0` and released the allocation. The workflow **failed required power validation** because the exclusive eight-GPU allocation exposed eight devices to the client instead of four; this is measured throughput evidence, not a green smoke. Commit `6f60a8bf2` limits native server/client steps to the validated serving GPU count while retaining node exclusivity. [The verification run](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35790840643) at `6f60a8bf2` **passed E2E**: 10/10 requests, 297.74 output tokens/s (**+0.36%** against the same API baseline), mean TTFT -3.79%, mean TPOT -0.11%. Power validation observed exactly four GPUs (maximum sample gap 1.071 s), artifacts were collected, and Slurm completed `0:0` with its allocation released. The five-recipe, 16-point representative batch is paced one allocation at a time. H200 c4 has now passed, completing initial low-concurrency coverage for all five recipes. The [B200 Qwen TRT-MTP c4 run](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35795174666) completed all three TP2/TP4/TP8 variants serially with required power validation. MI355X ATOM c4 now passes required power and cleanup after the sampler fix, as detailed below. The [H200 c4 smoke](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35807018306) passed at `77961ed42` with required power and no evals. MI300X c16 has since passed, as detailed below. H200 c64 has also passed, including its DP attention/MTP1 settings, as detailed below. B200 c32 has also passed with exactly four power-valid GPUs, as detailed below. H200 c256 and MI300X c64 have also passed, completing both recipes’ selected low/medium/high points. B200 SGLang c256 has now passed as well, completing its selected c1/c32/c256 points. B200 Qwen TRT c128 has also passed. MI355X ATOM c32 and c256 have now passed, completing the selected batch at 16/16. The final MI355X ATOM c256 point has passed. All 16 selected points across five recipes are complete: 11,290/11,290 measured requests, required power validation and cleanup passed, and all task-owned allocations are released. The batch always ran at most one task-owned GPU allocation. These no-eval smokes do not qualify all 50 converted configs or establish full performance or accuracy parity. The Qwen TP8 c4 historical delta remains unresolved: current exact CLI selection expands all three TP variants and rejects their shared experiment name as ambiguous, so no three-variant rerun was dispatched for a single follow-up point.

- [Qwen3.5 B200 TRT-MTP c4, TP2](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35795174666/job/106972849136), runtime `6f60a8bf2`, SRT `c29ef7c`: FP4, TRT-LLM `1.3.0rc18`, TP2/EP1, DP attention off, 8k1k. The benchmark job **passed** with 40/40 measured requests and 770.39 output tokens/s versus 769.23 in the matching 2026-06-24 API baseline (**+0.15%**). Mean TTFT +2.80%; mean TPOT -0.68%. Required power passed on exactly two GPUs (maximum sample gap 1.040 s); Slurm `16906` completed `0:0` and released its allocation. TP4 and TP8 also passed as recorded below; the full three-variant workflow completed successfully. No accuracy eval was requested.

- [Qwen3.5 B200 TRT-MTP c4, TP8](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35795174666/job/106972849169), runtime `6f60a8bf2`, SRT `c29ef7c`: FP4, TRT-LLM `1.3.0rc18`, TP8/EP8, DP attention off, 8k1k. The benchmark job **passed** with 40/40 measured requests and 1042.85 output tokens/s versus 1081.62 in the matching 2026-06-24 API baseline (**-3.58%**). Mean TTFT +3.55%; mean TPOT +2.17%. Required power passed on eight GPUs (maximum sample gap 1.001 s); Slurm `16907` completed `0:0` and released its allocation before TP4 started. This throughput decrease is flagged for a fresh comparison; a single historical-baseline smoke cannot identify its cause or establish performance parity.

- [Qwen3.5 B200 TRT-MTP c4, TP4](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35795174666/job/106972849182), runtime `6f60a8bf2`, SRT `c29ef7c`: FP4, TRT-LLM `1.3.0rc18`, TP4/EP4, DP attention off, 8k1k. **40/40 requests passed**, 942.20 output tokens/s versus 917.70 in the matching 2026-06-24 API baseline (**+2.67%**); mean TTFT -6.64%, mean TPOT -1.68%. Required power passed on exactly four GPUs (maximum sample gap 1.001 s); Slurm `16908` completed `0:0` and released its allocation. All three c4 TP variants and result collection finished successfully.

- [MI355X DSR1 ATOM-MTP c4 startup failure](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35799232293), runtime `b3a5a7f39`, SRT `c29ef7c`: FP4, ATOM `rocm7.2.3_ubuntu24.04_py3.12_pytorch_release_2.10.0_atom20260511`, TP8/EP1, 8k1k. Python 3.12 raised `IndexError` in `importlib.cache_from_source` while importing a PyTorch generated module from `/` with `PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX` enabled. **Zero benchmark requests; no throughput or accuracy result.** Slurm `45548` failed `1:0` and released its allocation. The same import-path failure was reproduced locally. Commit `161aa243a` restores the legacy container working-directory behavior through native `srun_options.container-workdir=/infmax-workspace`, using the existing repository mount and preserving caller overrides. All 69 focused CPU tests, native command generation, Ruff and changelog validation passed. The retry at `838607d8a` completed 40/40 requests, confirming the startup fix; its separate power-validation failure is recorded below.

- [MI355X DSR1 ATOM-MTP c4 measurement](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35800411078), runtime `838607d8a`, SRT `c29ef7c`: FP4, TP8/EP1, DP attention off, 8k1k. **40/40 requests completed**, 611.90 output tokens/s versus 605.22 in the matching 2026-05-20 API baseline (**+1.10%**); mean TTFT -2.56%, mean TPOT -0.35%. Slurm `45549` completed `0:0` and released its allocation. The workflow **failed required power validation**: all eight GPUs were observed, but CSV samples stopped 3.68–4.68 s before the benchmark ended (`benchmark_window_not_bracketed`). This is measured throughput, not a green smoke or accuracy qualification. The existing CSV filter was reproduced buffering live pipe input with `mawk` despite `fflush()`. Commit `dd955705c` replaces it with a shared Bash line reader, preserving validation and benchmark settings. All 237 focused CPU tests, a Linux streaming check, Ruff, shell syntax and append-only changelog validation passed. [The c4 verification run](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35802940526) at `dd955705c` **passed E2E**: 40/40 requests, **610.71 output tokens/s (+0.91%)** against the same May 20 API baseline; mean TTFT -0.36%, mean TPOT -1.39%. Required power passed on all eight GPUs with a maximum sample gap of 2 s. Slurm `45550` completed `0:0` and released its allocation. No accuracy eval was requested. That MI355X allocation and the subsequent H200 c4 allocation are released.

H200 exact selection exposed stale single-digit entries in `configs/runners.yaml`: `_7` matched no registered `_07` runner. Commit `77961ed42` aligns both H200 labels with all 14 live registered two-digit names. Eight runner-filter CPU tests, exact one-point generation and append-only changelog validation passed. Benchmark settings are unchanged.

- [H200 DSR1 TRT-MTP c4, current fork pin](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35807018306), runtime `77961ed42`, SRT `c29ef7c`: FP8, TRT-LLM `1.3.0rc14`, TP8/EP8, DP attention off, MTP3, 8k1k. **E2E passed**, 40/40 requests, **413.62 output tokens/s** versus 413.01 in the matching 2026-05-18 API baseline (**+0.15%**); mean TTFT -1.97%, mean TPOT -0.36%. Required power passed on all eight GPUs (maximum sample gap 1.164 s); source revisions and artifacts were verified. Slurm `88762` completed `0:0` and released its allocation. No accuracy eval was requested.

- [MI300X Qwen3.5 SGLang c16](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35808254223), runtime `77961ed42`, SRT `c29ef7c`: FP8, SGLang `v0.5.12-rocm720-mi30x`, TP8/EP1, DP attention off, no speculation, 8k1k. **E2E passed**, 160/160 measured requests, **650.52 output tokens/s** versus 652.14 in the matching 2026-05-17 API baseline (**-0.25%**); mean TTFT +0.89%, mean TPOT +0.21%. Required power passed on all eight GPUs (maximum sample gap 2 s). Source revisions and artifacts were verified. title: [GB300][SGLang][AgentX] Improve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash performance
body:
Improve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash AgentX on GB300 using the latest official SGLang nightly and shipped-default DSpark precision across the full TP2/TP4 concurrency curve.

- Pin `nightly-dev-cu13-20260922-582389ce` to manifest `sha256:0e1b14e302619a42ef5581b87db6804651d4f946301cf543d74a3a1eb1c33b40` (reverified September 22).
- Keep TP4 Engram tables on GPU and TP2 tables in the upstream per-rank host layout. Preserve native 1M context, every trace and child session, GPU-resident KV, automatic backends and five-token DSpark.
- Retain memory fraction 0.80, request/graph cap 64 and prefill/decode interval 16. From C2 onward, reserve `min(64*CONC, 4096)` SWA tails; C1 keeps the default.
- Select prefill chunk 8,192 only for TP2 C64/C128. TP2 C32 and all other points retain 4,096. No untested combination with the cap-128 or memory-0.85 candidates.
- Throughput uses the committed golden acceptance policy; full GSM8K uses real verification and no sample limit. No draft precision patches or STP entries.

## Completed selection evidence

| TP2/C64 candidate | Total tok/s/GPU | p90 interactivity | p90 TTFT |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Sep22 chunk 4,096 / cap 64 | 90,885.06 | 84.42 | — |
| Chunk 8,192 / cap 64 | 142,565.09 | 66.63 | 17.01 s |
| Chunk 4,096 / cap 128 | 89,800.62 | 84.62 | 49.88 s |

The [chunk candidate](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35685096648) completed canonical qualification in ordinary Slurm job 33800: **56.86% higher throughput / 21.06% lower interactivity** than the Sep22 baseline, 7,859 responses, zero errors, five canonical cutoff cancellations, full eligible latency coverage and valid power. Its [full GSM8K](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35685098460) passed all 1,319 samples at **97.19% strict accuracy** in job 33801. Host hugepage variation limits causal attribution.

The independently [tested cap-128 candidate](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35692561363) completed job 33816 with 4,885 responses, zero errors, 40 cutoff cancellations, complete latency coverage and valid power. Its full GSM8K passed 97.42% / 1,319 in job 33817. It is not selected. Harness configuration matches the chunk comparison except for the allocated localhost serving/metrics ports.

At TP2/C128, the matched [memory-0.80 baseline](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35687852448) and [memory-0.85 candidate](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35687831050) completed jobs 33805/33806 successfully. Throughput was 6,945.94 versus 6,758.79 tok/s/GPU; interactivity 130.69 versus 130.25. Both had ~16.24% prefix hit rates and 254/253 cutoff cancellations. Raising memory did not fix this poor high-concurrency behavior, so retain 0.80. **C128 with chunk 8,192 is not yet qualified** and must pass the final sweep.

These ordinary Slurm results are supplemental; their managed E2E jobs remain queued. The [previous Sep21 full sweep](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35662253021) is fully green and has been requested for staging, but it does not qualify the latest selected recipe.

## Final qualification

Selected head: `e88de2322e79e6969fc9fc8b796d54b606f0c937`. The [latest full sweep](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35740060326) runs **16 canonical performance points plus 16 full GSM8K evaluations**, TP2/TP4 at C1–C128, with global `full-sweep-enabled` and `all-evals`.

Main was synchronized while preserving unrelated config blocks and historical changelog bytes; exactly one PR-added entry remains. Bash syntax, diff checks, strict committed changelog validation and actual matrix generation pass. Keep the PR ready and do not merge. Request staging for this new run only after it is terminal green.

## AI model disclosure

`gpt-6-astra`, high reasoning: hardware recipe implementation, experiment selection, validation and integration. Coordinator: runtime investigation and dispatch; its exact runtime model identifier could not be verified.

title: [AMD][AgentX] Add DeepSeek-V4-Pro FP4 ATOM PD-disagg AgentX hicache MTP on MI355X / 在 MI355X 上添加 DeepSeek-V4-Pro FP4 ATOM PD 分离式 AgentX hicache MTP recipe
body:
## Summary

Add the ATOM **PD-disaggregated** agentic arm for DeepSeek-V4-Pro FP4 on MI355X — `dsv4-fp4-mi355x-atom-disagg-agentic-hicache-mtp` — the ATOM counterpart to the existing `dsv4-fp4-mi355x-sglang-disagg-agentic-hicache-mtp` arm, so the two engines are directly comparable on the AgentX trace workload. Modeled on ATOM's `recipes/DeepSeek-V4-Agentic-PD-Max.md` (TP / DP-attention / DP+CPU-offload tiers).

Most atom-disagg plumbing already exists (proven by the non-agentic `dsv4-fp4-mi355x-atom-disagg` arm): `server.sh` dispatches `atom-disagg` → `server_atom.sh`, `job.slurm` routes atom-disagg + resolves the `<model>-AgentX` recipe, and `launch_mi355x-amds.sh` already builds `dsv4_fp4_mi355x_atom-disagg.sh` under `multi_node/agentic/`. This PR fills the agentic gaps.

## Recipe / search space

1P1D TP8, `atomesh` PD router, `mooncake` RDMA KV transfer, image `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609140614`:
- **TP** (EP1): conc `1, 2, 8, 16`, no offload
- **DP-attention** (EP8, dp-attn): conc `64, 128`, no offload
- **DP-attention + CPU offload** (EP8, dp-attn): conc `256`, `lmcache_offload` DRAM tier (`multi` connector, `max_pending_saves=8`, `slot_sidecar_staging_slots=4`, LRU, 256-token chunks)

Per recipe: prefix caching on, FP8 KV/index cache, block-size 256, TBO on prefill only, MTP (`--method mtp --num-speculative-tokens 3`) with synthetic acceptance length 2.49 on throughput runs, dp-sticky `idx2idx` routing on the DP tiers, `max-num-seqs = 2×concurrency`.

## Changes

- **`configs/amd-master.yaml`** — new config key.
- **`benchmarks/multi_node/agentic/dsv4_fp4_mi355x_atom-disagg.sh`** (new) — agentic launcher (sibling of the sglang-disagg one).
- **`benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/models_atom.yaml`** — new `DeepSeek-V4-Pro-AgentX` entry.
- **`benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/server_atom.sh`** — `IS_AGENTIC` branch (prefix caching, `max-num-seqs=2×conc`, `lmcache_offload` multi-connector on the offload tier, dp-sticky/idx2idx router, synthetic `--spec-decode-acceptance-length`, `trace_replay.sh` client). The throughput path is unchanged.
- **`perf-changelog.yaml`** — changelog entry (pr-link updated to this PR).

## Validation

- Matrix `test-config` expands into the expected 7 rows (TP conc 1/2/8/16, DP conc 64/128, offload conc 256 with `kv-offloading=dram`/`lmcache`, node-count 2, `DECODE_MTP_SIZE=3`).
- `bash -n` on the new launcher and edited `server_atom.sh`; offload connector JSON validated and round-trips through `eval`.
- `utils/matrix_logic` + `utils/changelog_gate_tests` suites pass (374 tests); full `amd-master.yaml` validates.
- Full MI355X e2e sweep (`--no-evals`) is the real gate — **not yet run**.

## Notes / assumptions (verify on first bring-up)

- `mem_frac_static 0.9` with no `LD_PRELOAD` dma-buf shim assumes MI355X-amds RDMA memory registration works (the recipe's shim + lower-fraction caveats are Crusoe-cluster-specific).
- The conc-256 offload tier receives `total-cpu-dram-gb ≈ 2399` from the matrix (dram-utilization 0.80) → ~299 GiB per worker, above the recipe's 128; verify the host clears the memory floor.
- The DP tiers use `ep:8`; the recipe's DP sections are written as TP8 DP-attention. This follows the existing `DeepSeek-V4-Pro` EP+DPA pattern with prefill-only TBO — confirm the EP flag is right for this checkpoint.

## Test plan

- [x] `generate.py test-config` for `dsv4-fp4-mi355x-atom-disagg-agentic-hicache-mtp`
- [x] `bash -n` + connector-JSON validation
- [x] matrix/changelog unit suites
- [ ] Full agentic e2e sweep on MI355X (`--no-evals`)

<details><summary>中文</summary>

## 摘要

在 MI355X 上新增 DeepSeek-V4-Pro FP4 的 ATOM **PD 分离式** agentic 分支 `dsv4-fp4-mi355x-atom-disagg-agentic-hicache-mtp`，作为现有 `dsv4-fp4-mi355x-sglang-disagg-agentic-hicache-mtp` 分支的 ATOM 对照，使两种引擎在 AgentX 轨迹负载上可直接对比。参考 ATOM 的 `recipes/DeepSeek-V4-Agentic-PD-Max.md`（TP / DP-attention / DP+CPU 卸载三档）。

大部分 atom-disagg 基础设施已存在（由非 agentic 的 `dsv4-fp4-mi355x-atom-disagg` 分支验证）：`server.sh` 将 `atom-disagg` 分派到 `server_atom.sh`，`job.slurm` 负责 atom-disagg 路由并解析 `<model>-AgentX` recipe，`launch_mi355x-amds.sh` 已能在 `multi_node/agentic/` 下构造 `dsv4_fp4_mi355x_atom-disagg.sh`。本 PR 补齐 agentic 部分。

## Recipe / 搜索空间

1P1D TP8，`atomesh` PD 路由，`mooncake` RDMA KV 传输，镜像 `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609140614`：
- **TP**（EP1）：并发 `1, 2, 8, 16`，无卸载
- **DP-attention**（EP8, dp-attn）：并发 `64, 128`，无卸载
- **DP-attention + CPU 卸载**（EP8, dp-attn）：并发 `256`，`lmcache_offload` DRAM 档（`multi` 连接器，`max_pending_saves=8`，`slot_sidecar_staging_slots=4`，LRU，256-token 分块）

按 recipe：开启前缀缓存、FP8 KV/index 缓存、block-size 256、仅 prefill 启用 TBO、MTP（`--method mtp --num-speculative-tokens 3`）在吞吐运行使用合成接受长度 2.49、DP 档使用 dp-sticky `idx2idx` 路由、`max-num-seqs = 2×并发`。

## 变更

- `configs/amd-master.yaml` — 新增配置项。
- `benchmarks/multi_node/agentic/dsv4_fp4_mi355x_atom-disagg.sh`（新）— agentic 启动脚本。
- `benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/models_atom.yaml` — 新增 `DeepSeek-V4-Pro-AgentX`。
- `benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/server_atom.sh` — `IS_AGENTIC` 分支（前缀缓存、`max-num-seqs=2×并发`、卸载档 `lmcache_offload` multi 连接器、dp-sticky/idx2idx 路由、合成 `--spec-decode-acceptance-length`、`trace_replay.sh` 客户端）；吞吐路径不变。
- `perf-changelog.yaml` — changelog 条目。

## 验证

- 矩阵 `test-config` 展开为预期的 7 行（TP 并发 1/2/8/16，DP 并发 64/128，卸载档并发 256 `kv-offloading=dram`/`lmcache`，node-count 2，`DECODE_MTP_SIZE=3`）。
- 对新启动脚本与修改后的 `server_atom.sh` 执行 `bash -n`；卸载连接器 JSON 已校验并可通过 `eval` 往返。
- `utils/matrix_logic` 与 `utils/changelog_gate_tests` 测试通过（374 项）；完整 `amd-master.yaml` 校验通过。
- MI355X 完整 e2e 扫描（`--no-evals`）为最终把关——**尚未运行**。

## 说明 / 假设（首次上线需验证）

- `mem_frac_static 0.9` 且无 `LD_PRELOAD` dma-buf shim，假设 MI355X-amds 的 RDMA 内存注册可用（recipe 的 shim 与更低显存比例是 Crusoe 集群特有）。
- 卸载档并发 256 从矩阵获得 `total-cpu-dram-gb ≈ 2399`（dram-utilization 0.80）→ 每 worker 约 299 GiB，高于 recipe 的 128；请确认主机内存余量。
- DP 档使用 `ep:8`；recipe 的 DP 部分写作 TP8 DP-attention。此处沿用现有 `DeepSeek-V4-Pro` 的 EP+DPA 方式并仅在 prefill 启用 TBO——请确认该 checkpoint 的 EP 标志正确。

</details>

title: fix(gb200): enable MiniMax-M3 reasoning parsing for Dynamo TRT / 修复 GB200 MiniMax-M3 Dynamo TRT 推理内容解析
body:
## Description

Enable `DYN_REASONING_PARSER=minimax_m3` for the seven MiniMax-M3 NVFP4 GB200 Dynamo TensorRT-LLM AgentX recipes, and set `reasoning_parser: minimax_m3` in each TensorRT-LLM engine configuration.

This keeps MiniMax-M3 reasoning blocks classified as reasoning content instead of ordinary response content while keeping the frontend and engine parser settings aligned.

Validation:
- Parsed all seven recipes, `configs/nvidia-master.yaml`, and `perf-changelog.yaml`.
- Passed migration verification and dry-run validation for all seven recipes.
- Passed exact-key matrix generation for `minimaxm3-fp4-gb200-dynamo-trt-agentic-agg-mtp`.
- Passed the synthetic-injector tests.
- Verified master-to-recipe image, topology, concurrency, parser-setting, and golden synthetic-acceptance parity.

- [x] Configuration change

- [ ] Other (please describe)

- [x] I have updated documentation if necessary
- [x] **For every change that can affect benchmark performance and every recipe addition or modification, I have appended a new entry to the physical end of `perf-changelog.yaml` and have not edited historical entries**

Do this **only once there is a final full sweep that is all green with evals passing**, since after this comment the sweep label will no longer automatically kick off new sweeps. Remove and re-add the label to force one.

<details>

## 说明

在七个 MiniMax-M3 NVFP4 GB200 Dynamo TensorRT-LLM AgentX 配方中启用 `DYN_REASONING_PARSER=minimax_m3`，并在每个 TensorRT-LLM 引擎配置中设置 `reasoning_parser: minimax_m3`。

这样可将 MiniMax-M3 推理块归类为推理内容，而不是普通响应内容，同时保持前端与引擎解析器设置一致。

title: [H200][SGLang][AgentX] Improve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash performance
body:
This change qualifies DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with SGLang on H200 using the published vLLM starting topologies: TP4/EP1 and TP8/EP1 at concurrency 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128. The earlier EP4/EP8/DP8 sweep missed that topology/range requirement; its green results are historical baseline evidence, not qualification of this revision.

The [deadline-corrected official sweep](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35821534010) is running at `f70e9e554896715401523948028b0456b4254157`: **16 canonical performance +16 full GSM8K evaluations**. The previous exact-EP1 run passed all 16 accuracy cells and 12 performance cells; four C64/C128 performance cells could not finish within the eight-hour allocation. Its requested failed-only retry retained the old deadline and was superseded. Only C64/C128 performance allocation/job limits increase to 24/24.5 hours; normal warmup and the full 3600-second profile remain unchanged. No old-sweep reuse is requested. Full accuracy, error/coverage checks and frontier comparison remain required; power is optional under the user's explicit override. vLLM parity has not been established.

- Preserved official image for this deadline-only repair: `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20260922-582389ce` (selected September22; this repair does not claim it remains the newest published tag); pinned source `582389cec557c613f87a054c6968bdbf52165f20`.
- Effective EP1 preserves every expert on each rank while tensor-sharding its intermediate weights. Native Marlin supports the resulting padded widths576/288; pinned SM90 CUTLASS rejects dimensions not divisible by128. Target and draft use the framework's shipped/default precision; no custom precision or engine patch.
- Preserve per-rank anonymous Engram host tables, GPU-resident KV, memory fraction0.70, chunk4096, prefill/decode interval16, tails1024, native five-token DSpark and validated H200 dense-GEMM launch settings. These baseline runs introduce no additional tuning knobs.
- Throughput uses the existing golden acceptance curve and normal warmup with3600-second profiles. Full evaluations use real verification and no sample limit.

[Initial exact-topology performance gates](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35762101498) established successful runtime at both EP1 topologies; C1/C8 passed while C32 continues.
