title: perf(dsv4): route DP-attention agentic traffic with cache_aware / 用 cache_aware 路由 DP-attention 智能体流量
body:
> **Draft.** The root-cause analysis below is measured. The specific fix
> (`cache_aware`) is not yet validated end-to-end; I am running that now and
> will post numbers before marking this ready.

## Why

`dsv4 fp4 mi355x vllm TP8/DPA mtp c128` reaches a **90.5%** GPU prefix cache hit
rate against a **95.5%** theoretical ceiling, while the matching ATOM point
reaches **92.4%** against **95.9%**.

- vLLM: [run 34774626435 / job 103780081837](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34774626435/job/103780081837)
- ATOM: [run 33376779864 / job 99523226161](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/33376779864/job/99523226161)

Normalising against each run's own ceiling, ATOM converts 96.4% of the
theoretically cacheable tokens into hits and vLLM only 94.7%.

## Root cause

Under `--data-parallel-size 8` each DP rank is a separate engine with its own KV
pool (`GPU KV cache size: 6,259,837 tokens` x8) and its own prefix cache. A
request only hits if it lands on the rank that already holds its prefix.

The launcher pins sessions with `--policy consistent_hash` plus
`AIPERF_HTTP_X_SESSION_ID_FROM_CORRELATION_ID=1`. That works exactly as written
— `router.log` shows session keys spread evenly over the 8 ranks (10.4%–15.9%
of sessions each). The problem is the choice of key.

Joining the run's `profile_export.jsonl` against `router.log`:

| | |
|---|---|
| trajectories (`root_correlation_id` / `source_trace_id`) | 216 |
| distinct `x_correlation_id` values used as routing keys | 1,440 |
| requests at `agent_depth` 1 (sub-agent branches) | 4,707 / 7,569 |
| trajectories scattered over 2–8 DP ranks | **99 / 216 (45.8%)** |
| trajectories scattered over all 8 ranks | 13 (6.0%) |
| prompt tokens belonging to a split trajectory | **446M / 819M (54.5%)** |

The agentic trace fans one trajectory out into several sub-agent branches that
inherit the parent's context. Each branch gets its own correlation ID, so
`consistent_hash` sends it to a different rank, and that rank has to prefill the
shared prefix into its own pool again.

Per-rank hit rates track this: 87.1% / 87.5% / 89.4% / 90.3% / 90.4% / 91.6% /
91.9% / 92.3% (volume-weighted 90.48%, matching the reported 90.5%).

## Evidence for the mechanism

On an 8xMI355X box I brought up the same config locally (same args, same
`block size 256` / `DEEPSEEK_SPARSE_SWA`, 6,336,403 tokens per rank) and replayed
a synthetic workload shaped like the trace — one long shared trajectory prefix,
seven sub-agent branches — pinning each request with `X-data-parallel-rank` so
routing was the only variable:

| routing key | prefix cache hit rate | wall | mean TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|
| per-branch (what we do today) | 9.19% | 768s | 83.0s |
| per-trajectory | **64.90%** | 406s | 43.0s |
| single shared cache | 64.90% | 956s | 105.0s |

Co-locating a trajectory's branches recovers everything a single shared cache
would give for this shape, which says the partitioning itself is fine and the
routing key is what hurts.

Please read those absolute numbers as a mechanism check, not a prediction of the
production delta: the synthetic deliberately contains no within-branch multi-turn
reuse, which is where most real hits come from and which already works today.

## The change

`cache_aware` is vllm-router's own default. It keeps a radix tree of prompt
prefixes, routes to the rank holding the longest match, and falls back to load
balancing once a rank is `--balance-abs-threshold` (64) requests ahead. It keys
on prompt content, so it co-locates sub-agent branches without any session
header, and it also captures prefixes shared *across* trajectories (system
prompt, tool definitions, common repo context) that no session-keyed policy can
catch. `AIPERF_HTTP_X_SESSION_ID_FROM_CORRELATION_ID` becomes unused and is
dropped.

## Open questions for review

1. **Validation.** I have not yet run the full `aiperf` replay under
   `cache_aware`. Doing that here needs `semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126`,
   which is not in the local HF cache. Happy to drive it through CI instead if
   that is easier.
2. **Load balance.** `cache_aware` trades balance for locality. With ISL p95 at
   373k tokens and only 5.97x max concurrency per rank, the default
   `cache_threshold 0.3` / `balance_abs_threshold 64` may need tuning. Worth a
   sweep?
3. **Scope.** `dsv4_fp4_b200_vllm_mtp.sh` and `dsv4_fp4_b300_vllm_mtp.sh` carry
   the identical `consistent_hash` block. I left them alone until this is
   validated on MI355X — say the word and I will include them.

## Unrelated finding, not fixed here

`VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL=32768` (set just below this block) is a
no-op. The CI log shows `Unknown vLLM environment variable detected:
VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL`, and the run's own
`vllm:cache_config_info` reports `prefix_cache_retention_interval 0`. The name
also does not exist in current vLLM nightly (`0.3.1.dev251+g0961bbae2`). Since
the comment cites vllm-project/vllm#43447 and #44774 for SWA prefix-cache
retention, someone who knows the intent should decide whether to drop it or
chase the real knob. Left untouched to keep this diff to one concern.

title: [TileRT] Add GLM-5.3 FP8 MI355X prefill/decode-disaggregated recipes (8k1k + AgentX) / 新增 GLM-5.3 FP8 MI355X 的 PD 分离配方（8k1k + AgentX）
body:
> **Upstream continuation of [#3328](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3328) by @CrimsonDump.** The branch is the same commit, authored by @CrimsonDump and re-pushed to this repository so the normal same-repository sweep pipeline can run it (fork PRs need the trusted dispatcher). Review follow-ups are pushed here as separate commits. Credit for the recipe belongs to @CrimsonDump.
>
>
> **Status (2026-09-22):** full sweep **green** on `992c9c0a1` ([run 35715072662](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35715072662)) at GLM-5.3's full **1048576**-token context: 8k1k conc 1 → 16/16, median TTFT 886 ms, TPOT 1.97 ms, 344 tok/s; AgentX conc 1 → 234 requests, ISL p50 ~337k tokens, TTFT median 6.49 s, 491 tok/s per user. bf16 MLA wire layout (the only one TileRT 0.1.6 accepts from vLLM on ROCm); TileRT's two 99.06 GiB PD buffers live in 2 MiB-backed pinned host memory via a 5-file patch applied at container start (engine-patch waiver `docs/waiver/3330.md`; vLLM unpatched). **Depends on [InferenceX-app#1202](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/pull/1202) being deployed first** (the app had no `glm5.3` DB key; without it the site drops these rows at unofficial render and at official ingest). Open: one `RUN_EVAL=true` GSM8K pass on MI355X, the waiver's upstream TileRT link, the provisional golden-AL curve. Derivations: [root cause](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3330#issuecomment-5770227325), [ionic registration ceiling](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3330#issuecomment-5770977844), [cross-node transfer proof](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3330#issuecomment-5771627506), [results](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3330#issuecomment-5774769517).
> <details><summary>中文</summary>
>
> 本 PR 是 [#3328](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3328)（作者 @CrimsonDump）在上游仓库的延续。分支为同一提交，作者仍为 @CrimsonDump，仅重新推送到本仓库，以便走常规的同仓库 sweep 流程（fork PR 需要受信任调度器）。评审后续修改以独立提交追加在此。配方的原始贡献归属 @CrimsonDump。
>
> </details>

## Description

Adds GLM-5.3 FP8 on MI355X as a prefill/decode-disaggregated TileRT recipe: upstream vLLM ROCm prefill (TileRTConnector, `kv_producer`) + TileRT `decode_server` + an OpenAI-compatible `pd_router`, `framework: tilert`, KV over mooncake. Two scenarios — Single-turn 8k1k and AgentX agentic-coding — mirroring the merged B200 `glm5.1-fp8-b200-tilert` entries on the `amd_utils` orchestration.

**Artifacts.** Two first-party images, `ghcr.io/tile-ai/tilert-rocm-decode:0.1.6` (decode) and `ghcr.io/tile-ai/tilert-rocm-prefill:0.1.6` (prefill, the upstream `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm` release image plus the mooncake ROCm transfer engine). Neither carries the wheel: `setup_deps.sh` installs `tilert==0.1.6` from PyPI into both ranks at container start — full install on decode, `--no-deps` connector plugin on prefill, so the image's torch/transformers/vLLM are untouched.

**Topology.** 1 prefill node (TP8) + 1 decode node (TP8), `conc-list: [1]` because TileRT decode serves one sequence at a time. bf16 KV cache on both roles — the ROCm vLLM sparse-MLA backend has no `fp8_ds_mla` dtype. `max-model-len` 1048576 (GLM-5.3's full context window), MTP at draft depth 3, `gpu-memory-utilization` 0.85 on the prefill.

**Golden AL.** Nothing hard-codes an acceptance length. `server_tilert.sh` reads the committed curve at launch, selecting it exactly as `infx/srt_slurm/synthetic_acceptance.py` does, applies it to agentic throughput only, suppresses it under `RUN_EVAL`/`EVAL_ONLY`, and fails the run rather than silently falling back to real acceptance if the curve or draft length is missing.

> **Reviewers:** `golden_al_distribution/glm5.3_mtp.yaml` is **GLM-5.2's curve, copied**. No SPEED-Bench run exists for GLM-5.3; the two share a base and layer topology (`config.json` differs only by the fp8 quantization block), and only the K=3 cell is carried over because the ROCm TileRT GLM profile builds MTP at that depth only. The file is labelled `PROVISIONAL`. Flagging it rather than letting it read as a measured 5.3 curve — happy to take direction: a measured curve, a non-MTP agentic entry, or a waiver.

**Two checklist items worth stating up front.** *Framework ordering:* GLM-5.3 on AMD has no vLLM/SGLang entry, so this lands a TileRT arm first; the in-tree precedent is NVIDIA `glm5.1`, also TileRT-only, merged in #2533 (2026-08-09) and #2650 (2026-08-23), both after the ordering rule was added in #1886 (2026-06-22). *Engine patching, with waiver:* vLLM runs exactly as shipped, but the TileRT PD transport layer is patched at container start ([`benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/patches/tilert-0.1.6-pd-buffers-in-dram.patch`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/b01cf3c0c/benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/patches/tilert-0.1.6-pd-buffers-in-dram.patch), 5 pure-Python files under `tilert/pd_vllm`, applied by `setup_deps.sh` to the pip-installed `tilert==0.1.6` on both ranks when `TILERT_PD_BUFFER_DEVICE=cpu`; marker-gated, pinned to 0.1.6) so that both PD buffers live in 2 MiB-backed pinned host memory; at the full 1M context they do not fit on the GPU. Covered by [`docs/waiver/3330.md`](docs/waiver/3330.md) — what is patched, why the unmodified stack cannot run this benchmark, upstream link (TileRT issue/PR **pending**), and the removal plan.

## AI model disclosure

- **Model/version (original recipe):** `claude-opus-5[1m]` — Claude Opus 5 (1M context), via Claude Code. This is the identifier the original runtime exposed.
- **Follow-up commits on this PR** (review fixes, orchestration and memory analysis from `d924515e5`; the DRAM-buffer patch and waiver from `432e65111`): `claude-opus-5[1m]` (Claude Opus 5, 1M context) through `fb663fa26`, then `claude-fable-5-1[1m]` (Claude Fable 5.1) from `432e65111`, both via Claude Code; the adversarial verification and review subagents ran on `claude-fable-5-1[1m]`. Numbers quoted in those commits and comments were measured on the MI355X cluster or computed from the tilert 0.1.6 / vLLM 0.24.0 sources, as stated per item.
- **Role:** Wrote the recipe, orchestration and configs; ran the local validation on 2x8 MI350X; drafted this description and the commit message. All numbers quoted here were produced by the runs described under *Validation* and read back from the resulting artifacts, not generated by the model.
- **Follow-up model:** `GPT 6 Astra`, via Perplexity Computer. Ported the `RDMAV_FORK_SAFE=1` fix from CrimsonDump's commit to both TileRT ranks, added explanatory comments and performance-changelog entries, and ran shell syntax and changelog/matrix validation. No delegated agents were used for this follow-up; no GPU/RDMA benchmark was rerun.

## Related Issue

<!-- none -->

## Type of Change

- [x] New feature
- [x] Configuration change
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Validation

Run on 2x8 MI350X with those images and wheel, through the official entry points:

| | result |
|---|---|
| GSM8K (`RUN_EVAL=true EVAL_ONLY=true`, 1319 items) | strict-match **0.9750** ±0.0043, flexible-extract **0.9735** ±0.0044 |
| AgentX 3600 s, conc 1 | `submission_valid: true`, coverage TTFT 99.8% / ITL 99.9%, 532 requests, 0 errors |
| Single-turn 8k1k, conc 1 | TTFT p50 **1010 ms**, 16/16 requests completed |
| Matrix logic UTs | 335 passed |

**MI350X is not MI355X.** Same `gfx950` ISA, 256 CU / 288 GB / 8 TB/s, but 1000 W vs 1400 W TBP and 2200 vs 2400 MHz peak. These numbers show the recipe runs and is accurate; they are **not** leaderboard results — the sweep produces those on real `mi355x` runners.

## Checklist

- [x] I have tested my changes locally
- [x] Engine-patch waiver filed at `docs/waiver/3330.md` (TileRT PD transport only; vLLM unpatched)

- [x] **For every change that can affect benchmark performance and every recipe addition or modification, I have appended a new entry to the physical end of `perf-changelog.yaml` and have not edited historical entries**

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 改动说明

以 TileRT 的 prefill/decode 分离形态新增 MI355X 上的 GLM-5.3 FP8：上游 vLLM ROCm 作 prefill（TileRTConnector、`kv_producer`）+ TileRT `decode_server` + 兼容 OpenAI 的 `pd_router`，`framework: tilert`，KV 走 mooncake。两个场景：单轮 8k1k 与 AgentX 智能体编码，形态对齐已合并的 B200 `glm5.1-fp8-b200-tilert`，走 `amd_utils` 编排链。

**产物**：两个第一方镜像 —— decode 用 `ghcr.io/tile-ai/tilert-rocm-decode:0.1.6`，prefill 用 `ghcr.io/tile-ai/tilert-rocm-prefill:0.1.6`（上游 `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm` 发布镜像 + 源码构建的 mooncake ROCm 传输引擎）。两者都不含 wheel：`setup_deps.sh` 在容器启动时从 PyPI 装 `tilert==0.1.6`，decode 全装、prefill `--no-deps` 只装 connector 插件，镜像内的 torch/transformers/vLLM 一概不动。

**拓扑**：1 个 prefill 节点（TP8）+ 1 个 decode 节点（TP8），`conc-list: [1]`，因为 TileRT decode 一次只服务一条序列。两侧均用 bf16 KV cache —— ROCm 上 vLLM 的稀疏 MLA 后端没有 `fp8_ds_mla`。`max-model-len` 1048576，MTP 草稿深度 3。

**黄金接受率**：任何地方都不写死接受率。`server_tilert.sh` 在启动时读取提交的曲线，选择规则与 `infx/srt_slurm/synthetic_acceptance.py` 完全一致；仅作用于 agentic 吞吐，`RUN_EVAL`/`EVAL_ONLY` 下自动关闭；曲线或草稿深度缺失时直接失败，而不是静默回落到真实接受率。

> **请评审裁决**：`golden_al_distribution/glm5.3_mtp.yaml` 是**从 GLM-5.2 抄来的曲线**。GLM-5.3 没有 SPEED-Bench 数据，两者同底座、同层拓扑（`config.json` 仅多 fp8 量化块），且只搬了 K=3 那一格（ROCm 的 TileRT GLM profile 只编了这个深度）。文件头已标 `PROVISIONAL`。主动挑明，而不是让它看起来像实测的 5.3 曲线。实测曲线、改非 MTP 的 agentic 条目、或走豁免，都听安排。

**两条主动说明的清单条款**：① 框架顺序 —— AMD 侧 GLM-5.3 目前只有 TileRT；在树先例是 NVIDIA `glm5.1` 同样只有 TileRT（#2533、#2650，均在规则 #1886 之后合入）。② 引擎补丁与豁免 —— vLLM 原样运行；但 TileRT 的 PD 传输层在容器启动时被打补丁（`patches/tilert-0.1.6-pd-buffers-in-dram.patch`，由 `setup_deps.sh` 在 `TILERT_PD_BUFFER_DEVICE=cpu` 时应用），使两个 PD 缓冲位于 2 MiB 大页支撑的锁页主机内存中——完整 1M 上下文下它们无法放入 GPU。已按 `docs/waiver/3330.md` 提交豁免（补丁内容、未修改栈无法运行的原因、上游链接（TileRT PR 待开）、移除计划）。

## AI 模型使用说明

- **模型/版本（原始配方）**：`claude-opus-5[1m]` —— Claude Opus 5（1M 上下文），经 Claude Code 使用。这是原始运行时暴露的标识。
- **本 PR 后续提交**（自 `d924515e5` 起的评审修复、编排与内存分析；自 `432e65111` 起的 DRAM 缓冲补丁与豁免）：至 `fb663fa26` 为 `claude-opus-5[1m]`，自 `432e65111` 起为 `claude-fable-5-1[1m]`，均经 Claude Code；对抗性验证与评审子代理运行于 `claude-fable-5-1[1m]`。所引数字均为 MI355X 集群实测或由 tilert 0.1.6 / vLLM 0.24.0 源码计算，逐项注明。
- **工作内容**：编写配方、编排与配置；在 2×8 MI350X 上执行本地验证；起草本说明与提交信息。文中所有数字均来自「验证」一节所述的实际运行、并从产物中读回，不是模型生成的。
- **后续修改模型**：`GPT 6 Astra`，经 Perplexity Computer 使用。将 CrimsonDump 提交中的 `RDMAV_FORK_SAFE=1` 修复移植到 TileRT 两侧，补充说明注释和性能变更记录，并执行 Shell 语法及变更记录/矩阵验证。本次后续修改未使用委派 agent，也未重新运行 GPU/RDMA 基准测试。

## 关联 issue

无。

## 改动类型

新功能 + 配置改动。

## 验证结果

在 2×8 MI350X 上、用上述镜像与 wheel、走官方入口：GSM8K strict-match **0.9750**、flexible-extract **0.9735**；AgentX 3600 秒 `submission_valid: true`、覆盖率 99.8%/99.9%、532 请求、0 错误；单轮 8k1k TTFT p50 **1010 ms**、16/16 请求完成；矩阵逻辑单测 335 通过。

⚠️ **这是 MI350X，不是 MI355X**：同 `gfx950` ISA、同 256 CU / 288 GB / 8 TB/s，但 TBP 1000W vs 1400W、峰值频率 2200 vs 2400 MHz。这些数字用于证明配方能跑且结果正确，**不是打榜成绩** —— 榜上成绩由 sweep 在真实 `mi355x` 机器上产出。

title: perf: add concurrency 96 to B200 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash AgentX sweep / 为 B200 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash AgentX 扫描新增并发 96
body:
Add concurrency 96 between 64 and 128 to `dsv41flash-fp4-b200-vllm-agentic-dspark` (B200 TP4, Engram UVA offload, native five-token DSpark at golden AL 3.51). The image, recipe script, DSpark settings and every other row are unchanged. c96 takes the same CUDA graph capture size as c128: the 64-token floor doubles until it covers 96 × 6 tokens, giving 1024.

Motivation: the SSD Engram sibling sweeps in #3080 (runs 35111026929 and 35134710007) showed the B200 curve turning over between c64 and c128, with c128 saturated in both runs, so the main recipe needs a point there.

Sweep: c1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 96, 128; full AgentX trace, AL 3.51; eval at c128 unchanged. Local checks: exact-key matrix generation emits nine throughput rows including `dsv41flash_tp4_conc96_kvnone_spec-mtp`, and the perf-changelog validator passes against `origin/main`. GPU throughput and eval are gated by CI.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

为 `dsv41flash-fp4-b200-vllm-agentic-dspark`（B200 TP4，Engram UVA 卸载，原生五 token DSpark，golden AL 3.51）在并发 64 和 128 之间新增并发 96。镜像、配方脚本、DSpark 设置及其他各行保持不变。c96 与 c128 使用相同的 CUDA graph 捕获范围：64 token 下限翻倍至覆盖 96 × 6 token，即 1024。

动机：#3080 的 SSD Engram 对照扫描（运行 35111026929 与 35134710007）显示 B200 曲线在 c64 与 c128 之间转折，且 c128 在两次运行中均已饱和，因此主配方需要在此区间增加一个点。

扫描并发为 1、2、4、8、16、32、64、96、128；完整 AgentX 轨迹，AL 3.51；c128 评估不变。本地检查：精确 key 矩阵生成输出九行吞吐配置（含 `dsv41flash_tp4_conc96_kvnone_spec-mtp`），perf-changelog 校验对 `origin/main` 通过。GPU 吞吐量与评估由 CI 验证。

</details>

title: [AMD] Update GLM-5.2 MI355X image, HiCache capacity, and sweep / 更新 GLM-5.2 MI355X 镜像、HiCache 容量与 sweep

## Summary

Update the GLM-5.2 MI355X AgentX recipe to the 20260920 SGLang ROCm image, increase the TP4/EP4 host KV tier to 180 GB/rank within a 0.85 SA DRAM budget, and focus each topology on its intended concurrency range. The recipe uses SGLang's default `kernel` / `page_first` HiCache path.

## Changes

- Update the image from `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.19-rocm720-mi35x-20260917` to `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260920`.
- Remove explicit `--hicache-io-backend direct` and `--hicache-mem-layout page_first_direct` overrides.
- Raise `dram-utilization` from `0.80` to `0.85` and replace the TP4/EP4 ratio-1.0 host KV pool with `--hicache-size 180`.
- Set the TP4/EP4 HiCache arm to concurrency `[4, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16]`.
- Set the TP8/EP1 GPU-resident arm to concurrency `[1, 2, 4]`; `c=4` intentionally overlaps both arms for topology comparison.
- Keep both parallel topologies unchanged and append the required performance changelog entry.

## Memory sizing evidence

- The ratio-1.0 baseline allocated 115.19 GB/rank for host KV and 26.40 GB/rank for the DSA indexer.
- At 180 GB/rank, host KV grows by 56.3%; the indexer scales to approximately 41.25 GB/rank, for approximately 885 GB across TP4.
- Matrix generation resolves the 0.85 TP4 CPU DRAM budget to 1,274 GB. Measured startup overhead leaves approximately 125 GB of headroom at the selected size.
- A strict-budget canary showed that 270 GB/rank does not fit even at 0.90, failing during DSA indexer allocation. The 180 GB/rank setting retains approximately 10% startup headroom under the stricter 0.85 budget.

title: config(dsv41flash): sweep MI355X at TP=2 and TP=4 through concurrency 128 / MI355X DSv4.1-Flash 在 TP=2 与 TP=4 下扫描至并发 128
body:
## Description

Adds a TP=2 search space next to TP=4 for `dsv41flash-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-dspark`, and extends both rows to concurrency 128 (previously TP=4 only, c1–c32).

TP=2 is what this sweep is really for. The Engram tables cost 47.2 GiB of device memory per rank at TP=4, which is what forced four GPUs per server on this SKU; with those tables held in host memory the model fits on two, doubling the servers per node. Whether DSv4.1-Flash on MI355X is throughput-bound or interactivity-bound at agentic concurrencies depends on that choice, and today we have no TP=2 point to compare against.

That offload only became available on ROCm in [vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491), merged 2026-09-21T02:17:12Z, which widened the two `is_cuda()` gates to `is_cuda_alike()` so `engram_config` resolves on gfx950. The pinned nightly is six commits ahead of that merge, so it carries the change. Because `cpu_offload` now defaults to on via `VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD`, the recipe sets it explicitly per TP rather than inheriting the default: `{"cpu_offload":true}` at TP=2, `{"cpu_offload":false}` at TP=4. TP=4 stays GPU-resident so its numbers remain comparable with the validated c1–c32 run; TP=2 needs the offload, since the tables cost 94.4 GiB per rank there against a 288 GiB card.

Supersedes [#3111](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3111), which extended TP=4 to c128 and was closed in favour of this sweep. Its recipe change is carried here: `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/dsv41flash_fp4_mi355x_vllm_mtp.sh` drops the fixed `max_num_seqs=128` in favour of the MI355X API-server default of 1024, because a fixed 128 caps in-flight sequences at the outer concurrency exactly when the sweep reaches c128, leaving no headroom for AgentX subagent fan-out. The CUDA graph ceiling now derives from `max(2 * CONC, 128)`: 1024 through c64, 2048 at c128.

**Image pinned.** The entry runs on `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100-3df4ae153eb385e27b52f26c81f8edb9e20b9984`, the ROCm 10.0 nightly published 2026-09-21T05:50:03Z. Docker Hub reports it `active` and `linux/amd64` at digest `sha256:eccb72b74b8c04ce7406d9212e200b129f58e24be642795a857f755a94fdb3a1`, and a registry manifest request to `registry-1.docker.io` returns that same digest for the tag. This sweep is the qualification for the image; the previous green run on `nightly-eed1f3d0` is not evidence for it.

The pin is on the `nightly-rocm100` channel (ROCm 10.0). [#3215](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3215) stayed on the plain ROCm nightly channel, but it scoped itself to an image-only bump on the channel already in place and did not reject `nightly-rocm100` on technical grounds. `kimik3-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-mtp` already runs that channel on this same `cluster:mi355x-amds` fleet, so ROCm 10.0 is proven for vLLM AgentX on MI355X. #3215 also edits this `image:` line, so whichever lands second rebases onto the other.

Generated matrix for the edited key — 16 points, TP=4 and TP=2 each across c1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128:

```bash
uv run --no-project --exclude-newer PT12H --python 3.12 --with pydantic --with pyyaml \
  python -m infx.matrix.generate test-config \
  --config-files configs/amd-master.yaml \
  --runner-config configs/runners.yaml \
  --config-keys dsv41flash-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-dspark
```

```
dsv41flash_tp4_conc{1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128}_kvnone_spec-mtp
dsv41flash_tp2_conc{1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128}_kvnone_spec-mtp
```

Each point resolves `runner: cluster:mi355x-amds`, `precision: fp4`, `spec-decoding: mtp`, `kv-offloading: none`, `dram-utilization: 0.60`, matching the existing TP=4 row. `configs/amd-master.yaml`, `configs/runners.yaml` and `perf-changelog.yaml` all parse. All 16 points carry the pinned image and no `TBD` placeholder survives anywhere in the changed files. `infx.workflows.validate_perf_changelog --base-ref origin/main --head-ref HEAD` passes, and the recipe script passes `bash -n` and `git diff --check`. GPU sweep and eval results are still pending.

## AI model disclosure

- Model/version: Claude Opus 5 (runtime identifier `claude-opus-5-thinking-high`), via the Cursor agent.
- Role: drafted the config and changelog edits, moved the pin to the `nightly-rocm100` channel, verified the published tag against Docker Hub and the registry, ran local YAML parsing, matrix generation and changelog validation, and wrote this description. All changes are reviewed by the submitter.

## Related Issue

N/A

- [x] Configuration change

## Checklist

- [x] I have completed the AI model disclosure and kept it current
- [x] I have tested my changes locally
- [ ] I have updated documentation if necessary
- [x] **For every change that can affect benchmark performance and every recipe addition or modification, I have appended a new entry to the physical end of `perf-changelog.yaml` and have not edited historical entries**
- [ ] **Before merging via reuse, an authorized maintainer (`OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`) has commented `/use <run_id>` (or the legacy `/reuse-sweep-run`) on this PR**

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 说明

为 `dsv41flash-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-dspark` 在 TP=4 之外新增 TP=2 搜索空间，并将两者的并发扩展到 128（此前仅 TP=4，且并发为 c1–c32）。

本次 sweep 的重点是 TP=2。Engram 表在 TP=4 时每 rank 占用 47.2 GiB 设备内存，这正是该 SKU 此前必须每服务器四张 GPU 的原因；将这些表放在主机内存后，模型可在两张 GPU 上运行，每节点的服务器数量随之翻倍。DSv4.1-Flash 在 MI355X 上于 agentic 并发下究竟受吞吐还是受交互性限制，取决于这一选择，而目前我们没有可供对比的 TP=2 数据点。

该下放能力在 ROCm 上直到 [vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491)（2026-09-21T02:17:12Z 合并）才可用：它将两处 `is_cuda()` 判断放宽为 `is_cuda_alike()`，使 `engram_config` 在 gfx950 上得以解析。所固定的 nightly 比该合并提交领先 6 个提交，因此包含该改动。由于 `cpu_offload` 现在经由 `VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD` 默认开启，recipe 按 TP 显式设置该值，而不是沿用默认：TP=2 为 `{"cpu_offload":true}`，TP=4 为 `{"cpu_offload":false}`。TP=4 保持表常驻 GPU，使其数据与已验证的 c1–c32 运行保持可比；TP=2 则需要该下放，因为此时每 rank 的表需 94.4 GiB，而单卡仅 288 GiB。

本 PR 取代 [#3111](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3111)（该 PR 将 TP=4 扩展到 c128，已为本次 sweep 关闭），并承接其 recipe 改动：`benchmarks/single_node/agentic/dsv41flash_fp4_mi355x_vllm_mtp.sh` 移除固定的 `max_num_seqs=128`，改用 MI355X API server 默认值 1024。因为扫描到 c128 时，固定 128 恰好把在途序列数限制在外层并发上，使 AgentX 子代理扇出没有余量。CUDA graph 上限改由 `max(2 * CONC, 128)` 推导：c64 及以下为 1024，c128 为 2048。

**镜像已固定。** 该条目运行在 `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100-3df4ae153eb385e27b52f26c81f8edb9e20b9984` 上，这是 2026-09-21T05:50:03Z 发布的 ROCm 10.0 nightly。Docker Hub 显示其状态为 `active`、架构为 `linux/amd64`，digest 为 `sha256:eccb72b74b8c04ce7406d9212e200b129f58e24be642795a857f755a94fdb3a1`；向 `registry-1.docker.io` 请求 manifest 也返回相同的 digest。本次 sweep 即为该镜像的验证；此前在 `nightly-eed1f3d0` 上的绿色运行不能作为其证据。

镜像使用 `nightly-rocm100`（ROCm 10.0）渠道。[#3215](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3215) 此前继续使用原有的 ROCm nightly 渠道，但它只是把自身范围限定为在既有渠道上做纯镜像更新，并未基于技术原因否定 `nightly-rocm100`。本 `cluster:mi355x-amds` 集群上的 `kimik3-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-mtp` 已在使用该渠道，因此 ROCm 10.0 在 MI355X 上的 vLLM AgentX 场景已得到验证。#3215 同样修改了这一行 `image:`，因此后合并的一方需要 rebase。

针对所改 key 生成的矩阵共 16 个点，TP=4 与 TP=2 各覆盖 c1、2、4、8、16、32、64、128（命令与输出见上方英文部分）。每个点均解析为 `runner: cluster:mi355x-amds`、`precision: fp4`、`spec-decoding: mtp`、`kv-offloading: none`、`dram-utilization: 0.60`，与现有 TP=4 行一致。`configs/amd-master.yaml`、`configs/runners.yaml` 与 `perf-changelog.yaml` 均可正常解析。16 个点全部使用已固定的镜像，改动文件中不再残留任何 `TBD` 占位。`infx.workflows.validate_perf_changelog --base-ref origin/main --head-ref HEAD` 通过，recipe 脚本通过 `bash -n` 与 `git diff --check`。GPU sweep 与 eval 结果尚未完成。

## AI 模型使用说明

- 模型/版本：Claude Opus 5（运行时标识 `claude-opus-5-thinking-high`），通过 Cursor agent 使用。
- 工作内容：起草配置与 changelog 改动，将镜像固定切换到 `nightly-rocm100` 渠道，对照 Docker Hub 与 registry 核验已发布的 tag，在本地运行 YAML 解析、矩阵生成与 changelog 校验，并撰写本说明。所有改动均由提交者复核。

## 关联 Issue

无

## 改动类型

- [x] 配置改动

</details>

title: feat(agentx): retune GLM5.2 FP4 MI355X ATOM recipe on _0921 docker
body:
# Description

Tracks the updated GLM-5.2 standalone recipe (ROCm/ATOM PR 2345) on the MI355X ATOM AgentX config. Four changes, no new concurrency points and no change to the draft-depth or golden-AL schedule.

**1. Image bump.** `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609151450` → `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609211553`, recipe follows ROCm/ATOM PR 2345.

**2. No KV offload below C16.** The small-concurrency TP4 arm moves from `kv-offloading: dram` with the `lmcache` 0.4.5 backend to `kv-offloading: none`, so conc `[2, 4, 8, 10]` serve off the native GPU prefix cache alone and no longer start an LMCache CPU tier. The TP4+DCP4 arm and the TP8 arm are unchanged.

| Arm | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `tp: 4`, conc `[2, 4, 8, 10]` | `kv-offloading: dram`, `lmcache` 0.4.5 | `kv-offloading: none` |
| `tp: 4`, `dcp-size: 4`, conc `[16, 24, 32, 40, 48]` | `kv-offloading: dram`, `lmcache` 0.4.5 | unchanged |
| `tp: 8`, conc `[1, 2, 4]` | `kv-offloading: none` | unchanged |

`dram-utilization: 0.171` stays as is — the DCP4 arm still resolves `TOTAL_CPU_DRAM_GB=256` from it.

**3. New server flags.** `--index_cache_dtype fp4` and `--block-size 64` are now passed on every point. Neither flag was set before, so both took the ATOM default.

**4. Dropped env override.** `ATOM_USE_FLYDSL_GATHER_KV_B_PROJ=0`, which pinned `gather_kv_b_proj` to the Triton path on the DCP prefill-context and MTP verify paths, is removed; the updated recipe no longer sets it.

### Files changed

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/glm5.2_fp4_mi355x_atom_mtp.sh` | Add `--index_cache_dtype fp4` and `--block-size 64`; remove `ATOM_USE_FLYDSL_GATHER_KV_B_PROJ=0` |
| `configs/amd-master.yaml` | Image pin, `kv-offloading: none` on the small-concurrency arm, ROCm/ATOM PR reference, comments |
| `perf-changelog.yaml` | New entry appended at the physical end |

The C2–C10 offload change needs no script edit: `KV_OFFLOAD_BACKEND` arriving empty already routes to `require_agentic_kv_offload_none`.


<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 改动说明

将 MI355X ATOM AgentX 配置对齐更新后的 GLM-5.2 单机配方（ROCm/ATOM PR 2345）。共四处改动，并发点集合不变，draft depth 与 golden AL 的调度规则也不变。

**1. 镜像更新。** `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609151450` → `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609211553`，recipe参考 ROCm/ATOM PR 2345。

**2. C16 以下不再做 KV offload。** 小并发 TP4 臂由 `kv-offloading: dram` 搭配 `lmcache` 0.4.5 后端改为 `kv-offloading: none`，因此并发 `[2, 4, 8, 10]` 仅依赖原生 GPU prefix cache，不再启动 LMCache CPU 层。TP4+DCP4 臂与 TP8 臂保持不变。

| 臂 | 改动前 | 改动后 |
|---|---|---|
| `tp: 4`，并发 `[2, 4, 8, 10]` | `kv-offloading: dram`，`lmcache` 0.4.5 | `kv-offloading: none` |
| `tp: 4`，`dcp-size: 4`，并发 `[16, 24, 32, 40, 48]` | `kv-offloading: dram`，`lmcache` 0.4.5 | 不变 |
| `tp: 8`，并发 `[1, 2, 4]` | `kv-offloading: none` | 不变 |

`dram-utilization: 0.171` 保持不变 —— DCP4 臂仍需由它解析出 `TOTAL_CPU_DRAM_GB=256`。

**3. 新增 server 参数。** 所有并发点现在都会传入 `--index_cache_dtype fp4` 与 `--block-size 64`。这两个参数此前均未设置，走的是 ATOM 默认值。

**4. 移除环境变量覆盖。** 删除 `ATOM_USE_FLYDSL_GATHER_KV_B_PROJ=0`（原用于在 DCP prefill-context 与 MTP verify 路径上将 `gather_kv_b_proj` 固定到 Triton 实现）；更新后的配方不再设置该变量。

### 变更文件

title: [H100][SGLang][AgentX] Improve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash performance
body:
Match the published vLLM H100 baseline exactly: **TP8/EP1, no DP attention, concurrency 1/2/4/8/16/20/24/28**. The new full sweep qualifies eight canonical performance cells and eight complete GSM8K cells. The earlier green EP8/DP8 sweep does not qualify this topology correction.

- Pin official `nightly-dev-cu13-20260922-4cbf290f`, published September 22 at 20:34 UTC, manifest `sha256:504d34fd712ac2656e9a9da363160e49fddb9957b60092893d6b773fc26c0f5f`.
- Use supported native MXFP4 Marlin on Hopper, shipped DSpark/MTP precision, native 1M context, per-rank host Engram, GPU KV, static memory fraction 0.75, 2,048-token prefill chunks and the stock reserve of eight SWA prefix tails per concurrency. Pool and graph capacity require fresh H100 runtime validation.
- Retain the H100 block32 FP8 launch configurations, interval-16 scheduling, expandable allocator and concurrency-scaled SWA tails. These change launch configuration and capacity, not checkpoint data, scales or draft precision.
- Preserve all 393 traces, seed 42, child sessions, ten warmup requests per lane, 3,600-second profiles and the committed golden acceptance curve. Accuracy uses real verification and all 1,319 GSM8K questions without a limit.
- C20 and above get a 12-hour allocation, matching 750-minute job timeout and one-hour warmup drain because prior C20 attempts exhausted those limits while still progressing. No shortened workload. Power remains reported honestly and is optional under the user's explicit waiver.
- Exactly one PR-added changelog entry; `full-sweep-enabled` and `all-evals` are enabled. Ready for review; no merge authorized.

The exact topology/concurrency grid is confirmed by the [published vLLM run](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35314892357), its stored startup commands and the current repository configuration. vLLM does not enable expert parallelism. SGLang's explicit EP1 preserves expert tensor parallelism instead of substituting EP8 or DP8.

[Official SGLang cookbook](https://lmsysorg.mintlify.app/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4_1).

## Validation and staging

Local strict matrix generation confirms exact agreement with vLLM for all eight TP/EP/DP/concurrency tuples; Bash syntax, allocation-policy behavior, diff checks and the byte-preserving changelog gate pass. The first [exact-topology sweep](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35788596311) measured 49.04 GiB target weights plus about 1.45 GiB for DSpark. At static fraction 0.70, only 3.51–3.53 GiB remained for KV: C16–C28 failed because the inherited SWA reserves consumed 5.41–9.32 GiB, while C8 held only 469,760 full tokens. Logs were preserved and the unusable configuration stopped. The revised static fraction, smaller prefill chunk and stock tail reserve address that measured capacity failure; [Replacement official full sweep](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35795081193) is queued at `52bd856dbf0649f44712b304e2ee2e97d5a81fba`; full GPU qualification is pending. Live node logs and metrics will determine whether an individual run needs early termination; elapsed time alone is not failure evidence.

The historical [EP8/DP8 full sweep](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35690159495) passed 20/20 cells and has a [staging acknowledgement](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3345#issuecomment-5784432720). It remains separate evidence. The corrected full sweep will be staged again immediately after all cells pass; vLLM parity is not claimed.

## AI model disclosure

`gpt-6-astra` with high reasoning effort prepared the H100 configuration, topology correction, runtime investigations and qualification. The coordinating agent's exact runtime model identifier was not exposed and could not be verified.

title: fix(speedbench-al): auto-PR commits golden AL matrix to golden_al_distribution/
body:
## Problem

The `speedbench-al.yml` workflow's `open-pr` step copies the measured AL matrix to `benchmarks/speedbench-reference-al.yaml` — a path that **does not exist on main** and is not consumed by anything. The canonical golden AL curves live in `golden_al_distribution/` and are referenced from:

- the README "Current golden curves" table,
- the AgentX methodology article (`packages/app/src/components/datasets/agentx-methodology-article.tsx`),
- the agentic throughput recipes (e.g. `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/qwen3.8next_fp4_b300_sglang_mtp.sh` → `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=2.32` from `golden_al_distribution/qwen3.8next_mtp.yaml`).

Because the auto-PR never landed the matrix in the right place, **every golden YAML to date (qwen3.8-flash-next included) had to be committed by hand**, with the `# Source GitHub Actions run:` header pasted in separately. This is the friction blocking a complete qwen3.8-flash-next AL distribution: the only successful run ([33034290269](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/33034290269)) collected `thinking=[on]`, `mtp=[1 2 3 4 5 6]` and was committed manually as a partial `qwen3.8next_mtp.yaml`.

## Fix

Rewrite the `open-pr` step so a completed collection run commits directly:

1. **Target filename**: resolve `golden_al_distribution/<model-prefix>_<spec-decoding>.yaml` with a new `golden-yaml-name` input override for non-standard suffixes.
2. **Source-run header**: prepend the `# Source GitHub Actions run:` line the collector does not emit, matching the canonical shape of the other curves.
3. **README table**: update the "Current golden curves" row in place (regex replace if the file already has one; insert before "## Primary references" otherwise).
4. **PR title/body**: describe the `golden_al_distribution/` commit and link the source run.

## Why not also add the missing thinking_off / mtp 7-8 cells for qwen3.8-flash-next?

Those cells require a **GPU collection run** on a B300 runner (the `speedbench-al.yml` workflow). I have only `pull` access to this org repo, so I cannot dispatch the workflow, and I will not fabricate acceptance-length values — every golden AL is a real SPEED-Bench measurement with an auditable Actions run behind it. This PR removes the manual-copy step so the next dispatch (`thinking-modes=off on`, `mtp-list=1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8`) lands the complete qwen3.8-flash-next matrix automatically.

## Verification

- `yaml.safe_load` on the workflow → parses cleanly.
- README-row regex tested against the real `golden_al_distribution/README.md`: matches and replaces the existing `qwen3.8next_mtp.yaml` row.
- Collector script and partial YAML unchanged; only the auto-PR plumbing changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Workflow YAML validates
- [x] Only `.github/workflows/speedbench-al.yml` changed
- [x] No fabricated AL values

title: Port MI355X DeepSeek V4 AgentX DSPARK to AMD-enabled srt-slurm
body:
## Scope

Port the now-merged upstream MI355X DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 AgentX DSPARK configuration using native srt-slurm v2. The old #3188 baseline is already present in current InferenceX main.

- Preserve the seven-point upstream sweep: TP4 at c4; TP8 at c16 without offload; TP8 with HiCache at c32/c48; TP8 with DP attention and UMBP at c128/c192/c256. Each point still allocates two nodes.
- Use the native cluster `model_paths` alias for the existing `/it-share/data/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813` checkpoint, as the production launcher did. The shared Hub cache is mounted at `/hf_hub_cache/hub`; no cache seeding or duplicate model download.
- Preserve the serving image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.19-rocm720-mi35x-20260913` and separate client image `...-20260907`.
- Preserve DSPARK block size 3, one speculative step, four verification tokens, DP LM-head support, throughput golden AL 3.01, real verification for evaluation, the FP4 indexer, role-specific memory/DP settings, and concurrency-scaled admission and decode graph ranges.
- One native srt-slurm recipe uses base/override variants for the four configurations. HiCache remains prefill-only at ratio 2.5; UMBP remains prefill-only with a 1.5 TB DRAM tier and no intermediate HiCache tier.
- UMBP uses srt-slurm's existing generic service on the prefill node: start before workers, track it as critical, and wait for the GPU-registration log marker. Its ROCm scratch-reclaim and hardware-queue settings match the original prefill launch environment. No engine patches.
- `launch_mi355x-amds.sh` remains the single cluster entrypoint. srt-slurm owns allocation, worker/router/service lifecycle, log streaming, and completion. The adapter in `infx.workflows.srt_slurm` maps CI inputs and collects results.
- Shared legacy removal and launcher/profile/adapter functionality live in #2542. This child adds only the AgentX master entry and recipe; `benchmark_serving.py` is unchanged.

## Orchestration differences

Native SGLang routing and MoRI replace the legacy launch/barrier/process coordination. Model, precision, capacity, MTP, and throughput settings are preserved; startup commands are not byte-identical. srt-slurm assigns its own endpoint/bootstrap ports and handles native-worker startup.

The existing upstream native SGLang backend adds `--skip-server-warmup` for disaggregation, avoiding a local synthetic warmup against a placeholder peer. This startup behavior is not introduced by the AMD stack. Canonical AgentX benchmark warmup is retained, and real P/D serving and evaluations must pass before validation is claimed.

The UMBP socket lives in the allocation-specific shared `/logs` mount so the service and worker containers can both access it. The host-memory capacity guard is preserved. One managed readiness deadline of 5400 seconds replaces three sequential 1800-second startup waits; workers still wait for the final GPU-registration marker, not merely a listening socket. A failed service is managed by srt-slurm.

Caller-owned runtime settings and the separate benchmark image are forwarded into the custom benchmark. Cluster RDMA checks and free-hugepage preparation retain the existing host-setup integration.

Synthetic acceptance is selected by the shared golden-curve connector instead of a hard-coded recipe value.

## Stack

Based directly on [shared AMD integration #2542](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/2542), which is rebased onto InferenceX `main` at `6c5eff0b8b699530a49c9f2c654cd03219914d01`. This child contains only its workload configs, schema-2 recipes, and append-only performance changelog entry. Shared launcher/profile/adapter changes live in #2542.

The base selects SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm `c3a5cecd5d4513aa69444323cd6bce668dcbdc88`: #1 → #11 → #7 → #14, synchronized with NVIDIA srt-slurm `712e174a9a64d4140cbeb3521b53a2c8ba7b8c81`. NVIDIA runners retain their existing runtime selection.

## Refresh status

Offline matrix validation: 7 topology/workload rows covering 7 benchmark concurrency points; all 14 prepared throughput/eval configurations pass the pinned runtime's schema/topology checks. The seven AgentX points retain concurrency-scaled admission/graphs and native UMBP service coordination.

No fresh E2E tests or sweeps were started or rerun. Sweep-trigger labels are removed. Historical runtime evidence is listed in the base PR and does not validate these new heads. Full GPU validation remains pending authorization; this refresh makes no new performance or merge-readiness claim.

## AI model disclosure

The exact AI model/version for this refresh is not exposed by the runtime and could not be verified. No subagents contributed to this refresh; earlier model identities are not reliably recorded.

title: perf(amd): tune MiniMax-M3 ATOM AgentX memory, graphs, indexer CP, and offload / 调优 MiniMax-M3 ATOM AgentX 显存、图捕获、Indexer CP 与卸载
body:
## Summary

Proxy the five commits from [yitingw1:atom/m3-agentic-recipe-0916](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/compare/main...yitingw1:InferenceX:atom/m3-agentic-recipe-0916), including the latest indexer-CP update, onto an upstream branch so the trusted AgentX CI can run.

Tune the MiniMax-M3 MXFP4 ATOM AgentX recipe on 8×MI355X:

- Raise `gpu-memory-utilization` from 0.90 to 0.95.
- Capture fine-grained CUDA graph sizes for the observed running-batch range.
- Enable indexer-only context parallelism for TP4 C15/C20/C24/C28/C32/C40/C48; the TP-size gate keeps it disabled for TP2 C20.
- Restore EAGLE3 at C40/C48.
- Add the TP2 C20/C25/C30 LMCache offload curve and derive lookup workers from TP.
- Spread offload ranks across NUMA nodes (`0,4` for TP2 and `0,1,4,5` for TP4).
- Remove dead per-band assignments, the unusable hybrid state-offload tier, and unused C56 handling.
- Move to `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609161144-yitingw1-opt_m3_dense_splits` and record LMCache `0.5.5rc3+rocm7.2.4` on both offload arms.

The source commits retain Wang Yiting's authorship. The upstream-only commits append the required performance changelog entry and carry the isolated priority-classifier fix already developed in #2912 (exact base/head diff context and a 16-turn structured classification budget). The first run demonstrated the existing 8-turn failure mode and fell back to patchwork priority before any GPU job started.

## Matrix

| Arm | Concurrency | Configuration |
|---|---|---|
| TP4 resident | 1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 24, 28, 32 | EAGLE3 K3, golden AL 2.78; indexer CP at C15/C20/C24/C28/C32 |
| TP2 resident | 1, 2 | EAGLE3 K3, golden AL 2.78 |
| TP2 DRAM offload | 20, 25, 30 | LMCache chunk 256 + `ATOM_SLRU`; indexer CP disabled; GPUs `0,4` |
| TP4 DRAM offload | 40, 48 | LMCache chunk 256 + `ATOM_SLRU`; EAGLE3 + indexer CP; GPUs `0,1,4,5` |

The PR sweep is throughput-only (`no-evals: true`) to avoid vendor-eval fan-out. Exactly one representative TP4 C48 offload eval is dispatched separately; [run 35114649037](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35114649037) covered the previous head and will be replaced by a run against this updated head.

## Validation and measured evidence

- Local Bash syntax, YAML parsing, and strict matrix generation pass; the configuration generates 19 AgentX throughput jobs.
- TP4 C24 fine-grained CUDA graphs: throughput +9.2%, interactivity +50.7%, with unchanged estimated graph memory.
- Expanded TP4 indexer CP, same-commit 1,800 s A/B pairs: C15/C24/C28 interactivity +3.7%/+12.3%/+16.7% and ISL-normalized throughput +0.67%/+0.24%/+2.7%. C20 is interpolated between C15 and C24, not directly measured; matched prefix-hit rates rule out a cache artifact.
- TP4 C32 indexer CP: ITL P50 -37.8%; throughput +14.6% raw / +11.0% ISL-normalized; TTFT P50 -1.2%.
- CP correctness: 9/9 points bit-identical across four ranks with real collectives, up to 315K context.
- TP2 offload C20/C25/C30: 48,850 / 60,124 / 60,288 tok/s/chip at interactivity 66.0 / 50.3 / 40.6.
- GPU memory utilization 0.95 completed two real-replay TP4 runs without OOM.
- TP2 NUMA-spread host-memory pinning improved from 45 minutes to 21 seconds, with unchanged throughput.

## Known limitations

- EAGLE3 at C40/C48 is inferred from measured forward-step behavior but has not yet been measured end to end.
- TP4 NUMA-split throughput validation is still running; cross-socket all-reduce may affect the result.
- C20 indexer CP is interpolated between measured C15 and C24; nothing below C15 is enabled because it has not been measured and the kernel microbenchmark is negative near batch 2.
- Offload measurements used LMCache 0.4.5; the new image contains 0.5.5rc3. API compatibility was checked, but behavior has not yet been re-measured.
- `allocated_cpu_dram_gb` / `dram-utilization: 0.20` does not describe the recipe's actual 256 GB per-rank allocation: 512 GB at TP2 and 1,024 GB at TP4. This is kept unchanged because the reported measurements used that allocation.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

本 PR 将 yiting 的五个提交（包括最新的 indexer CP 扩展）原样转推到 InferenceX 上游分支，以便使用可信的 AgentX CI。原始提交保留 Wang Yiting 的作者信息；上游额外提交追加仓库要求的性能 changelog，并复用 #2912 中独立的优先级分类器修复（提供精确 base/head diff 上下文并允许 16 turns）。首轮已复现现有 8-turn 分类失败，在 GPU 任务开始前回退为 patchwork 优先级。

主要变化包括：将 GPU 显存利用率提高到 0.95；按真实运行 batch 增加细粒度 CUDA graph；在 TP4 C15/C20/C24/C28/C32/C40/C48 启用 indexer-only CP（TP2 C20 由 TP-size gate 保持关闭）；C40/C48 恢复 EAGLE3；新增 TP2 C20/C25/C30 的 LMCache SLRU offload 曲线；按 TP 生成 lookup worker；offload 时将 TP2 放到 GPU `0,4`、TP4 放到 `0,1,4,5`；删除无效的 per-band 赋值、不可用的 hybrid state-offload 分支和未使用的 C56；更新到 20260916 的 ATOM rocm7 镜像及 LMCache 0.5.5rc3。

PR sweep 仅运行 19 个吞吐任务（`no-evals: true`），避免展开整套 vendor eval；另单独运行且只运行一个具有代表性的 TP4 C48 offload eval。旧 head 的 [run 35114649037](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35114649037) 已通过，新 head 会重新跑一次并替换这里的链接。

本地 Bash、YAML 与严格矩阵生成均通过，共生成 19 个 AgentX 吞吐任务。附件中记录的 A/B 结果包括：TP4 C24 细粒度图吞吐 +9.2%、交互性 +50.7%；同提交、每 arm 1,800 秒的 indexer CP A/B 中，C15/C24/C28 交互性分别 +3.7%/+12.3%/+16.7%，ISL 归一化吞吐分别 +0.67%/+0.24%/+2.7%，C20 为 C15 与 C24 之间的插值而非直接测量；TP4 C32 indexer CP 的 ITL P50 降低 37.8%，ISL 归一化吞吐提高 11.0%；TP2 offload C20/C25/C30 分别达到 48,850 / 60,124 / 60,288 tok/s/chip；TP2 跨 NUMA 放置将主机内存 pinning 从 45 分钟缩短到 21 秒。

已知限制保持公开：C40/C48 的 EAGLE3 尚未完成端到端测量；TP4 跨 NUMA 的吞吐对比仍在运行；C20 的 CP 效果来自 C15/C24 插值，C15 以下因未测且 kernel microbenchmark 在 batch 约 2 时为负而不启用；offload 数字来自 LMCache 0.4.5，而新镜像为 0.5.5rc3；实际 CPU DRAM 固定为每 rank 256 GB，与 `dram-utilization: 0.20` 元数据不一致（TP2 实际 512 GB、TP4 实际 1,024 GB）。

</details>


## Changelog sync update

Two items from the perf-changelog entry supersede or extend the text above:

- **`dram-utilization` corrected to `0.687`.** This makes the recorded budget match the real per-rank pinning: `LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_CPU_SIZE = TOTAL_CPU_DRAM_GB / TP` resolves to ~256 GB per rank on both offload arms (512 GB total at TP2, 1,024 GB at TP4), independent of TP. It replaces the earlier `dram-utilization: 0.20` metadata noted under "Known limitations", which under-described the allocation.
- **EAGLE3-GQA draft online-quant verification (ATOM commit `b6e2a39433d73b586c366ca90e661f098eb463e3`).** `--online_quant_config ptpc_fp8` does **not** change the `Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA` draft precision. `atom/models/eagle3_llama.py` builds every draft linear (`qkv_proj`, `o_proj`, `gate_up_proj`, `down_proj`, `fc`) with no `quant_config`, so `should_stream_online_quant` short-circuits to `False` and `OnlineQuantStreamer.maybe_create` finds no streaming candidates. The EAGLE3 draft loads and runs at its native bf16 checkpoint precision; only the target MiniMax-M3 weights are online-quantized to `ptpc_fp8`, and the `exclude_layer` list applies to the target alone.

title: [B300][SGLang][AgentX] Improve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash performance
body:
Add B300 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash AgentX with SGLang DSpark at TP2/EP2 and TP4/EP4, covering concurrency 1–128. Pin the latest official CUDA nightly `nightly-dev-cu13-20260922-582389ce` to amd64 digest `35ea4d321b0735051dcce2599fc495853ad1ef30f6a1908f0a75e74204362d14`.

- Preserve shipped-default DSpark precision and automatic model backends. Use thinking-on DSpark5, the existing measured AL 3.51 for throughput, and real verification for accuracy.
- Keep Engram tables in per-rank host mappings with native FP8 payload and GPU-resident KV. Scale retained SWA tails to `64 × concurrency`, bounded to 128–4096; use 4096-token prefill chunks, prefill/decode interval 4 at TP2 C32+ and 16 elsewhere, and decode graphs capped at batch 64.
- Use static memory 0.70 except TP2 C16 at 0.80 and C32+ at 0.85. Prefetch checkpoints from shared Lustre.
- Scope the Slurm batch/PMIx workaround to this B300 SGLang AgentX lane, retaining normal GPU allocation, log streaming and terminal-status checks. Mount the runtime at `/ix` to preserve the image’s editable SGLang installation.
- Add exactly one performance changelog entry. No STP points are selected.

## Measured evidence

| Test | Logical tokens/s/GPU | p90 interactivity | Result |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| [TP2 C16, normal warmup and 3600-second measurement](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35682688853) | 54,233.16 | 161.10 | Entire workflow passed; 2,536 profiled requests, zero errors, valid power; 99.96% TTFT / 100% ITL coverage |
| [Published vLLM, same TP2 C16](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34897575633) | 54,600.25 | 156.99 | SGLang is 0.67% lower in throughput and 2.62% higher in interactivity |
| [TP2 C64, memory 0.80, 20-minute screen](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35677548685) | 84,921.67 | 96.78 | Zero errors |
| [TP2 C64, memory 0.85, matched 20-minute screen](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35683226899) | 98,173.64 | 90.70 | +15.6% throughput / −6.3% interactivity; zero errors |

The 0.85 setting increases the measured TP2 full-context pool from 18.29M to 26.84M tokens while leaving SWA capacity unchanged and 30.01 GiB free after graph capture. [Full TP2 C128 GSM8K at 0.85 passed](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35683228888): all 1,319 examples, 97.35% flexible-extract / 97.42% strict-match. [TP2 0.80 and TP4 0.70 also passed full GSM8K](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35680969828); TP4 scored 97.04% / 97.12%.

Short screens are candidate comparisons, not full-duration vLLM parity evidence. The pinned AgentX harness retains child-session replay and includes child requests in its totals; earlier C1 exports completed eight child sessions and captured 42 child requests per point.

## Remaining qualification

[TP4 host-Engram screens](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35676434285) remain slow despite high prefix reuse: C1 measured 3,979.38 / 74.86, C16 11,098.35 / 50.39, and C64 12,560.02 / 40.05. Read-only NVLink/P2P, PCIe, CPU affinity, NUMA and huge-page checks passed. A matched same-node replay/profile showed similar behavior on September 21 and 22 images, so there is no isolated image-cause finding.

The GPU-resident Engram candidate was rejected. Its C16 screen completed at 10,694.37 logical tokens/s/GPU and 43.10 p90 interactivity, with 375 successful requests, zero errors and valid power: 3.64% less throughput and 14.46% less interactivity than the host-table baseline. Full nonempty input configurations match; placement and memory changed together on different nodes. At C1, 3,990.98 / 96.77 represents 0.29% higher throughput and 29.28% higher interactivity than host tables, but remains dominated by selected TP2 C1. Retain host Engram for TP4. The rejected candidate’s queued workflow tests and replacement accuracy fallback were cancelled; completed evidence is preserved.

The [TP2 C64 interval-4 screen](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35687394139) is fully green at **110,322.88 logical tokens/s/GPU /47.83 p90**, with 2,045 successful requests, zero errors, valid power and 100% duration coverage. Its matched interval-16 baseline is 98,173.64/90.70: **+12.38% throughput /−47.27% interactivity**. The completed ordinary Slurm replication 4843 reached 113,556.80/48.98 with 2,082 successful requests, zero errors, valid power and 99.97%/100% coverage. Both complete exported input configurations exactly match the interval-16 baseline. This is a throughput/interactivity tradeoff, not a win on both metrics or canonical parity proof.

Retain interval 4 as the high-concurrency TP2 saturation candidate; TP4 and TP2 C1–C16 remain at 16. [Full C128 GSM8K qualification](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35739874597) passed at **97.50% strict /97.42% flexible**, all 1,319 original/effective questions and no sample limit; the entire workflow is green. The integrated head `d4c38818ce6eb20093b7f6cc7ba860522ef41632` is synced with main `6c5eff0b8b699530a49c9f2c654cd03219914d01`; final selection must be assessed from the full curve.

Bash checks, actual recipe argument/acceptance checks, launcher success/failure propagation, paths containing spaces, matrix generation and changelog validation pass. The current plan expands to **16 performance + 16 accuracy jobs**, with one changelog entry. The interval-4 accuracy gate passed; `full-sweep-enabled` and `all-evals` launched the [final canonical sweep](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35743388889) on the integrated head. A fully green canonical sweep remains required; whole-curve vLLM parity is not established. No merge is requested.

## AI model disclosure

`gpt-6-astra`, high reasoning: requested platform and H200 continuation agents contributed recipe implementation, investigation, validation and final integration. The effective runtime model identifier could not be independently verified. Coordinator: integration, runtime fixes, validation and dispatch; its exact runtime model identifier could not be verified.

title: [B200][SGLang][AgentX] Improve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash performance
body:
B200 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash loses reusable sliding-window prefixes under concurrent AgentX traffic. This change scales SWA prefix capacity, keeps Engram in per-rank host shards, and pins official SGLang `nightly-dev-cu13-20260922-582389ce` by digest. Every point uses shipped-default DSpark precision, interval 16, and the committed five-token golden AL 3.51. Accuracy uses real verification.

| Topology | Concurrency | Static fraction | Prefill chunk | SWA tails |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| TP4/EP4 | 1–128, powers of two | 0.80 | 4096 | 64 × concurrency, bounded to 128–4096 |
| TP2/EP2 | 1, 2, 4, 8 | 0.92 | 2048 | 128 × concurrency |

TP2 uses the unmodified stock loader with expandable allocator segments and a pinned-source hash check. The previous loader patch and waiver are removed. The B200 launcher translates pinned Docker digests to its installed Enroot syntax and stops on import failure. Exactly one performance changelog entry is added.

The checkpoint is `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`, cached revision `dba1be0a40aa45a94ad051997016db3960a90277`. Its embedded DSpark head runs through the pinned image's default handling, including native Markov BF16 and upstream FP8 `wo_a`→BF16 conversion. No draft precision override or custom draft patch is applied.

## Validation and measured results

[Canonical attempt 1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35683233478/attempts/1) completed **all 12 performance jobs and all 12 full GSM8K evaluations** on PR head `f6e7873ff09337d7ad768ced6e2d0ea2e4236d26`. Every eval contains **1,319 examples**, scoring **97.04–97.88% strict exact match**. All performance aggregates report zero errors.

**Power qualification remains pending for TP2 C2.** Its job was green, but artifact review found `power_valid=0` from a 14.296-second telemetry gap on both GPUs. The other 11 points have valid power. [Attempt 2](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35683233478/attempts/2) reruns only the affected performance job at the same commit; the passing results and all accuracy evaluations are retained. No source change was needed.

Measured total tokens/s/GPU / p90 interactivity:

| Concurrency | TP2/EP2 | TP4/EP4 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 11,686.19 / 364.35 | 6,834.69 / 484.75 |
| 2 | 11,728.32 / 337.34† | 6,888.43 / 458.92 |
| 4 | 16,571.51 / 302.55 | 9,205.80 / 433.72 |
| 8 | 29,578.30 / 219.42 | 15,656.91 / 333.40 |
| 16 | — | 28,203.42 / 205.87 |
| 32 | — | 53,603.75 / 142.85 |
| 64 | — | 61,922.44 / 97.47 |
| 128 | — | 4,775.33 / 180.67 |

† Awaiting the same-head power retry; this is not a qualified power result.

TP4 C1–C8 exceed published same-TP/C vLLM in both metrics: throughput gains **0.71–4.85%**, interactivity gains **13.35–17.10%**. TP2 C1 remains **6.66% / 3.08%** below vLLM throughput/interactivity; C8 remains **2.57% / 5.43%** below. The maximum measured SGLang throughput is **61,922 tok/s/GPU**, versus published vLLM **92,086**. Higher interactivity at some high-load points is a tradeoff, not whole-frontier parity. **Full vLLM frontier parity is not established.**

The [published vLLM reference](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35480787586/attempts/1) uses the same canonical 3,600-second profile, 10 warmup requests per lane, 393 trace entries, seed 42, and block-5 golden AL 3.51. It has its own engine image and EP1 topology, versus SGLang EP=TP. This is a published reference comparison, not a simultaneous engine A/B.

## Bounded experiments and selection

- Keep block 5: matched latest-image [block 4](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35681496007) loses both TP2 C1 metrics against [block 5](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35681497714). C8 trades 0.63% throughput for 0.80% interactivity, insufficient single-run evidence to change the selected recipe. Block 4 passed [full real-verification GSM8K](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35681499154), but accuracy alone does not establish a performance benefit.
- Exclude TP2 C16: [canonical probe](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35693407052) at the proven C8 serving capacity achieved **4,974.23 / 188.97**, with **24.17% cache reuse**, 289 successful requests, zero errors, 17 drain cancellations, 100% metric coverage and valid power. It is dominated by C8. It is not part of this PR and no accuracy qualification is claimed for it. The standalone fallback stopped automatically when this official job was admitted.

Bash syntax, diff checks, append-only changelog and matrix validation passed. PR remains ready with `full-sweep-enabled` and `all-evals`. The image was rechecked against Docker Hub at **2026-09-22 14:14 UTC** and remains the latest official CUDA nightly. Final power retry is pending; do not merge.

Reference: [official SGLang cookbook](https://lmsysorg.mintlify.app/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4_1).

title: [Klaud Cold] Add MI300X TP4 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vLLM AgentX arm with Engram host offload / 新增 Engram 主机卸载的 MI300X TP4 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vLLM AgentX 臂
body:
> **Update (2026-09-22): the TP2 arm has been removed — measured infeasible.**
> Run [35671005506](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35671005506) ran TP2 at concurrency 1 and the engine refused to start:
> `Available KV cache memory: -13.51 GiB` → `No available memory for the cache blocks`.
> That is with the indexer buffer already halved to 4096 batched tokens. A 192 GB card cannot hold ~145 GiB/rank of Engram-offloaded weights and still leave a usable 1M-context KV pool. Raising `gpu-memory-utilization` to 0.95 recovers ~9 GiB and halving the buffer again ~4 GiB, which still leaves effectively no KV — so the arm is removed rather than tuned.
> **TP8 and TP4 are unaffected and remain.** TP4 passed at concurrency 1 and 32 in that same run, at ~81 GiB/rank. MI325X runs the TP2 configuration successfully on its larger 256 GB card ([#3337](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3337), merged).

---

## Summary

Try DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on MI300X at **TP4 and TP2** with the Engram tables offloaded to pinned host memory, alongside the existing TP8 arm which keeps them GPU-resident.

MI300X carries 192 GB per card. The offloaded per-rank resident weight footprint follows the fitted model `256 GiB / TP + 17.2 GiB`, validated on the Blackwell arms:

| TP | resident weights / rank | indexer buffer | headroom on a 192 GB card |
|----|------------------------|----------------|---------------------------|
| 8  | 49.2 GiB (tables resident, so higher in practice) | 16 GiB | large |
| 4  | 81.2 GiB | 16 GiB | comfortable |
| 2  | 145.2 GiB | 8 GiB | tight, hence the caps |

TP2 is the interesting case and the reason this is an experiment rather than a settled recipe. At ~145 GiB of weights per rank the KV pool is the smallest of any arm in this recipe, so the TP2 path halves the sparse-attention indexer buffer to 4096 batched tokens, scales `max-num-seqs` to `2*CONC` clamped to `[16, 256]`, and caps cudagraph capture at 512. That is exactly the cap set the Blackwell TP2 arms validated on B200, GB200 and GB300. The TP2 concurrency list stops at 8 for the same reason.

## Changes

- `configs/amd-master.yaml`: add `tp: 4` (concurrency 1 to 32) and `tp: 2` (concurrency 1 to 8) rows beside the existing `tp: 8` row, and repin the image.
- `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/dsv41flash_fp4_mi300x_mtp.sh`: set `--engram-config` per TP (offload below TP8, resident at TP8), add the TP2 cap block, and add `--no-swa-bounded-replay`.

The image moves off the expired `nightly-eed1f3d0` tag to `nightly-3df4ae15`, the same commit the MI355X arm uses. It carries [vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491), which widened two `is_cuda()` gates to `is_cuda_alike()` so `engram_config` resolves on gfx942. Because that change also makes `cpu_offload` default on through `VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD`, the recipe now sets the value explicitly per TP rather than inheriting a default that would silently move the TP8 tables to host memory.

`--no-swa-bounded-replay` is carried over pre-emptively: [vllm-project/vllm#56227](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56227) turned SWA bounded replay on by default between the two pins and relies on a window clamp the ROCm sparse SWA path does not have. That crashed every gfx950 point with `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT`, and gfx942 runs the same path. Prefix caching stays on.

## Relationship to the TP4-only PR

[#3332](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3332) adds TP4 alone on this SKU. This PR supersedes it if both go green. Note that #3332 cannot currently be validated: the MI300X Slurm fleet has been unreachable since 2026-08-28, with all nine compute nodes `down*`, so its sweep sits permanently queued. This PR will hit the same wall until that cluster returns.

## Test plan

- [ ] Full sweep: TP8 at concurrency 1 to 32, TP4 at 1 to 32, TP2 at 1 to 8.
- [ ] Confirm the TP8 curve still matches the validated concurrency 1 to 32 run, so the image repin and the explicit `cpu_offload: false` are neutral there.
- [ ] Confirm TP2 reaches a usable KV pool rather than OOMing at engine init.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

## 摘要

在 MI300X 上尝试 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的 **TP4 与 TP2** 配置，将 Engram 表卸载到固定页主机内存，同时保留 Engram 表驻留 GPU 的现有 TP8 臂。

MI300X 每张卡 192 GB。卸载后每 rank 常驻权重遵循已在 Blackwell 臂上验证的拟合模型 `256 GiB / TP + 17.2 GiB`：TP4 约 81 GiB，TP2 约 145 GiB。

TP2 是本 PR 的重点，也是它属于实验而非定型配方的原因。约 145 GiB 权重使其 KV 池为本配方中最小，因此 TP2 路径将稀疏注意力 indexer 缓冲区减半至 4096 batched tokens，`max-num-seqs` 取 `2*CONC` 并夹在 `[16, 256]`，cudagraph capture 上限 512。这组参数与 Blackwell TP2 臂在 B200、GB200、GB300 上验证过的完全一致。TP2 并发列表止于 8，原因相同。

## 改动

- `configs/amd-master.yaml`：在现有 `tp: 8` 行旁新增 `tp: 4`（并发 1 至 32）与 `tp: 2`（并发 1 至 8）行，并重新固定镜像。
- `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/dsv41flash_fp4_mi300x_mtp.sh`：按 TP 设置 `--engram-config`（TP8 驻留，低于 TP8 卸载），新增 TP2 收紧逻辑，并加入 `--no-swa-bounded-replay`。

镜像从已失效的 `nightly-eed1f3d0` 迁移到 `nightly-3df4ae15`，与 MI355X 臂相同。该镜像包含 [vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491)，使 `engram_config` 在 gfx942 上可解析；由于其同时让 `cpu_offload` 通过 `VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD` 默认开启，配方现按 TP 显式设置该值，以免 TP8 的表被悄然移至主机内存。

`--no-swa-bounded-replay` 为预防性携带：[vllm-project/vllm#56227](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56227) 将 SWA bounded replay 默认开启，其依赖的 window clamp 在 ROCm sparse SWA 路径中缺失，曾使所有 gfx950 数据点以 `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT` 崩溃，而 gfx942 使用同一路径。prefix caching 保持开启。

## 与 TP4 单独 PR 的关系

[#3332](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3332) 仅新增 TP4。若两者均通过，本 PR 取代之。注意 #3332 目前无法验证：MI300X Slurm 集群自 2026-08-28 起全部九个计算节点 `down*`，其扫描永久排队。本 PR 在该集群恢复前会遇到同样的阻塞。

## 测试计划

- [ ] 完整扫描：TP8 并发 1 至 32，TP4 并发 1 至 32，TP2 并发 1 至 8。
- [ ] 确认 TP8 曲线与已验证的并发 1 至 32 运行一致，以证明镜像重固定与显式 `cpu_offload: false` 在该臂为中性改动。
- [ ] 确认 TP2 能获得可用的 KV 池，而非在引擎初始化时 OOM。

title: feat: validate ATOM and Infera on MI300X and MI355X
body:
## Summary

This stacked validation PR exercises the combined AMD platform work plus ATOM backend and Infera routing support from SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm#3 on MI300X and MI355X.

It intentionally uses Qwen3-0.6B and short fixed-sequence workloads to validate orchestration, routing, KV transfer, cleanup, and artifact collection rather than tune performance.

## Dependency structure

- Base InferenceX AMD integration: #2542
- Combined srt-slurm implementation: https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm/pull/3
- Infera ATOM KV-event decoder: https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Infera/pull/114
- ATOM deterministic Mooncake TCP selection: https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/pull/1866

Current runtime pins:

- srt-slurm `5ecfb13d1ba0960045482f1ef006312d8729d37a`
- Infera `8ed8f1728c745d4e91ba9eaa09ed81159aa57e41`
- stable ATOM overlay `2ab42bc2c64d1ad04f698c396da48473e71a6dbb`

## Configurations

For both MI300X and MI355X:

- aggregate: one node, two independent TP1 ATOM workers behind Infera KV-aware routing
- disaggregated: two nodes, one TP1 prefill worker plus one TP1 decode worker, Mooncake TCP KV transfer
- c1 and c4 fixed-sequence points, ISL 128 / OSL 32
- exact framework identity checks and uploaded benchmark, power-audit, and multinode server-log artifacts

The launcher mounts the pinned Infera and ATOM sources over the stable `rocm/infera:atom-v0.1.1` image so validation is reproducible without rebuilding the container.

## Implementation and local validation

- MI300X and MI355X launcher contract tests: 11 passed.
- Workflow gating tests: 42 passed.
- Both launchers pass `bash -n`.
- Changed YAML parses and the generated matrix contains only the requested ATOM/Infera rows.
- `git diff --check` passes.
- The E2E dispatcher now restores the missing `EVALS` assignment and has a regression test ensuring every emitted matrix variable is defined. This fixes the previously red wrapper where all materialized workload jobs were green.

## Hardware evidence

### MI300X

[Run 31524554022](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/31524554022), exact tested head `f9bdbe1c583182be2071c99fe0bb22cdcb68efb7`:

- [Aggregate job 93889668083](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/31524554022/job/93889668083): Slurm 11836 `COMPLETED 0:0`; two workers registered; c1/c4 succeeded; 25 HTTP 200 responses; no fatal server markers.
- [1P/1D job 93889668107](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/31524554022/job/93889668107): Slurm 11835 `COMPLETED 0:0`; 25/25 producer writes, 25/25 decode first-token injections, two TCP transports, zero RDMA installs, and zero registration/transfer/socket failures.
- Aggregate router logs show both ATOM KV-event subscriptions, zero wire-decode errors, and KV-aware decisions progressing from 0 to 6 to 14 cached blocks.

### MI355X

- [1P/1D run 31523759856](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/31523759856), [job 93887067116](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/31523759856/job/93887067116): Slurm 38524 `COMPLETED 0:0`; 25/25 writes, 25/25 decode injections, two TCP transports, zero RDMA installs, zero transfer failures; c1/c4 results and logs uploaded.
- [Aggregate run 31524668094](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/31524668094), [job 93890045967](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/31524668094/job/93890045967): Slurm 38526 `COMPLETED 0:0`; two workers registered; c1/c4 succeeded; artifacts uploaded.

The prior MI355X attempt that returned HTTP 200 but failed every KV write is not counted as success. Its root cause was Mooncake selecting RDMA after HCA discovery despite `protocol=tcp`. Exact corrected runs inject `MC_FORCE_TCP=true`; their uploaded logs prove TCP installation and clean KV transfer.

## Current head

PR head is `eb814bbf0894e17132d43b241e4671388e698ba9`. The hardware-tested runtime content is unchanged from `f9bdbe1`; the final commit only repairs the E2E matrix output and adds its regression test. Final-head workflow proof: https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/31526765208 completed SUCCESS, including matrix generation, the MI300X aggregate workload, result collection, and success-rate calculation.

title: [AgentX GB200] enable Kimi-K3 power on the remaining recipes and re-sweep the full curve / 为剩余配方启用实测功耗并重跑完整曲线
body:
## Description

The four GB200 Kimi-K3 AgentX recipes without power collection (`agg-tp16-latency`, `agg-tep16-balanced`, `agg-dep16`, `agg-dep16-vllm-simple-offload`) now carry the `telemetry:` block from #3045 at the fleet-standard 1000 ms / 2 s, the same cadence as the seven GB200 Kimi-K3 recipes that already pass the power gate. Also keeps `infx.results.power` importable under the runners' python3.10.

Those four recipes are the single `kimik3-fp4-gb200-dynamo-vllm-agentic` key. AgentX resolves one curve per hardware, so the changelog selects all four GB200 keys and the sweep re-measures all 31 points.

**What [run 35492708340](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492708340) (head `5338791`, which already included the 500 ms / 1 s commit `885d227`) showed.** 19 of 31 jobs failed, in three groups:

- **10 power-gated.** The benchmark completed and only publication validation failed, with `sample_gap_exceeded`: TP16 c1/c2/c4/c8, TEP16 c16/c24/c32, vllm-simple c192, tp8pp2-mooncake c72/c96.
- **8 DEP16 OOM.** DEP16 c32/c64/c96/c128/c256 and vllm-simple c128/c256/c384 — every point of the two recipes that set `max-num-batched-tokens: 16384`.
- **1 client abort.** tp8pp2-mooncake-mtp c16 ended in `ProfileAborted` with `measurement_window_incomplete`, no OOM and no worker crash in any of its 16 logs. It is an aiperf-side abort, not an engine failure.

`endpoint_http_error` appears in all 29 power manifests, passing jobs included; it is the collector's first polls racing the exporter start and does not gate.

**The gated points.** All misses are on the head node, whose dcgm-exporter shares the node with the frontend, NATS/etcd, the AIPerf client and the collector; it answers in 1.0–1.6 s under load (`max_scrape_duration_seconds` on the passing 1000/2 lanes, 242 `write: broken pipe` late responses in the TP16 c1 exporter log). A 1 s request timeout turns that tail into repeated misses, and the collector is fixed-cadence, so the "sleeps after each scrape" premise behind 500/1 was wrong as well. This PR restores 1000/2 (`e318545`).

Restoring the cadence is not sufficient on its own: `_check_coverage` voids a window as soon as one device's largest gap passes `MAX_SAMPLE_GAP_SECONDS`, with no budget, so a single late scrape still discards every GPU of the job. `b63c1768` adds a ceiling plus a fractional budget and pins the matching producer change, [SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm#23](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm/pull/23), until it merges. The pin advances exactly one commit from main's `984180e5`. That change also covers the tp8pp2-mooncake c72/c96 stalls, which no longer need separate srt-slurm work.

**The DEP16 OOM.** FlashInfer's MXFP4 MoE workspace is allocated per forward, outside the memory profiler's budget, and scales with the batch's token count. At 16384 it requested 3.64 GiB against 3.50 GiB free (177.50 of 184.00 GiB in use) and killed rank DP1/TP3/EP7 24 minutes into DEP16 c32; the surviving ranks then hung in a collective until the NCCL heartbeat monitor aborted the job, which is why these read as mid-run engine deaths rather than allocation failures. TP4/DP4 keeps four times the non-expert weights per GPU that a TP16 recipe does, so the headroom the larger chunk needs is not there — `agg-tep16-balanced` and `agg-tp16-latency` run the same kernel at 8192 and complete. `1731889` drops both DEP16 recipes to 8192, which every surviving GB200 recipe already uses and which leaves KV cache capacity untouched. This supersedes the memory follow-up in #3322.

**Testing:** changelog, matrix plan (31 benchmark + 31 eval jobs), `utils/test_gb200_k3_telemetry_budget.py` and the python-floor tests pass locally. For the gap budget, `utils/test_aggregate_power_multinode.py` passes with five added cases, the four retained H200 power packages of run 35532102407 replay as expected through the patched `_check_coverage`, and the producer side is 131 passed with the constants byte-identical on both sides. The OOM classification above is read from the retained artifacts of DEP16 c32 and vllm-simple c128; the other six share both the recipe and the signature. Neither fix has been exercised on GB200 yet — that is what this full sweep is for.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

GB200 上还没有功耗采集的四个 Kimi-K3 AgentX 配方（`agg-tp16-latency`、`agg-tep16-balanced`、`agg-dep16`、`agg-dep16-vllm-simple-offload`）现在使用 #3045 的 `telemetry:` 配置，采用集群标准的 1000 ms / 2 s，与已通过功耗闸门的七个 GB200 Kimi-K3 配方一致。同时修复 `infx.results.power` 在 runner 的 python3.10 下无法导入的问题。

这四个配方就是 `kimik3-fp4-gb200-dynamo-vllm-agentic` 这一个 key。AgentX 每个硬件只解析出一条曲线，因此 changelog 选中全部四个 GB200 key，sweep 重测 31 个点。

**[Run 35492708340](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492708340)（head `5338791`，已包含 500 ms / 1 s 的 `885d227`）的实际结果。** 31 个 job 中 19 个失败，分三类：

- **10 个被功耗闸门拦下。** benchmark 已跑完，只在发布校验因 `sample_gap_exceeded` 失败：TP16 c1/c2/c4/c8、TEP16 c16/c24/c32、vllm-simple c192、tp8pp2-mooncake c72/c96。
- **8 个 DEP16 OOM。** DEP16 c32/c64/c96/c128/c256 与 vllm-simple c128/c256/c384——恰好是设置了 `max-num-batched-tokens: 16384` 的两个配方的全部点。
- **1 个客户端中止。** tp8pp2-mooncake-mtp c16 以 `ProfileAborted` 结束，伴随 `measurement_window_incomplete`，其 16 份日志中既无 OOM 也无 worker crash。这是 aiperf 侧的中止，不是引擎失败。

`endpoint_http_error` 出现在全部 29 个功耗 manifest 中（含通过的 job），是采集器首轮轮询早于 exporter 就绪的记录，不参与闸门判定。

**被拦下的点。** 所有 miss 都在头节点上，其 dcgm-exporter 与 frontend、NATS/etcd、AIPerf 客户端和采集器共用该节点，负载下响应 1.0–1.6 s（通过的 1000/2 lane 的 `max_scrape_duration_seconds`；TP16 c1 的 exporter 日志有 242 条 `write: broken pipe` 迟到响应）。1 s 超时把这条长尾变成反复 miss；而采集器是固定节奏的，500/1 所依据的"每次抓取后再 sleep"前提也不成立。本 PR 恢复 1000/2（`e318545`）。

只恢复节奏并不够：`_check_coverage` 只要某个设备的最大间隙超过 `MAX_SAMPLE_GAP_SECONDS` 就判废整个窗口，且没有任何预算，因此一次迟到的 scrape 仍会作废该作业所有 GPU 的数据。`b63c1768` 增加了一个上限加一个按比例的预算，并在生产端改动 [SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm#23](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm/pull/23) 合入前先 pin 该提交；pin 相对 main 的 `984180e5` 只前进一个 commit。该改动同时覆盖 tp8pp2-mooncake c72/c96 的停顿，这两个点不再需要单独的 srt-slurm 工作。

**DEP16 的 OOM。** FlashInfer 的 MXFP4 MoE workspace 按每次 forward 分配，不在内存 profiler 的预算内，且大小随 batch 的 token 数增长。在 16384 下它申请 3.64 GiB，而当时只剩 3.50 GiB free（184.00 GiB 中已占用 177.50 GiB），在 DEP16 c32 开跑 24 分钟后杀掉了 DP1/TP3/EP7 这个 rank；其余 rank 随后卡在集合通信上，直到 NCCL 心跳监控终止作业——这也是它们表现为运行中途引擎死亡、而非一次分配失败的原因。TP4/DP4 每张卡驻留的非专家权重是 TP16 配方的四倍，没有更大 chunk 所需的余量——`agg-tep16-balanced` 与 `agg-tp16-latency` 在 8192 下运行同一个 kernel 且能跑完。`1731889` 把两个 DEP16 配方降到 8192，这正是所有存活的 GB200 配方已在使用的值，且不影响 KV cache 容量。此项取代 #3322 中的显存后续工作。

**测试：** changelog、矩阵规划（31 个 benchmark + 31 个 eval 作业）、`utils/test_gb200_k3_telemetry_budget.py` 以及 python 版本下限测试在本地通过。gap 预算方面，`utils/test_aggregate_power_multinode.py` 新增五例后全部通过，run 35532102407 留存的四个 H200 功耗包在打过补丁的 `_check_coverage` 下回放结果符合预期，生产端 131 passed 且两侧常量逐字一致。上述 OOM 分类读自 DEP16 c32 与 vllm-simple c128 的留存产物，其余六个点配方与特征均相同。两项修复都尚未在 GB200 上验证过——这正是本次完整 sweep 的目的。

</details>

## Related Issue

Follows #3045; supersedes the memory follow-up in #3322 / 承接 #3045；取代 #3322 中的显存后续工作。
