title: [GB200][SGLang][AgentX] Improve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash performance
body:
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash AgentX lost prefix reuse on GB200 because the default SWA tail reserve exhausted while full-context KV remained available. This recipe retains bounded SWA tails and uses the latest official SGLang nightly with shipped-default DSpark precision.

- Pin CUDA 13 nightly `20260922-582389ce` to manifest `sha256:0e1b14e302619a42ef5581b87db6804651d4f946301cf543d74a3a1eb1c33b40`; TP4/EP4, DSpark only, concurrency 1–128.
- Keep per-rank host Engram, static memory 0.70, prefill chunk 4,096, GPU-resident KV, native 1M context and all traces/subagent sessions.
- Reserve `min(64*CONC, 1024)` SWA tails. The C16 measured pool retains 27.0M full-context tokens and 439,040 SWA slots; the cap protects the measured 51.82 GiB KV budget at high concurrency.
- Apply prefill/decode interval 16 only at the measured C16 point. Other points retain default scheduling.
- Preserve native five-token DSpark and committed golden acceptance for throughput; evals use real verification. No custom draft precision patches.

## Completed C16 qualification

Exact candidate `0822a4da0417f5f4979ff861ddb1af4878ef6bc7` completed ordinary Slurm canonical performance (job 26049) and full GSM8K (job 26050), every step exiting 0. The corresponding managed [performance](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35699479565) and [full GSM8K](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35699482171) jobs remain queued; standalone evidence is not workflow-green status.

| Matched TP4/C16 setting | Total tok/s/GPU | p90 interactivity | p90 TTFT |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Original host baseline | 7,852.84 | 6.56 | 43.93 s |
| Host, 1,024 tails | 27,110.90 | 135.77 | 2.35 s |
| Host, 1,024 tails + interval 16 | 27,029.26 | 154.30 | 3.51 s |

The selected C16 scheduling setting improves interactivity **13.65%** for **0.30% lower throughput**, with TTFT increasing 1.16 seconds. This is a measured tradeoff, not a claim of improvement in every metric. Both tail candidates use identical AIPerf input configurations, all 393 traces, ten warmup requests per lane and a 3,600-second scored window with the canonical drain. Host hugepage backing varies between runs, limiting causal attribution.

The selected candidate has 2,532 scored responses, 1,324 child requests, zero errors/cancellations, complete TTFT/E2E coverage and ITL coverage for all 2,529 eligible multi-token responses. Four-GPU power validation passed. Cache hits reached 96.91%. Full GSM8K passed **97.35% strict accuracy across all 1,319 questions**, with no sample limit. Raw artifacts and exact source/job provenance are retained in the GB200 qualification directory.

The [separately published vLLM TP4/C16 result](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35529685706/attempts/1) reports 28,349.65 tok/s/GPU and interactivity 174.22. This selected SGLang result remains **4.66% lower in throughput and 11.43% lower in interactivity**; no parity claim. GPU Engram placement and interval-only experiments were also measured but not selected.

## Final sweep

Selected PR head: `d8398c0da69f2fd5f8300a9b80fa43c6f80ae2aa`. Main was synchronized with the documented byte-preserving changelog helper; exactly one PR-added entry remains. Bash syntax, diff checks, strict committed changelog validation and actual matrix generation pass: eight canonical performance rows plus eight full GSM8K rows, C1–C128.

The [full sweep](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35708592394) uses global `full-sweep-enabled` and `all-evals`. Other concurrency tail settings are memory-reviewed candidates and still require runtime qualification. The PR remains ready; no merge before complete qualification.

title: [Klaud Cold] Add MI300X TP4 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vLLM AgentX arm with Engram host offload / 新增 Engram 主机卸载的 MI300X TP4 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vLLM AgentX 臂
body:
## Summary
Adds a **TP4** arm with **Engram CPU offload** to `dsv41flash-fp4-mi300x-vllm-agentic-dspark`, beside the existing TP8 arm, and repins the image.

- New search-space row `tp: 4` at concurrency 1-32, mirroring the TP8 grid so the two are directly comparable.
- `dsv41flash_fp4_mi300x_mtp.sh` now sets `--engram-config` **explicitly per TP**: `cpu_offload:false` at TP8, `cpu_offload:true` at TP4.
- Image repinned from `nightly-eed1f3d0…` to `nightly-3df4ae153eb385e27b52f26c81f8edb9e20b9984`.
- New `--no-swa-bounded-replay` flag.

## Why the image had to move
The pinned `nightly-eed1f3d0…` tag **404s on Docker Hub**; it survives only on node caches. The new pin is the same upstream commit the MI355X arm moved to in #3326, on the plain ROCm channel that the gfx942 arms already use rather than the `rocm100` channel, which no gfx942 recipe has exercised.

That commit is also what makes this change possible: [vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491) widened two `is_cuda()` gates to `is_cuda_alike()`, so `engram_config` finally resolves on gfx942. Previously this recipe had to omit the flag entirely.

## Why `--engram-config` is now explicit on both arms
On builds carrying #57491, `cpu_offload` **defaults on** through `VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD`. Bumping the image without setting it would silently move the TP8 tables to host memory and change that curve. Setting it explicitly to `false` at TP8 keeps the existing arm behaviourally identical, and `true` at TP4 is what makes TP4 fit.

## Why `--no-swa-bounded-replay`
[vllm-project/vllm#56227](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56227) turned SWA bounded replay on by default **between the two pins**. It relies on a window clamp that landed in the FlashInfer and FlashMLA kernels; the ROCm sparse SWA path only gained the `replay_start` kwarg. On gfx950 that crashed every point with `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT` at the first prefix hit carrying a replay start. **gfx942 runs the same ROCm sparse path**, so this recipe pre-empts it rather than burning a sweep to rediscover it. Prefix caching stays on.

## Memory
With the Engram tables offloaded, resident weights are ~81 GiB per rank at TP4, from the per-rank fit across the measured H100 TP8, H200 TP4 and B200 TP2 points (256 GiB sharded plus 17.2 GiB replicated). On a 192 GB card at `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9` that leaves roughly **60 GiB of KV per GPU** after the indexer's 16 GiB `[batched-tokens, 1M]` logits buffer. TP8 with the tables resident is unchanged at roughly 73 GiB per rank.

## Test plan
- [ ] `full-sweep-enabled` sweep: TP4 concurrency 1-32 AgentX + evals green
- [ ] TP8 re-runs green on the new image and matches the prior curve
- [ ] Confirm the c1 log shows the Engram offload line at TP4 and no offload at TP8

<details><summary>中文</summary>

## 摘要
在 `dsv41flash-fp4-mi300x-vllm-agentic-dspark` 现有 TP8 臂旁新增启用 **Engram CPU 卸载**的 **TP4** 臂，并重新固定镜像。

- 新增 `tp: 4` 搜索空间行，并发 1-32，与 TP8 网格一致以便直接对比。
- `dsv41flash_fp4_mi300x_mtp.sh` 现按 TP **显式**设置 `--engram-config`：TP8 为 `cpu_offload:false`，TP4 为 `cpu_offload:true`。
- 镜像由 `nightly-eed1f3d0…` 重新固定为 `nightly-3df4ae153eb385e27b52f26c81f8edb9e20b9984`。
- 新增 `--no-swa-bounded-replay`。

## 镜像为何必须更换
原固定的 `nightly-eed1f3d0…` 在 Docker Hub 上已 **404 失效**，仅依靠节点缓存存活。新 pin 与 #3326 中 MI355X 臂所用为同一上游 commit，但选用 gfx942 臂一贯使用的普通 ROCm 通道，而非尚无 gfx942 配方验证过的 `rocm100` 通道。

该 commit 也正是本次改动的前提：[vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491) 将两处 `is_cuda()` 判定放宽为 `is_cuda_alike()`，使 `engram_config` 得以在 gfx942 上解析；此前本配方只能完全省略该参数。

## 为何两个臂都显式设置 `--engram-config`
在包含 #57491 的构建中，`cpu_offload` 会通过 `VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD` **默认开启**。若仅升级镜像而不设置该值，TP8 的 Engram 表会被静默移至主机内存，改变该曲线。TP8 显式设为 `false` 可保持现有臂行为完全一致，TP4 设为 `true` 则是其得以运行的前提。

## 为何需要 `--no-swa-bounded-replay`
[vllm-project/vllm#56227](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56227) 在两个 pin **之间**将 SWA bounded replay 默认开启。其依赖的 window clamp 已进入 FlashInfer 与 FlashMLA kernel，但 ROCm sparse SWA 路径仅获得 `replay_start` 参数。在 gfx950 上，这使所有数据点在首次命中携带 replay start 的 prefix 时以 `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT` 崩溃。**gfx942 使用同一 ROCm sparse 路径**，因此本配方提前规避，而非再耗费一次 sweep 重新发现。prefix caching 保持开启。

## 显存
Engram 表卸载后，TP4 每 rank 常驻权重约 81 GiB，该数值来自对已实测的 H100 TP8、H200 TP4 与 B200 TP2 数据点的按 rank 拟合（256 GiB 分片 + 17.2 GiB 每 rank 副本）。在 192 GB 卡、`--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9` 下，扣除 indexer 的 16 GiB `[batched-tokens, 1M]` logits 缓冲区后，每张 GPU 约剩 **60 GiB KV**。TP8 表驻留 GPU 的情形不变，约 73 GiB/rank。

## 测试计划
- [ ] `full-sweep-enabled` sweep：TP4 并发 1-32 AgentX 与 evals 全绿
- [ ] TP8 在新镜像上重跑全绿，且与此前曲线一致
- [ ] 确认 c1 日志中 TP4 出现 Engram 卸载行、TP8 无卸载

</details>

title: [Klaud Cold] Add MI325X TP4 and TP2 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vLLM AgentX arms with Engram host offload / 新增 Engram 主机卸载的 MI325X TP4 与 TP2 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vLLM AgentX 臂
body:
## Summary

Try DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on MI325X at **TP4 and TP2** with the Engram tables offloaded to pinned host memory, alongside the existing TP8 arm which keeps them GPU-resident.

MI325X carries 256 GB per card, 64 GB more than MI300X, and that difference is what makes TP2 comfortable here. The offloaded per-rank resident weight footprint follows the fitted model `256 GiB / TP + 17.2 GiB`, validated on the Blackwell arms:

| TP | resident weights / rank | indexer buffer | headroom on a 256 GB card |
|----|------------------------|----------------|---------------------------|
| 8  | 49.2 GiB (tables resident, so higher in practice) | 32 GiB | large |
| 4  | 81.2 GiB | 32 GiB | large |
| 2  | 145.2 GiB | 16 GiB | workable |

Because a 256 GB card absorbs the ~145 GiB TP2 weight footprint with room left over, TP2 keeps the full concurrency 1 to 32 list here, unlike the MI300X sibling which stops at 8.

## Changes

- `configs/amd-master.yaml`: add `tp: 4` and `tp: 2` rows, both at concurrency 1 to 32, beside the existing `tp: 8` row, and repin the image.
- `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/dsv41flash_fp4_mi325x_mtp.sh`: set `--engram-config` per TP (offload below TP8, resident at TP8), add the TP2 cap block, and add `--no-swa-bounded-replay`.

At TP2 the recipe halves the sparse-attention indexer buffer to 8192 batched tokens, scales `max-num-seqs` to `2*CONC` clamped to `[16, 256]`, and caps cudagraph capture at 512. That is the cap set the Blackwell TP2 arms validated on B200, GB200 and GB300.

The image moves off the expired `nightly-eed1f3d0` tag to `nightly-3df4ae15`, the same commit the MI355X arm uses. It carries [vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491), which widened two `is_cuda()` gates to `is_cuda_alike()` so `engram_config` resolves on gfx942. Because that change also makes `cpu_offload` default on through `VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD`, the recipe sets the value explicitly per TP rather than inheriting a default that would silently move the TP8 tables to host memory.

`--no-swa-bounded-replay` is carried over pre-emptively: [vllm-project/vllm#56227](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56227) turned SWA bounded replay on by default between the two pins and relies on a window clamp the ROCm sparse SWA path does not have. That crashed every gfx950 point with `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT`, and gfx942 runs the same path. Prefix caching stays on.

## Relationship to the TP4-only PR

[#3333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3333) adds TP4 alone on this SKU and is currently passing, 9 points green at the time of writing on this same image and the same Engram offload configuration. That run is the evidence the offload path works on gfx942; this PR extends it down to TP2. If both go green, this one supersedes #3333.

## Test plan

- [ ] Full sweep: TP8, TP4 and TP2 each at concurrency 1 to 32.
- [ ] Confirm the TP8 curve still matches the validated concurrency 1 to 32 run, so the image repin and the explicit `cpu_offload: false` are neutral there.
- [ ] Compare the TP4 points against #3333 to confirm they reproduce.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

## 摘要

在 MI325X 上尝试 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的 **TP4 与 TP2** 配置，将 Engram 表卸载到固定页主机内存，同时保留 Engram 表驻留 GPU 的现有 TP8 臂。

MI325X 每张卡 256 GB，比 MI300X 多 64 GB，这正是 TP2 在此更为宽裕的原因。卸载后每 rank 常驻权重遵循已在 Blackwell 臂上验证的拟合模型 `256 GiB / TP + 17.2 GiB`：TP4 约 81 GiB，TP2 约 145 GiB。

由于 256 GB 卡能容纳约 145 GiB 的 TP2 权重并仍有余量，本 PR 的 TP2 保留完整的并发 1 至 32 列表，而 MI300X 同类 PR 止于 8。

## 改动

- `configs/amd-master.yaml`：在现有 `tp: 8` 行旁新增 `tp: 4` 与 `tp: 2` 行（均为并发 1 至 32），并重新固定镜像。
- `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/dsv41flash_fp4_mi325x_mtp.sh`：按 TP 设置 `--engram-config`（TP8 驻留，低于 TP8 卸载），新增 TP2 收紧逻辑，并加入 `--no-swa-bounded-replay`。

TP2 时配方将稀疏注意力 indexer 缓冲区减半至 8192 batched tokens，`max-num-seqs` 取 `2*CONC` 并夹在 `[16, 256]`，cudagraph capture 上限 512，与 Blackwell TP2 臂在 B200、GB200、GB300 上验证过的一致。

镜像从已失效的 `nightly-eed1f3d0` 迁移到 `nightly-3df4ae15`，与 MI355X 臂相同。该镜像包含 [vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491)，使 `engram_config` 在 gfx942 上可解析；由于其同时让 `cpu_offload` 通过 `VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD` 默认开启，配方现按 TP 显式设置该值。

## 与 TP4 单独 PR 的关系

[#3333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3333) 仅新增 TP4，目前正在通过，撰写时已有 9 个数据点在相同镜像与相同 Engram 卸载配置下变绿。该运行即是卸载路径在 gfx942 上可用的证据；本 PR 将其延伸至 TP2。若两者均通过，本 PR 取代 #3333。

## 测试计划

- [ ] 完整扫描：TP8、TP4、TP2 各自并发 1 至 32。
- [ ] 确认 TP8 曲线与已验证的并发 1 至 32 运行一致，以证明镜像重固定与显式 `cpu_offload: false` 在该臂为中性改动。
- [ ] 将 TP4 数据点与 #3333 对比，确认可复现。

</details>

body:
## Summary
Adds a **TP4** arm with **Engram CPU offload** to `dsv41flash-fp4-mi325x-vllm-agentic-dspark`, beside the existing TP8 arm, and repins the image.

- New search-space row `tp: 4` at concurrency 1-32, mirroring the TP8 grid so the two are directly comparable.
- `dsv41flash_fp4_mi325x_mtp.sh` now sets `--engram-config` **explicitly per TP**: `cpu_offload:false` at TP8, `cpu_offload:true` at TP4.
- Image repinned from `nightly-eed1f3d0…` to `nightly-3df4ae153eb385e27b52f26c81f8edb9e20b9984`.
- New `--no-swa-bounded-replay` flag.

## Why the image had to move
The pinned `nightly-eed1f3d0…` tag **404s on Docker Hub**; it survives only on node caches. The new pin is the same upstream commit the MI355X arm moved to in #3326, on the plain ROCm channel that the gfx942 arms already use rather than the `rocm100` channel, which no gfx942 recipe has exercised.

That commit is also what makes this change possible: [vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491) widened two `is_cuda()` gates to `is_cuda_alike()`, so `engram_config` finally resolves on gfx942. Previously this recipe had to omit the flag entirely.

## Why `--engram-config` is now explicit on both arms
On builds carrying #57491, `cpu_offload` **defaults on** through `VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD`. Bumping the image without setting it would silently move the TP8 tables to host memory and change that curve. Setting it explicitly to `false` at TP8 keeps the existing arm behaviourally identical, and `true` at TP4 is what makes TP4 fit.

## Why `--no-swa-bounded-replay`
[vllm-project/vllm#56227](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56227) turned SWA bounded replay on by default **between the two pins**. It relies on a window clamp that landed in the FlashInfer and FlashMLA kernels; the ROCm sparse SWA path only gained the `replay_start` kwarg. On gfx950 that crashed every point with `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT` at the first prefix hit carrying a replay start. **gfx942 runs the same ROCm sparse path**, so this recipe pre-empts it rather than burning a sweep to rediscover it. Prefix caching stays on.

## Memory
With the Engram tables offloaded, resident weights are ~81 GiB per rank at TP4, from the per-rank fit across the measured H100 TP8, H200 TP4 and B200 TP2 points (256 GiB sharded plus 17.2 GiB replicated). On a 256 GB card at `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9` that leaves roughly **100 GiB of KV per GPU** after the indexer's 32 GiB `[batched-tokens, 1M]` logits buffer. TP8 with the tables resident is unchanged at roughly 73 GiB per rank.

## Test plan
- [ ] `full-sweep-enabled` sweep: TP4 concurrency 1-32 AgentX + evals green
- [ ] TP8 re-runs green on the new image and matches the prior curve
- [ ] Confirm the c1 log shows the Engram offload line at TP4 and no offload at TP8

<details><summary>中文</summary>

## 摘要
在 `dsv41flash-fp4-mi325x-vllm-agentic-dspark` 现有 TP8 臂旁新增启用 **Engram CPU 卸载**的 **TP4** 臂，并重新固定镜像。

- 新增 `tp: 4` 搜索空间行，并发 1-32，与 TP8 网格一致以便直接对比。
- `dsv41flash_fp4_mi325x_mtp.sh` 现按 TP **显式**设置 `--engram-config`：TP8 为 `cpu_offload:false`，TP4 为 `cpu_offload:true`。
- 镜像由 `nightly-eed1f3d0…` 重新固定为 `nightly-3df4ae153eb385e27b52f26c81f8edb9e20b9984`。
- 新增 `--no-swa-bounded-replay`。

## 镜像为何必须更换
原固定的 `nightly-eed1f3d0…` 在 Docker Hub 上已 **404 失效**，仅依靠节点缓存存活。新 pin 与 #3326 中 MI355X 臂所用为同一上游 commit，但选用 gfx942 臂一贯使用的普通 ROCm 通道，而非尚无 gfx942 配方验证过的 `rocm100` 通道。

该 commit 也正是本次改动的前提：[vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491) 将两处 `is_cuda()` 判定放宽为 `is_cuda_alike()`，使 `engram_config` 得以在 gfx942 上解析；此前本配方只能完全省略该参数。

## 为何两个臂都显式设置 `--engram-config`
在包含 #57491 的构建中，`cpu_offload` 会通过 `VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD` **默认开启**。若仅升级镜像而不设置该值，TP8 的 Engram 表会被静默移至主机内存，改变该曲线。TP8 显式设为 `false` 可保持现有臂行为完全一致，TP4 设为 `true` 则是其得以运行的前提。

## 为何需要 `--no-swa-bounded-replay`
[vllm-project/vllm#56227](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56227) 在两个 pin **之间**将 SWA bounded replay 默认开启。其依赖的 window clamp 已进入 FlashInfer 与 FlashMLA kernel，但 ROCm sparse SWA 路径仅获得 `replay_start` 参数。在 gfx950 上，这使所有数据点在首次命中携带 replay start 的 prefix 时以 `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT` 崩溃。**gfx942 使用同一 ROCm sparse 路径**，因此本配方提前规避，而非再耗费一次 sweep 重新发现。prefix caching 保持开启。

## 显存
Engram 表卸载后，TP4 每 rank 常驻权重约 81 GiB，该数值来自对已实测的 H100 TP8、H200 TP4 与 B200 TP2 数据点的按 rank 拟合（256 GiB 分片 + 17.2 GiB 每 rank 副本）。在 256 GB 卡、`--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9` 下，扣除 indexer 的 32 GiB `[batched-tokens, 1M]` logits 缓冲区后，每张 GPU 约剩 **100 GiB KV**。TP8 表驻留 GPU 的情形不变，约 73 GiB/rank。

## 测试计划
- [ ] `full-sweep-enabled` sweep：TP4 并发 1-32 AgentX 与 evals 全绿
- [ ] TP8 在新镜像上重跑全绿，且与此前曲线一致
- [ ] 确认 c1 日志中 TP4 出现 Engram 卸载行、TP8 无卸载

</details>

- SGLang nightly `20260918-20518d85` with pinned Dynamo and native srt-slurm.
- Automatic measured acceptance for throughput; real verification for accuracy evaluations.

title: Consolidate deprecated configs and remove retired runtime support
body:
Deprecated configuration and support code remained scattered across per-deprecation archives, active server registries, launcher branches, and agent instructions. Consolidate the master archives and complete the retirement cleanup while preserving the exceptions documented in `MODELS.md`.

### Changes

- Replace 17 master archive files with `configs/deprecated/amd-master.yaml` and `configs/deprecated/nvidia-master.yaml`. Preserve all 133 AMD and 235 NVIDIA entries, comments, and settings, with blank lines between configs. Disambiguate 112 older colliding 1k1k keys using `-deprecated-1k1k` and original-key comments.
- Move 11 retired AMD server-registry entries, the Kimi node-exclusion rule, and GLM-5 setup into `benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/deprecated/`. This includes retired DSV4/MiniMax fixed-sequence registry variants as well as fully retired model families.
- Remove retired-model branches from five launchers, runtime settings, and DSV4 fixed-sequence benchmark helpers. Correct workflow dispatch examples, review instructions, model-onboarding guidance, and misleading deprecation comments.
- Add mandatory archival and retirement-parity instructions to `AGENTS.md`; synchronize affected English/Chinese guides.

### Retirement scope

All 191 active master definitions already match enacted retirement policy and remain unchanged. Preserve GLM-5.1 B200 TileRT (including 1k1k), conditional non-speculative AgentX coverage, SPEED-Bench collectors and their live scheduling/staging dependencies, historical readers/golden data, and explicitly retained srt-slurm/llm-d recipe YAMLs. Generic manual overrides can still support deliberate historical replay; this is not a universal execution ban.

No active benchmark recipe or performance behavior changes. Registry archival preserves original values; removed routing branches were specific to already-retired coverage. No performance changelog entry or GPU sweep is needed.

### Independent audit loop

Three independent read-only auditors reviewed frozen revisions over five rounds, reporting findings only to the main agent. title: docs: define draft precision as serve-the-draft-as-it-ships / 将 draft 精度规则定义为按发布默认方式运行 draft
body:
## Summary

The current Draft-model precision rule says the draft must keep its "original, unquantized weights and native precision" with no "upcasts ... at load time". Agents read that literally and did the opposite of what we want:

- On the Qwen FP8 B200/B300 work (#3268 / #3269), the checkpoint stores its MTP head in FP8. The agent treated that as a policy conflict, pulled the BF16 release's MTP weights, and built a separate `unquant` BF16-draft path before reverting to the embedded FP8 head.
- On DeepSeek V4.1 Flash H200 SGLang (#3341), the pinned nightly loads the DSpark `wo_a` FP8 weights as BF16 (DeepSeek's reference does the same). The agent read that as a forbidden load-time upcast and started writing a local FP8 dense patch to stop it, then halted pending clarification.

Neither of those is what the rule was for. The rule exists to stop submission-side precision hacks on the draft (`quark_mxfp4` on a BF16 MTP head, `SGLANG_GLM_NEXTN_MOE_PTPC=1`, ATOM `ptpc_fp8` reaching the MTP block).

This PR restates the rule as **serve the draft as it ships**:

- Baseline = the draft head/weights that ship with the served checkpoint, at their stored precision, loaded by the pinned upstream image with its default handling and no draft-related settings from the submission.
- Compliant when effective draft precision matches that baseline. Forbidden when the submission makes the draft cheaper than that baseline (online/offline quant, dtype or KV-dtype overrides below the default, checkpoint or head substitution, patches that change draft load/compute precision, pruning).
- Explicitly allowed: embedded FP8/FP4 heads in FP8/FP4 checkpoints, the framework's default load-time conversions, the framework's default draft KV dtype or an upstream-supported KV dtype applied consistently to target and draft, and real upstream optimizations that run the same draft computation faster.
- Keeps the existing non-exemptions (upstream recipe, passing evals, unchanged/new AL, synthetic acceptance) and the MLPerf Appendix C comparison.

## Files

- `CONTRIBUTING.md` / `CONTRIBUTING_zh.md`: rewrite the Draft-model precision section with the Qwen FP8 and DSpark `wo_a` worked examples.
- `docs/PR_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md` / `docs/PR_REVIEW_CHECKLIST_zh.md`: reword the draft item and the "does not permit changing draft precision" clause in the architecture item. English template kept verbatim across both files.
- `.github/codeowner-signoff-verify-prompt.md`: rewrite Check 13 (renamed "Draft runs as shipped") around the baseline definition; keep the existing inspection leads and the ATOM `exclude_layer` example. Update the Check 8 cross-reference.

## Notes for reviewers

- The checklist template text changes, so open sign-offs that copied the old template will fail Check 5 until re-posted with the current template.
- Verifier prompt changes are validated post-merge per `docs/documentation-procedures.md` (throwaway `[DO NOT MERGE]` PR with a sign-off comment).
- No recipes, configs, or `perf-changelog.yaml` changes; docs and verifier prompt only.

## AI model disclosure

Prepared by Claude Fable 5.1 (Perplexity Computer orchestrator) from Cameron Quilici's instructions and the Slack policy discussion. No delegated agents.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

### 概述

现行 Draft 模型精度规则要求 draft 保留"原始、未量化的权重与原生精度"，且禁止"加载时升精度"。Agent 按字面理解后，做出了与我们意图相反的操作：

- 在 Qwen FP8 B200/B300 工作（#3268 / #3269）中，checkpoint 以 FP8 存储 MTP head。Agent 将其视为违反政策，改为下载 BF16 发布版本的 MTP 权重并搭建单独的 `unquant` BF16 draft 路径，之后才回退到内嵌 FP8 head。
- 在 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash H200 SGLang（#3341）中，锁定的 nightly 将 DSpark `wo_a` FP8 权重加载为 BF16（DeepSeek 参考实现亦如此）。Agent 将其视为被禁止的加载时升精度，开始编写本地 FP8 dense 补丁以阻止该转换，随后暂停等待澄清。

这两种情况都不是该规则的本意。规则的目的是阻止提交方对 draft 的精度 hack（对 BF16 MTP head 使用 `quark_mxfp4`、`SGLANG_GLM_NEXTN_MOE_PTPC=1`、ATOM `ptpc_fp8` 波及 MTP block）。

本 PR 将规则重述为**按发布时的默认方式运行 draft**：

- 基线 = 随所服务 checkpoint 一同发布的 draft head/权重，保持其存储精度，由锁定上游镜像以默认方式加载，且不带任何来自提交方的 draft 相关设置。
- draft 实际运行精度与基线一致即合规；提交方使 draft 比基线更"便宜"即违规（在线/离线量化、低于默认值的 dtype 或 KV dtype 覆盖、替换 checkpoint 或 head、改变 draft 加载/计算精度的补丁、裁剪）。
- 明确允许：FP8/FP4 checkpoint 内嵌的 FP8/FP4 head、框架默认的加载时转换、框架默认的 draft KV dtype 或对 target 与 draft 一致应用的上游支持的 KV dtype，以及让同样的 draft 计算跑得更快的真实上游优化。
- 保留现有的不可豁免项（上游配方、通过 evals、AL 未变或新测 AL、合成接受）以及 MLPerf 附录 C 对照。

### 文件

- `CONTRIBUTING.md` / `CONTRIBUTING_zh.md`：重写 Draft 模型精度章节，加入 Qwen FP8 与 DSpark `wo_a` 示例。
- `docs/PR_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md` / `docs/PR_REVIEW_CHECKLIST_zh.md`：改写 draft 条目及架构条目中"不允许更改 draft 精度"的措辞。两个文件中的英文模板保持逐字一致。
- `.github/codeowner-signoff-verify-prompt.md`：围绕基线定义重写检查 13（更名为 "Draft runs as shipped"），保留现有排查线索与 ATOM `exclude_layer` 示例；更新检查 8 的交叉引用。

### 审阅说明

- 清单模板文本有变，复制旧模板的未完成签署在重新发布前将无法通过检查 5。
- 验证器提示词的改动按 `docs/documentation-procedures.md` 在合并后验证（使用 `[DO NOT MERGE]` 测试 PR 发布签署评论）。
- 不涉及 recipe、配置或 `perf-changelog.yaml`；仅改动文档与验证器提示词。

### AI 模型披露

由 Claude Fable 5.1（Perplexity Computer 编排模型）根据 Cameron Quilici 的指示及 Slack 政策讨论撰写。无委派 agent。

</details>

title: config(dsv41flash): offload MI325X Engram tables to host DRAM / 将 MI325X Engram 表卸载到主机 DRAM
body:
## Summary

Three changes to the **existing** `dsv41flash-fp4-mi325x-vllm-agentic-dspark` TP8 arm. No new arms, no retuning — the point is to isolate the Engram lever on an already-validated curve.

1. `--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}'` — offload the Engram tables to pinned host memory.
2. `--no-swa-bounded-replay` — work around the ROCm SWA fault.
3. Repin the image `nightly-eed1f3d0` → `nightly-rocm100-3df4ae15`, which is where both of the above land. This is the same ROCm 10 nightly the MI355X arm runs, at the same vLLM commit.

## Why

**Engram.** [vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491) widened the two `is_cuda()` gates to `is_cuda_alike()`, so gfx942 now resolves an `EngramConfig` where it previously ignored the flag. Left resident, the tables cost 183 GiB per rank at TP8 — HBM a 256 GB card would otherwise spend on KV.

Every NVIDIA DSv4.1-Flash arm has offloaded since [#2963](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/2963) (2026-09-11); MI355X and MI325X are the only holdouts. On the MI355X sweep ([run 35574132719](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35574132719)) the resident-table arm is exactly the one whose KV pool starves at high concurrency:

| | KV memory | KV tokens | max concurrency @ 1M ctx |
|---|---|---|---|
| B300 TP4 (offloaded) | 132.48 GiB | 63.1M | 60.17x |
| MI355X TP4 (resident) | 38.05 GiB | 14.8M | 14.14x |

**SWA bounded replay.** [vllm-project/vllm#56227](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56227) turned it on by default after the `eed1f3d0` pin. The window clamp it depends on landed only in the FlashInfer and FlashMLA kernels; the ROCm sparse SWA path got just the `replay_start` kwarg. Every gfx950 point of [run 35567570539](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35567570539) died with `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT` at the first prefix hit carrying a replay start; adding this flag turned all 16 points green. gfx942 runs the same ROCm sparse path, so it needs the same guard on this image.

## Not a duplicate of #3337

[#3337](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3337) also touches this recipe, but the two differ on purpose:

| | #3337 | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Engram at TP8 | **resident** (kept for comparability) | **offloaded** |
| Engram below TP8 | offloaded | n/a |
| New TP4 / TP2 arms | adds both at conc 1-32 | none |
| TP2 batched-token / seq / capture caps | adds | none |

#3337 explores *new* TP4/TP2 arms while holding TP8 fixed. This PR changes only TP8 so the delta against its own validated baseline is attributable to the Engram flip alone. They conflict textually; happy to rebase onto whichever lands first, or to fold this into #3337 if maintainers prefer one MI325X PR.

## Testing

Config-only change; correctness rides on the sweep this PR triggers. Supporting evidence gathered on MI355X (gfx950, same ROCm sparse path):

- Engram offload verified on-device at TP4: `Engram table offloaded to pinned host memory: 96002514 rows x 256, 23.60 GiB per rank`, byte-identical row sharding to the B300 arm.
- `--no-swa-bounded-replay` converted 16/16 crashed points to success on [run 35574132719](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35574132719), GSM8K 0.9750-0.9757.

## AI assistance

Investigation and patch drafted with AI assistance (Cursor). All conclusions are backed by the CI logs and on-device measurements linked above; a human reviewed every changed line.

Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)

title: [AgentX GB300] refresh the full Kimi-K3 curve so every point carries measured power / 重测完整曲线使每个点都带实测功耗
body:
## Description

The 6 published GB300 Kimi-K3 disaggregated points come from the 2026-09-14 sweep, whose recipes did not yet declare the `dcgm-power` provider — its job logs report `USES_DCGM_POWER=0` and the points carry `power_valid=0` with no power values. #3047 enabled the provider but its run was purged, so nothing power-enabled has been published. AgentX resolves one curve per hardware, so only a sweep selecting both config keys can replace them together. Also migrates the four disagg recipes to the current srtctl telemetry schema. `provider` and `default_frequency` were retired for `dcgm_exporter` and `collect_interval_ms` when `utils/srt-slurm` moved to the upstream pin; 140 recipes migrated and six Kimi-K3 ones did not, so srtctl rejected these four as `Unknown field` before submitting anything — the disaggregated half of the curve failed while the already-migrated aggregated half passed.

**Testing:** all four telemetry blocks now load under the pinned srtctl schema and fail to load without the change. The matrix plan resolves 11 benchmark + 11 eval jobs on one image, 5 aggregated + 6 disaggregated, matching the published curve. Sweep running.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

已发布的 6 个 GB300 Kimi-K3 分离部署点来自 2026-09-14 的 sweep，当时配方尚未声明 `dcgm-power` provider —— 作业日志显示 `USES_DCGM_POWER=0`，这些点是 `power_valid=0` 且没有功耗数值。#3047 已启用该 provider，但其运行被清除，因此至今没有带功耗的已发布数据。AgentX 每个硬件只解析出一条曲线，只有同时选中两个 config key 的 sweep 才能整体替换它们。同时将四个分离部署配方迁移到当前的 srtctl telemetry schema。`utils/srt-slurm` 切到上游 pin 时，`provider` 与 `default_frequency` 已被 `dcgm_exporter` 和 `collect_interval_ms` 取代；140 个配方完成迁移，六个 Kimi-K3 配方没有，因此 srtctl 在提交任何作业前就以 `Unknown field` 拒绝了这四个配方 —— 曲线中分离部署的一半失败，而已迁移的聚合部署一半通过。

**测试：** 矩阵规划解析出 11 个 benchmark + 11 个 eval 作业，同一镜像，5 个聚合 + 6 个分离部署，与已发布曲线一致。sweep 尚未启动。

</details>

## Related Issue

title: feat(agentx): retune Kimi-K3 FP4 MI355X ATOM DSpark recipe
body:
> **Source PR:** This PR mirrors https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3169 (from `gbyu-amd:kimik3-atom-agentx-0911`), re-created on an in-repo `amd/` branch so sweep dispatch and labels (`AMD`, `agentx`, `full-sweep-enabled`) apply.

Track the checked-in ATOM recipe [`recipes/Agentic-Kimi-K3.md`](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/blob/k3_agentic_recipe/recipes/Agentic-Kimi-K3.md) at ROCm/ATOM#2131, retuned per concurrency on image `kimi_k3_agentic_0911`.

Publish the concurrency set **[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72]** in place of [1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 14, 16, 32, 40, 56, 64]. Concurrency 48 and 72 are new points, 12 and 14 are dropped, and every surviving point is retuned.

- `gpu-memory-utilization` is 0.90 and `max-num-batched-tokens` is 8192 on every point, so the launcher sets both once instead of per band.
- `max-num-seqs` is 32 through concurrency 16 and `2 * CONC` from 32 up.
- `AITER_REUSE_IDENTICAL_COMM_GROUPS` becomes a threshold: 1 at concurrency 56, 64, and 72, 0 from 1 through 48.
- The two paged-KV `dram-utilization` blocks carry onto the new set, still divided by TP for the per-rank `LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_CPU_SIZE`: 0.343 lands 128 GB/rank for concurrency 8 through 48, 0.513 lands 192 GB/rank for 56 through 72.

The concurrency-14 CUDA-graph pin goes with the point, and was already dead code: it set `CUDAGRAPH_MAX_NUM_SEQS=32` inside the `case` block, which the capture-width derivation overwrote with `2 * CONC` two statements later, so it never reached the server. Capture behaviour is unchanged — `--level 3` with `--cudagraph-mode FULL` over `[2 .. 2 * CONC * (1 + draft tokens)]` — and reproduces the recipe's `graph_max` column at all eleven points:

| CONC | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 | 32 | 40 | 48 | 56 | 64 | 72 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `max-num-seqs` | 32 | 32 | 32 | 32 | 32 | 64 | 80 | 96 | 112 | 128 | 144 |
| draft tokens | 7 | 7 | 7 | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `graph_max` | 16 | 32 | 64 | 64 | 128 | 64 | 80 | 96 | 112 | 128 | 144 |

title: [Klaud Cold] Add GB300 TP2 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vLLM AgentX arm with Engram host offload / 新增 Engram 主机卸载的 GB300 TP2 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vLLM AgentX 臂
body:
## Summary
Adds a **TP2** arm to `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-vllm-agentic-dspark` next to the existing TP4 arm, keeping the Engram n-gram tables in pinned host DRAM through `--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}'` (the shared vLLM AgentX script passes this on every arm). This is the GB300 counterpart of the B200 TP2 arm in #3216.

**Memory budget**, measured in the c1 server log of the merged GB300 TP4 run [35073891536](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35073891536) from #3176:

- TP4 loads 81.57 GiB of weights per rank on a 277 GiB GPU.
- TP2 halves the rank count. Measured on the first sweep, weights are ~175 GiB per GPU, more than the naive 2x because the non-expert weights are replicated on every rank.
- **Script change: the B200 TP2 caps now apply to every TP2 arm.** The first sweep's c128 point died in memory profiling with a KV budget of -5.34 GiB ([run 35528745995](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35528745995)): the sparse-attention indexer's `[batched-tokens, 1M]` fp8 logits buffer is 32 GiB at the upstream 16384 batched tokens, and graph capture at 1024 (reached at c128) adds ~22 GiB. `dsv41flash_fp4_vllm_mtp.sh` now caps `--max-num-batched-tokens` at 4096, bounds `--max-num-seqs` to 2x concurrency (16-256) and stops capture at 512 whenever TP is 2, leaving ~36 GiB of KV per GPU. TP4 and TP8 arms keep the upstream defaults.
- This is the same block PR #3216 adds for B200, generalised in its comment to cover all three TP2 SKUs. Whichever of the two merges first, the other resolves to the same code.

TP2 doubles the per-GPU expert work while removing two GPUs of all-reduce, so per-GPU throughput should improve at low concurrency and the E2EL curve should bend earlier than TP4.

**Upstream recipe:** the merged vllm-project recipe's `single_node_tp` map defaults every non-H100/B300 NVIDIA SKU to TP4 and documents Engram CPU offload as the memory lever for smaller replica counts ([DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml](https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/blob/main/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml)). TP2 with Engram offload is the same cell B300 already carries there.

## Test plan
- [ ] `full-sweep-enabled` sweep: TP2 c1-c128 AgentX + evals green
- [ ] Confirm the c1 log shows ~175 GiB of weights and a positive KV budget at the upstream batched-token default
- [ ] TP4 points re-run under the same config key with unchanged serve args; results should match the merged curve

<details><summary>中文</summary>

## 摘要
在 `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-vllm-agentic-dspark` 现有 TP4 臂旁新增 **TP2** 臂，Engram n-gram 表继续通过 `--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}'` 放在固定页主机 DRAM 中（共享的 vLLM AgentX 脚本在所有臂上都会传入该参数）。本 PR 是 #3216 中 B200 TP2 臂的 GB300 对应版本。

**显存预算**，取自 #3176 已合并的 GB300 TP4 运行 [35073891536](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35073891536) 的 c1 服务日志：

- TP4 在 277 GiB GPU 上每 rank 加载 81.57 GiB 权重。
- TP2 将 rank 数减半。首次 sweep 实测每张 GPU 权重约 175 GiB，高于简单的两倍，因为非专家权重在每个 rank 上都有副本。
- **脚本改动：B200 TP2 的上限现适用于所有 TP2 臂。** 首次 sweep 的 c128 点在内存分析阶段失败，KV 预算为 -5.34 GiB（[run 35528745995](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35528745995)）：上游 16384 batched tokens 下 indexer 的 `[batched-tokens, 1M]` fp8 logits 缓冲区为 32 GiB，而 c128 时 graph 捕获达 1024，额外占用约 22 GiB。`dsv41flash_fp4_vllm_mtp.sh` 现在在 TP=2 时将 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 限为 4096、`--max-num-seqs` 限为并发的两倍（16-256）、graph 捕获上限 512，为每张 GPU 留出约 36 GiB KV。TP4 与 TP8 臂沿用上游默认值。
- 该代码块与 PR #3216 为 B200 添加的相同，仅将注释推广到三个 TP2 SKU；两者中先合并的一个决定最终文本，另一个解析为相同代码。

TP2 使每 GPU 专家计算量翻倍，同时减少两张 GPU 的 all-reduce，低并发下每 GPU 吞吐应有提升，E2EL 曲线拐点也会早于 TP4。

**上游配方：** 已合并的 vllm-project 配方中 `single_node_tp` 映射对 H100/B300 以外的所有 NVIDIA SKU 默认为 TP4，并将 Engram CPU 卸载记录为降低副本 GPU 数时的显存手段（[DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml](https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/blob/main/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml)）。TP2 配合 Engram 卸载正是 B300 已采用的单元。

## 测试计划
- [ ] `full-sweep-enabled` sweep：TP2 c1-c128 AgentX 与 evals 全绿
- [ ] 确认 c1 日志显示约 175 GiB 权重，且在上游 batched-token 默认值下 KV 预算为正
- [ ] TP4 数据点在同一配置键下重跑，服务参数不变；结果应与已合并曲线一致

</details>

title: [Klaud Cold] Add H200 TP4 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vLLM AgentX arm with Engram host offload / 新增 Engram 主机卸载的 H200 TP4 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vLLM AgentX 臂
body:
## Summary
Adds a **TP4** arm to `dsv41flash-fp4-h200-vllm-agentic-dspark` next to the existing TP8 arm, keeping the Engram n-gram tables in pinned host DRAM through `--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}'`. This is the H200 counterpart of the B200 TP2 arm in #3216.

**Memory budget** (from the c1 server logs of the merged H200 TP8 run 35020525087 and the B200 TP2 run 35480787586):
- TP8 loads 49.6 GiB of weights per rank and leaves 66 GiB of KV per rank.
- TP4 doubles that to ~99 GiB of weights per 141 GB H200. With ~8 GiB non-torch, activations and graphs, ~15 GiB of KV remains per rank, ~60 GiB / ~17M tokens across the four ranks.
- B200 TP2 served c1-c128 green on 21.5 GiB / 6.18M tokens of KV, so this pool is ~3x that precedent. Expect heavy preemption on 1M-token trajectories above c32, not failures.
- Engram host memory rises to 23.6 GiB per rank (94 GiB pinned total), well inside the DGX Cloud H200 node DRAM.

**Script change** (`benchmarks/single_node/agentic/dsv41flash_fp4_vllm_mtp.sh`, shared by the H200 symlink): on sub-TP8 arms running on GPUs under 150 GB, cap `--max-num-batched-tokens` at 4096 (the indexer's `[batched-tokens, 1M]` fp8 logits buffer is 32 GiB at the upstream 16384), bound `--max-num-seqs` to 2x concurrency (16-256) and stop CUDA graph capture at 512 tokens. The gate leaves B200/GB200 TP4 and every TP8 arm on the upstream defaults, so no existing point changes recipe.

**Hopper note:** H200 has no FP4 tensor cores, so the NVFP4 experts run through the same dequant path as the TP8 arm. TP4 doubles the per-GPU expert work while removing four GPUs of all-reduce; the per-GPU throughput curve should land near TP8 at low concurrency and bend earlier.

**Upstream recipe:** the merged vllm-project recipe's `single_node_tp` map already defaults every non-H100/B300 NVIDIA SKU, H200 included, to TP4 (https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/blob/main/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml), so this arm matches the published TP without a recipes change. The Engram host offload and the batched-token/scheduler caps are the same InferenceX memory levers the merged H200 TP8 and H100 arms already carry.

## Test plan
- [ ] `full-sweep-enabled` sweep: TP4 c1-c128 AgentX + evals green
- [ ] Confirm the c1 log shows ~99 GiB weights and a positive KV budget with the 4096 batched-token cap
- [ ] TP8 points re-run under the same config key with unchanged serve args (the script gate leaves TP8 on the upstream defaults); their results should match the merged curve

<details><summary>中文</summary>

## 摘要
在 `dsv41flash-fp4-h200-vllm-agentic-dspark` 现有 TP8 臂旁新增 **TP4** 臂，Engram n-gram 表继续通过 `--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}'` 放在固定页主机 DRAM 中。本 PR 是 #3216 中 B200 TP2 臂的 H200 对应版本。

**显存预算**（来自已合并 H200 TP8 运行 35020525087 与 B200 TP2 运行 35480787586 的 c1 服务日志）：
- TP8 每 rank 加载 49.6 GiB 权重，剩余 66 GiB KV。
- TP4 每张 141 GB H200 约 99 GiB 权重；扣除约 8 GiB 非 torch 内存、激活与 graph 后，每 rank 约剩 15 GiB KV，四 rank 合计约 60 GiB / 约 1700 万 token。
- B200 TP2 仅凭 21.5 GiB / 618 万 token 的 KV 跑通了 c1-c128，本臂 KV 池约为其三倍。预计 c32 以上在 1M token 轨迹上会有较多抢占，但不会失败。
- Engram 主机内存升至每 rank 23.6 GiB（合计 94 GiB 固定页），远低于 DGX Cloud H200 节点的 DRAM 容量。

**脚本改动**（`benchmarks/single_node/agentic/dsv41flash_fp4_vllm_mtp.sh`，H200 通过符号链接共用）：在显存低于 150 GB 的 GPU 上运行低于 TP8 的臂时，将 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 上限设为 4096（上游 16384 时 indexer 的 `[batched-tokens, 1M]` fp8 logits 缓冲区达 32 GiB），`--max-num-seqs` 限定为并发的两倍（16-256），CUDA graph 捕获上限 512 token。该判定条件使 B200/GB200 TP4 与所有 TP8 臂保持上游默认值，已有数据点的配方不变。

**Hopper 说明：** H200 没有 FP4 tensor core，NVFP4 专家权重与 TP8 臂一样走反量化路径。TP4 使每 GPU 专家计算量翻倍，同时减少四张 GPU 的 all-reduce；每 GPU 吞吐曲线在低并发下应接近 TP8，并更早出现拐点。

**上游配方：** 已合并的 vllm-project 配方中 `single_node_tp` 映射对 H100/B300 以外的所有 NVIDIA SKU（包括 H200）默认即为 TP4（https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/blob/main/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml），因此本臂与已发布的 TP 一致，无需修改 recipes。Engram 主机卸载与 batched-token/调度批次上限沿用已合并的 H200 TP8 与 H100 臂所使用的 InferenceX 内存手段。

## 测试计划
- [ ] `full-sweep-enabled` sweep：TP4 c1-c128 AgentX 与 evals 全绿
- [ ] 确认 c1 日志显示约 99 GiB 权重且在 4096 batched-token 上限下 KV 预算为正
- [ ] TP8 数据点在同一配置键下重跑，服务参数不变（脚本判定条件使 TP8 保持上游默认值）；结果应与已合并曲线一致

</details>

title: feat(glm52-agentx): add compact B300 TensorRT-LLM recipes / 新增 B300 TensorRT-LLM 紧凑配方
body:
## Description

Adds six GLM-5.2 NVFP4 AgentX recipes on B300 using Dynamo 1.4.0 and TensorRT-LLM 1.3.0rc26 with disaggregated serving. The master config registers worker topology, concurrency, image, and recipe paths under `glm5.2-fp4-b300-dynamo-trt-agentic-mtp-compact`.

Each TensorRT-LLM worker occupies a separate node. Worker environments set `OMP_NUM_THREADS=12`, `MIMALLOC_PURGE_DELAY=10000`, and `ETCD_LEASE_TTL=120`. The native `numa_cpu_bind` helper applies each MPI rank's GPU-local NUMA CPU mask before execution, without OpenMP binding variables. Benchmark and eval readiness checks require all workers to register within 30 minutes. The setup helper removes matching, same-user regular shared-memory files that predate the allocation start by more than ten minutes; repeated setup preserves the current job's segments. The concurrency-20 recipe retains PMIx diagnostics after cleanup.

The recipes preserve LIBFABRIC NIXL transfer, zero bounce-buffer size, the legacy KV manager with standard CUDA allocations, and provider warnings. Dynamo installs use writable virtual environments and bounded retries with hash verification. Single-frontend eval endpoints reside on `head`. The B300 AgentX launcher forwards the workflow result filename, collects per-concurrency aggregates, and propagates failed Slurm producer status after staging artifacts.

This replaces #2789. The configuration guide documents the runtime contracts in English and Chinese.

## Validation

- Loaded all six recipes with the pinned srt-slurm implementation and rendered all worker endpoint commands, including placement, CPU binding, and worker environment.
- Generated the throughput and eval matrices and verified recipe/master topology alignment.
- Executed cleanup tests against isolated filesystem fixtures, including age boundaries, repeated setup, symlink/directory preservation, and invalid allocation timestamps.
- Exercised missing-registration timeouts and native CPU affinity with controlled external inputs.
- Validated the appended changelog and whitespace. GPU sweep and eval completion remain pending for the updated head.

## AI model disclosure

The exact model/version identifiers for the primary assistant and delegated agents could not be verified from the available runtime context. AI agents assisted with runtime changes, validation, documentation, and independent review. Model identifiers used for the original PR preparation have not been verified from the available history.

- [x] Bug fix

## 说明

新增六个 GLM-5.2 NVFP4 AgentX 配方，在 B300 上使用 Dynamo 1.4.0 与 TensorRT-LLM 1.3.0rc26 分离式服务。主配置在 `glm5.2-fp4-b300-dynamo-trt-agentic-mtp-compact` 下登记工作进程拓扑、并发、镜像和配方路径。

每个 TensorRT-LLM 工作进程独占一个节点。工作进程环境设置 `OMP_NUM_THREADS=12`、`MIMALLOC_PURGE_DELAY=10000` 和 `ETCD_LEASE_TTL=120`。原生 `numa_cpu_bind` 辅助脚本在执行前，为各 MPI rank 应用其 GPU 所在 NUMA 节点的 CPU 掩码，不设置 OpenMP 绑定变量。基准测试和 eval 的就绪检查都要求全部工作进程在 30 分钟内完成注册。启动辅助脚本只清理当前用户拥有、名称匹配且修改时间早于作业分配开始时间十分钟以上的普通共享内存文件；重复执行不会删除本次作业的共享内存。并发 20 的配方在清理后继续记录 PMIx 诊断信息。

title: [DNM] Add MI355X TP2 Engram CPU offload / 添加 MI355X TP2 Engram CPU 卸载
body:
## Scope

**AgentX ONLY. No fixed-sequence or 8k1k benchmarks.**

Add `dsv41flash-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-dspark-tp2-engram-cpu` for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on MI355X TP2 at concurrency 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, with a c32 real-rejection eval. Pin `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-af1c01499b289be555c475669ba50a88e96d846e` and pass `--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}'`.

The bundled patch adds AMD pinned-host Engram TP storage through the existing ROCm-capable UVA helper and permits explicit TP-only configuration. Common hashing, lookup math, TP ownership and graph staging are unchanged. Engram DP sharding and shared memory remain rejected. Original TP4 config and image stay unchanged. KV stays GPU-resident; AgentX throughput retains golden AL 3.51 and eval uses real block rejection.

The earlier mixed sweep was cancelled at the user's correction. The 8k1k config, entrypoint and client path have been removed. `full-sweep-enabled` now selects only the AgentX experiment.

## Verification

- Three local recipe behavior tests cover TP4 preservation, TP2 offload, and real-rejection eval.
- CPU configuration validation and clean patch application to the pinned source pass.
- GPU jobs must pass real lookup/graph preflight before model loading. GPU-less skips cannot pass preflight.
- [Run 35181013534, attempt 2](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35181013534/attempts/2) passed on head `6f87d7427967a03ac8fae42bc97486630c850702`: AgentX TP2 c1, c2, c4, c8, c16, c32 and c32 eval.
- All seven GPU jobs ran all three preflight tests successfully, including actual host/HBM lookup, TP2 shard reconstruction and graph replay; no GPU skips. Serving logs confirm pinned-host Engram tables and `cpu_offload=True`.
- All six throughput jobs passed result/error-rate and required server-metric validation and uploaded benchmark artifacts. Request errors were 0 at c1/c2/c4/c16, 1/1172 (0.085%) at c8, and 2/3369 (0.059%) at c32, within the unchanged repository threshold.
- [Real-rejection c32 eval](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35181013534/job/105101151381) passed GSM8K: strict-match 0.9712, flexible-extract 0.9704 (threshold 0.9). Eval artifacts were uploaded and collection passed.
- [Current-head CI](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35181013341) passed Lint and Tests. No fixed-sequence benchmark jobs ran in this AgentX-only sweep.

Hardware validation is complete for this experiment. Keep draft pending human review and the upstream-publication gate below; do not merge or bypass review.

## Patch disclosure

The bundled patch is now the runtime part of upstream [vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491) ("[ROCm][DSv4.1] Keep the Engram tables in host memory on ROCm"), applied to the same pinned image: the two `is_cuda()` gates in `vllm/config/engram.py` and `vllm/config/vllm.py` widen to `is_cuda_alike()`, and `amd/model.py` imports the shared `Engram` from `nvidia/engram.py`. The earlier private `amd/engram.py` implementation is removed; `rocm_preflight.py` now exercises the upstream `ParallelEngramEmbedding` and `Engram` classes on the GPU. The upstream test-file hunk is not shipped because the image has no test tree. The branch was merged with `origin/main` (append-only changelog resolution) to clear the conflict and retrigger the sweep. [Waiver](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/feat/dsv41flash-mi355x-tp2-engram-cpu/docs/waiver/3217.md) records patch scope and the removal plan; the upstream PR is open, not merged, so the upstream-publication merge gate remains outstanding. Model-support context: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56214. The hardware evidence above is from the previous patch and must be re-established by the new sweep.

AI assistance was used for implementation and local testing.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

## 范围

**仅运行 AgentX，不运行固定序列或 8k1k。**

为 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 添加 MI355X TP2 Engram CPU 卸载配置，并发为 1、2、4、8、16、32，c32 执行真实拒绝采样 eval。固定 af1c014 ROCm 镜像，并传入 `--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}'`。补丁采用现有 ROCm UVA helper 实现 pinned-host TP 表，保留公共计算和图暂存逻辑；仍拒绝 DP 分片及共享内存。原有 TP4 不变，KV 驻留 GPU，吞吐保留黄金 AL 3.51。

按用户更正，已取消混合扫描并移除 8k1k 配置、入口及客户端路径。`full-sweep-enabled` 仅选择 AgentX 实验。本地三个配方行为测试、CPU 配置及补丁应用检查通过。

[运行 35181013534，attempt 2](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35181013534/attempts/2)
在提交 `6f87d7427967a03ac8fae42bc97486630c850702` 上全部通过：TP2 AgentX c1、c2、c4、c8、c16、c32 和 c32 eval。七个 GPU 作业均实际运行并通过全部三个预检，无 GPU 跳过；服务日志确认 pinned-host Engram 和 `cpu_offload=True`。六个吞吐作业均通过结果、请求错误率及服务指标验证，并上传基准产物。c8 错误率为 1/1172（0.085%），c32 为 2/3369（0.059%），其余为零，均在未修改的仓库阈值内。真实拒绝采样 eval 的 GSM8K strict-match 为 0.9712，flexible-extract 为 0.9704，均超过 0.9 阈值。当前提交的 Lint 和 Tests 通过，此 AgentX-only 扫描未运行固定序列基准。

保持 draft，不合并或绕过审核。附带补丁现为上游 [vllm-project/vllm#57491](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57491) 的运行时部分（放宽 `is_cuda()` 门控为 `is_cuda_alike()`，并在 `amd/model.py` 中导入共享 `nvidia/engram.py` 的 `Engram`），镜像不变；此前的私有 `amd/engram.py` 实现已移除，预检改为验证上游类。分支已合并 `origin/main`（changelog 仅追加解决冲突）以重新触发扫描。补丁豁免见 `docs/waiver/3217.md`；上游 PR 仍为 open 状态，公开配方的合并条件仍未满足。上述硬件证据来自旧补丁，需由新扫描重新建立。实现和本地测试使用 AI 辅助。

</details>

title: [TileRT] Add GLM-5.3 FP8 MI355X prefill/decode-disaggregated recipes (8k1k + AgentX) / 新增 GLM-5.3 FP8 MI355X 的 PD 分离配方（8k1k + AgentX）
body:
## Description

Adds GLM-5.3 FP8 on MI355X as a prefill/decode-disaggregated TileRT recipe: upstream vLLM ROCm prefill (TileRTConnector, `kv_producer`) + TileRT `decode_server` + an OpenAI-compatible `pd_router`, `framework: tilert`, KV over mooncake. Two scenarios — Single-turn 8k1k and AgentX agentic-coding — mirroring the merged B200 `glm5.1-fp8-b200-tilert` entries on the `amd_utils` orchestration.

**Artifacts.** Two first-party images, `ghcr.io/tile-ai/tilert-rocm-decode:0.1.6` (decode) and `ghcr.io/tile-ai/tilert-rocm-prefill:0.1.6` (prefill, the upstream `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm` release image plus the mooncake ROCm transfer engine). Neither carries the wheel: `setup_deps.sh` installs `tilert==0.1.6` from PyPI into both ranks at container start — full install on decode, `--no-deps` connector plugin on prefill, so the image's torch/transformers/vLLM are untouched.

**Topology.** 1 prefill node (TP8) + 1 decode node (TP8), `conc-list: [1]` because TileRT decode serves one sequence at a time. bf16 KV cache on both roles — the ROCm vLLM sparse-MLA backend has no `fp8_ds_mla` dtype. `max-model-len` 202752, MTP at draft depth 3.

**Golden AL.** Nothing hard-codes an acceptance length. `server_tilert.sh` reads the committed curve at launch, selecting it exactly as `infx/srt_slurm/synthetic_acceptance.py` does, applies it to agentic throughput only, suppresses it under `RUN_EVAL`/`EVAL_ONLY`, and fails the run rather than silently falling back to real acceptance if the curve or draft length is missing.

> **Reviewers:** `golden_al_distribution/glm5.3_mtp.yaml` is **GLM-5.2's curve, copied**. No SPEED-Bench run exists for GLM-5.3; the two share a base and layer topology (`config.json` differs only by the fp8 quantization block), and only the K=3 cell is carried over because the ROCm TileRT GLM profile builds MTP at that depth only. The file is labelled `PROVISIONAL`. Flagging it rather than letting it read as a measured 5.3 curve — happy to take direction: a measured curve, a non-MTP agentic entry, or a waiver.

**Two checklist items worth stating up front.** *Framework ordering:* GLM-5.3 on AMD has no vLLM/SGLang entry, so this lands a TileRT arm first; the in-tree precedent is NVIDIA `glm5.1`, also TileRT-only, merged in #2533 (2026-08-09) and #2650 (2026-08-23), both after the ordering rule was added in #1886 (2026-06-22). *No engine patching:* the complete diff contains no `.patch`, `git apply`, `sed` into site-packages, monkey-patching, or container-file overwrites; vLLM runs exactly as shipped and no waiver is needed.

## AI model disclosure

- **Model/version:** `claude-opus-5[1m]` — Claude Opus 5 (1M context), via Claude Code. This is the identifier the runtime exposes; no other model or delegated agent contributed.
- **Role:** Wrote the recipe, orchestration and configs; ran the local validation on 2x8 MI350X; drafted this description and the commit message. All numbers quoted here were produced by the runs described under *Validation* and read back from the resulting artifacts, not generated by the model.

## Related Issue

<!-- none -->

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] New feature
- [x] Configuration change
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Validation

Run on 2x8 MI350X with those images and wheel, through the official entry points:

| | result |
|---|---|
| GSM8K (`RUN_EVAL=true EVAL_ONLY=true`, 1319 items) | strict-match **0.9750** ±0.0043, flexible-extract **0.9735** ±0.0044 |
| AgentX 3600 s, conc 1 | `submission_valid: true`, coverage TTFT 99.8% / ITL 99.9%, 532 requests, 0 errors |
| Single-turn 8k1k, conc 1 | TTFT p50 **1010 ms**, 16/16 requests completed |
| Matrix logic UTs | 335 passed |

**MI350X is not MI355X.** Same `gfx950` ISA, 256 CU / 288 GB / 8 TB/s, but 1000 W vs 1400 W TBP and 2200 vs 2400 MHz peak. These numbers show the recipe runs and is accurate; they are **not** leaderboard results — the sweep produces those on real `mi355x` runners.

## Checklist

- [x] I have completed the AI model disclosure and kept it current
- [x] I have tested my changes locally
- [x] I have updated documentation if necessary
- [x] **For every change that can affect benchmark performance and every recipe addition or modification, I have appended a new entry to the physical end of `perf-changelog.yaml` and have not edited historical entries**
- [ ] **Before merging via reuse, an authorized maintainer (`OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`) has commented `/use <run_id>` (or the legacy `/reuse-sweep-run`) on this PR**

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 改动说明

以 TileRT 的 prefill/decode 分离形态新增 MI355X 上的 GLM-5.3 FP8：上游 vLLM ROCm 作 prefill（TileRTConnector、`kv_producer`）+ TileRT `decode_server` + 兼容 OpenAI 的 `pd_router`，`framework: tilert`，KV 走 mooncake。两个场景：单轮 8k1k 与 AgentX 智能体编码，形态对齐已合并的 B200 `glm5.1-fp8-b200-tilert`，走 `amd_utils` 编排链。

**产物**：两个第一方镜像 —— decode 用 `ghcr.io/tile-ai/tilert-rocm-decode:0.1.6`，prefill 用 `ghcr.io/tile-ai/tilert-rocm-prefill:0.1.6`（上游 `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm` 发布镜像 + 源码构建的 mooncake ROCm 传输引擎）。两者都不含 wheel：`setup_deps.sh` 在容器启动时从 PyPI 装 `tilert==0.1.6`，decode 全装、prefill `--no-deps` 只装 connector 插件，镜像内的 torch/transformers/vLLM 一概不动。

**拓扑**：1 个 prefill 节点（TP8）+ 1 个 decode 节点（TP8），`conc-list: [1]`，因为 TileRT decode 一次只服务一条序列。两侧均用 bf16 KV cache —— ROCm 上 vLLM 的稀疏 MLA 后端没有 `fp8_ds_mla`。`max-model-len` 202752，MTP 草稿深度 3。

**黄金接受率**：任何地方都不写死接受率。`server_tilert.sh` 在启动时读取提交的曲线，选择规则与 `infx/srt_slurm/synthetic_acceptance.py` 完全一致；仅作用于 agentic 吞吐，`RUN_EVAL`/`EVAL_ONLY` 下自动关闭；曲线或草稿深度缺失时直接失败，而不是静默回落到真实接受率。

> **请评审裁决**：`golden_al_distribution/glm5.3_mtp.yaml` 是**从 GLM-5.2 抄来的曲线**。GLM-5.3 没有 SPEED-Bench 数据，两者同底座、同层拓扑（`config.json` 仅多 fp8 量化块），且只搬了 K=3 那一格（ROCm 的 TileRT GLM profile 只编了这个深度）。文件头已标 `PROVISIONAL`。主动挑明，而不是让它看起来像实测的 5.3 曲线。实测曲线、改非 MTP 的 agentic 条目、或走豁免，都听安排。

**两条主动说明的清单条款**：① 框架顺序 —— AMD 侧 GLM-5.3 目前只有 TileRT；在树先例是 NVIDIA `glm5.1` 同样只有 TileRT（#2533、#2650，均在规则 #1886 之后合入）。② 未打补丁 —— 全 diff 无 `.patch` / `git apply` / 改 site-packages / monkey-patch / 覆盖容器文件，vLLM 原样运行，无需豁免。

## AI 模型使用说明

- **模型/版本**：`claude-opus-5[1m]` —— Claude Opus 5（1M 上下文），经 Claude Code 使用。这是运行时暴露的标识；没有其他模型或委派 agent 参与。
- **工作内容**：编写配方、编排与配置；在 2×8 MI350X 上执行本地验证；起草本说明与提交信息。文中所有数字均来自「验证」一节所述的实际运行、并从产物中读回，不是模型生成的。

## 关联 issue

无。

## 改动类型

新功能 + 配置改动。

## 验证结果

在 2×8 MI350X 上、用上述镜像与 wheel、走官方入口：GSM8K strict-match **0.9750**、flexible-extract **0.9735**；AgentX 3600 秒 `submission_valid: true`、覆盖率 99.8%/99.9%、532 请求、0 错误；单轮 8k1k TTFT p50 **1010 ms**、16/16 请求完成；矩阵逻辑单测 335 通过。

⚠️ **这是 MI350X，不是 MI355X**：同 `gfx950` ISA、同 256 CU / 288 GB / 8 TB/s，但 TBP 1000W vs 1400W、峰值频率 2200 vs 2400 MHz。这些数字用于证明配方能跑且结果正确，**不是打榜成绩** —— 榜上成绩由 sweep 在真实 `mi355x` 机器上产出。

## 检查清单

清单已在上方英文部分勾选，此处不重复。

</details>

title: [NV] Move GB300 DeepSeek-V4-Pro AgentX disagg to the Mooncake external linker / 将 GB300 DeepSeek-V4-Pro AgentX 分离式配置切换到 Mooncake external linker
body:
## Summary / 概要

Move the GB300 DeepSeek-V4-Pro Dynamo-SGLang AgentX disaggregated Pareto ladder (1P1D c480, 2P1D c960, 3P1D c1440, 4P1D c1920) from hierarchical cache to the Mooncake unified-cache external linker, and pick up the matching prefill scheduling changes.

将 GB300 DeepSeek-V4-Pro Dynamo-SGLang AgentX 分离式 Pareto 配置（1P1D c480、2P1D c960、3P1D c1440、4P1D c1920）从 hierarchical cache 切换到 Mooncake unified-cache external linker，并同步相应的 prefill 调度改动。

- Serve the host KV tier through the unified-cache external linker on Mooncake, with group semantics enabled.
- Let decode ranks contribute host DRAM to the store, and retain only a sparse SWA checkpoint per 32768-token interval, so the same DRAM holds more prefixes at the same eviction watermark.
- Split a prefill request into 2048-token chunks and defer intermediate chunk KV transfer.
- Raise prefill mem-fraction-static from 0.85 to 0.92.
- Pin the image to lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20260908-20ca564b and record the offload backend as mooncake in the master config.
- Use the split CUDA-graph batch-size flag, since the source this configuration runs against no longer carries the deprecated alias.

- 主机侧 KV 层改由 Mooncake 上的 unified-cache external linker 提供，并启用 group semantics。
- decode rank 也贡献主机 DRAM 容量，并按 32768 token 间隔只保留稀疏 SWA checkpoint，使同样的 DRAM 在相同驱逐水位下容纳更多前缀。
- prefill 按 2048 token 切分单个请求，并延迟中间 chunk 的 KV 传输。
- prefill mem-fraction-static 从 0.85 提升到 0.92。
- 镜像固定为 lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20260908-20ca564b，master config 中的 offload backend 记为 mooncake。
- 改用拆分后的 CUDA graph batch size 参数，因为该配置所依赖的源码已移除旧别名。

## Temporary source override / 临时源码覆盖

The serving change is still in review as sgl-project/sglang#39694 and is not in a released image. Until it ships, the gb300-nv runner clones that branch (pinned by commit) into the srt-slurm configs directory and the servers import it through PYTHONPATH, while still using the container's compiled kernels. A small compatibility shim restores the ServerArgs accessor that the pinned Dynamo wheel still calls. A setup script runs before every server and aborts the job when either piece is missing or is the wrong revision, so a run cannot silently fall back to the container's SGLang.

This is explicitly temporary. The clone block in the runner, the setup script, the compatibility shim, and the recipes' setup_script/PYTHONPATH keys all come out in one commit once the change is in the pinned image.

服务端改动仍在 sgl-project/sglang#39694 评审中，尚未进入发布镜像。在此之前，gb300-nv runner 会将该分支（按 commit 固定）克隆到 srt-slurm 的 configs 目录，服务进程通过 PYTHONPATH 导入，同时继续使用容器内编译好的 kernel。另有一个兼容补丁，用于恢复固定版本 Dynamo wheel 仍在调用的 ServerArgs 访问方法。setup 脚本在每个服务进程启动前运行，当任一部分缺失或版本不符时直接让任务失败，避免静默回退到容器自带的 SGLang。

这是明确的临时方案：改动进入固定镜像后，runner 中的克隆逻辑、setup 脚本、兼容补丁以及 recipe 中的 setup_script/PYTHONPATH 会在同一个提交中移除。

## Validation / 验证

body:
## Description

Repin the DSV4 MI355X vLLM AgentX recipe (`dsv4-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-mtp`) to the newest published ROCm nightly, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100-d05da62e9ccdf8e342b15bf6785d83224cc165af` (digest `sha256:461e9c79…`, Docker Hub pushed `2026-09-20T06:32:10Z`, tag commit vllm-project/vllm@d05da62e), up from `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-eed1f3d0c6043bd494424a22443ee198dd56f657` on `main` (pinned in #3071).

The original revision of this PR pinned the 2026-09-15 build `nightly-rocm100-cd10ed6f…`. That tag is now five nightlies old, so the pin moved forward to the current one. `main` has also been merged into the branch, which moved this PR's `perf-changelog.yaml` entry to the physical end of the file; `main`'s changelog bytes are preserved byte-for-byte.

### What the new nightly adds

`d05da62e` is 294 upstream commits ahead of `cd10ed6f` and 352 ahead of the CSA merge commit. Besides [vllm-project/vllm#51794](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51794), which enables CSA (Compressed Sparse Attention) multi-stream overlap for DeepSeek-V4 on ROCm so the two compressor `wkv_gate` GEMMs run on aux HIP streams instead of serially on the main stream during decode, the range brings in:

| Upstream PR | Change |
| --- | --- |
| [#57132](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57132) | Reverts the DeepSeek-V4 accuracy breakdown on ROCm (accuracy-relevant for the eval leg) |
| [#57465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57465) | Fixes fused MoE expert distribution for DeepSeek V4 |
| [#56853](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56853) | Enables HCA dual-stream overlap for DeepSeek-V4 |
| [#50455](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50455) | Fixes the sparse-indexer logits collapse on gfx950/gfx942 |
| [#56743](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56743), [#57434](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57434) | gfx950 decode top-k optimization and ragged-metadata reuse across layers |
| [#55934](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55934) | triton + triton_kernels 3.8 MXFP4 MoE support for DeepSeek-V4 |
| [#56885](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56885) | Bumps AITER to v0.1.22.post1 |

No recipe fields other than `image` change. The search space, concurrency lists (`1, 4, 8, 16, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64` without DP attention and `64, 128, 192` with DP attention plus `vllm-router` 0.1.14), `dram-utilization: 0.60`, and the `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=0` workaround from #3071 are untouched. `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/dsv4_fp4_mi355x_vllm_mtp.sh` reads the image from `amd-master.yaml` and is unmodified.

title: perf: extend MI355X DSv4.1 Flash AgentX sweep to c128, bump ROCm nightly / 扩展 MI355X DSv4.1 Flash AgentX 扫描至并发 128 并更新 ROCm nightly
body:
## Description

Stage concurrency 64 and 128 for the MI355X DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP4 AgentX sweep, and bump the image from the placeholder `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-TBD` to the latest published upstream ROCm nightly, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-af1c01499b289be555c475669ba50a88e96d846e`.

This replaces closed #3068. That PR derived graph capture directly from client concurrency, which did not account for AgentX subagent fan-out and regressed c1/c2.

The recipe now uses vLLM's API-server default `max_num_seqs`, which is 1024 on MI355X. CUDA graph capture remains 1024 tokens through c64 and becomes 2048 at c128, covering twice the outer concurrency while avoiding the 2048-token memory cost at lower points.

The image is now pinned to a real, verified-to-exist nightly tag, so this PR is ready for review and a full GPU sweep.

Pending the full sweep triggered by the `full-sweep-fail-fast` label.

title: Test H100 ModelScope loading from empty caches / 测试 H100 ModelScope 冷缓存加载
body:
## Description

Add H100 BF16 coverage for `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` through ModelScope. Every job starts with a verified-empty ModelScope cache and an independent empty HF cache. `trtllm-serve` downloads the remote model itself; the benchmark then uses the tokenizer from that same local snapshot. Snapshot reports record file sizes and SHA256 and reject unexpected HF fallback files.

The lane uses `nvcr.io/nvidia/tensorrt-llm/release:1.3.0rc27`, matching source `v1.3.0rc27` (`6e1cc953c071b8a9055b03ef2ae4ee0bc4c645c4`), with a source-matched runtime backport of [TensorRT-LLM #2](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/TensorRT-LLM/pull/2). Dependencies are pinned to `modelscope==1.40.1` and `modelscope-hub==0.4.3`. [The engine-patch waiver](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/feat/trtllm-modelscope-cold-cache/docs/waiver/3324.md) records scope, provenance, and removal. This is the requested new cold-cache PR and includes the unmerged integration from #3323.

## Validation

**[Full PR sweep passed](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35544218778)** on `e78910cb90fd425ef538e244c89e5524da161598`, with `full-sweep-enabled`. [Complete artifact audit](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3324#issuecomment-5753552101).

- TP1, 8k/1k, throughput c1/c4/c16/c32/c64: **1,170/1,170 successful requests**, zero failures, valid power.
- Full GSM8K c32: **870/1,319 strict (65.9591%)**, 878/1,319 flexible (66.5656%).
- Full GSM8K c64: **884/1,319 strict (67.0205%)**, 889/1,319 flexible (67.3995%).
- Both evals have zero empty responses and preserve five-shot chat, temperature 0, top_p 1, 5,376 output tokens, and the documented **0.60 model-specific regression floor**. Global thresholds are unchanged.
- All seven jobs began with empty caches. Their seven inference assets match the HF reference SHA256. Verified all seven server/job logs, raw samples, expected concurrency metadata, score validation, power audits, and matching five-row throughput/two-row eval aggregates.
- [CI passed](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35544218127): **1,880 tests, one skipped**, MCP compatibility, and lint. Python CodeQL passed. Local focused tests, matrix generation, committed changelog validation, and Bash syntax passed.

The final GitHub job records show 7/7 GPU jobs passed. `run-stats` is an early 6/7 snapshot: it completed 46 seconds before the last eval. Separate canary jobs were skipped, while all five throughput points and both evals executed.

[The controlled 12-evaluation HF/ModelScope comparison](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/TensorRT-LLM/pull/2#issuecomment-5753534425) also completed. It verified identical input assets, prompts and settings, but **did not establish identical accuracy**: ModelScope versus patched-HF strict means differ by −0.0758 percentage points at c32 and −1.5921 at c64. Same-arm repeat variation and the fixed-order, two-repeat design limit causal interpretation. Passing the integration floor is not an equivalence claim.

GPU evidence covers the release-compatible backport, not a build of the newer TensorRT-LLM PR branch. Model downloads and inference ran only on H100. This PR remains unmerged.

## AI model disclosure

Earlier integration work was disclosed as GPT-5; that earlier exact identifier could not be independently verified. This continuation used GPT-6-based Codex for implementation, validation, and monitoring; the exact runtime model/version is not exposed and could not be verified. No delegated agents were used.

title: [PowerX] skip unreadable in-window power cells instead of voiding the point / 跳过窗口内读不出的功耗单元格而非作废整个点
body:
## Description

amd-smi blanks `socket_power` while a GPU idles, which agentic replay hits constantly. One such cell inside the window raised `invalid_power_sample` and voided the whole hour. In run 35157825655 concurrency 48 passed with 29 outside the window; concurrency 10 died on one inside.

Blank cells are now skipped and counted in `window_degenerate_rows`, as out-of-window rows already are, leaving the bracketing, 3 s gap and GPU-count bounds to judge it. A device may lose two cells, or 1%, before `degenerate_power_samples_exceeded` rejects it.

**Testing:** 1846 CPU tests and ruff pass. Replaying nine archived CSVs recovers concurrency 4, 8, 10.

**Sweep:** the 9-point MI355X Kimi-K3 vllm matrix. ATOM is excluded because it resolves to its own published curve and #3207 replaces that curve with a retuned recipe, a new image and the concurrency set [1, 4, 14, 16, 48, 56, 72]; sweeping the current ATOM concurrencies here would supersede that retune whenever this merges second. The ATOM image never blanks the cell, so this recovers no ATOM point in any case. vllm 12/14/70 blank past the last in-band sample and still fail, correctly, until the collector is fixed.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

GPU idle 时 amd-smi 会把 `socket_power` 置为 N/A，而 agentic replay 在请求间隙反复进入该状态。窗口内出现一个这样的单元格就会触发 `invalid_power_sample`，作废整整一小时。run 35157825655 中并发 48 有 29 个空单元格落在窗口外，照常通过；并发 10 只因窗口内一个就被判无效。

这类单元格现在会被跳过并计入 `window_degenerate_rows`，与窗口外的行原有处理一致，覆盖由既有的窗口边界、3 秒采样间隔和 GPU 数上限判定，与 NVIDIA 同一标准。单台设备最多丢失两个单元格或 1%，超出即由 `degenerate_power_samples_exceeded` 判为无效。

**测试：** 1846 项 CPU 测试与 ruff 通过。回放九份归档 vllm CSV，并发 4、8、10 恢复有效。

**Sweep：** MI355X Kimi-K3 vllm 的 9 点矩阵。不包含 ATOM：它解析出的是另一条已发布曲线，而 #3207 会用重新调优的 recipe、新镜像和并发集 [1, 4, 14, 16, 48, 56, 72] 替换该曲线；此处重跑当前的 ATOM 并发点，只要本 PR 后合入就会把那次调优顶掉。ATOM 镜像也不会置空该单元格，因此本改动本来就恢复不了任何 ATOM 点。vllm 并发 12/14/70 在最后一个带内样本之后持续置空，属于窗口末端的采集缺失，在采集端修好之前仍会正确判为无效。

</details>

title: [Klaud Cold] Add GB300 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash SGLang DSpark AgentX / 新增 GB300 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash SGLang DSpark AgentX 配方
body:
Add `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-sglang-agentic-dspark`: the GB300 SGLang counterpart of the vLLM DSv4.1 Flash AgentX arm, built from the [SGLang cookbook](https://lmsysorg.mintlify.app/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4_1). DSv4.1 Flash has not shipped in an SGLang release, so the recipe uses the preview build `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-dsv41` (digest recorded in the master config and changelog). TP4/EP4, native five-token DSpark (`--speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5`), thinking on with reasoning effort high, `--mem-fraction-static 0.8`, GPU-resident KV cache (`kv-offloading: none`), concurrency 1–128. Throughput uses the [golden AL 3.51](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/main/golden_al_distribution/dsv41flash_dspark.yaml) (thinking on) through `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN`; accuracy evals keep real DSpark verification. `--max-running-requests` is `2 * CONC` for AgentX subagent fan-out and the decode graph batch covers it, floored at the cookbook's 64 and capped at 128.

Follows the cookbook's verified Blackwell low-latency cell; attention, MoE and FP8 GEMM backends resolve automatically (the cookbook warns that overriding them lands on the slow Triton block-FP8 fallback). The `gb300` launcher's `dsv41flash` model-path, `/ix` mount and capture-size gates previously accepted only `framework: vllm`; they now accept `sglang` too.

Pre-downloaded checkpoint: the launcher resolves `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` through the cluster's persistent HF cache exactly as the vLLM arm does; the script only completes or resumes a partial download.

Validation: `bash -n`, YAML parse, exact-key matrix generation, and changelog append (no deletions) pass. GPU validation pending; `full-sweep-fail-fast` is set on this PR.

title: [Kimi B300] repair RDMA startup and Mooncake recovery / 修复 RDMA 启动及加载恢复
body:
## Description

Restore B300 Mooncake startup with active Mellanox discovery and the host mlx5 provider, and backport request-local recomputation after failed KV loads.

Also raise `VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` to 1800. Concurrency 48 and 56 died with `EngineDeadError` after 293 s and 299 s of engine silence: a Mooncake load blocks inside `execute_model`, and vLLM caps that RPC at 300 s by default. `VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT`, already raised here, does not cover that path. Concurrency 70 recovered from a 240 s stall with ten times the failed KV loads, so the stall tail is normal for this workload and the cap left under a minute of headroom.

**Testing:** a new test asserts the timeout across every vLLM recipe that configures a `MooncakeStoreConnector`; it fails on the old recipe and passes on the new one. Changelog and matrix plan (11 benchmark + 11 eval jobs on one image) validate. [Sweep](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35497862601) running.

**Note:** the earlier concurrency 4 and 24 cancellations were queue contention, not a hang — neither ever started the benchmark. `batch_1` has 16 usable nodes of 18.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

修复 B300 的活动 Mellanox 网卡识别与主机 mlx5 驱动加载，并回移 KV 加载失败后的请求级本地重算逻辑。

同时将 `VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` 调高到 1800。并发 48 与 56 在引擎静默 293 秒和 299 秒后以 `EngineDeadError` 退出：引擎等待 Mooncake 加载时阻塞在 `execute_model` 内部，而 vLLM 对该 RPC 的默认上限是 300 秒；配方此前已调高的 `VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT` 覆盖不到这条路径。并发 70 在 KV 加载失败次数高出十倍的情况下仍从 240 秒停顿中恢复，说明该停顿尾部对这一 workload 属正常范围，300 秒只留下不到一分钟余量。

**测试：** 新增测试对所有配置了 `MooncakeStoreConnector` 的 vLLM 配方断言该超时值，在旧配方上失败、在新配方上通过。changelog 与矩阵规划（11 个 benchmark + 11 个 eval 作业，同一镜像）校验通过；[sweep](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35497862601) 运行中。

**说明：** 此前并发 4 与 24 的取消是排队争用而非卡死 —— 两者都没有真正启动 benchmark。`batch_1` 的 18 个节点中仅 16 个可用。

</details>

title: [Klaud Cold] Add MI300X Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 vLLM MTP 1k1k + 8k1k / 新增 MI300X Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 vLLM MTP 1k1k + 8k1k 配方
body:
**Goal:** Add `qwen3.827b-fp8-mi300x-vllm-mtp` on MI300X, using native MTP3 with the measured **thinking-on synthetic AL 2.52** for throughput.
**Baseline:** N/A — new model/SKU recipe; the acceptance reference is [#3304](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3304) and [SPEED-Bench run 35492787451](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492787451).

`vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-a8d1aa9c99b8698a2a78b611b7a10c30e6b3995b` · TP1 · 1k/1k + 8k/1k · concurrency 1–128. The recipe reads `thinking_on[3]` from `golden_al_distribution/qwen3.827b_fp8_mtp.yaml` and sends `rejection_sample_method=synthetic`, `synthetic_acceptance_length=2.52` to vLLM. The pinned Qwen chat template enables thinking; the script requires `THINKING_MODE=thinking_on`.

The FP8 target is pinned to `017b9c7af6b5689d5dd426a76e0bc077eb5ca20a`. Its native MTP head comes from the original BF16 `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` at `1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0`, with BF16 draft KV cache and explicit MTP quantization exclusions. Eval-only and combined throughput+eval paths use real standard verification. The shared helper rejects unmeasured draft lengths outside 1–4 and missing or invalid AL values.

Validation: CI Tests and Lint, exact-key matrix generation, Bash syntax, and changelog byte-prefix preservation passed. **The fresh full sweep passed all 18 GPU jobs: eight 1k/1k points, eight 8k/1k points, and two separate accuracy evals.** Both curves cover concurrency 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128. All eight 8k/1k artifacts were checked for the workload identity, positive throughput, synthetic AL 2.52, and unquantized native MTP linear modules. Real-verification GSM8K scored **97.12% at concurrency 64 and 97.04% at concurrency 128**, with all 1,319 questions in each eval. [Validated full sweep 35501520852](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35501520852).

The existing reuse authorization predates the AL and 8k/1k changes; select the new validated full sweep before merging.

## AI model disclosure

AL integration, 8k/1k coverage and validation: GPT-6; the exact runtime model/version identifier could not be verified. The original PR's AI model/version was not recorded and could not be verified. No delegated agents contributed to this update.

**基线：**N/A——新增模型/SKU 配方；接受长度依据 [#3304](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3304) 和 [SPEED-Bench 运行 35492787451](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492787451)。

`vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-a8d1aa9c99b8698a2a78b611b7a10c30e6b3995b` · TP1 · 1k/1k + 8k/1k · 并发 1–128。配方从 `golden_al_distribution/qwen3.827b_fp8_mtp.yaml` 读取 `thinking_on[3]`，向 vLLM 传入 `rejection_sample_method=synthetic`、`synthetic_acceptance_length=2.52`。固定版本的 Qwen chat template 默认开启 thinking，脚本要求 `THINKING_MODE=thinking_on`。

FP8 目标固定为 revision `017b9c7af6b5689d5dd426a76e0bc077eb5ca20a`。原生 MTP 头来自原始 BF16 `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B`，revision 为 `1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0`；草稿 KV cache 保持 BF16，并显式排除 MTP 量化。仅精度评测以及吞吐后紧接精度评测的路径均使用真实的标准验证。共享辅助程序拒绝超出 1–4 范围的草稿长度，以及缺失或无效的 AL。

验证：CI Tests 和 Lint、精确 key 矩阵生成、Bash 语法和 changelog 历史字节保留检查均通过。**新的完整 sweep 的 18 个 GPU 任务全部通过：八个 1k/1k 点、八个 8k/1k 点，以及两个独立精度评测。** 两条曲线均覆盖并发 1、2、4、8、16、32、64、128。八个 8k/1k artifact 均已核实工作负载标识、有效吞吐、合成 AL 2.52 和未量化的原生 MTP 线性层。真实验证 GSM8K 在**并发 64 时准确率为 97.12%，并发 128 时为 97.04%**，每次评测均完成全部 1,319 道题。[验证通过的完整 sweep 35501520852](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35501520852)。

现有复用授权早于 AL 和 8k/1k 更新；合并前应选择新验证通过的完整 sweep。

AI 模型披露：AL 集成、8k/1k 覆盖和验证由 GPT-6 完成；无法核实运行时精确模型及版本标识。原始 PR 未记录 AI 模型及版本，无法核实。本次更新未使用委派代理。

</details>
