title: [wip ai slop] Implement Phase 1 native H100 pilot / 实现阶段 1 原生 H100 试点
body:
Phase 1 moves `dsv41flash-fp4-h100-vllm-agentic-dspark` onto prepared native srt-slurm execution: one exclusive H100 node, one direct vLLM TP8 worker, and Python-owned AgentX/eval clients. Same-repository PR sweeps can qualify the real workload without deploying an app reader or collector. Qualification artifacts are ineligible for publication.

## Implementation

- Preserve the existing image/model, five-token DSpark, golden AL resource and workload policy. Run eight full 3,600-second throughput points at **c1,2,4,8,16,20,24,28**, plus a separate **real c28 GSM8K eval** covering all 1,319 documents and both filters. Power remains an explicit temporary parity exception; `require-power` is rejected.
- Prepare noneditable native/wrapper/client runtimes and pinned offline assets on shared storage. Bind the actual measured checkout, runtime/model/dataset identities, image bytes, interpreter mounts and inputs before allocation. The recipe stays in the existing `benchmarks/multi_node/srt-slurm-recipes/` hierarchy.
- Pin native **`62beb5ec4f8c33abc26851ba0adaded29957ca5b`** from [native PR #21](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/srt-slurm/pull/21). Native code owns allocation, durable submission intents, listener ownership, observation and bounded ownership-scoped cleanup. On the actual Step Manager cluster, `squeue --steps` omitted a running worker; the fix queries job-specific `scontrol` step records. Cancellation probes now share the real c28 eval serving-argument renderer.
- Use separate checkout/output identities per run, attempt and queue token; retain preparation failures and allow 600 minutes for preparation, native waiting and cleanup. Preserve the shared gitlink and clean reference clones. Scope: **no InferenceX-owned Bash in this migrated runtime path**. Existing dependency-owned Bash and the legacy H100 recipe remain available.

## Qualification and publication

The complete native PR matrix uses `PreparedSite` and `purpose: pr-qualification`. It emits one intent, nine point artifacts and a separately validated summary. Acceptance checks matrix/source identities, frozen digests, resources and terminal closure, raw/normalized AgentX results, and the full GSM8K corpus and score. `publication_eligible` is always false.

This route emits no normal benchmark/eval artifacts or `RESULT_FILENAME`, skips normal collection/import, and is rejected by reuse and receipt/publication validators even in mixed inventories. Publication still requires independently deployed reader/collector identities. App reader [PR #1179](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/pull/1179) was reverted by the separately user-authorized [PR #1180](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/pull/1180). The additive schema remains; native ingestion/publication remain gated. This PR, native #21 and [collector #3298](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3298) remain unmerged.

## Validation and remaining hardware work

Current head: `c3db6c7df5c0dbe5222eccff9a4403707c5c1bed`. Its actual GitHub test-merge commit is `19a0d648932ec5f668fecb26f0c377bdd229cf49`; this is not a merged PR. Compared with candidate `17423228f1f4ad225233364ba53b3f36f90a818b`, only the English/Chinese guides changed.

- Candidate [Linux CI 35484873112](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35484873112) passed: **1,925 producer tests (three skipped), 2,507 native tests (two skipped, six actual-GPU integrations deselected)**, plus the separately installed nine-point prepare/render contract, lint and MCP discovery. [Strict Zizmor 35484875668](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35484875668) passed. Local full producer and focused installed-runtime checks also passed. Automatic PR [CI 35485312449](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35485312449) **passed on the exact test-merge `19a0d648...` with the same counts and installed nine-point contract**. [Security 35485312486](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35485312486) and [CodeQL 35485311143](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35485311143) passed. The unlabeled sweep skipped every GPU/publication job.
- Prior provisioning [35481075834](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35481075834) passed all 38 stages on native `50c3dacc...`, including real offline client probes and full asset identities. Replacement [35484558552](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35484558552) **passed all 38 stages** on the true candidate branch commit `17423228...` with native `62beb5ec...`. All 168 native source/package files match the pinned source. The real installed-wrapper verifier passes against test-merge `19a0d648...`; runtime inputs are identical. The exact returned `PreparedSite` is configured and read back byte-for-byte. Its recorded provisioning source remains `17423228...`.
- Old sweep [35483266492](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35483266492) was deliberately cancelled before allocation because it could not qualify the corrected runtime. All nine logs stopped in initial asset hashing. [Post-cancel observation 35485241189](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35485241189) found no client runtime, bundle or native receipt at any of the nine exact paths. Its incomplete summary correctly failed. No point or GPU measurement qualified.
- Earlier startup [35483589637](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35483589637) cancelled owned Slurm job `18324` to terminal closure but missed the worker trigger. Client probe [35483590787](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35483590787) ended `FAILED` during vLLM initialization before its writer started. **Neither lifecycle gate passed.** New step discovery and c28 parity need actual replay; CUDA recovery is not assumed.
- Fresh [startup 35486680437](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35486680437) **passed** on exact test-merge `19a0d648...` and native `62beb5ec...`: live owned worker `18326.5` was observed, the allocation was explicitly cancelled, and native evidence confirms terminal `CANCELLED`, `cleanup_complete:true` and `restoration_success:true`. [Client 35486685532](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35486685532) **also passed**: corrected c28 server reached readiness, live client step `18327.8` was observed, cancellation closed its 17-record writer on SIGTERM and the owned allocation reached terminal `CANCELLED` with native cleanup/restoration complete. No preceding teardown was found. This proves generic native-client cleanup, not in-flight HTTP cancellation or graceful model shutdown. The sole `full-sweep-enabled` label now started fresh [full sweep 35487222760](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35487222760); all eight 3,600-second throughput points, full c28 GSM8K evaluation, strict summary and baseline comparison remain pending.

title: fix(klaud): harden candidate dispatch and recovery / 加固 Klaud 候选调度与恢复
body:
Klaud was spending agent slots on candidates whose published baseline could not be reconstructed, repeating recent candidates, and turning verified terminal cleanup into workflow failures when the Claude action serialized its duplicate structured output incorrectly.

This change makes current master configs define the pool, reviews a bounded batch, deprioritizes recent same-base candidates, verifies the complete public baseline before dispatch, backfills skipped selections, retries transient API failures, and reconciles every agent exit. Diagnostics now prefer the lifecycle-verified `outcome.json`; the prompt requires one exact `StructuredOutput` handoff, stops after terminal resolve/baseline evidence, keeps performance changelogs concise, and uses a shorter reporting contract.

All 16 cells completed every SPEED-Bench Qualitative coding prompt: 80 requests per cell, **1,280 successes and zero failures**. AL includes the bonus token; AR is accepted draft tokens divided by actual proposed tokens.

| Thinking | Draft tokens | FP8 AL | FP8 AR | BF16 AL | BF16 AR |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| off | 1 | 1.90 | 90.04% | 1.91 | 91.11% |
| off | 2 | 2.68 | 83.78% | 2.66 | 82.93% |
| off | 3 | 3.28 | 75.96% | 3.27 | 75.56% |
| off | 4 | 3.79 | 69.85% | 3.78 | 69.40% |
| on | 1 | 1.73 | 72.67% | 1.73 | 73.22% |
| on | 2 | 2.21 | 60.50% | 2.21 | 60.41% |
| on | 3 | 2.52 | 50.70% | 2.51 | 50.25% |
| on | 4 | 2.72 | 43.07% | 2.72 | 42.89% |

The two golden YAMLs retain AL values, precise AR fractions, raw counters, model revisions, sampling settings, dataset hash, and source runs:
- `golden_al_distribution/qwen3.827b_fp8_mtp.yaml`
- `golden_al_distribution/qwen3.827b_bf16_mtp.yaml`

Measurement: H200, TP1, concurrency 64, 16,384-token context, maximum output 4,096, seed 0, FP8 target KV cache, and Qwen model-card sampling for each thinking mode. Both target precisions use the original BF16 native MTP head and draft KV cache. The prepared dataset hash is identical across all four runs. Server logs, model inspection, request outputs, exact commands, and unrounded counters remain in each run's `speedbench-evidence` artifact.

| Target | Thinking off | Thinking on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FP8 | [35492786441](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492786441) | [35492787451](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492787451) |
| BF16 | [35492788796](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492788796) | [35492789880](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35492789880) |

The official FP8 checkpoint quantizes its embedded MTP tensors. The collector therefore loads the original BF16 head from `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` at `1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0`. The pinned vLLM loader also inherits target quantization for the MTP modules, so the collector explicitly excludes all original MTP weight modules using supported `--hf-overrides`. Runtime inspection confirms unquantized MTP linear modules. The FP8 target remains the official checkpoint at `017b9c7af6b5689d5dd426a76e0bc077eb5ca20a`.

The workflow now accepts explicit precision, TP, checkpoint revision, and collector/draft configuration; the existing H200 pool launcher supports the collector override. Priority jobs always request `nodes:1`. The Qwen collector rejects draft lengths outside 1–4 before model downloads, rejects incomplete cells or invalid counters, and keeps runtime directories under `/tmp` before staging final files.

Validation: 14 behavioral tests; Ruff check/format, Bash syntax, ShellCheck, actionlint, and Zizmor passed. The actual Bash collector rejected k=5 before download. All 16 measured cells passed artifact checks; AL/AR agree with vLLM's independent report, and the committed AL values match the workflow matrices. Generated text was inspected for both thinking modes. Related FP8 MTP recipes: [#3292](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3292), [#3293](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3293).

## AI model disclosure

Prepared by GPT-6 (implementation, source inspection, measurement orchestration, and validation). The exact runtime model/version identifier could not be verified. No delegated agents were used.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

新增 Qwen3.8-27B 的**原生 MTP** 黄金 AL/AR 曲线，覆盖 **FP8 和 BF16 目标模型、1–4 个草稿 token，以及 thinking 关闭/开启两种模式**。全部 16 个测量点均完成 SPEED-Bench Qualitative coding 类别的全部提示词：每点 80 次请求，共 **1,280 次成功、零失败**。AL 包含目标模型的保证 token；AR 为接受的草稿 token 数除以实际提出的草稿 token 数。完整数值见上表。

两个黄金 YAML（`qwen3.827b_fp8_mtp.yaml`、`qwen3.827b_bf16_mtp.yaml`）保留 AL、精确 AR 比例、原始计数器、模型版本、采样设置、数据集哈希和来源运行。

测量配置：H200、TP1、并发 64、上下文 16,384 token、最大输出 4,096 token、seed 0、FP8 目标 KV cache，以及模型卡规定的各 thinking 模式采样参数。两种目标精度均使用原始 BF16 原生 MTP 头和 BF16 草稿 KV cache。四次运行处理后的数据集哈希一致。上表链接的工作流 `speedbench-evidence` artifact 保留服务日志、模型检查、逐请求输出、精确命令和未舍入计数器。

官方 FP8 checkpoint 同时量化了内嵌 MTP 张量。因此收集器加载 `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` 在 revision `1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0` 的原始 BF16 MTP 头。固定版本的 vLLM loader 还会把目标量化配置传给 MTP 模块，因此通过受支持的 `--hf-overrides` 显式排除全部原始 MTP 权重模块。运行时检查确认 MTP 线性模块未量化。FP8 目标使用官方 checkpoint revision `017b9c7af6b5689d5dd426a76e0bc077eb5ca20a`。

工作流支持显式传入精度、TP、checkpoint revision，以及收集器和草稿配置；现有 H200 池 launcher 支持指定收集器。优先级任务始终请求 `nodes:1`。Qwen 收集器在下载模型前拒绝超出 1–4 范围的草稿长度，拒绝未完成的测量点或无效计数器，并在 `/tmp` 中创建运行目录，最后仅暂存输出文件。

验证：14 项行为测试，以及 Ruff 检查与格式检查、Bash 语法、ShellCheck、actionlint、Zizmor 均通过。实际 Bash 收集器在下载前拒绝了 k=5。全部 16 个测量点通过 artifact 核对，AL/AR 与 vLLM 独立报告一致，提交的 AL 数值与工作流矩阵一致，并检查了两种 thinking 模式的生成文本。相关 FP8 MTP 配方：[#3292](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3292)、[#3293](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3293)。

AI 模型披露：由 GPT-6 完成实现、源码核查、测量编排和验证；无法核实运行时精确模型及版本标识。未使用委派代理。

</details>

title: refactor(review): migrate CODEOWNER JavaScript to Python and recommend ≥5 Pareto points / CODEOWNER 从 JavaScript 迁入 Python，建议至少 5 个 Pareto 点 [wip ai slop]
body:
## Description

Highly recommend at least **5 measured points per affected throughput-versus-E2EL Pareto frontier**. Below five, or when coverage cannot be verified, keep a visible warning and require an explicit recorded admin exception before merge.

- Add Check 14 to CODEOWNER verification, plus an English checklist item and synchronized Chinese documentation.
- Add a deterministic review-time frontier counter. Count each affected curve separately; inspect artifacts and provenance independently; allow verified same-image existing points for append-only submissions.
- Add a `⚠️ Verdict: WARN` output. The trusted publisher inserts `@functionstackx @cquil11 @Oseltamivir @adibarra` above the findings, preserves REJECTED when another criterion fails, and updates the existing verdict comment instead of posting duplicates. Use only @usernames, without personal names.
- Keep the copyable checklist brief and free of explicit reviewer usernames: it says to tag a core maintainer. Only the automated Pareto-warning path inserts the four escalation mentions; passing/N/A coverage does not ping them.
- Validate every check row and reject incomplete, duplicate, malformed or contradictory verdicts. Coverage warnings are recognized with Markdown bullet prefixes; failed checks cannot be published as WARN.
- An admin exception must identify the assessed SHA, curves and rationale. The verifier checks the original human comment and repository admin permission/role. A standard approval, `/use`, Core membership or a bot assertion is not this exception.
- Keep the coverage checklist concise; detailed evidence, algorithm, source references and exception instructions live in verifier Check 14. The cross-repository synchronization rule is a single line in both `AGENTS.md` files, not a checklist item. Do not add Pareto coverage policy or checklist-pointer sections to `CONTRIBUTING.md` or `AGENTS.md`.
- Move all JavaScript from the CODEOWNER sign-off workflow into the `infx` package: `infx.workflows.signoff_resolve` resolves events and authorization, `infx.workflows.signoff_publish` maintains the verdict comment, and `infx.workflows.pareto_coverage` counts frontier points. Delete both `.cjs` helpers and replace both `actions/github-script` steps with locked Python module commands. The existing ownership-scope module remains in use.
- Use the shared `infx.github` transport, with an HTTP-status-bearing `RuntimeError` subclass so only an actual 404 permits recreating a deleted verdict comment. Preserve writer authorization, bot rejection, assessed-head checking, trusted-default-branch checkout, and advisory behavior.
- Reject manual sign-off URLs for another host, repository or PR, and verify repository-wide comment IDs actually belong to the requested PR. Validate generated output/command metadata.

## Companion PR

[InferenceX-app PR #1181](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/pull/1181)
contains the same one-line `AGENTS.md` instruction: Pareto logic changes must update
both repositories with matching regression tests and cross-linked PRs.
The app's algorithm remains unchanged. Review these documentation changes together.

## Research and scope

The [current signoff policy](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/13b32a37b8ed9b109a16ea45f0919d86cb81735c/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-pr-review-checklist-codeowner-sign-off) is advisory: it publishes one verdict comment, not commit statuses. The [Protect main ruleset](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/rules/13209060) separately requires Core/CODEOWNER review. This PR preserves that design: **no new required check, branch-rule change, merge action, or automatic bypass**. The admin exception is a review-policy requirement, not mechanically enforced by this comment.

The existing changed-file ownership scope is unchanged. Core/admin-only changes that currently skip automated signoff continue to do so; maintainers must apply the coverage policy during their review.

The dashboard implementation was inspected at [InferenceX-app `d507f36`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/commit/d507f3689274c82972709abb531bdedcb2e77946):

- [`metric-registry.ts`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/blob/d507f3689274c82972709abb531bdedcb2e77946/packages/app/src/components/inference/metric-registry.ts) selects `upper_right` for total token throughput per chip versus E2EL. Fixed-sequence uses median E2EL; AgentX uses the reviewed percentile, P90 by default.
- [`paretoFrontUpperRight`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/blob/d507f3689274c82972709abb531bdedcb2e77946/packages/app/src/lib/chart-utils.ts) sorts latency ascending and throughput descending on ties. It retains increasing throughput **and equal-throughput plateaus at distinct latencies**. Exact duplicates count once. This is the app's behavior, including its difference from strict mathematical non-dominance; this PR does not silently change the dashboard's math.
- [`chartFrontier`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/blob/d507f3689274c82972709abb531bdedcb2e77946/packages/app/src/components/inference/utils/powerCurves.ts) applies [`canonicalParetoIntersection`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/blob/d507f3689274c82972709abb531bdedcb2e77946/packages/app/src/components/inference/utils/canonicalFrontier.ts) only when canonical flags exist. The current [ChartDisplay](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/blob/d507f3689274c82972709abb531bdedcb2e77946/packages/app/src/components/inference/ui/ChartDisplay.tsx) does not stamp them on ordinary official E2EL points. The counter supports the conditional intersection without imposing it unconditionally on AgentX.

The counter consumes scoped coordinates; it is not an artifact downloader or provenance validator. The existing LLM verifier must identify all affected curves, inspect measured artifacts, map fields, verify grouping and independently check admin exceptions. Missing evidence warns rather than producing an invented point count.

## Validation

- 164 focused tests passed on Python 3.12: signoff scope, event resolution, publisher, Pareto counter and shared GitHub transport. Tests exercise real Python entrypoints and mock only GitHub transport; no Node dependency remains in these suites.
- 10,000 deterministic differential cases matched the Python counter against the actual pinned app frontier and canonical-intersection function bodies, including coordinate ties and conditional canonical intersection.
- Authenticated Zizmor auditor-mode check of the changed workflow passed with no unsuppressed findings (four existing documented ignores).
- Repository Ruff check and format check passed (`infx/`, 96 files).
- Built the `infx` wheel and checked the installed Pareto CLI outside the source checkout.
- English and Chinese pages contain byte-identical English signoff templates.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` has no added Pareto policy or checklist-pointer section. Both `AGENTS.md` files contain only the concise cross-repository rule; the review checklist has no cross-repository checkbox.

No GPU sweep or production verifier dispatch was run. No benchmark recipes, images, performance settings, workflow permissions or branch rules changed; no performance-changelog entry is needed.

## AI model disclosure

- Model/version: **GPT 6 Astra Fast**, the model label supplied in this session; no more granular build identifier was available.
- Role: repository research, implementation, tests, documentation and PR preparation.
- Follow-up fixes: **GPT-6 via Codex** (exact model variant/build identifier unavailable in this session), for verdict validation, regression coverage and synchronized documentation.
- No delegated agents were used.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 改动说明

强烈建议每条受影响的吞吐量与 E2EL Pareto 前沿至少有 **5 个实测点**。这不是不可豁免的最低门槛：少于五个点或无法核实时，显示警告，并要求管理员针对已评估 SHA、受影响曲线和理由明确记录例外决定后再合并。

- 新增 CODEOWNER Check 14、英文清单条目及同步中文文档。
- 新增确定性的审阅计数工具，逐曲线统计实测前沿；append-only 提交可计入来源已核实、配方未变且镜像相同的已有点。
- 新增 `⚠️ Verdict: WARN`。可信发布器在展开区域提醒 `@functionstackx @cquil11 @Oseltamivir @adibarra`，其他检查失败时仍保留 REJECTED，并复用原有裁定评论。只使用 @用户名，不附个人姓名。
- 可复制的清单保持简短，只要求提醒一位核心维护者，不写入具体审阅者用户名。仅在自动化 Pareto 警告路径中添加四位审阅者的提醒；覆盖度通过或为 N/A 时不触发这些提醒。
- 校验每项检查结果，拒绝缺失、重复、格式错误或前后矛盾的裁定。覆盖度警告支持 Markdown 列表前缀；其他检查失败时不能发布 WARN。
- 验证器需独立核实管理员原始评论和仓库 admin 权限/角色。普通批准、`/use`、Core 成员身份或机器人声明不能代替本项授权。
- 覆盖度清单保持简短；详细证据、算法、来源引用和例外说明集中在验证器 Check 14。跨仓库同步规则只在两仓库 `AGENTS.md` 中保留一句，不作为审阅清单条目。`CONTRIBUTING.md` 和 `AGENTS.md` 不新增覆盖度政策或指向清单的段落。
- 将 CODEOWNER 签核工作流的全部 JavaScript 迁入 `infx`：`infx.workflows.signoff_resolve` 负责事件解析及授权，`infx.workflows.signoff_publish` 维护裁定评论，`infx.workflows.pareto_coverage` 统计前沿点数。删除两个 `.cjs` 工具，以锁定依赖的 Python 模块命令替换两处 `actions/github-script`；继续使用现有归属范围模块。
- 复用 `infx.github`，新增带 HTTP 状态的 `RuntimeError` 子类，仅在评论更新返回 404 时重建评论。保留写权限检查、机器人排除、已评估 head 检查、可信默认分支检出和非强制门禁行为。
- 手动签核 URL 必须对应本仓库的指定 PR；额外核实仓库级评论 ID 确实属于该 PR，并校验写入输出和取证命令的元数据。

## 配套 PR

[InferenceX-app PR #1181](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/pull/1181)
在 `AGENTS.md` 中保留同一句要求：修改 Pareto 逻辑时，必须同步更新两仓库，
提供对应回归测试及互相链接的 PR。应用算法保持不变，两侧文档改动应一起审阅。

## 研究结论及范围

现有自动签核仅供审阅参考，不发布必需提交状态。本 PR 不新增合并门禁、不修改分支规则、不执行合并或绕过权限；管理员例外是审阅政策要求，评论本身不能阻止 GitHub 合并。现有 CODEOWNER 归属范围保持不变，原本跳过自动签核的 Core/admin-only 改动仍由维护者在人工审阅时执行此政策。

已核查 InferenceX-app `d507f36`：E2EL 图使用 `upper_right` 函数；固定序列采用 median E2EL，AgentX 采用审阅所选百分位，默认为 P90。该函数保留不同延迟下吞吐量相等的平台点，完全相同的坐标只计一次。这与严格数学非支配关系存在区别，本 PR 保留应用现有行为，不修改仪表板算法。

只有点上存在 canonical 标记时才取归一化交互性前沿交集；当前官方 E2EL 图表路径不会添加这些标记。计数工具支持该条件逻辑，不会对全部 AgentX 点强制取交集。

计数工具不负责下载 artifact、验证来源或发现遗漏曲线。现有 LLM 验证器仍需独立完成数据读取、字段映射、分组及管理员例外核实；证据缺失时报告 WARN，不编造点数。

## 验证

- Python 3.12 下 164 项相关测试通过，覆盖签核范围、事件解析、裁定发布、前沿计数及共享 GitHub 传输。测试运行真实 Python 入口，只模拟 GitHub 传输，不再依赖 Node。
- Python 计数器的 10,000 组确定性差分用例与锁定版本的应用前沿及 canonical 交集函数结果一致，包含相同坐标、平台点和条件交集。
- 使用认证的 Zizmor auditor 模式检查变更工作流，无未豁免发现，保留四项已有且已注明理由的忽略。
- 仓库 Ruff 检查及格式检查通过（`infx/` 共 96 个文件）；已构建 wheel 并在源码目录外验证安装后的 Pareto CLI。
- 双语页面英文模板一致性检查、`git diff --check` 均通过。
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` 不新增 Pareto 政策或清单链接段落；两仓库 `AGENTS.md` 仅保留简短的跨仓库同步规则，审阅清单中不再有跨仓库复选条目。
- 未运行 GPU sweep 或生产签核分发；未修改配方、镜像、性能设置、工作流权限或分支规则，因此无需性能变更日志。

## AI 模型使用说明

模型为本会话提供的 **GPT 6 Astra Fast**；没有更细的构建标识。该模型负责仓库研究、实现、测试、文档及 PR 准备，后续裁定校验、回归测试和双语文档修复使用 **GPT-6 via Codex**，本会话未提供精确模型变体或构建标识。未使用委派代理。

</details>

title: [Klaud Cold] Document lessons from the September 2026 DSpark and GLM-5.2 AgentX sweeps / 记录 2026 年 9 月 DSpark 与 GLM-5.2 AgentX sweep 的经验教训
body:
## Summary
- Add section 11 to `docs/eval-agentx-procedures.md` and its Chinese counterpart: evidence-backed lessons from the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash DSpark arms (#3239-#3247, #3216) and the GLM-5.2 nightly bumps (#3275-#3277), each tied to the GitHub Actions run that produced it
- Covers the Blackwell SGLang DSpark memory tiers (graph-tier pool cap, 0.70 static, 4096 chunk), the MI355X Engram and torch-allocator findings (`PYTORCH_HIP_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True`), the vLLM DSpark TP2 eval crash, detecting hung jobs without Slurm visibility, lease-controller and 24-hour queue mechanics, and repository mechanics (changelog key validation, merge-vs-rebase for the reuse gate, launcher refactor conflicts, SGLang and ROCm image gotchas)

Docs only; no recipe or config changes.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

body:
Add `dsv41flash-fp4-mi355x-sglang-agentic-dspark`: the MI355X SGLang counterpart of the vLLM DSv4.1 Flash AgentX arm, built from the [SGLang cookbook](https://lmsysorg.mintlify.app/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4_1). DSv4.1 Flash has not shipped in an SGLang release, so the recipe uses the preview build `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-dsv41-mi35x` (digest recorded in the master config and changelog). TP4/EP4, native five-token DSpark (`--speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5`), thinking on with reasoning effort high, `--mem-fraction-static 0.8`, GPU-resident KV cache (`kv-offloading: none`), concurrency 1–32. Throughput uses the [golden AL 3.51](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/main/golden_al_distribution/dsv41flash_dspark.yaml) (thinking on) through `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN`; accuracy evals keep real DSpark verification. `--max-running-requests` is `2 * CONC` for AgentX subagent fan-out and the decode graph batch covers it, floored at the cookbook's 64 and capped at 128.

Follows the cookbook's verified MI350X low-latency cell: `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `SGLANG_MOE_PADDING=1`, `AITER_FLYDSL_FORCE_REDUCE=1`, `ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=NONE`, `--disable-radix-cache`, breakable prefill graphs capped at 4096 tokens. The launcher already routes this checkpoint through the shared `/it-share/hf-hub-cache` and mounts the repo at `/ix` regardless of framework.

Pre-downloaded checkpoint: the launcher resolves `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` through the cluster's persistent HF cache exactly as the vLLM arm does; the script only completes or resumes a partial download.

Validation: `bash -n`, YAML parse, exact-key matrix generation, and changelog append (no deletions) pass. GPU validation pending; `full-sweep-fail-fast` is set on this PR.

One PR per SKU: h100, h200, b200, b300, gb200, gb300 and mi355x are opened separately.

title: [PowerX] isolate AMD monitor windows and worker lifecycle / 隔离 AMD 监控窗口与工作节点生命周期
body:
## Description

Make AMD monitor shutdown wait for usable end samples and coordinate native worker collectors without masking serving failures. Validate nine complete configuration curves across MI300X, MI325X and MI355X; exclude retired DSV4 8k1k. Default `KV_OFFLOADING` to `none` in AMD `submit.sh`: fixed-sequence rows never carry it, so since #3141 required it every AMD multi-node fixed-sequence submission failed before sbatch.

**Testing:** 1649 CPU tests, Bash/YAML and changelog/matrix checks pass.

**Pending:** 89 `full-sweep-enabled` jobs and hardware power acceptance.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

AMD 监控停止前等待有效终点样本，并协调各工作节点采集器，同时保留服务失败状态。使用 MI300X、MI325X 和 MI355X 的九条完整配置曲线验证，排除已退役 DSV4 8k1k。另在 AMD `submit.sh` 中给 `KV_OFFLOADING` 补上默认值 `none`：定长序列矩阵行从不携带该字段，而 #3141 开始强制校验它，导致所有 AMD 多节点定长序列作业在 sbatch 之前就提交失败。

**测试：** 1649 项 CPU 测试、Bash/YAML 与 changelog/矩阵校验通过。

**待完成：** 89 个 `full-sweep-enabled` 作业与硬件功耗验收。

</details>

## Related Issue

Independent on main; #3051 has merged. Split from #3026.

直接基于 main；#3051 已合并。拆分自 #3026。

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Configuration change
- [x] Documentation update
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Checklist

- [x] I have tested my changes locally
- [x] I have updated documentation if necessary
- [x] **For every change that can affect benchmark performance and every recipe addition or modification, I have appended a new entry to the physical end of `perf-changelog.yaml` and have not edited historical entries**
- [ ] **Before merging via reuse, an authorized maintainer (`OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`) has commented `/reuse-sweep-run` on this PR**. Do this **only once there is a final full sweep that is all green with evals passing**, since after this comment the sweep label will no longer automatically kick off new sweeps. Remove and re-add the label to force one.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes benchmark power teardown, Slurm/Docker launch paths, and exit-code semantics for many AMD recipes; incorrect coverage or receipt handling could invalidate power or mask serving failures when `REQUIRE_POWER` is set.
> 
> **Overview**
> **AMD single-node monitoring** in `benchmark_lib.sh` no longer uses a fixed sleep before killing `amd-smi`. Stop now polls `gpu_metrics.csv` until every GPU has a positive power sample at or after the first whole second past the stop request (`AMD_MONITOR_STOP_TIMEOUT_S`, default 30; `0` skips). The AMD path uses a per-run FIFO so both `amd-smi` and the `awk` consumer are torn down cleanly; FIFO failure honors `REQUIRE_POWER`. AgentX signal/EXIT cleanup sets the timeout to `0` so cancelled runs stop quickly.
> 
> **AMD multinode PowerX** adds `power.sh` and wires it through `server.sh`, `bench.sh`, and `job.slurm`: per-node `native_power_collect.sh` for fixed 8192/1024 (non-agentic) runs, ready/done receipts via a shared control dir, `stop` while servers are still up, staging of `native_power` as the runner user, and Docker env for `REQUIRE_POWER`, clock sync context, and collector revision. Exit codes keep serving failures primary; collector/staging failures fail the job only when power is required. Slurm `NUM_NODES` now reflects physical nodes when TP spans hosts. MI355x CI copies `native_power` into `LOGS`.
> 
> Docs, `perf-changelog.yaml` (broad AMD 8k/1k configs), and shell-contract tests cover stop coverage, lifecycle policy, and wiring.

Add the trusted control prerequisite for Phase 1: immutable measurement receipts, independently reviewed nine-point expectations, exact artifact-ID/digest transport, and later publication records. Python client/validation foundations are included, but this branch does not select or allocate the H100 pilot.

Land this prerequisite only after deploying the app reader in https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/pull/1179. The H100 producer is a separate child commit/PR. No hardware qualification or production deployment is claimed.

Large ZIP members are hashed in bounded chunks and eval samples are parsed line by line, retaining CRC, size, identity and score checks. Real 64 MiB ZIP and 32 MiB sample regressions stay below 8 MiB of peak Python allocations.

title: Add B200 Qwen3.5 397B FP8 disaggregated AgentX recipes
body:
Adds Qwen3.5-397B-A17B FP8 disaggregated AgentX recipes for B200 using Dynamo + SGLang through pinned srt-slurm. The matrix covers concurrency 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, and 64 with one TP4 prefill worker and one TP4 decode worker colocated on eight GPUs. C8–C32 use 104 GB of prefill HiCache per rank. C48 and C64 use 215 GB per rank with first-use write-through backup and a decode static-memory fraction of 0.88. Both use Mooncake intra-node NVLink transfer. Paired B300 PR: #3268.

The serving image is `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20260918-20518d85`, Dynamo is pinned to `805a77f053d807b0d8def5d27f674a6df0ed839e`, and srt-slurm to `984180e5b8755aef85e9995048b5a16cb5336bce`. Native NEXTN MTP settings are explicit; InferenceX selects measured synthetic acceptance automatically for throughput and removes simulation for real-verification evals.

Only new disaggregated points are proposed for publication. Existing aggregate curve scopes remain unchanged: publishing a sparse replacement aggregate sweep would discard other winning points under the dashboard's latest-run selection. Same-image aggregate and 2P1D experiments are comparison evidence.

### Performance qualification

C8's dependency-startup stall required a same-head failed-only retry through the dashboard after the other eleven GPU jobs and their artifacts were safe; its retry passed at 97.5739% accuracy.

The published database was refreshed read-only at 2026-09-19 02:42 UTC: all 33 B200 FP8 AgentX measurements were unchanged. All six full-hour PD measurements are mutually nondominated and extend that discrete published frontier; no interpolation or rounded cutoff is used for eligibility. Adding them while retaining the existing aggregate scopes would expand the primary frontier from 14 to 16 points:

- C16 dominates aggregate TP4 C8: 12,419.78/GPU at 269.536 versus 10,565.53 at 257.732, or +17.5% throughput and +4.6% interactivity. P90 TTFT increases from 0.851s to 0.995s.

title: [AgentX GB200] collect Kimi power and reserve CUDA Graph memory / 采集功耗并预留 CUDA Graph 显存

Enable required measured power on the seven GB200 Kimi-K3 dynamo-vLLM recipes (two DCP16 Mooncake, five TP8/PP2 Mooncake concurrency points) and lower TP8/PP2 `gpu-memory-utilization` 0.92→0.87 for CUDA Graph headroom.

**Testing:** full sweep [run 34836531846](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34836531846) on `2c6069f8`: 13/13 benchmarks, 13/13 evals green. Recipes byte-identical to head; the later `kimik3-dspark-config-compat.sh` change (drops `set -u`) is sourced by none of them.

title: feat(agentx): retune GLM5.2 FP4 MI355X ATOM recipe on _0915 docker (TP+MTP, DCP+TP+MTP)
body:
> **Source PR:** This PR mirrors https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3171 (from `zhuyuhua-v:glm5.2-atom-agentx-0915`), re-created on an in-repo `amd/` branch.

## Summary

Aligns the `glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-atom-agentic-mtp` benchmark to the validated standalone ATOM recipe (ROCm/ATOM PR 2247). Switches to the `_0915` nightly runtime, adds per-concurrency MTP draft depth with the golden acceptance length, enables TP4+DCP4 for high concurrency, and rewrites the online-quant exclude, cache, and NUMA settings.

## Changes

### `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/glm5.2_fp4_mi355x_atom_mtp.sh`
- **Per-concurrency MTP depth + golden AL** via `--spec-decode-acceptance-length` (was fixed `K3 / AL 2.99` with `--spec-decode-acceptance-rate`): `K5 / 3.61` for C1–C8, `K4 / 3.33` for C10–C40, `K3 / 2.99` for C48. Golden AL from `golden_al_distribution/glm5.2_mtp.yaml` (`glm-5.2-fp8`, `thinking_on`).
- **DCP support**: reads `DCP_SIZE` (default 1), adds `--decode-context-parallel-size` when >1, with DCP-aware CUDA-graph capture sizes.
- **online-quant exclude rewritten** to a 7-module pattern (was a single `*expert*` pattern): global `ptpc_fp8` that excludes `lm_head`, `model.embed_tokens`, every `*.mlp.gate`, all MoE experts on layers 0–77 (kept native MXFP4), and the entire MTP head via `model.layers.78.*` (kept native BF16). Only the dense attention/MLP Linears are re-quantized to `ptpc_fp8`. Layer 78 is excluded explicitly because `amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4` ships the MTP block in BF16 and the expert patterns only reach layer 77.
- Added `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.95`, `--enable_prefix_caching`, `export ATOM_USE_FLYDSL_GATHER_KV_B_PROJ=0` (GLM-5.2 MLA head dims), and `export LMCACHE_NUMA_MODE=auto`.

### `configs/amd-master.yaml` (`glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-atom-agentic-mtp`)
- **Image** → `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609151450` (was `..._glm52_agentic_0813`).
- **Added TP4+DCP4 arm** for high concurrency: `conc-list: [16, 24, 32, 40, 48]` with `dcp-size: 4`.
- **`dram-utilization` 0.14 → 0.171**, yielding `TOTAL_CPU_DRAM_GB = 256` per TP4 rank, matching the recipe's `LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_CPU_SIZE=256`. The TP8 GPU-only arm is unaffected.

## Per-concurrency configuration

| Concurrency | Parallelism | `--num-speculative-tokens` | `--spec-decode-acceptance-length` |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| C1, C2, C4 | TP8 (GPU-only) | 5 | 3.61 |
| C2, C4, C8 | TP4 | 5 | 3.61 |
| C10 | TP4 | 4 | 3.33 |
| C16, C24, C32, C40 | TP4 + DCP4 | 4 | 3.33 |
| C48 | TP4 + DCP4 | 3 | 2.99 |

## Validation

Run locally on MI355X (container `nightly_202609151450`, ATOM `e03b7f17` / AITER `797cce25`). C2/C4/C8/C10/C16/C24/C32/C40 completed on first attempt with a full 3,600 s AgentX profile; forced acceptance is performance-only.

## Notes

Forced acceptance length is performance-only and does not preserve accuracy — disable `--spec-decode-acceptance-length` for GSM8K / SWE-bench / any correctness eval.

title: [Klaud Cold] Add MI325X Qwen3.8-27B bf16 vLLM TP1 DSpark 1k1k enforce-eager / 新增 MI325X Qwen3.8-27B bf16 vLLM TP1 DSpark 1k1k enforce-eager 配方
body:
Add `qwen3.827beager-bf16-mi325x-vllm-mtp`: Qwen3.8-27B in bf16 ([Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B)) on a single MI325X (256 GB), served by vLLM `nightly-eed1f3d0c6043bd494424a22443ee198dd56f657` with TP1 and the RadixArk DSpark drafter [`Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM`](https://huggingface.co/Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM) (byte-identical weights to `RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark`; only `architectures` is changed so vLLM routes it to `Qwen3DSparkForCausalLM`). Single-turn 1k1k only, concurrency 1-128.

Serve shape: `--speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","model":"Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}'` (seven tokens is the drafter's trained block size; its card measured k=4 and k=6 slower, and probabilistic sampling ~23% faster than greedy), Triton attention with a bf16 KV cache (gfx942 has no calibrated fp8 attention scales), `--max-num-seqs` sized to the sweep point (floor 16, 256 for accuracy evals: vLLM's default 1024 exceeded the 472 GDN cache blocks next to the weights on H100 in run 35357364404), `--no-enable-prefix-caching` so every request prefills its full prompt, `--language-model-only` (text-only serving of `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration`), `--reasoning-parser qwen3`, `--tool-call-parser qwen3_xml`, and the matrix context as `--max-model-len`, plus `--enforce-eager`. Adaptive verification stays off because vLLM's GDN attention backend rejects it for this hybrid architecture. Prompts go through the chat template so draft acceptance reflects real text rather than random tokens; acceptance is real (no golden AL exists yet for this drafter). On gfx942 the recipe follows the MiniMax-M3 and DSv4.1 Flash ROCm arms: `--attention-backend TRITON_ATTN`, bf16 KV cache, `VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=0`, image `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm` nightly (tag verified on Docker Hub). The eager variant keeps its own model-prefix `qwen3.827beager` only because the launcher resolves the benchmark script from `exp-name` (model-prefix plus scenario); it is otherwise identical to the `qwen3.827b` recipe with `--enforce-eager` added. MODELS.md rows live in the H100 base PR (#3260).

Validation: `bash -n`, YAML parse, exact-key matrix generation, and changelog append (no deletions) pass. GPU validation pending; `full-sweep-fail-fast` is set on this PR.

One PR per SKU.

<summary>中文</summary>

新增 `qwen3.827beager-bf16-mi325x-vllm-mtp`：bf16 的 Qwen3.8-27B（[Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B)）在单张 MI325X（256 GB）上由 vLLM `nightly-eed1f3d0c6043bd494424a22443ee198dd56f657` 以 TP1 提供服务，并使用 RadixArk 的 DSpark 草稿模型 [`Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM`](https://huggingface.co/Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM)（权重与 `RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark` 逐字节一致，仅修改 `architectures` 以便 vLLM 路由到 `Qwen3DSparkForCausalLM`）。仅单轮 1k1k，并发 1-128。

服务参数：`--speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","model":"Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}'`（7 为草稿模型训练时的 block size；其模型卡实测 k=4、k=6 更慢，probabilistic 采样比 greedy 快约 23%），Triton attention 与 bf16 KV cache（gfx942 无校准的 fp8 attention scale），`--max-num-seqs` 按并发点设定（下限 16，精度评测为 256：运行 35357364404 中 vLLM 默认的 1024 超过 H100 上权重旁仅剩的 472 个 GDN cache block），`--no-enable-prefix-caching` 使每个请求完整 prefill 其提示词，`--language-model-only`（仅文本服务 `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration`），`--reasoning-parser qwen3`，`--tool-call-parser qwen3_xml`，`--max-model-len` 使用矩阵上下文，并加 `--enforce-eager`。由于 vLLM 的 GDN attention 后端不支持该混合架构的自适应验证，该选项保持关闭。提示词经 chat template 处理，使草稿接受率反映真实文本而非随机 token；接受率为真实值（该草稿模型尚无黄金 AL）。 在 gfx942 上遵循 MiniMax-M3 与 DSv4.1 Flash 的 ROCm 配方：`--attention-backend TRITON_ATTN`、bf16 KV cache、`VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=0`，镜像为 `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm` nightly（tag 已在 Docker Hub 验证）。 eager 变体使用独立的 model-prefix `qwen3.827beager`，仅因 launcher 依据 `exp-name`（model-prefix 加场景）解析基准脚本；除新增 `--enforce-eager` 外与 `qwen3.827b` 配方完全一致。MODELS.md 行随 H100 基础 PR（#3260）提交。

验证：`bash -n`、YAML 解析、精确 key 矩阵生成、changelog 追加（无删除）均通过。GPU 验证待完成；本 PR 已添加 `full-sweep-fail-fast`。

每个 SKU 一个 PR。

Add `qwen3.827b-bf16-h100-vllm-mtp`: Qwen3.8-27B in bf16 ([Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B)) on a single H100 (80 GB), served by vLLM `nightly-cd10ed6f9f6b37a8ace9cf380007e66fe12ec0c3` with TP1 and the RadixArk DSpark drafter [`Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM`](https://huggingface.co/Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM) (byte-identical weights to `RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark`; only `architectures` is changed so vLLM routes it to `Qwen3DSparkForCausalLM`). Single-turn 1k1k only, concurrency 1-128.

Serve shape: `--speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","model":"Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}'` (seven tokens is the drafter's trained block size; its card measured k=4 and k=6 slower, and probabilistic sampling ~23% faster than greedy), `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, `--language-model-only` (text-only serving of `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration`), `--reasoning-parser qwen3`, `--tool-call-parser qwen3_xml`, and the matrix context as `--max-model-len`. Adaptive verification stays off because vLLM's GDN attention backend rejects it for this hybrid architecture. Prompts go through the chat template so draft acceptance reflects real text rather than random tokens; acceptance is real (no golden AL exists yet for this drafter). This PR also adds the Qwen3.8-27B rows to MODELS.md / MODELS_zh.md; the H200 PR references them.

Validation: `bash -n`, YAML parse, exact-key matrix generation, and changelog append (no deletions) pass. GPU validation pending; `full-sweep-fail-fast` is set on this PR.

One PR per SKU: h100 and h200 are opened separately.

服务参数：`--speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","model":"Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}'`（7 为草稿模型训练时的 block size；其模型卡实测 k=4、k=6 更慢，probabilistic 采样比 greedy 快约 23%），`--kv-cache-dtype fp8`，`--language-model-only`（仅文本服务 `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration`），`--reasoning-parser qwen3`，`--tool-call-parser qwen3_xml`，`--max-model-len` 使用矩阵上下文。由于 vLLM 的 GDN attention 后端不支持该混合架构的自适应验证，该选项保持关闭。提示词经 chat template 处理，使草稿接受率反映真实文本而非随机 token；接受率为真实值（该草稿模型尚无黄金 AL）。 本 PR 同时在 MODELS.md / MODELS_zh.md 中新增 Qwen3.8-27B 行；H200 PR 引用之。

title: [Klaud Cold] Add MI300X DeepSeek V4.1 Flash vLLM DSpark AgentX / 新增 MI300X DeepSeek V4.1 Flash vLLM DSpark AgentX 配方
body:
Add `dsv41flash-fp4-mi300x-vllm-agentic-dspark`: the MI300X (gfx942) vLLM AgentX arm for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a copy of the validated MI355X arm ([run 34710937012](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34710937012)) on the same ROCm nightly `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-eed1f3d0c6043bd494424a22443ee198dd56f657`. gfx942 is not in the [upstream recipe's](https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/blob/main/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml) hardware table (h100, h200, b200, gb200, gb300, mi350x), so this is a day-zero arm. It runs **TP8** rather than the MI355X TP4: a 192 GB card must hold its share of the 511 GB checkpoint plus the GPU-resident Engram tables (upstream AMD defaults, no CPU offload) and still leave a 1M-context KV pool. Native five-token DSpark; throughput uses the [golden AL 3.51](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/main/golden_al_distribution/dsv41flash_dspark.yaml) (thinking on) with synthetic rejection, evals keep real block verification, adaptive verification stays off on ROCm as vLLM refuses it there. AMD overrides as upstream: `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1`, `VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1`, `--moe-backend aiter`. gfx942 has no FP4 MFMA; the plain `aiter` name lets vLLM's selector skip the gfx950-only CK a8w4 experts, and pinning `aiter_triton_mxfp4_bf16` (Triton W4A16) is the first repair lever if startup rejects every candidate. `--max-num-seqs 128`, `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9`, concurrency 1–32.

MI300X also caps `--max-num-batched-tokens` at 8192 (the MI355X arm uses 16384) because the sparse-attention indexer allocates a `[batched-tokens, 1M]` fp8 logits buffer at startup, 16 GiB vs 32 GiB on a 192 GB card. The launcher raises its Slurm allocation from 180 to 480 minutes for this checkpoint, since the node-local HF cache means the first arm on each node downloads 511 GB before serving. This PR also adds the MI300X/MI325X docs section (EN/ZH); the MI325X PR references it.

Pre-downloaded checkpoint: `runners/launch_mi300x-amd.sh` mounts the cluster's HF hub cache and the script runs `hf download` into it, so the first arm on a node pulls the checkpoint and later arms reuse it. The launcher now mounts the checkout at `/ix` for this checkpoint and rewrites `RESULT_DIR`, as the MI355X launcher does, so AgentX runtime directories stay out of `/workspace`.

Validation: `bash -n`, YAML parse, exact-key matrix generation (6 points), and changelog append (no deletions) pass. GPU validation pending; `full-sweep-fail-fast` is set on this PR.

One PR per SKU; the MI300X and MI325X arms are opened separately.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

新增 `dsv41flash-fp4-mi300x-vllm-agentic-dspark`：DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在 MI300X（gfx942）上的 vLLM AgentX 配方，复制自已验证的 MI355X 配方（[运行 34710937012](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34710937012)），使用同一 ROCm nightly `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-eed1f3d0c6043bd494424a22443ee198dd56f657`。gfx942 不在[上游配方](https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/blob/main/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml)的硬件表中（h100、h200、b200、gb200、gb300、mi350x），因此属于 day-zero 配方。采用 **TP8** 而非 MI355X 的 TP4：192 GB 显卡需容纳 511 GB 检查点的分片以及常驻 GPU 的 Engram 表（上游 AMD 默认，不做 CPU offload），并仍留出 1M 上下文 KV 池。原生五 token DSpark；吞吐测试使用 thinking 开启的黄金 AL 3.51 与合成拒绝采样，eval 保留真实块验证，ROCm 上 vLLM 拒绝自适应验证因此保持关闭。AMD 设置与上游一致：`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`、`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1`、`VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1`、`--moe-backend aiter`。gfx942 没有 FP4 MFMA；通用的 `aiter` 名称允许 vLLM 选择器跳过仅 gfx950 可用的 CK a8w4 专家内核，若启动时所有候选均被拒绝，首选修复手段是固定 `aiter_triton_mxfp4_bf16`（Triton W4A16）。`--max-num-seqs 128`、`--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9`，并发 1–32。

MI300X 另将 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 上限设为 8192（MI355X 配方为 16384）：稀疏注意力 indexer 在启动时分配 `[batched-tokens, 1M]` 的 fp8 logits 缓冲区，在 192 GB 显卡上为 16 GiB 而非 32 GiB。launcher 为该检查点将 Slurm 分配从 180 分钟提高到 480 分钟，因为节点本地 HF 缓存意味着每个节点的首次运行需先下载 511 GB。本 PR 同时新增 MI300X/MI325X 文档章节（中英）；MI325X 的 PR 引用该章节。

title: [Klaud Cold] Add GB200 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash SGLang DSpark AgentX / 新增 GB200 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash SGLang DSpark AgentX 配方
body:
Add `dsv41flash-fp4-gb200-sglang-agentic-dspark`: the GB200 SGLang counterpart of the vLLM DSv4.1 Flash AgentX arm, built from the [SGLang cookbook](https://lmsysorg.mintlify.app/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4_1). title: refactor: standardize srt-slurm cluster configuration across launchers
body:
## Summary

Move inline `srtslurm.yaml` generation into checked-in cluster profiles and one shared writer. Rebased onto `main` after #3270; this is a configuration refactor, not an additional backend port.

- Add six profiles under `runners/srt-slurm/`: B200 Nscale, B300 DSXE, GB200, GB300, H100 DGXC, and H200 DGXC.
- Preserve #3270's one-launcher-per-pool structure. B200's `native-srt` and `multinode-srt` paths share one profile; the latter supplies its two additional container aliases explicitly. There is no compat launcher or compat profile.
- Keep native srt-slurm settings in YAML. Supply job-local paths explicitly and merge optional model aliases, container aliases, and mounts through `write_srt_cluster_config`.
- Replace heredoc/string assembly and exporter `sed` injection. Substitution happens after YAML parsing, so punctuation in paths remains data.
- Preserve cluster scheduling flags, GPU counts, time limits, image aliases, cache selections, and workload-dependent mounts. Engine flags, recipes, routing, and the srt-slurm pin are unchanged.
- Leave non-srt-slurm paths untouched, including B200 single-node and fixed-sequence TileRT execution. AMD launchers on this base have not yet adopted the separate srt-slurm port, so this PR does not convert them.

The earlier TileRT bug-fix claim and associated changelog entry have been removed: fixed-sequence TileRT bypasses this configuration-generation path, so synthetic execution of that block did not establish a reachable runtime bug.

## Validation

- Six focused behavioral tests pass: real Bash-to-Python rendering, optional power exporter handling, missing-input failure, YAML-safe substitution, mapping overlays, and preservation of an existing output on invalid input.
- Re-ran the Linux before/after comparison against the merged #3270 launcher: 164 configuration variants are semantically identical and pass the schema from InferenceX's pinned srt-slurm revision (`984180e5b8755aef85e9995048b5a16cb5336bce`), including both B200 srt-slurm paths.
- Bash syntax checks for all changed shell files, full `infx` Ruff lint/format checks, and `git diff --check` pass.
- No GPU sweep has been dispatched for this PR. These checks establish configuration equivalence, not hardware E2E validation.

## AI model disclosure

OpenAI Codex prepared and rebased this PR. The exact underlying model/version identifier could not be verified from the runtime. No delegated agent contributed to this InferenceX PR.

title: refactor(runners): one launcher per pool for B200 Nscale
body:
## Description

There is exactly one B200 Nscale runner pool (`b200-nscale-slurm_00`..`_10`, labels `b200-nscale` / `cluster:b200-nscale`), and the workflows dispatch with `bash ./runners/launch_${RUNNER_NAME%%_*}.sh`, so the only launcher that pool ever resolves to is `runners/launch_b200-nscale-slurm.sh`. `runners/launch_b200-nscale-compat.sh` (renamed from the retired pool's `launch_b200-dgxc.sh` in #2746) was only ever reached by an `exec` from that file. Two files for one pool made it look like there were two pools, and the `b200-nscale-compat` alias in `runtime_settings.sh` matched no runner.

This PR restores a 1:1 mapping between runner pools and launcher files for B200 Nscale and writes the rule down.

**Changes**

- `runners/launch_b200-nscale-slurm.sh`: absorbs the compat script. The three execution paths are selected once near the top and named in the log:
  - `native-srt`: the multi-node lanes whose srt-slurm recipes are maintained against this cluster (DSV4 / Kimi K2.6 / Kimi K3 / GLM-5.2 FP4, GLM-5.1 FP8 TileRT) — the old slurm launcher body.
  - `multinode-srt`: every other multi-node job — the old compat multi-node body.
  - `single-node`: `salloc` + `srun` of the `benchmarks/single_node` script — the old compat single-node body.
  Each body is carried over verbatim as a function. The only consolidated code is the enroot squash import, which the two files had duplicated: one `import_squash` / `enroot_uri_for_image` / `ensure_writable_squash_dir` now serves both srt-slurm paths using the caller's `SQUASH_DIR` and `SQUASH_LOCK_TIMEOUT`. `SLURM_PARTITION` / `SLURM_ACCOUNT` come from `runtime_settings.sh` via `check_env_vars` instead of being hardcoded a second time in the native path.
- `runners/launch_b200-nscale-compat.sh`: deleted.
- `runners/runtime_settings.sh`: drop the `b200-nscale-compat` case alias that no runner resolves to.
- `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/glm5.2_fp8_b200_sglang_mtp.sh`: comment now names the real launcher.
- `AGENTS.md`: new "Runner launchers (one file per pool)" section stating the routing contract and forbidding fallback launchers and launcher-name aliases.

**Behavior preservation**

- Path selection: the old two-file gate logic and the new `uses_native_srt_lane` were run side by side over 840 combinations of `IS_MULTINODE` × `FRAMEWORK` × `MODEL_PREFIX/PRECISION` × `SPEC_DECODING` × `IS_AGENTIC` with 0 mismatches (31 combinations select the native lane, as before).
- Bodies: `diff` of each function against its source region in the old files shows only the squash-helper consolidation, the `check_env_vars` moves to path entry, and one comment reword. The dead duplicated `minimaxm2.5` squash-dir block and the unused `NSCALE_MODEL_ROOT` constant are gone.

title: Local benchmarks for custom accelerators (MetaX C500 reference) / 自定义加速卡本地基准测试（MetaX C500 参考实现）
body:
## Summary

Adds a fully local, air-gapped path for running the InferenceX
fixed-sequence benchmark methodology on vendor accelerators — no GitHub
Actions, no Slurm, no upload to the InferenceX server. MetaX C500
(`mx-smi` + `vllm-metax` 0.23.0 / MACA image) is the end-to-end reference
implementation; the pieces are vendor-generic and extend to the next chip
(Ascend `npu-smi`, Gaudi `hpu-smi`, Moore Threads `mtsmi`, ...) by adding a
telemetry branch and a launcher.

The pipeline produces the same canonical artifacts as CI — raw client JSON,
`agg_<point>.json` (throughput/latency/energy per GPU), `power_validation_*`
sidecars, batch `agg_<run>.json` — plus an offline markdown comparison
against published InferenceX baselines.

## Motivation

Vendor teams want apples-to-apples numbers (throughput, latency, power)
against the published NVIDIA/AMD baselines on hardware that is not wired
into the self-hosted CI clusters. Today that requires a runner entry, a
master-config recipe, and a sweep run; this MR makes the same methodology
runnable on a single standalone host, including power telemetry, so results
can be validated before (or without) upstreaming the runner.

## Changes

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `benchmarks/benchmark_lib.sh` | Modified — `start_gpu_monitor`/`stop_gpu_monitor` gain a `metax` branch: streams `mx-smi --show-board-power --show-temperature --show-usage -l <ms> -o <raw.csv>` in the background, writes a best-effort identity sidecar, and on stop repairs a truncated tail and normalizes the raw stream to `timestamp,index,power_w`. The normalized schema is exactly what the existing generic header detection in `infx/results/power` expects, so validation/integration work unchanged. The pre-kill one-extra-interval sleep (already present for AMD) now also covers MetaX so the stream brackets the benchmark window. |
| `benchmarks/single_node/fixed_seq_len/qwen3.8_int8_c500.sh` | New — single-point launcher for Qwen3.8-27B W8A8 on C500 via vllm. Either `docker run`s a dedicated `vllm-metax` container (`--device /dev/mxcd --device /dev/dri`, `--entrypoint ""`, `--no-enable-prefix-caching`, model bound read-only at the same absolute path) or benchmarks an already-running server via `EXISTING_SERVER_PORT` (+ `OPENAI_API_KEY` for auth). Extra engine flags pass through `METAX_EXTRA_VLLM_ARGS`; memory headroom via `METAX_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION`/`METAX_MAX_NUM_SEQS`. Runs `wait_for_server_ready`, `run_benchmark_serving`, and the GPU monitor around them, propagating the client exit code. |
| `benchmarks/local/run_local_sweep.sh` | New — the local orchestrator: checks client deps on host python, sweeps `CONC_LIST` through the launcher, normalizes each point with `python3 -m infx.results.fixed_sequence`, batch-aggregates the canonical per-point files with `python3 -m infx.results.collect_results`, and (optionally, `BASELINES_DIR=`) writes `comparison.md` via `local_compare`. No GHA/Slurm; results stay in `$RESULTS_DIR` under `~/inferencex-local-bench/`. |
| `infx/results/local_compare.py` | New — offline comparison of one run against baseline JSON files (other engines/GPUs). Matches points on (model prefix, framework, precision, spec decoding, disagg, ISL, OSL, concurrency); reports run/baseline values plus Δ and Δ% for `tput_per_gpu`, `output_tput_per_gpu`, `median_ttft`, `p99_ttft`, `median_tpot`, `p99_tpot`, `median_intvty`, and `joules_per_total_token`. Stdlib-only, no DB. |
| `infx/results/fetch_baselines.py` | New — one-shot exporter that pulls published rows from the public InferenceX API (`/api/v1/benchmarks?model=...`), rewrites them into the canonical per-point dict format, and writes one file per (hardware, framework, precision) for later air-gapped comparison. |
| `utils/test_local_compare.py` | New — behavior tests for the comparison tool (hand-computed deltas, match-key scoping, batch loading, markdown rendering). |
| `.agents/skills/custom-gpu-bench/SKILL.md` | New — agent skill generalizing the workflow to the next vendor, with the reference file map and validation checklist. |
| `CUSTOM_GPU_BENCHMARK_PLAN.md` | New — the execution plan this MR implements, with an "Implementation status" section pointing at each artifact. |

Not changed: `configs/runners.yaml`, master configs, workflows, and the
existing NVIDIA/AMD telemetry paths (the metax branch is additive; hosts
without `mx-smi` behave exactly as before).

## How it works (end-to-end)

1. Host python (a venv with `transformers aiohttp huggingface_hub numpy tqdm
   requests`) is the benchmark client; the vendor container only serves the
   OpenAI-compatible API.
2. `run_local_sweep.sh` loops concurrencies; per point the launcher starts
   the monitor (mx-smi raw CSV), starts (or reuses) the engine, waits for
   `/health`, and runs `run_benchmark_serving` (`--request-rate inf`,
   `--ignore-eos`, warmups `2*conc`).
3. `fixed_sequence` parses the raw client JSON, gates on the request
   outcome, and emits `agg_<point>.json` including per-GPU throughput,
   second-unit latencies, intvty, and power (`joules_per_*`, `power_valid`)
   from the normalized mx-smi stream.
4. `collect_results` bundles the points into `agg_<run>.json`;
   `local_compare` diffs the run against baseline exports.

## Usage

```bash
# Baselines once, on any internet-connected host (exported format is stable):
python3 -m infx.results.fetch_baselines \
    --model "Qwen-3.5-397B-A17B" --isl 8192 --osl 1024 \
    --out-dir ~/inferencex-local-bench/baselines

# Local sweep (MetaX C500, vllm), fully offline afterward:
MODEL=/path/to/weights \
RUNNER_TYPE=metax-c500 MODEL_PREFIX=qwen3.8 FRAMEWORK=vllm PRECISION=int8 \
TP=1 ISL=8192 OSL=1024 CONC_LIST="4 8 16 32 64" \
IMAGE=cr.metax-tech.com/public-ai-release/maca/vllm-metax:0.23.0-... \
BASELINES_DIR=~/inferencex-local-bench/baselines \
bash benchmarks/local/run_local_sweep.sh
```

## Verification (run on a 1x MetaX C500 host)

- Qwen3-0.6B validation sweep, ISL 1024 / OSL 512, conc 1 and 2:
  - 10/10 and 20/20 requests completed, `benchmark_outcome.status=passed`;
  - power telemetry valid: `power_valid=1`, no invalidation reasons,
    `avg_power_w` 85.1/89.2 W, `total_gpu_energy_j` 3729/5183 J,
    `joules_per_total_token` 0.463/0.317;
  - canonical artifacts produced: `agg_<point>.json`,
    `power_validation_*.json`, `agg_<run>.json`, `comparison.md`.
- `utils/test_local_compare.py`: 3 passed (with the full
  `test_process_result.py` suite: 119 passed).
- `uvx ruff check infx` and `uvx ruff format --check infx`: clean;
  `bash -n` on all three shell scripts: clean.

## Known vendor notes (documented in the skill and plan)

- The vllm-metax fork rejects `--disable-log-requests`; extra flags go
  through `METAX_EXTRA_VLLM_ARGS` (validation used `--enforce-eager`;
  without it the engine core can stall after KV-cache initialization on a
  loaded GPU).
- When another server already occupies the GPU, lower
  `METAX_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION` so the target fits the free memory
  (vllm refuses to start when the target exceeds the free fraction).

## Out of scope

- Upstreaming the runner itself (`configs/runners.yaml`,
  `configs/metax-master.yaml`, `perf-changelog.yaml` entry) — that path
  remains GitHub-Actions-based per the plan; nothing in this MR changes CI
  behavior.
- Eval and agentic workloads; fixed-sequence only.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

为 InferenceX 增加完全本地（离线/无 GHA/无 Slurm/不上传服务器）的固定序列基准测试路径，
MetaX C500（`mx-smi` + vllm-metax 0.23.0/MACA 镜像）为端到端参考实现，结构可按供应商扩展
（Ascend `npu-smi`、Gaudi `hpu-smi`、Moore Threads `mtsmi` 等，只需新增遥测分支与 launcher）。

产出与 CI 一致的规范产物：原始客户端 JSON、逐点 `agg_<point>.json`（每卡吞吐/延迟/能耗）、
`power_validation_*` 审计文件、批量 `agg_<run>.json`，以及针对已发布 InferenceX 基线的
离线 Markdown 对比报告。

主要变更：
- `benchmarks/benchmark_lib.sh`：`start_gpu_monitor`/`stop_gpu_monitor` 新增 `metax`
  分支——后台流式采集 `mx-smi --show-board-power ... -o <raw.csv>`，停止时修复截断行并
  归一化为 `timestamp,index,power_w`，与现有 `infx/results/power` 通用列检测完全兼容，
  原有 NVIDIA/AMD 路径行为不变（纯增量）。
- `benchmarks/single_node/fixed_seq_len/qwen3.8_int8_c500.sh`：单点 launcher，docker 启动
  vllm-metax 容器，或通过 `EXISTING_SERVER_PORT` 复用已有服务；引擎额外参数经
  `METAX_EXTRA_VLLM_ARGS` 透传。
- `benchmarks/local/run_local_sweep.sh`：本地编排——并发扫描、逐点 `fixed_sequence`
  归一化、`collect_results` 批量汇总、可选 `local_compare` 对比。
- `infx/results/local_compare.py`：离线对比工具（按模型/框架/精度/ISL/OSL/并发匹配，
  输出 Δ 与 Δ%）；`infx/results/fetch_baselines.py`：一次性从公开 API 导出基线 JSON。
- `utils/test_local_compare.py`（3 项行为测试）、`.agents/skills/custom-gpu-bench/SKILL.md`
  （面向下一个供应商的操作技能）、`CUSTOM_GPU_BENCHMARK_PLAN.md`（执行计划与实现状态）。

title: [Klaud Cold] Add MI325X DeepSeek V4.1 Flash vLLM DSpark AgentX / 新增 MI325X DeepSeek V4.1 Flash vLLM DSpark AgentX 配方
body:
Add `dsv41flash-fp4-mi325x-vllm-agentic-dspark`: the MI325X (gfx942) vLLM AgentX arm for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a copy of the validated MI355X arm ([run 34710937012](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34710937012)) on the same ROCm nightly `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-eed1f3d0c6043bd494424a22443ee198dd56f657`. gfx942 is not in the [upstream recipe's](https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/blob/main/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml) hardware table (h100, h200, b200, gb200, gb300, mi350x), so this is a day-zero arm. It runs **TP8** rather than the MI355X TP4: a 256 GB card must hold its share of the 511 GB checkpoint plus the GPU-resident Engram tables (upstream AMD defaults, no CPU offload) and still leave a 1M-context KV pool. Native five-token DSpark; throughput uses the [golden AL 3.51](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/main/golden_al_distribution/dsv41flash_dspark.yaml) (thinking on) with synthetic rejection, evals keep real block verification, adaptive verification stays off on ROCm as vLLM refuses it there. AMD overrides as upstream: `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1`, `VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1`, `--moe-backend aiter`. gfx942 has no FP4 MFMA; the plain `aiter` name lets vLLM's selector skip the gfx950-only CK a8w4 experts, and pinning `aiter_triton_mxfp4_bf16` (Triton W4A16) is the first repair lever if startup rejects every candidate. `--max-num-seqs 128`, `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9`, concurrency 1–32.

MI325X keeps the MI355X arm's `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`; the 256 GB card absorbs the 32 GiB indexer buffer next to TP8 weights. Docs for both gfx942 arms live in the MI300X PR.

Pre-downloaded checkpoint: `runners/launch_mi325x-amds.sh` mounts the cluster's HF hub cache and the script runs `hf download` into it, so the first arm on a node pulls the checkpoint and later arms reuse it. The launcher now mounts the checkout at `/ix` for this checkpoint and rewrites `RESULT_DIR`, as the MI355X launcher does, so AgentX runtime directories stay out of `/workspace`.

Validation: `bash -n`, YAML parse, exact-key matrix generation (6 points), and changelog append (no deletions) pass. GPU validation pending; `full-sweep-fail-fast` is set on this PR.

One PR per SKU; the MI300X and MI325X arms are opened separately.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

新增 `dsv41flash-fp4-mi325x-vllm-agentic-dspark`：DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在 MI325X（gfx942）上的 vLLM AgentX 配方，复制自已验证的 MI355X 配方（[运行 34710937012](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34710937012)），使用同一 ROCm nightly `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-eed1f3d0c6043bd494424a22443ee198dd56f657`。gfx942 不在[上游配方](https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/blob/main/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml)的硬件表中（h100、h200、b200、gb200、gb300、mi350x），因此属于 day-zero 配方。采用 **TP8** 而非 MI355X 的 TP4：256 GB 显卡需容纳 511 GB 检查点的分片以及常驻 GPU 的 Engram 表（上游 AMD 默认，不做 CPU offload），并仍留出 1M 上下文 KV 池。原生五 token DSpark；吞吐测试使用 thinking 开启的黄金 AL 3.51 与合成拒绝采样，eval 保留真实块验证，ROCm 上 vLLM 拒绝自适应验证因此保持关闭。AMD 设置与上游一致：`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`、`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1`、`VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1`、`--moe-backend aiter`。gfx942 没有 FP4 MFMA；通用的 `aiter` 名称允许 vLLM 选择器跳过仅 gfx950 可用的 CK a8w4 专家内核，若启动时所有候选均被拒绝，首选修复手段是固定 `aiter_triton_mxfp4_bf16`（Triton W4A16）。`--max-num-seqs 128`、`--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9`，并发 1–32。

MI325X 保留 MI355X 配方的 `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`；256 GB 显卡可在 TP8 权重之外容纳 32 GiB 的 indexer 缓冲区。两个 gfx942 配方的文档位于 MI300X 的 PR 中。

验证：`bash -n`、YAML 解析、精确 key 矩阵生成（6 个点）、changelog 追加（无删除）均通过。GPU 验证待完成；本 PR 已添加 `full-sweep-fail-fast`。

每个 SKU 一个 PR；MI300X 与 MI325X 配方分别提交。

title: ci: reduce PAT usage and simplify secret names / 减少 PAT 使用并简化密钥命名
body:
Benchmark checkout and run-statistics jobs use the built-in job token instead of `REPO_PAT`. Remove PAT forwarding through reusable benchmark workflows and give statistics jobs explicit Contents/Actions read access. SpeedBench uses `SPEEDBENCH_PAT` for its existing branch/PR writes.

Rename the other workflow secret references to `AGENT_PAT`, `FRONTEND_PAT`, `DASH_API_KEY`, and `DB_RO_URL`, including reusable workflow declarations/callers and the Klaud guides. Keep `INFERENCEX_OFFICIAL_RO_HF_TOKEN` and runtime environment-variable names unchanged. Runner administration and unrelated service credentials remain separate. Retain legacy names for historical workflow reruns.

This PR changes credential wiring and required permissions only. Benchmark execution, SpeedBench branch selection, publishing logic, and generated PR text are unchanged. Related to #2382.

### Validation and rollout

- The five migrated secrets passed authenticated read checks in [run 35273695610](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35273695610). The database endpoint reported replica/read-only mode and returned the required baseline-table join.
- Zizmor: no unsuppressed findings. Actionlint: 36 existing findings, none added versus `main`. `git diff --check` passed.
- Run-statistics tests: 17 passed. [Full CI](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35276277453) passed Lint and Tests on the earlier head `18c32eba6`; subsequent changes restore the existing HF secret and remove the unrelated SpeedBench changes.
- The temporary credential-verification branch is removed and its workflow disabled. No verification workflow or secret values are included in this PR.

Production write paths have not been exercised with the newly rotated PATs. `SPEEDBENCH_PAT` has Contents/Pull requests write but no Workflows write; pushing from a measured ref that introduces workflow-file changes can therefore be rejected. The existing publishing logic is preserved.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

基准测试 checkout 和运行统计作业改用内置作业令牌，不再依赖 `REPO_PAT`。移除可复用基准测试工作流之间的 PAT 传递，并显式为统计作业申请 Contents/Actions 读取权限。SpeedBench 的现有分支和 PR 写入操作使用 `SPEEDBENCH_PAT`。

将其他工作流 secret 引用改为 `AGENT_PAT`、`FRONTEND_PAT`、`DASH_API_KEY` 和 `DB_RO_URL`，同步可复用工作流声明、调用方及 Klaud 指南。保留 `INFERENCEX_OFFICIAL_RO_HF_TOKEN` 和现有运行时环境变量名称。Runner 管理和其他服务凭据继续独立保存，旧名称保留以支持历史工作流重跑。

此 PR 仅修改凭据传递及所需权限。基准测试执行、SpeedBench 分支选择、发布逻辑及生成的 PR 文案均保持不变。关联 #2382。

### 验证与上线

title: fix(evals): run full Kimi and MiniMax vendor suites / 默认运行 Kimi 和 MiniMax 厂商完整评估套件
body:
Automatic AgentX evaluations now select the full vendor suites on AMD and NVIDIA: Kimi K3 runs all 204 schema cases in streaming and non-streaming modes (408 checks), and MiniMax M3 runs all 102 provider cases. Previously these defaults selected only two Kimi checks and one MiniMax case. Explicit smoke overrides remain available.

The Kimi full-suite adapter no longer imposes a two-hour whole-process deadline. Explicit positive adapter timeout overrides, the smoke deadline, native request deadlines, and CI/scheduler limits remain available. Both evaluators use their pinned stock verifier sources; no runtime framework patches are introduced. Completed quality scores remain diagnostic, while missing cases, request failures, timeouts and malformed reports fail validation.

## Validation

- 553 focused tests passed across matrix generation/validation, both vendor adapters, runtime dispatch and result collection. Coverage includes both hardware vendors, the default/full/smoke timeout policy, explicit timeout overrides, and rejecting incomplete Kimi coverage.
- Ruff, Bash syntax, and diff checks passed. GitHub Tests and Lint passed on `fc29dd49e`.
- Three of four representative hardware runs have completed: AMD/Kimi produced all 408 outcomes in 565.72 seconds, with 402 passed and six missing-tool-call assertion failures (98.53%). No integration error or request timeout/retry signature was reported. This is complete execution, not a perfect quality pass. AMD/MiniMax also completed all 102 requests in 3m22s with zero failed requests or reported request timeouts. Its tool-call match score is 96%, with one schema-validation failure and one reasoning-only output flagged by the native quality checks. NVIDIA/MiniMax completed all 102 requests in 6m15s, with zero failed requests or reported request timeouts and a 97% tool-call match score; it also has one schema-validation failure and one reasoning-only output. NVIDIA/Kimi is still queued.

| Cell | Recipe | Full suite | Run | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AMD / Kimi K3 | MI355X, vLLM ROCm100-af1, TP8/DCP1, resident c1, AITER draft | 204 cases / 408 checks | [Complete: 402/408](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35246262177) | `a3acf39d2`, exact candidate already under investigation |
| NVIDIA / Kimi K3 | B300, vLLM 3696c77, TP8/DCP8, resident c8 | 204 cases / 408 checks | [Dispatched](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35248968886) | `be1397ae2`, existing native resident diagnostic recipe |
| AMD / MiniMax M3 | MI355X, vLLM 2a02f6, MXFP4, TP4, resident c4 | 102 provider cases | [Complete: 102 requests, 96% match](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35248941071) | `fc29dd49e`, this draft head with automatic suite selection |
| NVIDIA / MiniMax M3 | H200, vLLM d9105e, MXFP8, TP8, resident c1 | 102 provider cases | [Complete: 102 requests, 97% match](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35248950742) | `fc29dd49e`, this draft head with automatic suite selection |

The Kimi runs explicitly select the same full verifier on existing candidate sources; they retain the historical two-hour cap and do not validate this draft's unbounded adapter setting on hardware. Each cell covers the listed recipe only. Different weights, formats, images and topologies do not support hardware-only quality comparisons. BFCL is a separate evaluator.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

AMD 和 NVIDIA 上的 AgentX 自动评估现默认选择完整厂商套件：Kimi K3 对全部 204 个 schema 用例分别运行流式和非流式请求，共 408 项检查；MiniMax M3 覆盖全部 102 个厂商用例。此前默认仅运行两项 Kimi 检查和一个 MiniMax 用例，显式冒烟选项仍然保留。

## Summary - Kimi Perf Tuning

Perf tuning for Kimi-K3 MXFP4 agentic decoding on MI355X (`kimik3_fp4_mi355x_mtp.sh`):

- **MTP** (DSpark speculative decoding) used at low concurrency.
- **DCP** (decode-context-parallel) used at high concurrency.
- **vLLM-simple CPU offload** (`SimpleCPUOffloadConnector`) used for KV offload.
 
Image : `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-e7edf17cea217e52701f913cd8491fcacf2d9490`

> **Medium Risk**
> Changes benchmark serving recipes and published matrix points (MTP/DCP/offload/image), which can shift reported performance but does not touch application auth or data paths.

> **Overview**
> **Perf tuning for Kimi-K3 MXFP4 agentic vLLM on MI355X** (`kimik3_fp4_mi355x_mtp.sh`), aligned with a newer ROCm nightly and a slimmer official benchmark matrix.

> The launch script is reworked around **concurrency bands**: low concurrency (1–16) keeps **DCP off**, enables **DSpark MTP** with per-`CONC` draft depth (`k`) and golden **synthetic acceptance lengths**, and sizes `max-num-seqs`, batched tokens, and CUDA-graph capture (`FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, ladder `1..LADDER`) for spec rows. title: [AMD] Enable triton DSA backends and top-k v2 path for glm5.2-fp4 in MI355X
body:
## Summary
- `--dsa-prefill-backend` / `--dsa-decode-backend`: `tilelang` → `triton` (requires sgl-project/sglang PR #30575, commit `8a6ab89bf0b90304b3b454a833fcdcaefb777c29`)
- `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.16-rocm720-mi35x-20260728` → `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.19-rocm10-mi35x-20260910`
- `SGLANG_OPT_USE_TOPK_V2`: `false` → `true` (sgl-project/sglang PR #36684, PR #36851 add the gfx950 path) No impact on performance because upstream SGLang already enable

Model, runner, and search space (TP4/EP4 HiCache vs TP8/EP1 GPU-resident arms), MTP speculative decoding with the committed golden acceptance length, and the concurrency grids are unchanged.

Unofficial local, MI355X TP4/EP4. Baseline is the `v0.5.19-rocm10-mi35x-20260908` image-only bump from #2917, not the CI curve. Δ = this PR / 0908 baseline (higher is better).


| conc | 0908 tput | this PR tput | Δ tput | 0908 intvty | this PR intvty | Δ intvty |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 3410.7 | 3659.4 | +7.3% | 152.8 | 166.4 | +8.9% |
| 2 | 3854.9 | 4032.8 | +4.6% | 120.2 | 135.8 | +12.9% |
| 4 | 5746.1 | 5989.9 | +4.2% | 122.9 | 125.3 | +2.0% |
| 8 | 10127.5 | 10571.9 | +4.4% | 75.5 | 87.4 | +15.8% |
| **10** | **12982.8** | **13099.8** | **+0.9%** | **64.1** | **71.6** | **+11.7%** |
| 12 | 12344.9 | 12875.7 | +4.3% | 57.5 | 67.8 | +17.9% |
| 16 | 10888.2 | 11599.8 | +6.5% | 23.3 | 24.9 | +6.8% |

No regression at any concurrency: throughput is +0.9% to +7.3% (mean +4.6%) and P90 interactivity +2.0% to +17.9% (mean +10.9%). The headline conc 10 point is throughput-neutral (+0.9%) and buys +11.7% on the interactivity tail, which is the shape you would expect if the change is mostly a decode-path win rather than a prefill one — at 90-210k input against a few hundred output tokens these points are overwhelmingly prefill-bound, so per-chip throughput barely moves while TPOT does.

The delta is not attributable to one switch. Top-k v2, the triton DSA backends, and a two-day image delta (0908 → 0910) all sit between the two columns; the sweep measures their sum, which is what the recipe ships.


## Test plan
- [x] `validate_perf_changelog.py` against `upstream/main`
- [ ] Single-arm smoke at TP4 conc 1 on the 0910 image (server starts, `--dsa-*-backend triton` accepted, no decode-time memory fault)
- [ ] Full AgentX sweep (`full-sweep-fail-fast`)
- [ ] Accuracy / eval run unchanged versus the 0908 baseline

## Risk

Low-to-moderate. This is a benchmark recipe change with no application logic, but unlike a pure image bump it flips three coupled switches at once: the top-k v2 kernel, the DSA prefill/decode backends, and the container. If the sweep regresses or crashes, bisect in that order — the DSA backend switch is the most likely culprit, since the previous attempt to move ROCm DSA decode off the default hit a GPU memory fault in the a8w8 qseqlen1 persistent kernel.

The `v0.5.19-rocm10-mi35x-20260910` tag uses a `rocm10` segment rather than the `rocm720` naming every other MI355X image in `configs/amd-master.yaml` carries; worth a reviewer confirming that is the intended tag family.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Benchmark-only, but it couples a container bump with DSA backend and kernel-path switches where prior ROCm DSA decode changes caused GPU faults; wrong image tag or silent fallback would skew CI sweeps.
> 
> **Overview**
> Updates the **GLM-5.2 FP4 MI355X SGLang agentic-MTP** benchmark recipe to align with newer upstream SGLang ROCm support, without changing TP/EP arms, HiCache sizing, MTP settings, or concurrency grids.
> 
> In `glm5.2_fp4_mi355x_sglang_mtp.sh`, **`SGLANG_OPT_USE_TOPK_V2`** flips from `false` to `true` now that gfx950 can use the fused DSA top-k v2 path (upstream PRs #36684 / #36851). **`--dsa-prefill-backend`** and **`--dsa-decode-backend`** move from `tilelang` to **`triton`**, which requires SGLang at or past PR #30575.
> 
> `configs/amd-master.yaml` bumps the pinned image from **`v0.5.16-rocm720-mi35x-20260728`** to **`v0.5.19-rocm10-mi35x-20260910`** so startup accepts the triton DSA flags and ships the ROCm top-k v2 build. **`perf-changelog.yaml`** records the same rationale for `glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-sglang-agentic-mtp`.
