title: feat(agentx): retune GLM5.2 FP4 MI355X ATOM recipe on _0915 docker(TP+MTP, DCP+TP+MTP)
body:
## Summary

Aligns the `glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-atom-agentic-mtp` benchmark to the validated standalone ATOM recipe (ROCm/ATOM PR 2247) . Switches to the `_0915` nightly runtime, adds per-concurrency MTP draft depth with the golden acceptance length, enables TP4+DCP4 for high concurrency, and fixes the online-quant exclude list, cache, and NUMA settings.

## Changes

### `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/glm5.2_fp4_mi355x_atom_mtp.sh`

- **Per-concurrency MTP depth + golden AL** via `--spec-decode-acceptance-length` (was a single fixed `K3 / AL 2.99` with `--spec-decode-acceptance-rate`): `K5 / 3.61` for C2–C8, `K4 / 3.33` for C10–C40, `K3 / 2.99` for C48. Values are the golden AL from `golden_al_distribution/glm5.2_mtp.yaml` (`glm-5.2-fp8`, `thinking_on`).
- **DCP support**: reads `DCP_SIZE` (default 1), adds `--decode-context-parallel-size` when >1, with DCP-aware CUDA-graph capture sizes.
- **7-module MTP-FP8 online-quant exclude** (was a single `*expert*` pattern, i.e. BF16 draft), so the MTP draft experts are online-quantized like the local runs.
- Added `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.95`, `--enable_prefix_caching`, `export ATOM_USE_FLYDSL_GATHER_KV_B_PROJ=0` (GLM-5.2 MLA head dims), and `export LMCACHE_NUMA_MODE=auto`.

### `configs/amd-master.yaml` (`glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-atom-agentic-mtp`)

- **Image** → `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609151450` (was `..._glm52_agentic_0813`).
- **Added TP4+DCP4 arm** for high concurrency: `conc-list: [16, 24, 32, 40, 48]` with `dcp-size: 4`.
- **`dram-utilization` 0.14 → 0.171**, which yields `TOTAL_CPU_DRAM_GB = 256` per TP4 rank (`min(3095781, 2861022) MiB × 0.171 × 4/8`), matching the recipe's `LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_CPU_SIZE=256`. The TP8 GPU-only arm is unaffected (no DRAM offload).

## Per-concurrency configuration

| Concurrency | Parallelism | `--num-speculative-tokens` | `--spec-decode-acceptance-length` |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| C2, C4, C8 | TP4 | 5 | 3.61 |
| C10 | TP4 | 4 | 3.33 |
| C16, C24, C32, C40 | TP4 + DCP4 | 4 | 3.33 |
| C48 | TP4 + DCP4 | 3 | 2.99 |

## Validation

The same recipe was run locally on MI355X (container `nightly_202609151450`, ATOM `e03b7f17` / AITER `797cce25`). C2/C4/C8/C10/C16/C24/C32/C40 completed on the first attempt with a full 3,600 s AgentX profile; forced acceptance is performance-only.

## Notes

Forced acceptance length is performance-only and does not preserve accuracy — disable `--spec-decode-acceptance-length` for GSM8K / SWE-bench / any correctness eval.

---


## 概述

将 `glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-atom-agentic-mtp` 基准对齐到已验证的 standalone ATOM recipe（ROCm/ATOM PR 2247）。切换到 `_0915` nightly 运行时，按并发选择 MTP draft 深度并使用 golden acceptance length，为高并发启用 TP4+DCP4，并修正 online-quant exclude 列表、缓存与 NUMA 设置。

## 改动

### `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/glm5.2_fp4_mi355x_atom_mtp.sh`

- **按并发选择 MTP 深度 + golden AL**，改用 `--spec-decode-acceptance-length`（原为固定 `K3 / AL 2.99` + `--spec-decode-acceptance-rate`）：C2–C8 用 `K5 / 3.61`，C10–C40 用 `K4 / 3.33`，C48 用 `K3 / 2.99`。取值来自 `golden_al_distribution/glm5.2_mtp.yaml`（`glm-5.2-fp8`、`thinking_on`）。
- **DCP 支持**：读取 `DCP_SIZE`（默认 1），>1 时加 `--decode-context-parallel-size`，并使用适配 DCP 的 CUDA-graph capture sizes。
- **7 段 MTP-FP8 online-quant exclude**（原为单一 `*expert*`，即 BF16 draft），使 MTP draft experts 与本地一致地被 online 量化。
- 新增 `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.95` ， `--enable_prefix_caching`， `export ATOM_USE_FLYDSL_GATHER_KV_B_PROJ=0`（GLM-5.2 MLA head 维度需要）、`export LMCACHE_NUMA_MODE=auto`。

### `configs/amd-master.yaml`（`glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-atom-agentic-mtp`）

- **镜像** → `rocm/atom-dev:nightly_202609151450`（原为 `..._glm52_agentic_0813`）。
- **新增 TP4+DCP4 臂**用于高并发：`conc-list: [16, 24, 32, 40, 48]`，`dcp-size: 4`。
- **`dram-utilization` 0.14 → 0.171**，使每个 TP4 rank 的 `TOTAL_CPU_DRAM_GB = 256`（`min(3095781, 2861022) MiB × 0.171 × 4/8`），与 recipe 的 `LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_CPU_SIZE=256` 一致。TP8 GPU-only 臂不受影响（无 DRAM offload）。

## 按并发的配置

| 并发 | 并行方式 | `--num-speculative-tokens` | `--spec-decode-acceptance-length` |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| C2、C4、C8 | TP4 | 5 | 3.61 |
| C10 | TP4 | 4 | 3.33 |
| C16、C24、C32、C40 | TP4 + DCP4 | 4 | 3.33 |
| C48 | TP4 + DCP4 | 3 | 2.99 |

## 验证

同一 recipe 已在本地 MI355X 运行（容器 `nightly_202609151450`，ATOM `e03b7f17` / AITER `797cce25`）。C2/C4/C8/C10/C16/C24/C32/C40 均首次尝试即通过完整 3,600 秒 AgentX profile；forced acceptance 仅用于性能测试。

## 说明

Forced acceptance length 仅用于性能，不保证精度——做 GSM8K / SWE-bench / 任何正确性评测时请关闭 `--spec-decode-acceptance-length`。

title: feat(agentx): retune Kimi-K3 FP4 MI355X ATOM DSpark recipe
body:
Track the checked-in ATOM recipe [`recipes/Agentic-Kimi-K3.md`](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/blob/k3_agentic_recipe/recipes/Agentic-Kimi-K3.md) at ROCm/ATOM#2131, retuned per concurrency on image `kimi_k3_agentic_0911`.

Publish the concurrency set **[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72]** in place of [1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 14, 16, 32, 40, 56, 64]. Concurrency 48 and 72 are new points, 12 and 14 are dropped, and every surviving point is retuned.

- `gpu-memory-utilization` is 0.90 and `max-num-batched-tokens` is 8192 on every point, so the launcher sets both once instead of per band.
- `max-num-seqs` is 32 through concurrency 16 and `2 * CONC` from 32 up.
- `AITER_REUSE_IDENTICAL_COMM_GROUPS` becomes a threshold: 1 at concurrency 56, 64, and 72, 0 from 1 through 48.

The concurrency-14 CUDA-graph pin goes with the point, and was already dead code: it set `CUDAGRAPH_MAX_NUM_SEQS=32` inside the `case` block, which the capture-width derivation overwrote with `2 * CONC` two statements later, so it never reached the server. Capture behaviour is unchanged — `--level 3` with `--cudagraph-mode FULL` over `[2 .. 2 * CONC * (1 + draft tokens)]` — and reproduces the recipe's `graph_max` column at all eleven points:

| CONC | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 | 32 | 40 | 48 | 56 | 64 | 72 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `max-num-seqs` | 32 | 32 | 32 | 32 | 32 | 64 | 80 | 96 | 112 | 128 | 144 |
| draft tokens | 7 | 7 | 7 | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `graph_max` | 16 | 32 | 64 | 64 | 128 | 64 | 80 | 96 | 112 | 128 | 144 |

title: Use native SRT overrides with automatic golden acceptance
body:
## Summary

Select synthetic acceptance automatically for SRT AgentX runs from the committed `golden_al_distribution` curves. Callers provide the model, scenario, and eval mode; each selected recipe supplies its actual speculative method, draft model, sampling settings, and token count. Submit the resulting engine settings with native `srtctl --set` / `--unset` arguments.

- Remove manual `SYNTHETIC_ACCEPTANCE` / `SYNTHETIC_ACCEPTANCE_LENGTH` configuration, including 66 master-config pairs and duplicated settings in 65 active SRT recipes. Remove the old YAML injector and backend modules.
- Use the generation role (decode or aggregated) to choose the golden curve. Distinguish MTP from DSpark, MiniMax original/GQA draft heads, Kimi draft sampling, and thinking mode. SGLang DSpark uses its block size; TRT receives golden AL minus one.
- Apply simulation automatically to speculative AgentX throughput. Eval-only and non-AgentX runs use real verification. `RUN_EVAL` does not disable the throughput run’s simulation. All seven SRT launcher paths use the same policy.
- Preserve other speculative JSON fields and recipe variants through the pinned SRT APIs. Check all planned selections before submission; missing curves or measured draft lengths fail explicitly. Source recipes are not rewritten at runtime.
- Remove the generic `RecipeOverride` layer and the separate launcher throughput/eval-only mode. Workflows explicitly supply thinking mode; receivers validate required inputs using the shared helper.

The SRT integration lives in `infx/srt_slurm`; launchers invoke `python3 -m infx.srt_slurm.synthetic_acceptance`.

## Acceptance correction

Four DSV4 GB200 vLLM AgentX recipes configure **two** speculative tokens but previously requested **2.49**, the three-token golden AL. Automatic selection uses the correct **2.27** value without changing their token count:

- `agg-tp8-mtp.yaml`
- `agg-dep8-mtp.yaml`
- `disagg-1p1d-dep8-dep8-mtp.yaml`
- `disagg-2p1d-dep8-dep8-mtp.yaml`

These are under `benchmarks/multi_node/srt-slurm-recipes/dsv4/vllm/gb200-fp4/agentx/`. The live GB300 Kimi smoke uncovered another mismatch: six recipes omitted `draft_sample_method`, and their pinned image actually defaults to `greedy`, while the previous manual AL selected the probabilistic curve. These recipes now explicitly retain `greedy` and select its measured curve: **3.22** for four draft tokens and **3.78** for seven (previously 3.36 / 3.84). Kimi curve lookup rejects omitted or unknown sampling methods rather than guessing. Other audited active targets retain their golden values.

## Validation

- Executed connector planning for all 388 referenced NVIDIA SRT configurations: no failures; 136 produced automatic overrides.
- Ruff lint and formatting passed with current main’s stricter rules. All 31 focused behavior tests pass locally and in the independent [SRT connector CI job](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35032012847/job/104592433363), including automatic curve selection, eval/non-AgentX/no-spec cleanup, `RUN_EVAL` handling, engine conversion, and variant handling.
- Startup-only Slurm smokes passed for GB200 DSV4 vLLM MTP2 (synthetic AL 2.27 and real eval verification) and GB300 Qwen3.5 SGLang NEXTN6 (synthetic AL 4.8 and eval cleanup of deliberately stale AL 99). All reached healthy servers and returned HTTP 200 with short generated responses. The corrected GB300 Kimi DSpark run also passed, returning 32 tokens at temperature 1.0 with explicit greedy drafting and AL 3.22.
- Smoke runs used the actual Bash helper, connector, and native SRT submission, preserving production images, models, topology, context, and memory settings. Only site paths, unique job names, bounded timeouts, tiny workloads/serve-only, and optional telemetry differed. No full AgentX sweep or accuracy eval was run.
- After merging current main, connector tests run in the consolidated CI suite with pinned SRT initialized. Discovery excludes the vendored upstream SRT test suite; InferenceX integration tests still exercise its real APIs.

## Startup smoke results

All cases use the actual `apply_srt_recipe` → Python connector → native SRT → Slurm path. Production engine settings were retained. HTTP checks below include real generated tokens, not just a live router.

| Cluster | Case | Slurm job | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GB200 | DSV4 vLLM MTP2, inferred AL 2.27 | 25493 | PASS: health/models/completion HTTP 200, eight generated tokens; completed 0:0 |
| GB200 | DSV4 vLLM eval-only, real verification | 25495 | PASS: health/models/completion HTTP 200, eight generated tokens; completed 0:0 |
| GB300 | Qwen3.5 SGLang NEXTN6, inferred AL 4.8 | 30976 | PASS: healthy application, chat and 32-token generation HTTP 200; simulation confirmed in actual worker environment |
| GB300 | Qwen3.5 SGLang eval-only, stale AL 99 seeded by caller | 30975 | PASS: all simulation variables removed; healthy application, chat and 32-token generation HTTP 200 |
| GB300 | Kimi-K3 vLLM DSpark4, explicit greedy, inferred AL 3.22 | 30978 | PASS: ready backend and HTTP 200 chat, 32 generated tokens at temperature 1.0; actual worker command confirms greedy/synthetic/AL 3.22 |

Initial eval job 25494 was replaced to use SRT's eval-stage smoke hook; initial Kimi job 30977 was stopped after finding the sampler mismatch. All smoke allocations are released: GB200 jobs completed successfully, and successful GB300 serve-only jobs were cancelled after their request check. Final `squeue` checks show none of the seven submitted job IDs remaining. These are startup checks, not performance or accuracy measurements. Kimi used the production hash-keyed Dynamo wheel cache; its runtime fingerprint reports package version `1.3.0`, which does not independently establish the configured Git commit.

## Additional startup and edge smokes

Eight more live cases passed on head `1014800402a255a2452c4dcc011848b2a67ef481`, using pinned SRT `984180e5b8755aef85e9995048b5a16cb5336bce` and the same actual Bash → connector → native SRT → Slurm path. Each reached healthy workers and returned HTTP 200 with generated tokens. No code changes were needed in this round.

| Cluster | Case | Slurm job | Runtime proof / result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GB200 | MiniMax-M3 TRT EAGLE3-GQA synthetic | 25500 | Actual backend env force value **1.78 = golden AL 2.78 − 1**; 15 tokens |
| GB200 | MiniMax-M3 TRT eval-only | 25501 | Caller-seeded force value **99 removed** from actual backend environments; 19 tokens |
| GB200 | DSV4 vLLM native caller override from MTP2 to MTP3 | 25502 | Actual engine config has **3 draft tokens and AL 2.49**; 24 tokens |
| GB300 | GLM5.2 SGLang native zip selector index 1 | 30980 | Preserved **1P4D**, prefill MTP1/decode MTP2, decode-derived **AL 2.5**; all five workers healthy, cross-node generation, 32 tokens |
| GB300 | Qwen3.5 SGLang disaggregated | 30979 | Non-speculative prefill has **no synthetic variables**; MTP3 decode has **AL 3.39**; cross-node generation, 32 tokens |
| GB300 | Kimi vLLM disaggregated greedy DSpark4 | 30981 | Both actual role processes have **AL 3.22**; prefill and decode registered, cross-node generation, 19 tokens |
| GB300 | Kimi vLLM probabilistic caller override | 30982 | Native sampler override selects **probabilistic / AL 3.36** in the actual backend; 32 tokens |
| GB300 | Kimi vLLM non-AgentX | 30983 | `IS_AGENTIC=0`, `THINKING_MODE` unset; caller-seeded **AL 99 removed**, actual backend uses **block** verification; 32 tokens |

All Kimi requests used temperature 1.0 and top-p 0.95. These checks retained production model/image, context, memory, topology and normal autotuning/graph capture. The intentional engine overrides are listed above. Smoke-only differences were isolated site paths/cache mounts, unique names, bounded timeouts and tiny requests; no full AgentX workload ran. Synthetic verification can produce repetitive or malformed text (observed for Qwen and disaggregated Kimi); these results establish startup/configuration/execution, not accuracy or performance.

GB200 jobs all completed with exit **0:0**. Successful GB300 serve-only jobs were cancelled after their request checks. All eight allocations were released, confirmed by final queue checks. Together with the first round, **13 live smoke cases passed**. Exact submitted configs, runtime process evidence, fingerprints, request responses and logs were retained in the isolated smoke workspaces.

## Final edge-case audit

Audited all eight SRT launcher callsites and workflow input forwarding. All 136 configured speculative AgentX variants generate overrides for their 197 eligible worker roles; 23 non-speculative roles remain excluded, and eval-only produces no synthetic additions. All 388 NVIDIA recipe references plan successfully, and 389 final native materializations match the intended role settings.

The audit found and fixed three supported-input edge cases:

- Recognize SGLang's `speculative-algo` abbreviation as well as `speculative-algorithm`; conflicting values fail explicitly. The abbreviation appears in 29 existing non-AgentX recipes and must also work when those recipes are used for AgentX.
- Remove synthetic variables from recipe-wide `environment` before applying role-local settings. Upstream SRT applies global environment after role environment, so stale globals could replace the selected golden AL or leak into eval/non-speculative roles.
- Compare native parsed override paths when detecting conflicting caller `--unset` operations. Quoted or whitespace-padded paths can no longer bypass the guard and remove generated simulation settings.

Regression coverage exercises all three cases using native override application. The full local suite passed: **1,779 passed, 1 skipped**, including **36 connector cases**. Ruff lint and formatting passed. The 13 GPU smoke results above remain evidence for their recorded commits; these final edge fixes were validated with the native parser/planner and regression suite.

## Upstream limitation

Native SRT broadcasts `--set` into zip groups. A replacement that collapses the group’s only varying dimension is rejected before submission; the adapter does not silently select a different variant.

title: fix(amd): restore native MTP checkpoint and collect all node logs
body:
The MI355X disaggregated recipe pairs Pro-0813 with the legacy EAGLE/MTP draft architecture, which logs missing required draft weights. Switch its model back to `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro` so the existing EAGLE path uses the original checkpoint’s native MTP weights. The existing selector restores thinking-on golden AL **2.49** for three draft tokens; evaluations retain real acceptance.

Also collect server logs from every Slurm node. `/run_logs` is node-local, and the old launcher copied only node 0’s tree, leaving decode logs out of GitHub artifacts. After the server step and container cleanup, run one collection task per node into the shared directory used by the existing artifact packager. Preserve server failures, fail otherwise-successful jobs if collection fails, and restore runner ownership. This adapts the fix proposed in #3167.

Explicitly pass the existing SGLang router port into evaluation. The shared library now requires `PORT` before parsing `--port`; without this caller input, evaluation exits after successful server startup. The endpoint remains port 30000. Forward the workflow-owned `AIPERF_EXPERIMENTAL_FAST` and `REQUIRE_POWER` values through the existing container environment allowlist; both are explicitly `0` for this sweep. This restores the intended client inputs without introducing defaults or changing validation.

The serving image and seven-point sweep remain unchanged. A perf changelog entry and `full-sweep-enabled` request fresh results.

Validation:
- All seven expected matrix points use the original checkpoint, MTP, and two nodes.
- Cluster inspection confirms all 64 original checkpoint shards and the required native MTP tensor names are present.
- Behavioral node-log staging tests: 2 passed, including separate prefill/decode trees and a missing-source failure.
- Real eval-library reproduction confirms the port fix uses the existing router endpoint.
- Bash syntax, Ruff lint/format, perf changelog/matrix validation, and `git diff --check` pass; historical changelog bytes are preserved.

Runtime checks confirmed complete native MTP loading on both roles, golden AL 2.49 in the throughput command, and both prefill/decode logs in an uploaded server artifact. GPU qualification is still in progress after fixing the missing client inputs. Confirm complete draft weight loading, real acceptance during evaluation, and both roles in uploaded server-log archives before treating the rerun as validated.

Follow-up to #2823.

title: Fix H100 OperatorX staged image imports / 修复 H100 OperatorX 预构建镜像导入
body:
H100 K3 MoE runs fail before kernel execution because Enroot cannot convert the vLLM image's OCI whiteouts. Reuse the existing H100 vLLM v0.19.1 squashfs through an explicit pool/backend override. Copy it into the private cache, verify the pinned SHA256 and squashfs structure, and verify cached bytes on reuse. A changed file fails instead of silently selecting another image.

The result records a `squashfs-sha256:` content digest and `staged-squashfs` source, distinct from an OCI manifest digest. H100's v0.19.1 image remains explicitly different from the other NVIDIA pools' v0.19.0. Other backend images and kernel timing are unchanged.

Validation: 68 OperatorX CPU behavior tests pass; targeted Ruff checks pass. [Read-only CI checksum verification](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35177524214) identified the staged bytes (this diagnostic deliberately failed without executing benchmarks). [H100 eight-case GPU validation](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35177935583) is running. The prior diagnostic commits are removed in the final diff.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

H100 K3 MoE 在执行内核前失败，原因是 Enroot 无法转换 vLLM 镜像的 OCI whiteout。本次通过明确的资源池/后端配置，复用已有的 vLLM v0.19.1 squashfs。导入器将文件复制到私有缓存，校验固定 SHA256 和 squashfs 结构，并在复用时再次校验缓存字节。文件变化会直接失败，不会静默更换镜像。

title: feat(operatorx): add Kimi K3 MoE benchmark profile / 新增 Kimi K3 MoE 测试配置
body:
Add an explicitly labeled **Kimi K3 (vLLM benchmark profile)** to OperatorX: BF16, 896 experts, top-16, hidden 7168, intermediate 3072, with 1/16/128/1024 local tokens and EP8/TP8 shapes. A shared vLLM fused-expert backend runs on CUDA and ROCm through the existing single-GPU CI path.

This follows the generic shapes in [vLLM #50082](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50082). Routing is prepared before timing; the measured kernel includes sorting, gate/up projection, SiLU-and-multiply, down projection and weighted reduction. EP8/TP8 emulate local weight shapes on one GPU, with no communication. The profile does **not** claim to reproduce the released K3 layer's SITU activation, latent projections, 3584-wide routed hidden path or shared experts. Those require a separate native-layer profile.

Validation:
- All eight BF16 cases passed on [H200](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35170766111), [MI300X](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35171951838), and [MI325X](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35171953290). At 1,024 local tokens with EP8, measured throughput is 322.57 / 181.63 / 215.11 TFLOPS/GPU respectively. Kernel code is unchanged from those measured commits.
- 66 behavioral CPU tests pass; the CLI planner resolves official pinned vLLM images and one-node dispatches. NVIDIA v0.19.0 provides amd64/arm64; AMD uses the existing official ROCm v0.19.0 image.
- [H100](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35171914052) failed before kernels at Enroot OCI whiteout conversion on both `/tmp` and `/var/tmp`, matching CollectiveX's known host limitation. The ineffective scratch override was removed. No node configuration was changed. **H100 is not validated.**
- B200, B300, GB200, GB300 and MI355X jobs are queued; no performance claim for those pools yet.
- [App #1165](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/pull/1165) merged after all unit/component/Chrome/Firefox and Bugbot checks passed. Verified the real H200 8/8 run and 322.57 TFLOPS in the local hidden UI. API v3 includes MoE and refreshes coverage from durable bundles.

title: feat(operatorx): GEMM and attention on nine GPU pools / 九种 GPU 的 GEMM 与 attention
body:
OperatorX adds single-GPU GEMM and MHA/GQA/materialized MLA attention dispatch for H100, H200, B200, B300, GB200, GB300, MI300X, MI325X, and MI355X. AMD gains ROCm torch GEMM with architecture-correct FP8 and separate torch/AITER attention backends. The paired hidden UI is merged in [InferenceX-app #1162](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/pull/1162).

AITER calls `flash_attn_func` directly for uniform BF16/FP16 contiguous attention with head dimensions <=256 and divisible by eight. Unsupported combinations remain explicit; AITER never falls back to torch. Shared torch attention fixes bottom-right causal masking for rectangular inputs and honors the declared BF16 output default. MLA measures materialized Q/K/V attention, excluding compressed-cache projection and RoPE. Artifacts record ROCm, torch and `amd-aiter` versions.

The workflow retains the existing priority scheduler and exactly one `nodes:1` label per shard. GB trays use their physical four-GPU topology. All matrix shards remain eligible: the former two-job cap could strand assigned labels on GitHub-held jobs. Architecture-matched digest-pinned images are imported on allocated compute nodes; AMD staging stays outside checkouts; cancellation recovers partial results and bounds Slurm cleanup. B300 follows the current account/partition/staging path and removes obsolete excluded node names. Per-platform controls live in `experimental/operatorx/platforms.json`.

Validation is ongoing; queued hardware is not claimed as measured. The initial B300 attention smoke was cancelled after its allocation log confirmed it had never left the Slurm resource queue; cleanup confirmed no active allocation, and its replacement uses merged main:

title: Add CollectiveX vLLM swap_blocks benchmark / 新增 CollectiveX vLLM 块复制基准测试
body:
## Description

Add an isolated CollectiveX benchmark for `vllm._custom_ops.swap_blocks`: pinned CPU→GPU, GPU→CPU, and same-GPU copies, with contiguous or seeded random mappings. Verify copied data, guard blocks, and source preservation outside the timed window. Record raw samples, latency percentiles, copied-payload bandwidth, image, source SHA, and GPU pool.

`backend=swap-blocks` dispatches one `nodes:1` cell per selected GPU pool without running EP sweeps. `only_sku` selects a single pool; blank selects H100, H200, B200, B300, GB200, GB300, MI300X, MI325X, and MI355X. CUDA uses official vLLM 0.25.1 and ROCm uses official vLLM 0.27.1; GB pools use ARM64. Current AMD Slurm pools are registered separately from legacy Docker pools. Allocation, staging, image import, and cleanup reuse the existing runtime.

The `large-blocks` profile sweeps 257 B through **1 GiB**, with requested counts **1/4/16/64/256/1024/2048** and an explicit **1 GiB copied-payload cap**. Each GPU produces **294 measurements**, **126 excluded combinations**, and **5,880 raw timing samples**. Bandwidth counts copied payload once. Timing includes submission and synchronization.

Fleet bring-up also removes retired B300 exclusion names at allocation time while preserving live exclusions, uses the current B300 squash cache, and uses B300/GB300 partition-default QoS. Import logs include filesystem diagnostics. Existing serving recipes/configurations and EP timed kernels are unchanged; there is no serving-config changelog or `/use` sweep applicable to this standalone benchmark.

## Validation

title: fix: enable Klaud fail-fast final sweeps / 支持 Klaud 最终完整扫描快速失败
body:
Klaud currently requires `full-sweep-enabled`, and its manifest/completion checks reject fail-fast sweeps even when every point and eval passes. Default new final sweeps to `full-sweep-fail-fast` and accept it throughout validation.

Keep `full-sweep-enabled` available for documented infrastructure exceptions and existing runs. Require exactly one supported sweep label, a successful final run on the exact head, and complete baseline/default-eval coverage. The prompt now distinguishes the original failure from fail-fast cancellations, requires cancelled points to be rerun, and waits for owned jobs to finish before changing labels.

Validation: 45 local behavior checks exercised the actual workflow script, Stop hook, and unsuccessful-sweep rejection; 79 existing tests passed. Ruff and strict online zizmor passed with no new suppressions. Actionlint passed with only its unsupported existing `$/` workflow-call diagnostic filtered (latest release 1.7.12). No GPU runs were dispatched.

保留 `full-sweep-enabled`，用于已记录的基础设施例外及已有运行。仍要求唯一受支持的 sweep 标签、精确 head 上成功的最终运行，以及全部基线测试点和默认 eval。提示词明确区分首个失败与 fail-fast 导致的取消，要求补跑被取消的测试点，并等待全部自有任务结束后再更改标签。

title: Add H100-first OperatorX Actions workflow / 添加优先使用 H100 的 OperatorX Actions 工作流
body:
## Description

Add a manual OperatorX sweep on the existing `h100-dgxc` and `h200-dgxc` runner pools. H100/PyTorch is the default, and the default testlist is the complete `gemm.json` catalog, split into at most 500 cases per shard. `gemm_perf` remains available as an explicit 11-case BF16 infrastructure smoke test.

Each shard requests one priority-scheduled node, stages the selected commit on shared storage, verifies the image digest, and waits for allocation, container execution, artifact recovery, and cleanup. Strict mode preserves unsupported and failed rows and fails on errors or zero successful measurements. Hosted PR checks validate planning; GPU work requires manual dispatch.

## Validation

- [Full H100 GEMM catalog](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35148048463): all 7,212 cases produced rows across 15 shards at `b51e15e6006db506547b0c0321f056bece096a4f`. The testlist blob matches current `main` (`a6bfe97dc703bc517a6ac56752fe1ade5a6b5778`).
- 2,777 OK (133 BF16, 1 FP16, 2,643 FP8), 4,351 unsupported, 84 CUDA out-of-memory errors, zero missing rows. Thirteen OK rows have M=0 and do not represent positive-size throughput measurements. The sweep is **red**, including the all-unsupported shard; no errors were relabeled to make it pass.
- Positive-size peaks: BF16 828.48 TFLOPS/GPU (`262144 × 1024 × 4096`); FP8 1,528.36 TFLOPS/GPU (`15360 × 7168 × 16384`). Derived from recorded latency using `2*M*N*K/(latency_us*1e6)` with `WORLD_SIZE=1`.
- [H100 smoke run](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35146452594): 11/11 BF16 cases passed on both attempts; targeted rerun reused the manifest and selected newer results.
- [Cancellation run](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35145103609): retained diagnostics. The corrected cleanup confirmation and recovery were subsequently GPU-validated.
- 16 CPU behavior tests pass. Current PR Lint, Tests, Zizmor, and full-catalog hosted planning checks pass. The latest commit changes only dispatch defaults and synchronized English/Chinese documentation.

H200 and other backends remain unvalidated. Existing kernels, timing iterations, model recipes, and master configs are unchanged. This is experimental execution infrastructure; OperatorX has no master-config key for the performance changelog.

Companion UI: [InferenceX-app PR #1157](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/pull/1157) adds OperatorX beside CollectiveX in Hidden and has been verified locally with these real H100 artifacts.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

为现有 `h100-dgxc` 和 `h200-dgxc` 运行器池添加 OperatorX 手动扫描工作流，默认使用 H100/PyTorch，并运行完整的 `gemm.json`，每个分片最多 500 个测试。`gemm_perf` 保留为显式选择的 11 项 BF16 基础设施快速检查。

每个分片通过优先级调度申请一个节点，在共享存储中暂存指定提交，核对镜像 digest，并等待分配、容器执行、产物恢复和清理完成。严格模式保留不支持和失败的结果；出现错误或没有任何成功测量时分片失败。PR 在托管运行器上验证执行计划，GPU 测试通过手动触发运行。

完整 H100 扫描 [35148048463](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35148048463) 在 15 个分片中为全部 7,212 个测试生成了结果。测试列表与当前 `main` 完全一致。结果为 2,777 项 OK（BF16 133 项、FP16 1 项、FP8 2,643 项）、4,351 项不支持、84 项 CUDA 显存不足，缺失结果为零。其中 13 项 OK 的 M=0，不计入有效吞吐量测量。扫描仍为失败状态，全不支持的分片也失败；没有修改错误分类来制造通过结果。

正维度测试的单卡峰值为 BF16 828.48 TFLOPS（`262144 × 1024 × 4096`）和 FP8 1,528.36 TFLOPS（`15360 × 7168 × 16384`）。根据记录的延迟和 `2*M*N*K/(latency_us*1e6)` 计算，`WORLD_SIZE=1`。11 项 BF16 快速检查的两次尝试均通过，局部重跑、取消诊断保留及后续清理恢复也已验证。16 项 CPU 行为测试及当前 PR 的 Lint、Tests、Zizmor、完整列表执行计划检查均通过。

H200 和其他后端尚未验证。没有修改现有内核、计时迭代次数、模型配置或主基准配置；OperatorX 尚无对应的主配置键可写入性能变更日志。最新提交仅调整触发默认值，并同步中英文文档。

配套界面：[InferenceX-app PR #1157](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX-app/pull/1157) 在 Hidden 菜单中将 OperatorX 与 CollectiveX 并列，已通过本次 H100 真实产物完成本地界面验证。

</details>

title: fix: refresh B200 SSD Engram rows on graph replay / 修复 B200 SSD Engram 图回放行刷新

GPU checks cover changing-ID replay, checkpoint persistence and TP boundaries.

Sweep: c1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 96, 128; full AgentX trace, DSpark5, AL 3.51. Eval uses real block rejection with adaptive verification off to preserve piecewise graphs. Local patch, syntax, lint, matrix and changelog checks pass; GPU correctness and performance are gated by CI.

Shared pagination rejects malformed or incomplete API listings.

Validation: 1,670 local tests passed in 16.85 seconds. A temporary comparison against the actual pre-refactor JavaScript matched all 2,047 cases (decisions, outputs, and rejection messages); it found and fixed the Python `None` versus JavaScript `null` rejection text for unfinished runs. The comparison harness was removed. Consolidated overlapping reuse tests, removed internal-helper mocks, and kept only behavioral tests. title: refactor: simplify advisory CODEOWNER verification / 重构：简化 CODEOWNER 参考验证
body:
The checklist verifier still tracked merge eligibility after its required status was removed. Remove that bookkeeping: submitted or edited checklists and manual retries now run verification and update one advisory verdict comment, recording only the SHA actually assessed.

- Remove commit-status publication, its write permission, admin-push carry-forward, obsolete label cleanup, and automatic head-update/reopen/ready catch-up.
- Keep trusted-default-branch execution, ownership scoping, human writer authorization, per-PR serialization, existing bot-comment reuse, and manual retries. Missed review events can be retried by editing the existing checklist or dispatching its URL.
- Exercise the actual comment publisher with controlled GitHub responses: updates, legacy comments, human-comment preservation, missing/invalid/failed verdicts, deleted-comment recovery, repeated publication, and API failures. Ownership tests still cover malformed, incomplete, and changing PR data.
- Include `.github/scripts/` edits in CI and synchronize English/Chinese documentation. The workflow and helpers shrink by 204 lines.

Validation: 1,626 tests and 171 subtests passed in 13.53s; 56 focused tests passed in 0.21s. Ruff lint/format, actionlint, JavaScript syntax, local offline Zizmor audit, and `git diff --check` passed. CI also runs the online security audit. No GPU benchmark changes.

Related: #2382, #3197.

title: refactor: share eval artifact loading and validation / 重构：统一评测工件读取与校验
body:
Collection, reuse validation, and Klaud repeatedly read the same eval results and metadata. This moves artifact consistency checks into `infx.results`, shares parsed result data within each phase, and gives Klaud result identities and validation errors in one pass.

The existing CLI entrypoints, artifact formats, rerun selection, and distinct collection/reuse validation policies are preserved. Validation reads the final files afresh after deduplication rewrites or removes artifacts. Most of the diff relocates existing validation code out of the workflow entrypoint. Deduplication preserves error ordering and aborts before artifact writes on fatal result-decoding errors, including when metadata is missing or invalid.

Validation:

- 2,112 before/after artifact cases matched collected rows, validation errors, CLI output/status, dedupe messages, and retained file bytes. The temporary comparison harness was removed.
- Full repository suite: 1,617 tests and 171 subtests passed in 14.87 seconds. Focused suite: 152 tests passed in 0.98 seconds.
- Randomized differential fuzzing: 200,627 cases matched after restoring dedupe error ordering and decoder-failure handling. Fuzzing is complete; no fuzzer is included in this PR.
- Ruff lint and formatting checks passed.
- On a controlled two-result fixture, collection needed 3 JSON reads instead of 4; Klaud eval inspection needed 4 instead of 11.

Related: #2382.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

收集、复用校验和 Klaud 会反复读取相同的评测结果与元数据。本次将工件一致性检查迁入 `infx.results`，在每个阶段复用已解析的结果，并让 Klaud 一次取得结果身份和校验错误。

保留现有 CLI 入口、工件格式、重跑结果选择规则，以及收集与复用各自的校验策略。去重改写或删除工件后，校验会重新读取最终文件。差异中的大部分内容是将已有校验代码从工作流入口迁出。去重保留原有错误顺序；即使元数据缺失或无效，致命的结果解码错误也会在改写任何工件之前终止处理。

验证结果：

- 2,112 组新旧工件对照用例的收集记录、校验错误、CLI 输出与退出状态、去重消息及保留文件字节均一致；临时对照脚本已删除。
- 全仓库 1,617 项测试和 171 项子测试通过，用时 14.87 秒；152 项针对性测试通过，用时 0.98 秒。
- 恢复去重错误顺序及解码失败处理后，200,627 组随机差分用例全部一致。模糊测试已结束；此 PR 不包含模糊测试器。
- Ruff lint 与格式检查通过。
- 在包含两个结果文件的受控样例中，收集的 JSON 读取次数由 4 次降至 3 次，Klaud 评测检查由 11 次降至 4 次。

关联：#2382。

</details>

title: Unify GitHub requests through gh and validate listings / 统一通过 gh 请求 GitHub 并验证列表
body:
Workflow helpers, Klaud, and recovery maintained separate GitHub transports and paginators. Recovery could also treat malformed jobs responses as an empty result. Share repository-scoped JSON requests and listing validation in `infx.github`, using `gh api` throughout.

- Remove the custom HTTP transport and page-number loop. GitHub CLI follows pagination links; malformed rows, missing/invalid counts on named listings, and fewer retrieved rows than GitHub reports fail the operation. Valid empty and bare-array listings remain supported.
- Workflow tokens override inherited credentials only in the subprocess and target `github.com`. Empty explicit tokens fail instead of falling back to local authentication. Klaud and recovery retain their existing `gh` authentication, error boundaries, claim-conflict handling, and successful outputs.
- Preserve module/CLI entrypoints, comment reactions, and authorization/recovery policy. Each request, including all its pages, has a 60-second timeout. GitHub CLI is already present in the affected runners; no new Python dependencies or workflow YAML changes.

Validation on `9eeb4e8d9`: **1,585 tests passed in CI in 29.03s**, plus lint, MCP compatibility, and sign-off scope. Locally, 175 focused behavioral tests passed in 0.99s and 106 comparisons against the actual prior implementations found no output differences across empty lists, page boundaries, multiple pages, named/bare listings, and response methods. The temporary comparisons left no files. Read-only GitHub checks matched all 188 files across two pages from merged PR #3022 with both local authentication and an explicit token overriding conflicting inherited credentials; completed-run jobs also passed. Tests mock the external process/API boundary and exercise real caller behavior, including reactions, sign-off scope, stats artifacts, and recovery.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

工作流辅助程序、Klaud 和恢复工具原先各自维护 GitHub 请求与分页逻辑；恢复工具还可能把格式错误的 Job 响应当作空结果。本 PR 将仓库范围的 JSON 请求与列表验证集中到 `infx.github`，统一使用 `gh api`。

- 删除自定义 HTTP 请求实现和按页码遍历的循环，改由 GitHub CLI 跟随分页链接。记录格式错误、命名列表计数缺失或无效、实际记录数少于 GitHub 报告数量时，操作会失败。有效空列表和裸数组列表仍受支持。
- 工作流 Token 仅在子进程中覆盖继承的凭据，并固定访问 `github.com`。显式传入空 Token 会失败，不会回退到本地认证。Klaud 和恢复工具保留现有 `gh` 认证、错误边界、claim 冲突处理和成功输出。
- 模块/CLI 入口、评论表态以及授权与恢复策略保持不变。每次请求（包括全部分页）的超时为 60 秒。受影响的 Runner 已有 GitHub CLI，不新增 Python 依赖，不修改工作流 YAML。

验证基于 `9eeb4e8d9`：**CI 中 1,585 项测试在 29.03 秒内通过**，Lint、MCP 兼容性及签核范围检查也通过。本地 175 项针对性行为测试在 0.99 秒内通过；对新旧真实实现进行的 106 项比较涵盖空列表、分页边界、多页、命名/裸数组列表及不同请求方法的响应，输出均一致，未留下临时文件。GitHub 只读验证中，已合并 PR #3022 的 188 个文件分布在两页，使用本地认证或显式 Token 覆盖冲突的继承凭据时，结果均一致；已完成 Run 的 Job 查询也通过。测试仅替换外部进程/API 边界，并实际执行表态、签核范围、统计产物及恢复等调用逻辑。

</details>

title: Add Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MXFP4 AgentX on MI355X / 新增 MI355X Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MXFP4 AgentX 配方
body:
## Description

Add `qwen3.8next-fp4-mi355x-sglang-agentic-mtp` using the public [AMD Quark MXFP4 checkpoint](https://huggingface.co/amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4).

- SGLang on `cluster:mi355x-amds`, TP8/EP1, concurrency 1/4/8/12/16, no KV offloading.
- Start from the [upstream MI355X balanced FP8 recipe](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next#hw=mi355x&variant=default&quant=fp8&strategy=balanced&nodes=single&pleOffload=auto), replacing the checkpoint with Quark MXFP4. The cookbook does not yet validate this MXFP4 combination.
- Use native NEXTN MTP with 3 steps, top-k 1, and 4 draft tokens. Throughput uses the repository's golden acceptance length of 2.32 with `match-expected` and `real-draft-token`; evals do not enable simulated acceptance.
- Pin `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:qwen38flashnext` to digest `sha256:f2e3928cd5be1d7bf9bfb783d57e9f5b35baa8e09d4248e5fc44da43c85c35e4`.
- Mount this recipe at `/ix` so the repository does not hide SGLang and AITER under the image's `/workspace`.
- Convert the pinned image to Enroot's digest URI syntax on cold-cache imports while preserving the original image/cache identity. The conversion is scoped to this model, framework, and image repository.
- Keep the canonical 256k AgentX trace source and one-hour profile. No engine patches, shortened profiling, skipped correctness assertions, or relaxed eval thresholds.

The new checkpoint keeps PLE in BF16. The separate FP8 recipe in #2754 hits an assertion when loading quantized PLE scales ([SGLang #36616](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/36616)); this PR does not modify that recipe or suppress the assertion.

## Validation

Local checks on `63449de4aab8defd5faa1718ebd3eba10edca92e`:

- Bash syntax and `git diff --check` passed.
- All 392 tests in `utils/matrix_logic/` and `runners/test_slurm_utils.py` passed, including launcher routing and cold-cache Enroot import behavior.
- Exact-key matrix generation with `--all-evals` selected all five MTP concurrency points for lm-eval.

GPU validation is blocked. In [sweep 35016198611, concurrency-1 eval](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35016198611/job/104541056806), the model reached warmup, then all eight ranks reported `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_EXCEPTION` / `hipErrorLaunchFailure`. The scheduler aborted at 02:10 UTC on September 16; surviving HTTP workers continued returning failed health checks until the 500-minute CI timeout. The remaining sweep was cancelled to release capacity. No eval score or throughput result passed.

[SGLang #36601](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36601) documents remaining shared-expert loader and ROCm QSA fixes for this checkpoint. The validated path in [cookbook PR #36919](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36919) uses TP8/EP8, page size 64, explicit AITER attention/MoE, and exact unmerged source over an immutable official nightly. This PR currently has neither that source override nor the revised topology. An engine-source override requires explicit authorization; no assertion has been disabled.

A local opt-in readiness fix detects confirmed scheduler/fatal GPU errors even when the HTTP wrapper survives. It passed 402 matrix, launcher, server-watch, and readiness tests, but is not yet pushed to avoid automatically launching another sweep against the known-failing image. The PR retains `full-sweep-fail-fast` and `all-evals`; a complete sweep and evals must pass on the final commit.

## Checklist

- [x] Local syntax, matrix, and launcher checks.
- [x] Performance changelog entries.
- [ ] Full GPU sweep and evals pass on the final PR commit.
- [ ] Corresponding upstream MXFP4 cookbook update.
- [ ] CODEOWNER review.
- [ ] Authorized maintainer posts `/reuse-sweep-run` after the final green sweep.

The FP8 cookbook is not MXFP4 validation. No merge is requested as part of this bring-up.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

新增 `qwen3.8next-fp4-mi355x-sglang-agentic-mtp`，使用公开的 `amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Quark-MXFP4` 权重，在 `cluster:mi355x-amds` 上运行 SGLang，配置为 TP8/EP1，并发度 1/4/8/12/16，不启用 KV offloading。

启动参数参考上方链接的 MI355X FP8 balanced 配方，并将权重替换为 Quark MXFP4。当前版本启用原生 NEXTN MTP，参数为 3 steps、top-k 1、4 draft tokens。吞吐测试采用仓库中的黄金接受长度 2.32，使用 `match-expected` 和 `real-draft-token`；评测不启用模拟接受率。上游 cookbook 尚未验证这个 MXFP4 组合。

镜像通过 digest 固定；仓库挂载到 `/ix`，避免覆盖镜像 `/workspace` 下的 SGLang 和 AITER。冷缓存导入将镜像引用转换为 Enroot 支持的 digest URI，保留原始镜像与缓存标识，转换仅影响此模型、框架和镜像仓库。

保留标准 256k AgentX 轨迹和一小时性能测试，不修改推理引擎、不缩短测试、不跳过正确性断言，也不降低评测阈值。新权重的 PLE 保持 BF16；本 PR 不修改 #2754 的 FP8 配方，也不屏蔽其 scale 断言。

在提交 `63449de4aab8defd5faa1718ebd3eba10edca92e` 上，Bash 语法、diff 检查、矩阵与 launcher 的 392 项测试均通过，包括冷缓存 Enroot 导入行为。`--all-evals` 为全部五个 MTP 并发点选择 lm-eval。这些本地检查不证明 SGLang MXFP4/NEXTN 的 GPU 运行兼容性。

[GPU sweep 35016198611 的并发度 1 评测](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35016198611/job/104541056806) 在 warmup 阶段出现 `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_EXCEPTION` / `hipErrorLaunchFailure`。scheduler 于 9 月 16 日 02:10 UTC 中止，但残留 HTTP worker 持续返回健康检查失败，直到 500 分钟 CI 超时。其余 sweep 已取消以释放资源，没有通过的评测分数或吞吐结果。

[SGLang #36601](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36601) 包含该权重所需的 shared-expert loader 和 ROCm QSA 修复。[cookbook PR #36919](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36919) 的验证路径采用 TP8/EP8、page size 64、显式 AITER attention/MoE，并在固定 digest 的官方 nightly 上挂载精确的未合并源码。本 PR 尚未采用该源码覆盖或新拓扑；覆盖引擎源码需明确授权，不会屏蔽断言。

本地已添加可选的就绪检查修复，在 HTTP wrapper 仍存活时也能检测 scheduler 中止或致命 GPU 错误。402 项相关测试通过，暂未推送，以免对已知失败的镜像再次自动启动 sweep。PR 保留 `full-sweep-fail-fast` 和 `all-evals`；合并前仍需最终提交的完整绿色 sweep、对应上游 cookbook、CODEOWNER 审查和授权维护者的 `/reuse-sweep-run`。本次任务不执行合并。

</details>

title: Fail closed when collecting workflow statistics / 运行统计收集异常时明确失败
body:
Workflow statistics currently catch authentication failures, exit successfully, and write `null` to `run_stats.json`. Collect job pages through the existing `infx.github` client instead, and fail before writing statistics if a request or response is invalid.

- Preserve successful JSON output, hardware matching, zero-count buckets, and counts across every retry (`filter=all`). Skipped and unrelated jobs remain excluded; cancelled and unfinished hardware jobs still count as attempts.
- Reject malformed pagination responses instead of treating them as empty results. Pagination owns `page` and `per_page`, while retaining caller filters.
- Load configuration when collecting statistics rather than during import, so installed hardware-matching helpers work outside a checkout.
- Remove PyGithub and four unused transitive dependencies. The CLI/module and legacy stub remain available. Redundant identity/repository/run preflight calls and their diagnostic messages are removed; the statistics table is unchanged.

Validation: 154 focused behavioral tests passed in 1.51s, including HTTP failures, multi-page retry counts, preservation of existing output after a later-page failure, installed-wheel behavior, reuse and sign-off consumers. A temporary comparison of the actual previous and new implementations covered 729 combinations of job conclusions with identical successful outputs; its scratch files were removed. Ruff check and format passed. CI passed all 1,558 tests in 28.97s, lint, MCP compatibility, and sign-off scope.

Follow-up to #3168. No benchmark, recipe, workflow YAML, or permission-policy changes.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

当前运行统计在身份验证失败后仍以成功状态退出，并将 `null` 写入 `run_stats.json`。本 PR 改为通过现有的 `infx.github` 客户端读取 Job 分页；请求失败或响应无效时，在写入统计文件之前报错。

- 保留成功时的 JSON 输出、硬件匹配、零计数分组，以及所有重试的统计（`filter=all`）。跳过和无关的 Job 仍不计入；取消和未完成的硬件 Job 仍计为一次尝试。
- 拒绝格式错误的分页响应，避免将其当作空结果。分页函数自行控制 `page` 和 `per_page`，同时保留调用方的筛选条件。
- 将配置读取推迟到收集统计时，使安装后的硬件匹配函数可以在仓库目录之外使用。
- 移除 PyGithub 及四个不再使用的间接依赖。保留模块 CLI 和旧路径入口，移除冗余的身份、仓库和运行预检请求及其诊断消息；统计表格不变。

验证：154 项针对性行为测试在 1.51 秒内通过，覆盖 HTTP 错误、多页重试计数、后续分页失败时保留原有输出、安装包行为，以及复用和签核调用方。临时对照运行了新旧真实实现的 729 种 Job 结论组合，成功输出完全一致，临时文件已清理。Ruff 检查和格式检查通过，CI 的 1,558 项测试在 28.97 秒内全部通过，Lint、MCP 兼容性和签核范围检查也通过。

这是 #3168 的后续改进，不修改基准测试、配方、工作流 YAML 或权限策略。

</details>

title: Package infx and centralize uv dependencies / 打包 infx 并统一管理 uv 依赖
body:
`infx` had no installable package or shared dependency definition. Callers repeated dependency lists, and several tools assumed their Python files lived inside a checkout.

This adds `pyproject.toml`, Python 3.12 selection, and `uv.lock`. Dependencies have reviewed major-version bounds and a 12-hour release cooldown; pre-1.0 packages are bounded by minor version. MCP stays on supported 1.x because 2.x replaces the handler API used by the server. Core dependencies stay small, with workflow/results extras and MCP/test groups. Ruff and Zizmor remain outside the lockfile and use their latest eligible releases. Lint and Tests use separate uv caches.

Result collection, comparisons, and run statistics use current `main`, resolved once during sweep setup and shared across jobs. Klaud passes one main commit to every candidate and uses a separate tooling checkout for its hooks. Sign-off uses trusted main. PR CI tests the source checkout plus installed-wheel entrypoints; benchmark scripts and recipes retain the selected checkout. E2E resolves that checkout once and forwards its SHA to all eight benchmark/eval routes, preventing drift while jobs queue (#3177). Repository commits have no release cooldown or release-version pin.

Source/editable installs preserve checkout behavior; installed wheels use the caller's repository for repository-dependent commands. The changelog validator preserves trusted imports across checkouts. Eval resources and the BFCL attribution license ship in the wheel. GPU image dependency installation retains its existing path. Run summaries show the selected setup, tooling, and reused-source commits.

Validation:
- Merged current `main` (`ebcda867d`) into the branch.
- **1,000,000 paired differential cases** compared real implementations from `main` with the installed wheel: all four matrix families, eval rows, artifact filenames, reuse parsing, recipe node counts, and hardware labels. **Zero differences.** Matrix acceptance/rejection and input preservation were checked independently too.
- Fuzzing used an isolated temporary folder with a 256 MiB limit; peak logical size was 126 MiB. The fuzzer and its generated fixtures were removed. No fuzzing code is included in this PR.
- **340 focused tests passed**, including clean core/results wheel installs, bundled resources/license attribution, and trusted cross-checkout planning. Ruff and actionlint passed; actionlint's existing unsupported `$/` syntax warning was excluded.
- Removed 19 redundant schema-constructor tests; all 147 remaining schema tests passed. [GitHub CI](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35072183406) on `8f071be7f` passed **1,545 tests in 32.22 seconds**, MCP compatibility, and Lint. Zizmor and sign-off passed. Claude’s final re-review gave LGTM with no blockers. Local checks do not exercise GitHub scheduling, external services, or GPU workloads. Before this PR lands, its locked collector commands cannot run against main because main does not yet contain package metadata; check the first relevant production runs after merge.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

`infx` 此前没有可安装的包或统一的依赖定义。调用方重复维护依赖列表，部分工具还假定 Python 文件始终位于源码仓库内。

本次添加 `pyproject.toml`、Python 3.12 版本选择及 `uv.lock`。依赖使用经过审查的主版本范围，并执行 12 小时发布冷却期；尚未达到 1.0 的包按次版本限制升级。MCP 保持在受支持的 1.x，因为 2.x 替换了当前服务使用的处理器 API。核心依赖保持精简，工作流和结果处理使用 extras，MCP 与测试使用依赖组。Ruff 和 Zizmor 不纳入 lockfile，继续使用满足冷却期的最新版本。Lint 和 Tests 使用独立的 uv 缓存。

结果收集、结果比较和运行统计使用当前 `main`，在 sweep setup 时解析一次提交并在各 job 间共享。Klaud 将同一个 main 提交传给所有候选任务，其 hook 使用独立的工具 checkout。Sign-off 使用受信任的 main。PR CI 测试源码 checkout 及安装后 wheel 的入口；基准测试脚本和配方仍使用所选 checkout。E2E 只解析一次该 checkout，并将 SHA 传给全部八条基准测试和评测路径，防止排队期间分支前进导致版本不一致（#3177）。仓库提交不受包发布冷却期限制，也不固定到某个发布版本。

源码和 editable 安装保留原有 checkout 行为；wheel 安装时，依赖仓库文件的命令使用调用方所在仓库。变更日志验证器在跨 checkout 调用时保留可信导入路径。评测资源和 BFCL 归属许可证随 wheel 分发。GPU 镜像依赖安装保留现有路径。运行摘要显示选定的 setup、工具和复用源提交。

title: fix(amd): collect logs from every Slurm node / 修复 AMD Slurm 多节点日志收集
body:
[by Codex]

## Summary

- collect server logs from every AMD Slurm node after the primary server step exits
- merge node-local prefill, decode, router, client, and wrapper logs into the shared log directory before artifact packaging
- restore runner ownership after the fan-in so later jobs can clean the workspace
- add behavioral coverage for merging separate prefill/decode node log trees
- document the AMD multinode diagnostic-artifact contract in English and Chinese

## Root cause

In run 34926284365, job 104504413449, the uploaded multinode server-log archive contained the rank-0 prefill/frontend logs but no decode log. `/run_logs` is backed by each compute node's local `/tmp`, while the engine launcher copied only rank 0's tree into shared storage. The workflow correctly uploaded the resulting tarball, but the decode node's tree had never reached it.

This change performs a second one-task-per-node Slurm staging pass after every server container and outer `tee` has exited. Each node merges its completed `/tmp/slurm_job-${SLURM_JOB_ID}` tree into the shared job directory, covering SGLang, vLLM, and Atom through the common AMD launcher.

## Validation

- `bash -n benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/job.slurm benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/stage_node_logs.sh`
- `python -m pytest utils/test_amd_node_log_staging.py -q` — 2 passed
- `git diff --check`

No `perf-changelog.yaml` entry is included because the new staging pass runs only after the measured server step has completed and changes diagnostic artifact collection, not benchmark execution or performance.

Fixes the missing decode-log artifact observed in https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34926284365/job/104504413449.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

## 摘要

- 在主要服务器步骤结束后，从每个 AMD Slurm 节点收集服务器日志
- 在打包工件之前，将各节点本地的 Prefill、Decode、Router、Client 和包装器日志合并到共享日志目录
- 汇总完成后恢复 Runner 用户所有权，确保后续作业可以正常清理工作区
- 添加行为测试，覆盖独立 Prefill/Decode 节点日志树的合并
- 同步更新中英文 AMD 多节点诊断工件契约文档

## 根因

在 Run 34926284365 的 Job 104504413449 中，上传的多节点服务器日志工件包含 Rank 0 的 Prefill/Frontend 日志，但缺少 Decode 日志。`/run_logs` 实际映射到每个计算节点本地的 `/tmp`，而引擎启动器只把 Rank 0 的日志树复制到共享存储。工作流正确上传了生成的压缩包，但 Decode 节点的日志树从未进入共享目录。

本变更会在所有服务器容器及其外层 `tee` 退出后，再执行一次每节点一个任务的 Slurm 日志汇总。每个节点都会把完整的 `/tmp/slurm_job-${SLURM_JOB_ID}` 日志树合并到共享作业目录。该修复位于 AMD 公共启动路径，因此同时覆盖 SGLang、vLLM 和 Atom。

## 验证

- `bash -n benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/job.slurm benchmarks/multi_node/amd_utils/stage_node_logs.sh`
- `python -m pytest utils/test_amd_node_log_staging.py -q` — 2 passed
- `git diff --check`

本 PR 未添加 `perf-changelog.yaml` 条目，因为新增汇总步骤只在被测服务器步骤完成后运行，仅改变诊断工件收集，不影响基准执行或性能。

</details>

Update `minimaxm3-fp4-b300-vllm-agentic-mtp` to `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-cd10ed6f9f6b37a8ace9cf380007e66fe12ec0c3`, remove its runtime offload patch call, and delete `runners/patch_vllm_simple_kv_offload.py` and its tests.

This PR contains only the B300 image/script update and the shared helper deletion; it does not include the other GPU's update. No documentation changes.

The image includes [vLLM #54756](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54756), which correctly registers mixed-size KV-cache regions. Latest stable v0.29.0 still contains the bug, so this uses the latest published regular nightly checked on September 15. Registry revision labels match the commit; AMD64 manifest is `sha256:0a329f66a92e19ad8c8e9b9a17bda6ecf70b1a8dcfd9c735360a251ce870d0d8`.

## Merge coordination

Companion PR: #3131. Both independently delete the same shared helper, as requested. Merging either PR alone leaves the other GPU's old offload script referencing the deleted file until its companion merges. Coordinate both merges; do not run that remaining old offload path between them. Each PR's changelog selects only its own GPU.

## Validation

- Bash syntax and `git diff --check` passed.
- Strict config generation passed for all 8 B300 points; compared with base, only the image changes.
- `runners/test_slurm_utils.py`: 27 passed after deleting the helper's tests.
- Historical changelog bytes preserved; changelog-driven matrix generation passed.
- Exact image revision checked for the offload fix and existing MiniMax-M3/EAGLE3 serving options.
- GPU full sweep and evals requested with `full-sweep-enabled`; results pending.

title: ci: enforce strict zizmor audits and harden workflows / 启用严格 zizmor 审计并加固工作流
body:
Add Zizmor security auditing and fix the workflow findings it exposes. Native path filters keep Python CI and workflow auditing independent: Python changes run Lint and Tests in parallel; workflow/action/security configuration changes run Zizmor. CI definitions, Ruff/pytest configuration, and MCP dependencies also trigger Python CI. Editing `ci.yml` runs all three jobs. Each workflow can be dispatched manually.

- Use the latest Zizmor release at least 12 hours old, with the auditor persona, strict collection, online checks, and no global rule exclusions.
- Pass workflow inputs as data instead of interpolating them into shell/Python source, and construct ingest dispatch payloads through the GitHub API.
- Narrow reusable-workflow secrets and token permissions; remove persisted benchmark checkout credentials while retaining the profiling storage deploy key needed to push traces.
- Combine Claude coding and review workflows, preserving their separate jobs, permissions, and prompts. Scope review concurrency per PR and use the official action's CLI installer.

Inline exceptions cover existing repository-scoped integration secrets, independent GPU/comment/Klaud requests, trusted `pull_request_target` control workflows, and the profiling storage push. Moving stored secrets into GitHub Environments remains separate work.

Validation:

- On `372ebc353`, [Python CI](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35049064485) and [Workflow security](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35049064463) passed: Ruff, Zizmor, **1,558 tests and 171 subtests**. The tests took 34.93 seconds. This PR changes `ci.yml`, so both workflows correctly run.
- [Independent Claude review](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3161#pullrequestreview-5217764856) found no issues on `4fd413336`, before the path-filter correction.
- The CODEOWNER sign-off status passed. No tests or benchmark settings changed relative to `main`.
- Same-repository `$/` calls are [official GitHub syntax](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-30-reference-same-repository-actions-with-self-repository-syntax/), including reusable workflows. They require runner 2.336.0+; the inspected hosted CI log reports 2.337.0. Current actionlint does not understand this syntax.
- [The combined Claude workflow](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35045882878) parsed and ran, but its action skipped review because OIDC validation requires the workflow to match `main`. Its green job is not review evidence. Post-merge execution still needs verification.
- No local tests or GPU benchmarks were run during takeover.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

加入 Zizmor 安全审计，并修复发现的工作流问题。使用 GitHub 原生路径过滤，将 Python CI 与工作流审计独立触发：Python 变更并行运行 Lint 和 Tests；工作流/action/安全配置变更运行 Zizmor。CI 定义、Ruff/pytest 配置和 MCP 依赖变更也会触发 Python CI。修改 `ci.yml` 会运行全部三项任务。两个工作流均可手动分发。

- 使用发布至少 12 小时的最新 Zizmor，启用 auditor 模式、严格输入收集和在线检查，不全局禁用规则。
- 将工作流输入作为数据传递，避免直接插入 Shell/Python 源码；通过 GitHub API 构建 ingest 分发请求。
- 收紧可复用工作流的 secret 传递和 token 权限，停止在基准测试 checkout 中保留凭据；仅保留向 profiling 存储仓库推送所需的 deploy key。
- 合并 Claude 编码与审阅工作流，保留各自的任务、权限和提示词；按 PR 隔离审阅并发，并使用官方 action 的 CLI 安装器。

行内豁免涵盖现有仓库级集成 secret、独立的 GPU/评论/Klaud 请求、可信的 `pull_request_target` 控制工作流，以及 profiling 存储推送。将实际 secret 值迁入 GitHub Environments 留作独立任务。

验证结果：

- `372ebc353` 的 [Python CI](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35049064485) 和 [Workflow security](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35049064463) 均通过：Ruff、Zizmor、**1,558 项测试与 171 项子测试**。测试耗时 34.93 秒。本 PR 修改了 `ci.yml`，因此两个工作流均按预期运行。
- [独立 Claude 审阅](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3161#pullrequestreview-5217764856) 已在路径过滤修正前的 `4fd413336` 上完成，未发现问题。
- CODEOWNER 签核状态通过。相较 `main`，本 PR 未修改测试或基准测试配置。
- 同仓库 `$/` 引用属于 [GitHub 官方支持的语法](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-30-reference-same-repository-actions-with-self-repository-syntax/)，适用于可复用工作流。要求 runner 2.336.0+；已检查的托管 CI 日志显示 2.337.0。当前 actionlint 尚不识别该语法。
- [合并后的 Claude 工作流](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35045882878) 已成功解析并运行，但 action 因 OIDC 校验要求工作流与 `main` 一致而跳过审阅。绿色任务状态不能作为审阅证据，合并后仍需确认其实际运行。
- 接手期间未运行本地测试或 GPU 基准测试。

</details>

The 09-14 nightly is the newest that predates the regression: its commit (4358a161, 2026-09-13 22:48 UTC) has no such import.
- Tag verified on Docker Hub: pushed 2026-09-14T01:10:50Z, digest `sha256:73cbbede63cd3454f2146073c6f80f151a2abef4a65b0992431b9c7a9aae5e5f`, multi-arch.

title: [Klaud Cold] glm5.2-fp8-b300-sglang-agentic-mtp: GLM-5.2 FP8 SGLang AgentX MTP on B300 with the staged checkpoint / B300 上 GLM-5.2 FP8 SGLang AgentX MTP（使用已暂存检查点）
body:
## Summary
Re-creation of #2884 on current `main`: the first **GLM-5.2 FP8** AgentX (agentic-coding) recipe on **B300**, `glm5.2-fp8-b300-sglang-agentic-mtp`, the FP8 precision sibling of `glm5.2-fp4-b300-sglang-agentic-mtp` and the B300 counterpart of the FP8 B200 recipe in #2863. The recipe, config block, and search space are the same as #2884; what changed is how the checkpoint is obtained.

- **Checkpoint is pre-staged.** `zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8` now sits at the normal DSXE location alongside the other staged models, so `runners/launch_b300-dsxe.sh` adds `GLM-5.2-FP8` to `STAGED_MODELS` (plus `glm-5.2-fp8` / `zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8` aliases) and exports `MODEL_PATH=/scratch/models/GLM-5.2-FP8`. The launcher's existing `srun test -r "$MODEL_PATH/config.json"` probe runs on the allocated node before the script starts.
- **Script no longer downloads.** The flock-serialized `hf download` block from #2884 is gone. The script keeps the completeness check (tokenizer, shard index, every shard the index names) and fails fast with a clear message if the staged tree is incomplete, instead of pulling ~756 GB onto the read-only staged root. Stand-alone runs without `MODEL_PATH` hand SGLang the HF id.
- **Serve flags unchanged from #2884:** TP8 low-latency arm, `--quantization fp8`, fp8_e4m3 KV, cutedsl bf16 GEMM, chunked-prefill 8192, `--mem-fraction-static 0.85`, fixed 270 GB/rank HiCache target pool, glm47 / glm45 parsers, EAGLE num-steps 3 / topk 1 / 4 draft tokens on golden AL 2.99 (measured on this FP8 checkpoint).
- **Image:** `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20260908-20ca564b` (verified on Docker Hub), the first nightly carrying sgl-project/sglang#38318 (EAGLE DSA fp8 KV read-path None guard); same tag as #2863.
- **Search space:** mirrors the NVFP4 B300 sibling: one TP8 + HiCache arm at conc [1, 4, 8, 12, 16], dram-utilization 0.80, on `cluster:b300-dsxe`.
- #2884's only sweep (run 34179028866) failed before serving on an enroot squash-import I/O error on the DSXE runner, not on the recipe.

Validation: `bash -n` on script and launcher, both YAMLs parse, changelog matrix and `generate_sweep_configs.py test-config --runner-config configs/runners.yaml` both yield the expected 5 throughput cells + 1 eval on `cluster:b300-dsxe`, launcher script-name construction resolves to `benchmarks/single_node/agentic/glm5.2_fp8_b300_sglang_mtp.sh`. `runners/` tests show the same 16 pre-existing `test_tilert_power_lifecycle.py` failures on `main`.

Recipes touched: `glm5.2-fp8-b300-sglang-agentic-mtp`

## Test plan
- [ ] full-sweep-fail-fast sweep passes on cluster:b300-dsxe (5 cells + eval).

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

基于当前 `main` 重建 #2884：B300 上首个 **GLM-5.2 FP8** AgentX（agentic-coding）配方 `glm5.2-fp8-b300-sglang-agentic-mtp`，为 `glm5.2-fp4-b300-sglang-agentic-mtp` 的 FP8 精度同级配方，也是 #2863 中 FP8 B200 配方的 B300 对应版本。配方、配置块与搜索空间与 #2884 相同，区别在于检查点的获取方式。

- **检查点已预先暂存。** `zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8` 现已与其他模型一样位于 DSXE 的标准暂存位置，因此 `runners/launch_b300-dsxe.sh` 将 `GLM-5.2-FP8` 加入 `STAGED_MODELS`（并添加 `glm-5.2-fp8` / `zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8` 别名），导出 `MODEL_PATH=/scratch/models/GLM-5.2-FP8`。启动器现有的 `config.json` 可读性探测会在分配到的节点上先行执行。
- **脚本不再下载。** 移除了 #2884 中基于 flock 串行化的 `hf download` 逻辑；脚本保留完整性校验（tokenizer、分片索引及索引列出的每个分片），若暂存目录不完整则立即报错退出，而不是向只读暂存根目录拉取约 756 GB。
- **服务参数与 #2884 保持一致：** TP8 低延迟分支、`--quantization fp8`、fp8_e4m3 KV、cutedsl bf16 GEMM、chunked-prefill 8192、`--mem-fraction-static 0.85`、每 rank 固定 270 GB HiCache 目标池、glm47 / glm45 解析器、EAGLE 3 步 / topk 1 / 4 草稿 token，黄金 AL 2.99。
- **镜像：** `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20260908-20ca564b`，首个包含 sgl-project/sglang#38318 的 nightly，与 #2863 相同。
- **搜索空间：** 与 NVFP4 B300 同级配方一致：单个 TP8 + HiCache 分支，并发 [1, 4, 8, 12, 16]，dram-utilization 0.80，运行于 `cluster:b300-dsxe`。
- #2884 唯一一次 sweep（运行 34179028866）在服务启动前因 DSXE 运行器上的 enroot squash 导入 I/O 错误失败，与配方无关。

验证：脚本与启动器 `bash -n` 通过，两个 YAML 可解析，changelog 矩阵与 `generate_sweep_configs.py test-config` 均生成预期的 5 个吞吐单元 + 1 个评测；`runners/` 测试中的 16 个失败在 `main` 上同样存在。

涉及配方：`glm5.2-fp8-b300-sglang-agentic-mtp`

测试计划：full-sweep-fail-fast sweep 在 cluster:b300-dsxe 上通过。

</details>

title: fix: use current target-branch CODEOWNERS / 使用目标分支最新 CODEOWNERS 修复签核
body:
#3109 still failed before verification because its recorded `base.sha` points to an old CODEOWNERS file containing the invalid `@InferenceX/core` team, even though `main` already corrected it. [Failed run](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35042859553).

Resolve the PR's current target branch through the trusted repository API, then pin both CODEOWNERS error validation and content reads to that one commit SHA. This lets existing PRs use corrected ownership without updating their branches. Retargeting a PR during scope resolution fails closed, as do branch lookup failures and invalid current ownership data. English and Chinese contributor guidance now describes this behavior.

Validation: 53 focused ownership/API tests pass; Ruff lint, formatting, and `git diff --check` pass. A read-only run against #3109's actual API data resolves the required owners successfully without modifying its branch.

Per maintainer instruction, merge with admin bypass without waiting for CI, then manually rerun #3109's sign-off verifier using the existing checklist.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

#3109 的签核流程仍在验证前失败：其记录的 `base.sha` 指向旧版 CODEOWNERS，其中包含无效的 `@InferenceX/core` 团队，尽管 `main` 已修正该引用。[失败的工作流](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35042859553)。

本次修复通过可信仓库 API 解析 PR 当前目标分支，并将 CODEOWNERS 错误校验和内容读取固定到同一提交 SHA。现有 PR 无需更新分支，即可使用已修正的归属规则。归属查询期间若 PR 更改目标分支，仍会阻止验证；目标分支查询失败或当前归属数据无效时也不会放行。同步更新中英文贡献指南。

验证：53 项归属及 API 测试全部通过；Ruff、格式检查和 `git diff --check` 均通过。使用 #3109 的真实 API 数据进行只读验证，已成功解析需要签核的 CODEOWNER，未修改其分支。

按维护者要求，使用管理员 bypass 直接合并，不等待 CI；随后使用 #3109 已有的检查清单重新触发签核验证。

</details>

title: fix: handle duplicate paths in sign-off checks / 修复签核检查对重复路径的处理
body:
PR #3109's sign-off verifier fails before producing a verdict because GitHub reports six changed paths but returns seven file entries: replacing a symlink with a regular file produces removed and added entries for the same path. [Failed verification](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35039610311/job/104616317390).

Compare the number of distinct `filename` values with `changed_files`, while retaining every entry for ownership checks, including `previous_filename`. Incomplete file lists still fail closed, including when duplicate entries make the raw count appear complete.

Validation:
- The three added regression cases fail before the fix and pass afterward: a type change within one page, one split across pages, and duplicates masking a missing path.
- `uv run --no-project --exclude-newer PT12H --python 3.12 --with pytest --with codeowners python -m pytest utils/test_signoff_scope.py utils/test_github.py -q`: 49 passed.
- Ruff lint and formatting checks pass for `infx/`; `git diff --check` passes.

After this lands on `main`, manually dispatch `codeowner-signoff-verify.yml` for #3109 using its existing checklist comment. The trusted workflow reads `main`, so #3109 does not need a branch update to receive this fix.

PR #3109 的签核验证在生成结论前失败：GitHub 报告了 6 个变更路径，但文件列表 API 返回 7 条记录，因为将符号链接替换为普通文件时，同一路径会分别出现删除和新增记录。[失败的验证任务](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35039610311/job/104616317390)。

验证：
- 新增的 3 个回归用例在修复前失败、修复后通过，覆盖同页文件类型变更、跨页重复路径，以及重复记录掩盖缺失路径的情况。

- `infx/` 的 Ruff 检查、格式检查及 `git diff --check` 均通过。

合入 `main` 后，使用 #3109 已有的检查清单评论手动触发 `codeowner-signoff-verify.yml`。可信工作流从 `main` 读取代码，因此 #3109 无需更新分支即可使用本修复。

title: Refresh DSV4 H200 AgentX with SGLang DSpark6
body:
[by Codex]
Refresh the H200 Dynamo+SGLang AgentX aggregate configuration for DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 using the 20260914 nightly, DSpark block size 6, and simulated acceptance length 3.77. The H200 launcher now serializes shared model staging and imports the selected SGLang image before SRT preflight.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Low Risk**
> Changes are confined to H200 AgentX benchmark recipes, perf changelog, and launcher staging—no application auth or production serving paths.
> 
> **Overview**
> Updates the **DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813** H200 AgentX aggregate lane to a newer **SGLang nightly**, **Dynamo router 1.5**, and **DSpark** speculative decoding (**K=6**, adjusted draft tokens/steps) instead of EAGLE/MTP-style settings. Benchmark simulation now uses **acceptance length 3.77** (was 2.49), and SGLang flags follow the rename to **`cuda-graph-max-bs-decode`**.
> 
> **`configs/nvidia-master.yaml`** pins the same model/image/router versions and switches the agentic search space from **`spec-decoding: mtp`** to **`draft_model`** so sweeps match the DSpark recipe.
> 
> **`launch_h200-dgxc-slurm.sh`** stages **`DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813`** into shared HF cache under a **file lock** (resumable download marker), validates the checkpoint before preflight, **imports/validates the SGLang squash** for DSV4 (same path as GLM-5.2), and sets an **8-hour default Slurm time limit** for DSV4 AgentX dynamo-sglang runs (replacing per-recipe `slurm.time_limit` removal).
>

title: fix: preserve Klaud baselines and fill candidate slots / 保留完整基线并补足候选
body:
Klaud could publish five unavailable 8k/1k baseline points even though the public API contained ten measured points, including 1k/1k. Baseline preparation now reconstructs the selected family at its original producer revisions, verifies legacy rows without fingerprints, and preserves the full roster. Unrelated sibling rows with incomplete provenance are ignored; matching current or historical points still require valid provenance. Final preflight and completion reject missing original points.

The overlap reviewer covers the entire shuffled candidate pool. Selection continues past duplicates, capacity losses and competing claims until five slots are filled or the pool is exhausted; an incomplete review is an error. Matrix verification compares complete schema-normalized settings, fixing false fingerprint failures from serialized defaults without accepting changed recipes.

Validation:

- Live public API and exact producer YAML: Qwen3.5/MI325X baseline returns **10/10 points with metrics**.
- **596 existing tests passed locally** across sign-off scope, eval batching, changelog, matrix generation/validation and reusable artifacts.
- **10 additional local behavioral checks passed** for unrelated missing/ambiguous/future-attempt provenance, feed ordering, and rejection of matching current/historical points with missing provenance. The temporary checks are not committed.
- Ruff and actionlint passed. Local zizmor reports only the existing low-severity self-repository syntax suggestion. No GPU jobs dispatched.

<details><summary>中文</summary>

公开 API 实际包含十个有指标的基线点（含 1k/1k），但 Klaud 曾只发布五个指标不可用的 8k/1k 点。现在按原始产出提交重建所选配置族，核实无指纹旧数据的来源，并保留完整清单。无关兄弟配置的数据行即使来源不完整也不会阻断准备；匹配当前或历史测试点的数据仍必须通过来源验证。最终预检和完成验证拒绝缺失原始基线点的结果。

重叠检查覆盖整个随机排序的候选池。遇到重复、容量变化或并发认领时继续寻找后续候选，直到补足五个名额或候选池耗尽；不完整检查明确报错。矩阵验证按相同 schema 比较完整设置，修复序列化默认值导致的指纹误判，同时仍拒绝实际 recipe 变更。

验证：真实公开 API 与原始 YAML 恢复十个有指标的点；596 项现有测试及 10 项新增本地行为检查通过，覆盖无关数据的来源异常、输入顺序以及当前和历史匹配点的来源校验。临时检查未提交。Ruff、actionlint 通过；zizmor 仅报告已有的低风险 self-repository 语法建议。未调度 GPU 作业。

</details>

title: fix: consolidate CI and scope CODEOWNER sign-off / 合并 CI 并按文件归属判断 CODEOWNER 签核
body:
CODEOWNER verification currently keys off `perf-changelog.yaml` rather than actual ownership, and `/reuse-sweep-run` acknowledgement writes can fail with HTTP 403 after successful validation.

- Replace four test workflows and the Ruff workflow with one `CI` workflow. Any `.py` change runs **Lint** and **Tests** in parallel using GitHub's native path filter. Manual dispatch runs both. Both jobs check out only the tested commit (`fetch-depth: 1`). No custom diff script or directory lists; changes only to non-Python files do not trigger Python CI.
- Keep automatic test discovery under `utils/`, `runners/`, and `experimental/CollectiveX/tests/`, four pytest workers, MCP compatibility checks, Python 3.12, CPU-only Torch, and the 12-hour dependency cooldown.
- Require sign-off when a changed file has an effective CODEOWNER other than a verified repository admin or `@SemiAnalysisAI/core`. title: [AMD][DSV4][Disagg] Enable UMBP, DP-attention tuning, FP4 sparse-attention indexer optimizing
body:
## Summary

Tunes the `dsv4-fp4-mi355x-sglang-disagg-agentic-hicache-mtp` (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-AgentX, MI355X, disaggregated, HiCache DRAM offload) recipe:

### DP-attention rework
- Gate DP-attention-only SGLang knobs (`SGLANG_SHARED_EXPERT_TP1`, `SGLANG_DP_SHARED_EXPERT_LOCAL`, `SGLANG_DP_USE_GATHERV`, `SGLANG_DP_USE_REDUCE_SCATTER`, wider `GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES`) behind `PREFILL_ENABLE_DP`/`DECODE_ENABLE_DP` in `env.sh`, instead of exporting them unconditionally, so TP-only arms keep `GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2`. Add `SGLANG_MORI_RECV_BOUND=1` for the disagg MoRI path.
- Round out `dp_flags` in `models.yaml` (`--tokenizer-worker-num 8`, `--enable-dp-attention-local-control-broadcast`, `--stream-interval 20`, , `enable_two_batch_overlap`) to mirror the single-node DP-attention recipe.
- Switch the active DP-attention search-space arm's decode side from `ep:8` to `ep:1` (DP-attention over TP-sharded MoE instead of expert-parallel dispatch).
- Widen `decode.dp.cuda_graph_bs_range` from `1-128` to `1-256` and the DP-attention arm's `conc-list` back to the full `[64, 96, 128, 192, 256]` sweep.

### FP4 sparse-attention indexer
- Bump the image from `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.18-rocm720-mi35x-20260831` to `...202609011`, the first tag carrying gfx95 (MI350X/MI355X) support for DeepSeek-V4's FP4 sparse-attention indexer via AITER kernels ([sglang PR #37353](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37353), merged 2026-09-02). Previously the flag was gated to NVIDIA SM100/SM120 only and hard-failed on AMD.
- Add `--enable-deepseek-v4-fp4-indexer` to `DeepSeek-V4-Pro-AgentX` `base_flags`. 
- Lower prefill/decode `mem_fraction_static` 0.90 -> 0.86 in DP case.

### Use umbp-linker as KV offload backend for high concurrencies (128, 192, 256)
Umbp linker helps to improve the tput  and reduce TTFT at high concurrency.


<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Touches disaggregated SGLang launch, KV offload paths, and benchmark concurrency limits; failures would show up as job timeouts or wrong throughput numbers rather than production user impact.
> 
> **Overview**
> Updates the MI355X disaggregated **DeepSeek-V4-Pro AgentX** recipe to **Pro-0813** on **sglang v0.5.19**, with **`--enable-deepseek-v4-fp4-indexer`** and refreshed DSv4 env/kernel routing (DP-attention knobs gated on role, `SGLANG_MORI_RECV_BOUND`, wildcard `DeepSeek-V4-Pro*` matching).
> 
> **KV offload:** Documents **HiCache** vs a new **`umbp-linker`** path (separate from HiCache; prefill-only, DP-attention required). Adds recipe/Slurm env for UMBP, **`umbp_standalone_server`** startup with multi-stage readiness waits, linker flag auto-detection, and configurable **`CONTAINER_BARRIER_TIMEOUT`**. HiCache default **`HICACHE_RATIO`** is **2.5** (was 3). High-concurrency sweep arms use UMBP linker instead of HiCache.
> 
> **Harness / models:** `models.yaml` AgentX entry scales **`max_running_requests`** and CUDA-graph ranges with **`BENCH_MAX_CONC_VALUE`**, per-DP/no-DP **`mem_fraction_static`**, updated flags (shared-expert fusion, DP broadcast), and **`DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813-AgentX`** alias. `server_sglang.sh` evaluates YAML formulas for graph ranges, caps decode concurrency by graph×TP, uses role-specific mem fractions, drops **`--prefill-round-robin-balance`**, and wires **Pro-0813** synthetic MTP golden AL (**3.01** for 3-step). **`amd-master.yaml`** expands the sweep (TP4/TP8, HiCache at 32/48, UMBP+DP at 128/192/256).
>

## Summary
Day-zero **GLM-5.2 FP8** AgentX (agentic-coding) recipe on **MI355X** with SGLang native EAGLE/MTP: `glm5.2-fp8-mi355x-sglang-agentic-mtp`, the FP8 precision sibling of `glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-sglang-agentic-mtp`.
