title: fix: harden pipeline edge cases and retain sign-off across admin updates / 修复流水线边界问题并在管理员更新后保留签核
body:
## Description

Fix pipeline failures exposed by local fuzzing and recover CODEOWNER sign-offs missed during merge conflicts. Pipeline behavior for valid inputs is preserved in the covered cases. Sign-off retention intentionally changes: admin updates are transparent to existing approval, while non-admin changes require fresh verification.

- Validate malformed config and power inputs without uncaught overflow/type errors or allocations based on untrusted node counts. Preserve unusual Git paths when loading historical generation inputs.
- Handle whitespace-only AgentX errors, normalize SGLang rank whitespace, ignore negative trace-turn indices, and replace repeated QPS scans with binary searches while preserving window boundaries and reported statistics.
- Quote multinode result filenames and keep a `/reuse-sweep-run` run ID on the command's physical line. Handle Darwin process-group cleanup without hiding permission errors for live processes.
- Recover the latest eligible existing CODEOWNER checklist before its first successful verification. Afterward, retain approval across authenticated repository-admin updates from a covered head, without calling Claude. Non-admin updates invalidate approval; a later admin push cannot clear an unreviewed non-admin change. Track assessed and covered SHAs in the trusted verdict, retire the lifetime-PASS label, and require fresh verification when update provenance is missing. Commit author names do not grant the admin exemption.
- Keep concrete regression tests for the fixes. Remove source inspections, copied policy predicates, smoke-only checks, and duplicate cases; shorten mocked waits while retaining real process and artifact checks. Exclude transient `__pycache__` files from test checkout copies to avoid the observed copy race.

## Related Issue

Investigated the intermittent test failure associated with #3021 and the missed review-summary sign-off on #3081. No recipe changes are included.

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Configuration change
- [x] Documentation update
- [x] Other: test cleanup

## Validation

- Final local suite after merging `main`: **1,801 passed, 6 skipped, 171 subtests passed in 21.28 seconds**, Python 3.12 with four workers. The skips require Torch.
- All 176 focused workflow tests pass, including repeated and delayed admin updates, pending collaborator changes, spoofed actors, admin reruns, malformed roles, and pushes during verification.
- Local fuzz campaigns and before/after comparisons found no remaining failures on the covered inputs. The fuzzing harness is not included in this PR.
- Workflow syntax validation, Node syntax checking, and `git diff --check` passed. Full Actionlint/ShellCheck reports three pre-existing diagnostics in the multinode workflow and no new diagnostics.
- Hosted CI on `8f8edc9e4`: all six active checks passed; three conditional checks were skipped. Live execution of the new GitHub verifier policy and GPU/Slurm execution have not been validated. Local tests use controlled external collaborators; they do not prove every possible input or hosted event sequence.

Benchmark recipes, serving arguments, and `perf-changelog.yaml` are unchanged. Runtime optimizations are in result processing and configuration loading, outside the measured benchmark workload.

## Checklist

- [x] I have tested my changes locally
- [x] I have updated documentation if necessary
- [ ] **For every change that can affect benchmark performance and every recipe addition or modification, I have appended a new entry to the physical end of `perf-changelog.yaml` and have not edited historical entries** — Not applicable: no measured-workload or recipe changes.
- [ ] **Before merging via reuse, an authorized maintainer (`OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`) has commented `/reuse-sweep-run` on this PR**. Do this **only once there is a final full sweep that is all green with evals passing**, since after this comment the sweep label will no longer automatically kick off new sweeps. Remove and re-add the label to force one.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

修复本地模糊测试发现的流水线问题，并补验因合并冲突而遗漏的 CODEOWNER 签核。在已覆盖的测试用例中，流水线对有效输入的行为保持一致。签核保留规则有意调整：管理员更新不影响已有批准，非管理员改动则需要重新验证。

- 对异常配置与功耗输入进行校验，避免未捕获的溢出或类型错误，以及根据不可信节点数量分配大量内存。读取历史版本的配置生成输入时，正确保留特殊 Git 路径。
- 处理仅包含空白字符的 AgentX 错误，规范化 SGLang rank 标记中的空白，忽略负数 trace-turn 索引，并用二分查找替代重复的 QPS 扫描，保持窗口边界与统计结果不变。
- 为多节点结果文件名添加正确的引用，限制 `/reuse-sweep-run` 的 run ID 必须位于命令所在行。修复 Darwin 进程组清理，同时保留对存活进程的权限错误。
- 首次验证成功前，补验最新的合格 CODEOWNER 检查清单。此后，经认证的仓库管理员从已覆盖 head 推送更新时保留批准，无需调用 Claude。非管理员更新会使批准失效，随后由管理员推送也不能消除尚未审阅的非管理员改动。可信裁定记录已验证和已覆盖的 SHA，停用终身有效的 PASS 标签，并在缺少更新来源信息时要求重新验证。提交中的作者姓名不能获得管理员豁免。
- 保留针对修复的具体回归测试。删除源码检查、复制生产判断逻辑的测试、仅作冒烟检查的测试及重复用例；缩短模拟等待，同时保留真实进程和产物检查。复制测试工作目录时忽略临时 `__pycache__` 文件，避免已观察到的复制竞态。

相关背景为 #3021 的间歇性测试失败，以及 #3081 中遗漏的 review summary 签核。本 PR 包含缺陷修复、文档更新和测试整理，不修改配方。

最终本地测试数量、耗时和跳过情况见上方 Validation：六个跳过项需要 Torch。176 项专项工作流测试全部通过，覆盖连续或延迟的管理员更新、尚未审阅的协作者改动、冒充触发者、管理员重跑他人事件、异常角色信息及验证期间的新推送。本地模糊测试和前后行为对比在覆盖范围内没有发现剩余失败；本 PR 不包含模糊测试框架。

工作流语法、Node 语法及差异空白检查通过。完整 Actionlint/ShellCheck 仍报告多节点工作流中已有的三个问题，没有新增诊断。`8f8edc9e4` 的托管 CI 中，六项实际运行的检查全部通过，三项条件检查跳过。新的 GitHub 签核规则尚未在真实环境中执行验证，也未进行 GPU/Slurm 运行；本地测试使用受控的外部依赖，不能证明所有可能输入或托管事件顺序。

基准测试配方、推理启动参数和 `perf-changelog.yaml` 均未修改。性能优化仅涉及结果处理与配置加载，位于基准测试计量范围之外，因此不适用性能变更日志要求。共用检查清单已在上方填写；未请求复用。

</details>

title: Update B200 MiniMax-M3 vLLM and remove the KV offload patch
body:
## Summary

Update `minimaxm3-fp4-b200-vllm-agentic-mtp` to `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-cd10ed6f9f6b37a8ace9cf380007e66fe12ec0c3`, remove its runtime offload patch call, and delete `runners/patch_vllm_simple_kv_offload.py` and its tests.

This PR contains only the B200 image/script update and the shared helper deletion; it does not include the other GPU's update. No documentation changes.

The image includes [vLLM #54756](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54756), which correctly registers mixed-size KV-cache regions. Latest stable v0.29.0 still contains the bug, so this uses the latest published regular nightly checked on September 15. Registry revision labels match the commit; AMD64 manifest is `sha256:0a329f66a92e19ad8c8e9b9a17bda6ecf70b1a8dcfd9c735360a251ce870d0d8`.

## Merge coordination

Companion PR: #3132. Both independently delete the same shared helper, as requested. Merging either PR alone leaves the other GPU's old offload script referencing the deleted file until its companion merges. Coordinate both merges; do not run that remaining old offload path between them. Each PR's changelog selects only its own GPU.

## Validation

- Bash syntax and `git diff --check` passed.
- Strict config generation passed for all 15 B200 points; compared with base, only the image changes.
- `runners/test_slurm_utils.py`: 27 passed after deleting the helper's tests.
- Historical changelog bytes preserved; changelog-driven matrix generation passed.
- Exact image revision checked for the offload fix and existing MiniMax-M3/EAGLE3 serving options.
- GPU full sweep and evals requested with `full-sweep-enabled`; results pending.
